`src/app/CliProcesses.cpp`:

```cpp
// WireScope - Command line: programs using the network (socket tables, traffic totals) and the trust
// check of a program file. English only: scripts parse this output.
#include "app/CliDetail.h"
#include "core/ProcessMapper.h"
#include "core/ProcessTrust.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <format>
#include <map>

namespace WS::Cli {

namespace {

std::string SignatureText(const TrustReport& t) {
    const std::string signer = ToUtf8(t.signer);
    switch (t.signature) {
    case Signature::Signed: return signer.empty() ? "signed" : "signed: " + signer;
    case Signature::Package: return signer.empty() ? "app package" : "app package: " + signer;
    case Signature::Unsigned: return "not signed";
    case Signature::Invalid: return "signature does not verify";
    case Signature::Unknown: return "file cannot be read";
    case Signature::Pending: break;
    }
    return "not checked";
}

std::string Reasons(uint32_t flags) {
    std::string out;
    auto add = [&](uint32_t flag, const char* text) {
        if (!(flags & flag)) return;
        if (!out.empty()) out += ", ";
        out += text;
    };
    add(TrustFlag::Imitation, "named like a Windows component outside the Windows folder");
    add(TrustFlag::Hidden, "hidden or system file");
    add(TrustFlag::UserFolder, "in a folder any program can write to");
    return out;
}

std::string RiskMark(const Console& con, Risk risk) {
    switch (risk) {
    case Risk::High: return con.Red() + con.Bold() + "[!]" + con.Reset();
    case Risk::Notice: return con.Yellow() + "[?]" + con.Reset();
    case Risk::None: break;
    }
    return "   ";
}

std::string Label(const ProcessInfo* p) {
    if (!p) return "(no process: ARP, ICMP, closed ports, TIME_WAIT)";
    return std::format("{} (pid {})", p->label, p->pid);
}

}  // namespace

int TrustFile(const Console& con, const std::wstring& path) {
    const TrustReport t = ProcessTrust::Verify(path);
    const Risk risk = t.risk();
    con.WriteLine(std::format("{} {}", RiskMark(con, risk), ToUtf8(path)));
    con.WriteLine(std::format("    Signature:  {}", SignatureText(t)));
    if (const std::string reasons = Reasons(t.flags); !reasons.empty()) con.WriteLine(std::format("    Location:   {}", reasons));
    const char* verdict = risk == Risk::High ? "suspicious: unsigned or altered code where it does not belong"
                          : risk == Risk::Notice ? "worth a look"
                                                 : "no concern";
    con.WriteLine(std::format("    Verdict:    {}{}{}", risk == Risk::High ? con.Red() : risk == Risk::Notice ? con.Yellow() : con.Green(), verdict,
                              con.Reset()));
    return risk == Risk::High ? 14 : risk == Risk::Notice ? 13 : 0;
}

int ListProcesses(const Console& con) {
    const auto snapshot = ProcessMapper::Instance().Current();
    std::vector<uint32_t> sockets(snapshot->processes.size(), 0);
    for (const Endpoint& e : snapshot->endpoints) ++sockets[e.process];
    std::vector<size_t> order(snapshot->processes.size());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < order.size(); ++i) order[i] = i;
    std::ranges::sort(order, [&](size_t a, size_t b) {
        const auto& pa = *snapshot->processes[a];
        const auto& pb = *snapshot->processes[b];
        return pa.name != pb.name ? pa.name < pb.name : pa.pid < pb.pid;
    });

    con.WriteLine(std::format("{}Programs with network sockets: {}{}", con.Bold(), order.size(), con.Reset()));
    con.WriteLine(std::format("{}        PID  SOCKETS  SIGNATURE                                 PROGRAM{}", con.Dim(), con.Reset()));
    std::map<std::wstring, TrustReport> verified;  // one verification per file
    int suspicious = 0;
    for (const size_t i : order) {
        const ProcessInfo& p = *snapshot->processes[i];
        TrustReport t{Signature::Unknown};
        if (!p.path.empty()) {
            auto [it, inserted] = verified.try_emplace(p.path);
            if (inserted) it->second = ProcessTrust::Verify(p.path);
            t = it->second;
        }
        if (t.risk() == Risk::High) ++suspicious;
        std::string signature = SignatureText(t);
        if (signature.size() > 40) signature = signature.substr(0, 39) + "~";
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{} {:>7}  {:>7}  {:<40}  {}", RiskMark(con, t.risk()), p.pid, sockets[i], signature,
                                  p.path.empty() ? p.label : ToUtf8(p.path)));
        if (t.risk() != Risk::None) {
            if (const std::string reasons = Reasons(t.flags); !reasons.empty()) {
                con.WriteLine(std::format("{}                                                              {}{}", con.Dim(), reasons, con.Reset()));
            }
        }
    }
    if (suspicious) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[!] {} program(s) look suspicious. WireScope.exe --trust <file> explains one file.{}", con.Red(), suspicious,
                                  con.Reset()));
    }
    con.WriteLine(std::format("{}    Traffic per program: WireScope.exe --processes --duration <seconds>{}", con.Dim(), con.Reset()));
    return suspicious ? 14 : 0;
}

void PrintProcessTraffic(const Console& con, std::vector<ProcessTraffic> totals) {
    auto bytes = [](const ProcessTraffic& t) { return t.total.bytesIn + t.total.bytesOut; };
    std::ranges::sort(totals, [&](const ProcessTraffic& a, const ProcessTraffic& b) { return bytes(a) > bytes(b); });
    con.WriteLine();
    con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[+] Traffic per program: {}{}", con.Bold(), totals.size(), con.Reset()));
    con.WriteLine(std::format("{}      RECEIVED        SENT     PACKETS  PROGRAM{}", con.Dim(), con.Reset()));
    constexpr size_t kShown = 30;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < totals.size() && i < kShown; ++i) {
        const ProcessTraffic& t = totals[i];
        con.WriteLine(std::format("  {:>12}  {:>10}  {:>10}  {}", ToUtf8(FormatBytes(t.total.bytesIn)), ToUtf8(FormatBytes(t.total.bytesOut)),
                                  ToUtf8(FormatCount(t.total.packetsIn + t.total.packetsOut)), Label(t.process.get())));
    }
    if (totals.size() > kShown) con.WriteLine(std::format("{}  ... and {} more{}", con.Dim(), totals.size() - kShown, con.Reset()));
}

}  // namespace WS::Cli
```

`src/app/CliSession.cpp`:

```cpp
// WireScope - Command line: one session of capture, firewall and simulator.
#include "app/CliDetail.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <atomic>
#include <format>

namespace WS::Cli {

namespace {

std::atomic<bool> g_stopRequested{false};
HANDLE g_cleanupDone = nullptr;  // set once the session has restored the network

BOOL WINAPI CtrlHandler(DWORD fdwCtrlType) {
    switch (fdwCtrlType) {
    case CTRL_C_EVENT:
    case CTRL_BREAK_EVENT:
        g_stopRequested = true;
        return TRUE;
    case CTRL_CLOSE_EVENT:
    case CTRL_LOGOFF_EVENT:
    case CTRL_SHUTDOWN_EVENT:
        // The process ends when this handler returns: give the main thread time to restore the
        // adapter mode and the filter table first.
        g_stopRequested = true;
        if (g_cleanupDone) WaitForSingleObject(g_cleanupDone, 4000);
        return TRUE;
    default:
        return FALSE;
    }
}

std::string GetProtocolColor(const Console& con, ProtocolType proto) {
    switch (proto) {
    case ProtocolType::DNS:  return con.Cyan() + con.Bold();
    case ProtocolType::TLS:  return con.Yellow() + con.Bold();
    case ProtocolType::TCP:  return con.Green();
    case ProtocolType::UDP:  return con.Blue();
    case ProtocolType::ICMP: return con.Red() + con.Bold();
    case ProtocolType::ARP:  return con.Magenta();
    default:                 return con.Dim();
    }
}

std::string Count(uint64_t n) {
    return ToUtf8(FormatCount(n));
}

std::string SessionStatus(TrafficController& ctl, const Options& o) {
    std::string line;
    if (o.firewall) {
        const auto fw = ctl.PollFirewall();
        uint64_t blocked = 0, allowed = 0;
        for (const Rule& r : ctl.Rules()) {
            const auto it = fw.rules.find(r.id);
            if (it == fw.rules.end()) continue;
            (r.action == RuleAction::Block ? blocked : allowed) += it->second.packets;
        }
        (ctl.Policy() == RuleAction::Block ? blocked : allowed) += fw.policy.packets;
        line += std::format("[firewall] {} rules · blocked {} · allowed {}", ctl.Rules().size(), Count(blocked), Count(allowed));
    }
    if (o.impair) {
        const auto s = ctl.Engine().GetStats();
        const double lossShare = s.SimSelected ? 100.0 * static_cast<double>(s.SimDropped + s.SimOverflow) / static_cast<double>(s.SimSelected) : 0.0;
        const double avgMs = s.SimDelayed ? static_cast<double>(s.SimDelaySumUs) / static_cast<double>(s.SimDelayed) / 1000.0 : 0.0;
        if (!line.empty()) line += "   ";
        line += std::format("[simulator] matched {} · delayed {} (avg +{:.1f} ms) · dropped {} ({:.1f} %) · in flight {}",
                            Count(s.SimSelected), Count(s.SimDelayed), avgMs, Count(s.SimDropped + s.SimOverflow), lossShare,
                            s.SimInFlight);
    }
    const auto s = ctl.Engine().GetStats();
    if (!line.empty()) line += "   ";
    line += std::format("[engine] read {} · re-injected {}", Count(s.TotalPackets), Count(s.Reinjected));
    return line;
}

} // namespace

int RunSession(const Console& con, const Options& o, std::vector<Rule> rules, DriverBridge& bridge, TrafficController& controller) {
    // --- Session ---------------------------------------------------------------
    auto adaptersRes = bridge.QueryAdapters();
    if (!adaptersRes || adaptersRes->empty()) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[-] No network adapters found.{}", con.Red(), con.Reset()));
        return 4;
    }
    uint32_t adapterIdx = 0;
    if (o.adapter) {
        adapterIdx = *o.adapter;
    } else {
        for (const auto& a : *adaptersRes) {
            if (a.HasGateway) {
                adapterIdx = a.Index;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if (adapterIdx >= adaptersRes->size()) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[-] Invalid adapter index {}. Available: 0..{}{}",
                                  con.Red(), adapterIdx, adaptersRes->size() - 1, con.Reset()));
        return 5;
    }
    const auto& adapter = (*adaptersRes)[adapterIdx];

    if (!controller.CanControl() && (o.firewall || o.impair)) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[-] Another WireScope instance controls the firewall and simulator. Close it first.{}", con.Red(), con.Reset()));
        return 10;
    }
    TrafficController& ctl = controller;
    if (auto r = ctl.SetAdapter(adapter.Handle); !r) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[-] {}{}", con.Red(), ToUtf8(r.error()), con.Reset()));
        return 5;
    }

    Handle cleanupDone(CreateEventW(nullptr, TRUE, FALSE, nullptr));
    g_cleanupDone = cleanupDone.get();
    g_stopRequested = false;
    SetConsoleCtrlHandler(CtrlHandler, TRUE);
    const ScopeExit restore([&] {
        ctl.Shutdown();
        SetEvent(cleanupDone.get());
    });

    auto failSession = [&](const std::wstring& error, int code) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[-] {}{}", con.Red(), ToUtf8(error), con.Reset()));
        return code;
    };

    con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[*] Adapter [{}] {} ({}){}", con.Cyan(), adapter.Index, adapter.FriendlyName, adapter.MacAddress, con.Reset()));

    if (o.firewall) {
        if (o.kernelFilters) {
            if (auto r = ctl.SetKernelOffload(true); !r) return failSession(r.error(), 7);
        }
        if (auto foreign = ctl.ForeignFilterCount(); foreign && *foreign > 0) {
            con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[!] The driver holds {} static filters of another application; they are kept and restored.{}",
                                      con.Yellow(), *foreign, con.Reset()));
        }
        WarnLockout(con, rules, o.policy);
        if (auto r = ctl.SetRules(std::move(rules)); !r) return failSession(r.error(), 7);
        if (auto r = ctl.SetPolicy(o.policy); !r) return failSession(r.error(), 7);
        if (auto r = ctl.SetFirewall(true); !r) return failSession(r.error(), 7);
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[+] Firewall active: {} rules, default policy {}, enforced by {}{}", con.Green(), ctl.Rules().size(),
                                  o.policy == RuleAction::Allow ? "allow" : "block",
                                  ctl.KernelOffload() ? "the driver's static filter table and the engine" : "the WireScope engine",
                                  con.Reset()));
        for (const Rule& r : ctl.Rules()) {
            con.WriteLine(std::format("      {}{:<6}{} {}", r.action == RuleAction::Block ? con.Red() : con.Green(),
                                      r.action == RuleAction::Block ? "block" : "allow", con.Reset(), r.text));
        }
    }

    if (o.impair) {
        if (auto r = ctl.SetImpairment(o.impairment); !r) return failSession(r.error(), 9);
        const auto& p = o.impairment;
        std::string rateStr;
        if (p.rateKbps > 0) rateStr = std::format(", rate {} kbps", p.rateKbps);
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[+] Simulator active: latency {} ms, jitter ±{} ms, loss {:.1f} %{}{}, {}{}", con.Green(),
                                  p.latencyMs, p.jitterMs, p.lossPercent, rateStr,
                                  p.dir == Dir::In ? ", inbound" : p.dir == Dir::Out ? ", outbound" : ", both directions",
                                  p.match.empty() ? std::string() : ", match: " + p.match, con.Reset()));
        if (!ctl.Engine().GetStats().HighResolutionTimer) {
            con.WriteLine(std::format("{}    High-resolution timer unavailable: delays are rounded to ~16 ms.{}", con.Dim(), con.Reset()));
        }
    }

    const std::string filterUtf8 = ToUtf8(o.filter);
    if (o.sniff) {
        if (!o.pcap.empty()) {
            if (ctl.Engine().StartPcap(o.pcap)) {
                con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[+] Recording to PCAP: {}{}", con.Green(), ToUtf8(o.pcap), con.Reset()));
            } else {
                con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[-] Failed to create PCAP file {}{}", con.Yellow(), ToUtf8(o.pcap), con.Reset()));
            }
        }
        ctl.Engine().SetPacketCallback([&con, &filterUtf8](const DecodedPacket& pkt) {
            if (!filterUtf8.empty()) {
                const bool matches = ContainsIgnoreCase(pkt.ProtocolName, filterUtf8) ||
                                     ContainsIgnoreCase(pkt.Source, filterUtf8) ||
                                     ContainsIgnoreCase(pkt.Destination, filterUtf8) ||
                                     ContainsIgnoreCase(pkt.DomainOrHost, filterUtf8) ||
                                     ContainsIgnoreCase(pkt.Info, filterUtf8) ||
                                     ContainsIgnoreCase(pkt.Process, filterUtf8);
                if (!matches) return;
            }

            const std::string protoColor = GetProtocolColor(con, pkt.Protocol);
            const char* dirStr = (pkt.Dir == Direction::Outbound) ? "OUT" : "IN ";
            std::string fate;
            switch (pkt.Fate) {
            case PacketFate::Delayed: fate = std::format(" {}+{} ms{}", con.Yellow(), (pkt.DelayUs + 500) / 1000, con.Reset()); break;
            case PacketFate::Dropped: fate = std::format(" {}[sim drop]{}", con.Red(), con.Reset()); break;
            case PacketFate::Blocked: fate = std::format(" {}[firewall]{}", con.Red(), con.Reset()); break;
            case PacketFate::Killed: fate = std::format(" {}[kill switch]{}", con.Red(), con.Reset()); break;
            default: break;
            }
            std::string procStr;
            if (!pkt.Process.empty()) procStr = std::format(" [{}]", pkt.Process);
            con.WriteLine(std::format("{:6d} [{}] {}{:<6}{}| {:>21} -> {:<21} | {:4d}B | {}{}{}",
                                      pkt.Index, dirStr, protoColor, pkt.ProtocolName, con.Reset(),
                                      pkt.Source, pkt.Destination, pkt.Length, pkt.Info, procStr, fate));
        });
        if (auto r = ctl.SetCapture(true); !r) return failSession(L"Failed to start the capture: " + r.error(), 6);
    }
    if (o.processes) {
        if (auto r = ctl.SetMonitor(true); !r) return failSession(L"Failed to count traffic per program: " + r.error(), 6);
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[+] Counting traffic per program from copies of the packets (traffic is not changed){}", con.Green(),
                                  con.Reset()));
    }

    con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[*] Running. Press Ctrl+C to stop and restore the network...{}\r\n", con.Dim(), con.Reset()));

    const uint64_t started = GetTickCount64();
    uint64_t lastStatus = started;
    const bool liveLine = !o.sniff && con.SupportsAnsi();
    while (!g_stopRequested) {
        Sleep(100);
        const uint64_t now = GetTickCount64();
        if (o.duration && now - started >= static_cast<uint64_t>(o.duration) * 1000) break;
        if (o.sniff && o.count > 0 && ctl.Engine().GetStats().TotalPackets >= o.count) break;
        if (!o.sniff && (o.firewall || o.impair)) {
            if (liveLine && now - lastStatus >= 1000) {
                con.Write("\r" + SessionStatus(ctl, o) + "\033[K");
                lastStatus = now;
            } else if (!liveLine && now - lastStatus >= 5000) {
                con.WriteLine(SessionStatus(ctl, o));
                lastStatus = now;
            }
        }
    }
    if (liveLine) con.WriteLine();

    const std::string status = (o.firewall || o.impair) ? SessionStatus(ctl, o) : std::string();
    const auto stats = ctl.Engine().GetStats();
    auto traffic = o.processes ? ctl.Engine().ProcessTotals() : std::vector<ProcessTraffic>();
    ctl.Shutdown();
    SetEvent(cleanupDone.get());

    con.WriteLine();
    con.WriteLine(std::format("{}{}[+] Session ended, network restored.{}", con.Green(), con.Bold(), con.Reset()));
    if (!status.empty()) con.WriteLine("    " + status);
    if (o.sniff) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("    Captured {} packets ({})", stats.TotalPackets, ToUtf8(FormatBytes(stats.TotalBytes))));
        if (stats.DnsQueries > 0) con.WriteLine(std::format("    DNS Queries: {}", stats.DnsQueries));
        if (stats.TcpPackets > 0) con.WriteLine(std::format("    TCP Packets: {}", stats.TcpPackets));
        if (stats.UdpPackets > 0) con.WriteLine(std::format("    UDP Packets: {}", stats.UdpPackets));
        if (stats.IcmpPackets > 0) con.WriteLine(std::format("    ICMP Packets: {}", stats.IcmpPackets));
    }
    if (stats.SendErrors > 0) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}    Re-injection errors: {}{}", con.Yellow(), stats.SendErrors, con.Reset()));
    }
    if (o.processes) PrintProcessTraffic(con, std::move(traffic));
    return 0;
}

} // namespace WS::Cli
```

```cpp
// WireScope - Command line: information, driver diagnostics and the translator tools.
#include "app/CliDetail.h"
#include "core/FilterAbi.h"
#include "core/Safety.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <format>

namespace WS::Cli {

int ShowInfo(const Console& con, DriverBridge& bridge) {
    auto verRes = bridge.GetVersion();
    con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[+] Successfully connected to driver: {}{}", con.Green(), ToUtf8(bridge.DevicePath()), con.Reset()));
    if (verRes) {
        const DWORD v = verRes.value();
        con.WriteLine(std::format("    Engine version: {}.{}.{} (0x{:08X})", (v >> 16) & 0xFF, (v >> 8) & 0xFF, v & 0xFF, v));
    }
    if (auto filters = bridge.GetStaticFilterCount()) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("    Static filters: supported, {} entries in the table", *filters));
    } else {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("    Static filters: {}", ToUtf8(filters.error())));
    }
    return 0;
}

int ListAdapters(const Console& con, DriverBridge& bridge) {
    auto adaptersRes = bridge.QueryAdapters();
    if (!adaptersRes) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[-] Failed to query adapters: {}{}", con.Red(), ToUtf8(adaptersRes.error()), con.Reset()));
        return 3;
    }

    const auto& adapters = adaptersRes.value();
    con.WriteLine(std::format("{}{}[+] Discovered {} Network Adapters:{}{}", con.Green(), con.Bold(), adapters.size(), con.Reset(), con.Reset()));
    con.WriteLine();

    for (const auto& a : adapters) {
        std::string statusTag;
        if (a.HasGateway) {
            statusTag = std::format(" {}{}[ACTIVE - Default Gateway]{}", con.Green(), con.Bold(), con.Reset());
        } else if (a.IsUp) {
            statusTag = std::format(" {}{}[LINK UP]{}", con.Cyan(), con.Dim(), con.Reset());
        }

        con.WriteLine(std::format("  [{}] {}{}{}{}", a.Index, con.Bold(), a.FriendlyName, con.Reset(), statusTag));
        con.WriteLine(std::format("      MAC Address:  {}", a.MacAddress));
        con.WriteLine(std::format("      MTU:          {}", a.MTU));
        con.WriteLine(std::format("      Kernel Handle: 0x{:X}", reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(a.Handle)));
        con.WriteLine(std::format("      System Name:  {}{}{}", con.Dim(), a.SystemName, con.Reset()));
        con.WriteLine();
    }
    return 0;
}

int ResetFilters(const Console& con, DriverBridge& bridge, bool force) {
    auto count = bridge.GetStaticFilterCount();
    if (!count) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[-] {}{}", con.Red(), ToUtf8(count.error()), con.Reset()));
        return 7;
    }
    if (*count > 0 && !force) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[!] The driver holds {} static filters, possibly from other applications.{}", con.Yellow(), *count, con.Reset()));
        con.WriteLine("    Add --force to remove them all.");
        return 8;
    }
    if (auto r = bridge.ResetStaticFilters(); !r) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[-] {}{}", con.Red(), ToUtf8(r.error()), con.Reset()));
        return 7;
    }
    con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[+] Static filter table cleared ({} entries removed).{}", con.Green(), *count, con.Reset()));
    return 0;
}

int ShowFilterTable(const Console& con, DriverBridge& bridge) {
    auto count = bridge.GetStaticFilterCount();
    if (!count) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[-] {}{}", con.Red(), ToUtf8(count.error()), con.Reset()));
        return 7;
    }
    con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[+] Driver static filter table: {} entries{}", con.Green(), *count, con.Reset()));
    auto table = bridge.ReadStaticFilters();
    if (!table) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[-] {}{}", con.Red(), ToUtf8(table.error()), con.Reset()));
        return 7;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < table->size(); ++i) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("  {:3}  {}", i + 1, DescribeFilter((*table)[i])));
    }
    return 0;
}

// Proves the STATIC_FILTER layout against the driver: writes PASS entries for documentation-only
// address ranges (RFC 5737 / RFC 3849, never routed), reads them back field by field, then puts the
// previous table back. PASS only skips user-mode processing, so the test cannot block anything.
int FilterSelfTest(const Console& con, DriverBridge& bridge, bool force) {
    auto before = bridge.ReadStaticFilters();
    if (!before) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[-] {}{}", con.Red(), ToUtf8(before.error()), con.Reset()));
        return 7;
    }
    if (!before->empty() && !force) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[!] The driver holds {} static filters; the self-test would replace them for a moment.{}",
                                  con.Yellow(), before->size(), con.Reset()));
        con.WriteLine("    Add --force to run it anyway (the table is restored afterwards).");
        return 8;
    }
    std::vector<STATIC_FILTER> probe;
    for (const char* text : {"ip4 udp to 203.0.113.0/24 dport 9", "out ip6 tcp to 2001:db8::/32 sport 7-9",
                             "in icmp type 8 from 198.51.100.7", "out ip4 from 192.0.2.10-192.0.2.13"}) {
        auto selector = ParseSelector(text);
        auto entries = selector ? Compile(*selector, FILTER_ACTION_PASS, nullptr)
                                : std::expected<std::vector<STATIC_FILTER>, std::string>(std::unexpected(selector.error()));
        if (!entries) {
            con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[-] Self-test selector \"{}\": {}{}", con.Red(), text, entries.error(), con.Reset()));
            return 1;
        }
        probe.insert(probe.end(), entries->begin(), entries->end());
    }
    const auto written = bridge.WriteStaticFilters(probe);
    const auto restored = bridge.WriteStaticFilters(*before);
    if (!written) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[-] Self-test failed: {}{}", con.Red(), ToUtf8(written.error()), con.Reset()));
        // Show where the driver's layout differs, for diagnosing other driver builds.
        if (auto raw = bridge.StaticFilterRoundTrip(std::span(probe).first(1)); raw) {
            const auto& [sent, back] = *raw;
            con.WriteLine("    offset  sent                                              read back");
            for (size_t at = 0; at < sent.size(); at += 16) {
                std::string a, b;
                bool differs = false;
                for (size_t i = at; i < at + 16 && i < sent.size(); ++i) {
                    a += std::format("{:02X} ", sent[i]);
                    b += std::format("{:02X} ", back[i]);
                    differs |= sent[i] != back[i];
                }
                con.WriteLine(std::format("    {}{:04X}    {:<48}  {}{}", differs ? con.Yellow() : "", at, a, b, differs ? con.Reset() : ""));
            }
        }
        (void)bridge.WriteStaticFilters(*before);
        return 7;
    }
    con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[+] Static filter layout verified: {} entries written and read back identically{}", con.Green(),
                              probe.size(), con.Reset()));
    con.WriteLine(std::format("    ({}-byte table header, {} bytes per STATIC_FILTER)", sizeof(STATIC_FILTER_TABLE_HEADER),
                              sizeof(STATIC_FILTER)));
    if (!restored) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[!] Restoring the previous table failed: {}{}", con.Yellow(), ToUtf8(restored.error()), con.Reset()));
        return 7;
    }
    con.WriteLine(std::format("    Previous table restored ({} entries).", before->size()));
    return 0;
}

void WarnLockout(const Console& con, const std::vector<Rule>& rules, RuleAction policy) {
    const auto risks = LockoutRisks(rules, policy);
    if (risks.empty()) return;
    con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[!] These rules block {}.{}", con.Yellow(), ToUtf8(DescribeRisks(risks)), con.Reset()));
    for (const auto& r : risks) {
        if (r.rule) con.WriteLine(std::format("    {}: {}", ToUtf8(Text::Get(r.name)), RuleText(*r.rule)));
        else con.WriteLine(std::format("    {}: the default policy (block)", ToUtf8(Text::Get(r.name))));
    }
}

int CheckRules(const Console& con, const Options& o, const std::vector<Rule>& rules) {
    con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[+] Nothing was applied: --check only explains the configuration.{}", con.Green(), con.Reset()));
    if (o.firewall) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("Firewall: {} rules, default policy {}", rules.size(), o.policy == RuleAction::Allow ? "allow" : "block"));
        // Mirrors TrafficController::Compose: the driver knows no processes, so from the first app rule
        // on everything is redirected to the engine (first match wins).
        size_t total = 0;
        size_t firstApp = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < rules.size(); ++i) {
            const Rule& r = rules[i];
            auto entries = Compile(r.match, r.action == RuleAction::Block ? FILTER_ACTION_DROP : FILTER_ACTION_PASS, nullptr);
            const size_t n = entries ? entries->size() : 0;
            if (r.match.app.set && !firstApp) firstApp = i + 1;
            if (!firstApp) total += n;
            const std::string where = r.match.app.set ? std::string("engine only") : std::format("{} driver entries", n);
            con.WriteLine(std::format("  {:2}. {}{:<5}{} {:<36} {}  [{}]", i + 1, r.action == RuleAction::Block ? con.Red() : con.Green(),
                                      r.action == RuleAction::Block ? "block" : "allow", con.Reset(), r.text, Summarize(r.match), where));
        }
        if (firstApp) {
            con.WriteLine(std::format("  Kernel offload would write {} entries, then redirect everything from rule {} on to the engine.", total,
                                      firstApp));
        } else {
            con.WriteLine(std::format("  Kernel offload would write {} entries plus the default policy.", total));
        }
        WarnLockout(con, rules, o.policy);
    }
    if (o.impair) {
        auto selector = ImpairmentSelector(o.impairment);
        const auto& p = o.impairment;
        std::string rateStr;
        if (p.rateKbps > 0) rateStr = std::format(", rate {} kbps", p.rateKbps);
        con.WriteLine(std::format("Simulator: latency {} ms, jitter \u00B1{} ms, loss {:.1f} %{}, traffic: {}", p.latencyMs, p.jitterMs, p.lossPercent, rateStr,
                                  selector ? Summarize(*selector) : selector.error()));
    }
    if (!o.firewall && !o.impair) con.WriteLine("Nothing to check: give --rule, --rules or simulator options.");
    return 0;
}

int ExportLanguage(const Console& con, const std::wstring& path) {
    if (!Text::ExportTemplate(path)) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[-] Cannot write {}{}", con.Red(), ToUtf8(path), con.Reset()));
        return 1;
    }
    con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[+] English template written to {}{}", con.Green(), ToUtf8(path), con.Reset()));
    con.WriteLine("    Translate the text after '=', save it as language\\<code>.lng next to WireScope.exe.");
    return 0;
}

int CheckLanguages(const Console& con, const std::wstring& file) {
    const auto reports = Text::Check(file);
    if (reports.empty()) {
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}[-] No language file found{}", con.Red(), con.Reset()));
        return 1;
    }
    int problems = 0;
    for (const auto& r : reports) {
        const bool clean = r.missing.empty() && r.unknown.empty() && r.placeholders.empty();
        con.WriteLine(std::format("{}{} ({}){}  {} of {} strings, {} %  {}", clean ? con.Green() : con.Yellow(), ToUtf8(r.language.name),
                                  ToUtf8(r.language.code), con.Reset(), r.language.translated, r.language.total, r.language.Coverage(),
                                  ToUtf8(r.file)));
        auto list = [&](const char* what, const std::vector<UINT>& ids) {
            if (ids.empty()) return;
            std::string line;
            for (UINT id : ids) line += std::format(" {}", id);
            con.WriteLine(std::format("    {}:{}", what, line));
        };
        list("missing", r.missing);
        list("unknown ids", r.unknown);
        list("placeholders differ from English (falls back to English)", r.placeholders);
        if (!clean) ++problems;
    }
    return problems ? 11 : 0;
}

} // namespace WS::Cli
```

`src/app/Console.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "app/Console.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <Windows.h>

namespace WS::Cli {

namespace {

enum class Kind { None, Console, Redirected };

Kind KindOf(HANDLE h) {
    if (!h || h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return Kind::None;
    switch (GetFileType(h)) {
    case FILE_TYPE_DISK:
    case FILE_TYPE_PIPE: return Kind::Redirected;
    case FILE_TYPE_CHAR: return Kind::Console;
    default: return Kind::None;
    }
}

FileHandle OpenConsole(const wchar_t* name) {
    return FileHandle(CreateFileW(name, GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE, nullptr,
                                  OPEN_EXISTING, 0, nullptr));
}

void QueueEnter() {
    const FileHandle in = OpenConsole(L"CONIN$");
    if (!in) return;
    INPUT_RECORD keys[2]{};
    keys[0].EventType = KEY_EVENT;
    keys[0].Event.KeyEvent.bKeyDown = TRUE;
    keys[0].Event.KeyEvent.wRepeatCount = 1;
    keys[0].Event.KeyEvent.wVirtualKeyCode = VK_RETURN;
    keys[0].Event.KeyEvent.wVirtualScanCode = static_cast<WORD>(MapVirtualKeyW(VK_RETURN, MAPVK_VK_TO_VSC));
    keys[0].Event.KeyEvent.uChar.UnicodeChar = L'\r';
    keys[1] = keys[0];
    keys[1].Event.KeyEvent.bKeyDown = FALSE;
    DWORD written = 0;
    WriteConsoleInputW(in.get(), keys, 2, &written);
}

void WaitForKey() {
    const FileHandle in = OpenConsole(L"CONIN$");
    if (!in) return;
    FlushConsoleInputBuffer(in.get());
    for (;;) {
        INPUT_RECORD record{};
        DWORD read = 0;
        if (!ReadConsoleInputW(in.get(), &record, 1, &read) || !read) break;
        if (record.EventType == KEY_EVENT && record.Event.KeyEvent.bKeyDown) break;
    }
}

} // namespace

Console::Console() {
    HANDLE out = GetStdHandle(STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE);
    const Kind outKind = KindOf(out);
    if (outKind == Kind::Redirected) {
        m_out = { out, false };
    }

    if (!m_out.handle) {
        if (AttachConsole(ATTACH_PARENT_PROCESS)) {
            m_attached = true;
        } else if (AllocConsole()) {
            m_allocated = true;
        }

        if (m_attached || m_allocated) {
            m_conout = OpenConsole(L"CONOUT$");
        }

        if (m_conout) {
            m_out = { m_conout.get(), true };
            if (GetConsoleMode(m_conout.get(), &m_originalOutMode)) {
                if (SetConsoleMode(m_conout.get(), m_originalOutMode | ENABLE_PROCESSED_OUTPUT | ENABLE_VIRTUAL_TERMINAL_PROCESSING)) {
                    m_supportsAnsi = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // ANSI coloring only active when output is a real console, never when piped
    m_supportsAnsi = m_supportsAnsi && m_out.console;
    if (m_allocated) {
        SetConsoleTitleW(L"WireScope");
    }
}

Console::~Console() {
    if (m_allocated) {
        WriteLine("\nPress any key to close this window.");
        WaitForKey();
    } else if (m_attached) {
        if (m_supportsAnsi && m_conout) {
            SetConsoleMode(m_conout.get(), m_originalOutMode);
        }
        QueueEnter();
    }
    m_conout.reset();
    if (m_attached || m_allocated) {
        FreeConsole();
    }
}

void Console::Write(std::string_view text) const {
    if (!m_out.handle || text.empty()) return;
    DWORD written = 0;
    if (m_out.console) {
        const std::wstring wide = ToWide(text);
        WriteConsoleW(m_out.handle, wide.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(wide.size()), &written, nullptr);
        return;
    }
    // Files and pipes get CRLF line ends
    std::string crlf;
    crlf.reserve(text.size() + 8);
    for (char c : text) {
        if (c == '\n' && (crlf.empty() || crlf.back() != '\r')) crlf.push_back('\r');
        crlf.push_back(c);
    }
    WriteFile(m_out.handle, crlf.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(crlf.size()), &written, nullptr);
}

void Console::WriteLine(std::string_view line) const {
    Write(line);
    Write("\n");
}

std::string Console::Reset() const { return m_supportsAnsi ? "\033[0m" : ""; }
std::string Console::Bold() const { return m_supportsAnsi ? "\033[1m" : ""; }
std::string Console::Dim() const { return m_supportsAnsi ? "\033[2m" : ""; }
std::string Console::Red() const { return m_supportsAnsi ? "\033[91m" : ""; }
std::string Console::Green() const { return m_supportsAnsi ? "\033[92m" : ""; }
std::string Console::Yellow() const { return m_supportsAnsi ? "\033[93m" : ""; }
std::string Console::Blue() const { return m_supportsAnsi ? "\033[94m" : ""; }
std::string Console::Magenta() const { return m_supportsAnsi ? "\033[95m" : ""; }
std::string Console::Cyan() const { return m_supportsAnsi ? "\033[96m" : ""; }

} // namespace WS::Cli
```

```cpp
// WireScope - Modern C++23 Network Packet Monitor & Sniffer
// Entry point: routes between GUI and CLI based on command-line arguments.

#include "app/Cli.h"
#include "gui/MainWindow.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include <Windows.h>

#pragma comment(lib, "comctl32.lib")

#pragma comment(lib, "ole32.lib")

namespace {

class ComApartment {
public:
    ComApartment() noexcept : m_hr(CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_APARTMENTTHREADED | COINIT_DISABLE_OLE1DDE)) {}
    ~ComApartment() { if (SUCCEEDED(m_hr)) CoUninitialize(); }
    ComApartment(const ComApartment&) = delete;
    ComApartment& operator=(const ComApartment&) = delete;

private:
    HRESULT m_hr;
};

} // namespace

int WINAPI wWinMain(HINSTANCE hInstance, HINSTANCE /*hPrevInstance*/, LPWSTR /*lpCmdLine*/, int nShowCmd) {
    int argc = 0;
    wchar_t** argv = CommandLineToArgvW(GetCommandLineW(), &argc);

    // If command-line arguments are provided, process in CLI mode
    if (argc > 1) {
        const int exitCode = WS::Cli::Run(argc, argv);
        LocalFree(argv);
        return exitCode;
    }
    LocalFree(argv);

    // Otherwise launch Graphical User Interface
    SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2);

    ComApartment com;
    WS::Ui::MainWindow window(hInstance);
    if (!window.Create(nShowCmd)) {
        return 1;
    }

    return window.Run();
}
```

`src/core/DriverBridge.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/DriverBridge.h"
#include "resources/resource.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
#include <iphlpapi.h>
#include <format>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <unordered_map>

#pragma comment(lib, "iphlpapi.lib")

namespace WS {

namespace {

struct AdapterInfo {
    std::string FriendlyName;
    bool IsUp{false};
    bool HasGateway{false};
};

std::unordered_map<std::string, AdapterInfo> GetAdapterFriendlyNames() {
    std::unordered_map<std::string, AdapterInfo> map;
    ULONG outBufLen = 15000;
    std::vector<BYTE> buffer(outBufLen);

    DWORD bestIf = 0;
    const IPAddr destAddr = 0x08080808; // 8.8.8.8 in network byte order
    (void)GetBestInterface(destAddr, &bestIf);

    DWORD ret = GetAdaptersAddresses(AF_UNSPEC, GAA_FLAG_INCLUDE_ALL_INTERFACES | GAA_FLAG_INCLUDE_GATEWAYS, nullptr,
                                    reinterpret_cast<PIP_ADAPTER_ADDRESSES>(buffer.data()), &outBufLen);
    if (ret == ERROR_BUFFER_OVERFLOW) {
        buffer.resize(outBufLen);
        ret = GetAdaptersAddresses(AF_UNSPEC, GAA_FLAG_INCLUDE_ALL_INTERFACES | GAA_FLAG_INCLUDE_GATEWAYS, nullptr,
                                   reinterpret_cast<PIP_ADAPTER_ADDRESSES>(buffer.data()), &outBufLen);
    }

    if (ret == NO_ERROR) {
        for (auto curr = reinterpret_cast<PIP_ADAPTER_ADDRESSES>(buffer.data()); curr != nullptr; curr = curr->Next) {
            if (curr->AdapterName) {
                std::string guid = curr->AdapterName;
                AdapterInfo info;
                if (curr->FriendlyName) {
                    info.FriendlyName = ToUtf8(curr->FriendlyName);
                }
                info.IsUp = (curr->OperStatus == IfOperStatusUp);
                if (bestIf != 0) {
                    info.HasGateway = (curr->IfIndex == bestIf);
                } else {
                    info.HasGateway = (curr->FirstGatewayAddress != nullptr);
                }
                map[guid] = std::move(info);
            }
        }
    }
    return map;
}

} // namespace

DriverBridge::DriverBridge() = default;

DriverBridge::~DriverBridge() {
    Disconnect();
}

void DriverBridge::ResetAllActiveModes() noexcept {
    if (!m_device) return;
    for (HANDLE hAdapter : m_activeAdapters) {
        ADAPTER_MODE modeReq{ hAdapter, MODE_BYPASS };
        DWORD returned = 0;
        DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), IOCTL_SET_ADAPTER_MODE,
                        &modeReq, sizeof(modeReq), nullptr, 0, &returned, nullptr);
    }
    m_activeAdapters.clear();
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> DriverBridge::Connect() {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (m_device) {
        return {};
    }

    // Try primary target: wsddntf (Topaz OFD / WinpkFilter OEM)
    const wchar_t* candidatePaths[] = {
        L"\\\\.\\wsddntf",
        L"\\\\.\\NDISRD"
    };

    for (const wchar_t* path : candidatePaths) {
        FileHandle dev(CreateFileW(
            path,
            GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE,
            FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE,
            nullptr,
            OPEN_EXISTING,
            FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL,
            nullptr
        ));

        if (dev) {
            m_device = std::move(dev);
            m_activeDevicePath = path;
            return {};
        }
    }

    const DWORD err = GetLastError();
    if (err == ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED) {
        return std::unexpected(Text::Get(IDS_DP_ACCESS_DENIED));
    }
    return std::unexpected(Text::Format(IDS_DP_OPEN_FAILED, FormatError(err)));
}

void DriverBridge::Disconnect() noexcept {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (m_device) {
        ResetAllActiveModes();
        m_device.reset();
        m_activeDevicePath.clear();
    }
}

std::expected<DWORD, std::wstring> DriverBridge::GetVersion() {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (!m_device) return std::unexpected(L"Driver not connected");

    DWORD version = 0;
    DWORD returned = 0;
    if (!DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), IOCTL_GET_VERSION, nullptr, 0,
                         &version, sizeof(version), &returned, nullptr)) {
        return std::unexpected(std::format(L"IOCTL_GET_VERSION failed: {}", FormatError()));
    }
    return version;
}

std::expected<std::vector<AdapterDescription>, std::wstring> DriverBridge::QueryAdapters() {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (!m_device) return std::unexpected(L"Driver not connected");

    TCP_ADAPTER_LIST rawList{};
    DWORD returned = 0;
    if (!DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), IOCTL_GET_TCPIP_INTERFACES, nullptr, 0,
                         &rawList, sizeof(rawList), &returned, nullptr)) {
        return std::unexpected(std::format(L"IOCTL_GET_TCPIP_INTERFACES failed: {}", FormatError()));
    }

    const auto friendlyMap = GetAdapterFriendlyNames();
    std::vector<AdapterDescription> result;
    const uint32_t count = std::min(rawList.m_nAdapterCount, static_cast<DWORD>(MAX_ADAPTER_COUNT));
    result.reserve(count);

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        AdapterDescription desc;
        desc.Index = i;
        desc.Handle = rawList.m_nAdapterHandle[i];
        desc.SystemName = rawList.m_szAdapterNameList[i];
        desc.MTU = rawList.m_usMTU[i];
        desc.Medium = rawList.m_nAdapterMediumList[i];

        std::span<const uint8_t, 6> macSpan(rawList.m_czCurrentAddress[i], 6);
        desc.MacAddress = FormatMac(macSpan);

        // Try extracting GUID from \\DEVICE\\{...}
        std::string friendly = desc.SystemName;
        const size_t braceStart = desc.SystemName.find('{');
        const size_t braceEnd = desc.SystemName.find('}');
        if (braceStart != std::string::npos && braceEnd != std::string::npos && braceEnd > braceStart) {
            const std::string guid = desc.SystemName.substr(braceStart, braceEnd - braceStart + 1);
            if (auto it = friendlyMap.find(guid); it != friendlyMap.end()) {
                friendly = it->second.FriendlyName;
                desc.IsUp = it->second.IsUp;
                desc.HasGateway = it->second.HasGateway;
            }
        }
        desc.FriendlyName = std::move(friendly);
        result.push_back(std::move(desc));
    }

    return result;
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> DriverBridge::SetAdapterMode(HANDLE hAdapter, DWORD mode) {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (!m_device) return std::unexpected(L"Driver not connected");

    ADAPTER_MODE req{ hAdapter, mode };
    DWORD returned = 0;
    if (!DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), IOCTL_SET_ADAPTER_MODE,
                         &req, sizeof(req), nullptr, 0, &returned, nullptr)) {
        return std::unexpected(std::format(L"IOCTL_SET_ADAPTER_MODE failed: {}", FormatError()));
    }

    if (mode == MODE_BYPASS) {
        m_activeAdapters.erase(hAdapter);
    } else {
        m_activeAdapters.insert(hAdapter);
    }
    return {};
}

std::expected<DWORD, std::wstring> DriverBridge::GetAdapterMode(HANDLE hAdapter) {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (!m_device) return std::unexpected(L"Driver not connected");

    ADAPTER_MODE req{ hAdapter, 0 };
    DWORD returned = 0;
    if (!DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), IOCTL_GET_ADAPTER_MODE,
                         &hAdapter, sizeof(hAdapter), &req, sizeof(req), &returned, nullptr)) {
        return std::unexpected(std::format(L"IOCTL_GET_ADAPTER_MODE failed: {}", FormatError()));
    }
    return req.dwFlags;
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> DriverBridge::SetAdapterEvent(HANDLE hAdapter, HANDLE hEvent) {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (!m_device) return std::unexpected(L"Driver not connected");

    struct {
        HANDLE hAdapter;
        HANDLE hEvent;
    } req{ hAdapter, hEvent };

    DWORD returned = 0;
    if (!DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), IOCTL_SET_ADAPTER_EVENT,
                         &req, sizeof(req), nullptr, 0, &returned, nullptr)) {
        return std::unexpected(std::format(L"IOCTL_SET_ADAPTER_EVENT failed: {}", FormatError()));
    }
    return {};
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> DriverBridge::SetPacketEvent(HANDLE hEvent) {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (!m_device) return std::unexpected(L"Driver not connected");

    DWORD returned = 0;
    if (!DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), IOCTL_SET_PACKET_EVENT,
                         &hEvent, sizeof(hEvent), nullptr, 0, &returned, nullptr)) {
        return std::unexpected(std::format(L"IOCTL_SET_PACKET_EVENT failed: {}", FormatError()));
    }
    return {};
}

std::expected<bool, std::wstring> DriverBridge::ReadPacket(HANDLE hAdapter, INTERMEDIATE_BUFFER& buffer) {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (!m_device) return std::unexpected(L"Driver not connected");

    ETH_REQUEST req{ hAdapter, &buffer };
    DWORD returned = 0;
    if (!DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), IOCTL_READ_PACKET,
                         &req, sizeof(req), nullptr, 0, &returned, nullptr)) {
        const DWORD err = GetLastError();
        if (err == ERROR_NO_MORE_ITEMS || err == ERROR_EMPTY || returned == 0) {
            return false; // Queue empty
        }
        return std::unexpected(std::format(L"IOCTL_READ_PACKET failed: {}", FormatError(err)));
    }
    return (buffer.m_Length > 0);
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> DriverBridge::SendPacketToAdapter(HANDLE hAdapter, const uint8_t* data, size_t length) {
    if (!data || length == 0 || length > MAX_PACKET_SIZE) {
        return std::unexpected(L"Invalid packet data or length");
    }

    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (!m_device) return std::unexpected(L"Driver not connected");

    INTERMEDIATE_BUFFER buf{};
    buf.m_Length = static_cast<DWORD>(length);
    buf.m_dwDeviceFlags = PACKET_FLAG_ON_SEND;
    memcpy(buf.m_IBuffer, data, length);

    ETH_REQUEST req{ hAdapter, &buf };
    DWORD returned = 0;
    if (!DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), IOCTL_SEND_PACKET_TO_ADAPTER,
                         &req, sizeof(req), nullptr, 0, &returned, nullptr)) {
        return std::unexpected(std::format(L"IOCTL_SEND_PACKET_TO_ADAPTER failed: {}", FormatError()));
    }
    return {};
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> DriverBridge::SendPacketToMstcp(HANDLE hAdapter, const uint8_t* data, size_t length) {
    if (!data || length == 0 || length > MAX_PACKET_SIZE) {
        return std::unexpected(L"Invalid packet data or length");
    }

    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (!m_device) return std::unexpected(L"Driver not connected");

    INTERMEDIATE_BUFFER buf{};
    buf.m_Length = static_cast<DWORD>(length);
    buf.m_dwDeviceFlags = PACKET_FLAG_ON_RECEIVE;
    memcpy(buf.m_IBuffer, data, length);

    ETH_REQUEST req{ hAdapter, &buf };
    DWORD returned = 0;
    if (!DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), IOCTL_SEND_PACKET_TO_MSTCP,
                         &req, sizeof(req), nullptr, 0, &returned, nullptr)) {
        return std::unexpected(std::format(L"IOCTL_SEND_PACKET_TO_MSTCP failed: {}", FormatError()));
    }
    return {};
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> DriverBridge::Reinject(HANDLE hAdapter, INTERMEDIATE_BUFFER& buffer) {
    if (buffer.m_Length == 0 || buffer.m_Length > MAX_PACKET_SIZE) {
        return std::unexpected(L"Invalid packet length");
    }
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (!m_device) return std::unexpected(L"Driver not connected");

    const bool outbound = (buffer.m_dwDeviceFlags & PACKET_FLAG_ON_SEND) != 0;
    ETH_REQUEST req{ hAdapter, &buffer };
    DWORD returned = 0;
    if (!DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), outbound ? IOCTL_SEND_PACKET_TO_ADAPTER : IOCTL_SEND_PACKET_TO_MSTCP,
                         &req, sizeof(req), nullptr, 0, &returned, nullptr)) {
        return std::unexpected(std::format(L"Re-injecting a packet failed: {}", FormatError()));
    }
    return {};
}

std::expected<DWORD, std::wstring> DriverBridge::GetStaticFilterCount() {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (!m_device) return std::unexpected(L"Driver not connected");

    DWORD count = 0;
    DWORD returned = 0;
    if (!DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), IOCTL_GET_PACKET_FILTERS_TABLE_SIZE,
                         nullptr, 0, &count, sizeof(count), &returned, nullptr)) {
        return std::unexpected(std::format(L"The driver has no static filter support (IOCTL_GET_PACKET_FILTERS_TABLE_SIZE: {})", FormatError()));
    }
    return count;
}

std::expected<std::vector<STATIC_FILTER>, std::wstring> DriverBridge::ReadStaticFilters() {
    auto count = GetStaticFilterCount();
    if (!count) return std::unexpected(count.error());

    // Room for a few entries more than reported, in case another application grows the table meanwhile.
    const size_t capacity = static_cast<size_t>(*count) + 16;
    std::vector<uint8_t> buffer(sizeof(STATIC_FILTER_TABLE_HEADER) + capacity * sizeof(STATIC_FILTER));
    auto* header = reinterpret_cast<STATIC_FILTER_TABLE_HEADER*>(buffer.data());
    header->m_TableSize = static_cast<DWORD>(capacity);

    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (!m_device) return std::unexpected(L"Driver not connected");
    DWORD returned = 0;
    if (!DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), IOCTL_GET_PACKET_FILTERS_TABLE, nullptr, 0,
                         buffer.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(buffer.size()), &returned, nullptr)) {
        return std::unexpected(std::format(L"IOCTL_GET_PACKET_FILTERS failed: {}", FormatError()));
    }
    // wsddntf reports the whole output buffer as returned, so the entry count comes from the header.
    // The entry layout itself is proven by WriteStaticFilters' read-back.
    if (returned < sizeof(STATIC_FILTER_TABLE_HEADER)) {
        if (*count == 0) return std::vector<STATIC_FILTER>{};
        return std::unexpected(std::format(L"The driver returned {} bytes for a table of {} filters", returned, *count));
    }
    const size_t entries = header->m_TableSize;
    const size_t needed = sizeof(STATIC_FILTER_TABLE_HEADER) + entries * sizeof(STATIC_FILTER);
    if (entries > capacity || returned < needed) {
        return std::unexpected(std::format(
            L"Static filter table not understood: the driver reports {} entries in {} bytes (buffer for {}, {} bytes per entry)",
            entries, returned, capacity, sizeof(STATIC_FILTER)));
    }
    std::vector<STATIC_FILTER> filters(entries);
    if (entries) {
        std::memcpy(filters.data(), buffer.data() + sizeof(STATIC_FILTER_TABLE_HEADER), entries * sizeof(STATIC_FILTER));
    }
    return filters;
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> DriverBridge::WriteStaticFilters(std::span<const STATIC_FILTER> filters) {
    if (filters.empty()) return ResetStaticFilters();

    std::vector<uint8_t> buffer(sizeof(STATIC_FILTER_TABLE_HEADER) + filters.size() * sizeof(STATIC_FILTER));
    auto* header = reinterpret_cast<STATIC_FILTER_TABLE_HEADER*>(buffer.data());
    header->m_TableSize = static_cast<DWORD>(filters.size());
    std::memcpy(buffer.data() + sizeof(STATIC_FILTER_TABLE_HEADER), filters.data(), filters.size() * sizeof(STATIC_FILTER));
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
        if (!m_device) return std::unexpected(L"Driver not connected");
        DWORD returned = 0;
        if (!DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), IOCTL_SET_PACKET_FILTERS, buffer.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(buffer.size()),
                             nullptr, 0, &returned, nullptr)) {
            return std::unexpected(std::format(L"IOCTL_SET_PACKET_FILTERS failed: {}", FormatError()));
        }
    }

    // Read the table back: a driver with a different structure layout would report other sizes or
    // other values, and a table it misread must not stay active.
    auto readBack = ReadStaticFilters();
    auto mismatch = [&]() -> std::wstring {
        if (!readBack) return readBack.error();
        if (readBack->size() != filters.size()) {
            return std::format(L"the driver holds {} filters after {} were written", readBack->size(), filters.size());
        }
        for (size_t i = 0; i < filters.size(); ++i) {
            const STATIC_FILTER& a = filters[i];
            const STATIC_FILTER& b = (*readBack)[i];
            if (a.m_Adapter != b.m_Adapter || a.m_dwDirectionFlags != b.m_dwDirectionFlags || a.m_FilterAction != b.m_FilterAction ||
                a.m_ValidFields != b.m_ValidFields ||
                std::memcmp(&a.m_DataLinkFilter, &b.m_DataLinkFilter, sizeof(a.m_DataLinkFilter)) != 0 ||
                std::memcmp(&a.m_NetworkFilter, &b.m_NetworkFilter, sizeof(a.m_NetworkFilter)) != 0 ||
                std::memcmp(&a.m_TransportFilter, &b.m_TransportFilter, sizeof(a.m_TransportFilter)) != 0) {
                return std::format(L"filter {} reads back differently", i);
            }
        }
        return {};
    }();
    if (!mismatch.empty()) {
        (void)ResetStaticFilters();
        return std::unexpected(L"The driver did not accept the filter table as written (" + mismatch +
                               L"). The table was cleared to keep the network safe.");
    }
    return {};
}

std::expected<std::pair<std::vector<uint8_t>, std::vector<uint8_t>>, std::wstring>
DriverBridge::StaticFilterRoundTrip(std::span<const STATIC_FILTER> filters) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> sent(sizeof(STATIC_FILTER_TABLE_HEADER) + filters.size() * sizeof(STATIC_FILTER));
    reinterpret_cast<STATIC_FILTER_TABLE_HEADER*>(sent.data())->m_TableSize = static_cast<DWORD>(filters.size());
    if (!filters.empty()) std::memcpy(sent.data() + sizeof(STATIC_FILTER_TABLE_HEADER), filters.data(), filters.size() * sizeof(STATIC_FILTER));
    std::vector<uint8_t> back(sent.size() + 16 * sizeof(STATIC_FILTER));
    reinterpret_cast<STATIC_FILTER_TABLE_HEADER*>(back.data())->m_TableSize = static_cast<DWORD>(filters.size() + 16);
    std::wstring error;
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
        if (!m_device) return std::unexpected(L"Driver not connected");
        DWORD returned = 0;
        if (!DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), IOCTL_SET_PACKET_FILTERS, sent.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(sent.size()), nullptr, 0, &returned, nullptr)) {
            return std::unexpected(std::format(L"IOCTL_SET_PACKET_FILTERS failed: {}", FormatError()));
        }
        if (!DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), IOCTL_GET_PACKET_FILTERS_TABLE, nullptr, 0, back.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(back.size()), &returned, nullptr)) {
            error = std::format(L"IOCTL_GET_PACKET_FILTERS failed: {}", FormatError());
        }
    }
    (void)ResetStaticFilters();
    if (!error.empty()) return std::unexpected(error);
    return std::pair{std::move(sent), std::move(back)};
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> DriverBridge::FlushQueue(HANDLE hAdapter) {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (!m_device) return std::unexpected(L"Driver not connected");

    DWORD returned = 0;
    if (!DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), IOCTL_FLUSH_ADAPTER_PACKET_QUEUE,
                         &hAdapter, sizeof(hAdapter), nullptr, 0, &returned, nullptr)) {
        return std::unexpected(std::format(L"IOCTL_FLUSH_ADAPTER_PACKET_QUEUE failed: {}", FormatError()));
    }
    return {};
}

std::expected<DWORD, std::wstring> DriverBridge::GetQueueSize(HANDLE hAdapter) {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (!m_device) return std::unexpected(L"Driver not connected");

    DWORD size = 0;
    DWORD returned = 0;
    if (!DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), IOCTL_GET_ADAPTER_PACKET_QUEUE_SIZE,
                         &hAdapter, sizeof(hAdapter), &size, sizeof(size), &returned, nullptr)) {
        return std::unexpected(std::format(L"IOCTL_GET_ADAPTER_PACKET_QUEUE_SIZE failed: {}", FormatError()));
    }
    return size;
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> DriverBridge::ResetStaticFilters() {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (!m_device) return std::unexpected(L"Driver not connected");

    DWORD returned = 0;
    if (!DeviceIoControl(m_device.get(), IOCTL_RESET_PACKET_FILTERS,
                         nullptr, 0, nullptr, 0, &returned, nullptr)) {
        return std::unexpected(std::format(L"IOCTL_RESET_PACKET_FILTERS failed: {}", FormatError()));
    }
    return {};
}

} // namespace WS
```

`src/core/DriverPackage.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/DriverPackage.h"
#include "resources/resource.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <fdi.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cstring>
#include <format>

#pragma comment(lib, "cabinet.lib")

#ifndef SEEK_SET
#define SEEK_SET 0
#define SEEK_CUR 1
#define SEEK_END 2
#endif

namespace WS::DriverPackage {

namespace {

constexpr int kMaxInputHandles = 8;
constexpr int kMaxOutputs = 8;
constexpr INT_PTR kOutputHandleBase = 0x100;

// XOR mask applied to the 4-byte cabinet magic header at offset 0..3 ('M','S','C','F').
constexpr BYTE kHeaderMask[4] = {0xA5, 0x5A, 0xF0, 0x0F};
constexpr BYTE kMaskedMagic[4] = {0xE8, 0x09, 0xB3, 0x49};

struct InputHandle {
    bool active{false};
    size_t offset{0};
};

struct OutputHandle {
    bool active{false};
    bool complete{false};
    std::wstring name;
    std::vector<BYTE> data;
    size_t position{0};
    size_t logicalSize{0};
};

struct CabExtractionState {
    const BYTE* cabData{nullptr};
    size_t cabSize{0};
    InputHandle inputs[kMaxInputHandles]{};
    OutputHandle outputs[kMaxOutputs]{};
};

thread_local CabExtractionState* t_state = nullptr;

bool IsInputHandle(INT_PTR handle) noexcept {
    return handle >= 1 && handle <= kMaxInputHandles;
}

bool IsOutputHandle(INT_PTR handle) noexcept {
    const INT_PTR index = handle - kOutputHandleBase;
    return index >= 0 && index < kMaxOutputs && t_state && t_state->outputs[index].active;
}

std::wstring MapSlotName(const char* rawName) {
    if (!rawName) return {};
    const char* base = rawName;
    for (const char* p = rawName; *p; ++p) {
        if (*p == '\\' || *p == '/') base = p + 1;
    }
    if (std::strcmp(base, "1") == 0 || _stricmp(base, "wsddntf.inf") == 0) return L"wsddntf.inf";
    if (std::strcmp(base, "2") == 0 || _stricmp(base, "wsddntf.cat") == 0) return L"wsddntf.cat";
    if (std::strcmp(base, "3") == 0 || _stricmp(base, "wsddntf.sys") == 0) return L"wsddntf.sys";
    return {};
}

LPVOID DIAMONDAPI FdiAlloc(ULONG size) {
    return HeapAlloc(GetProcessHeap(), 0, size);
}

void DIAMONDAPI FdiFree(LPVOID memory) {
    if (memory) HeapFree(GetProcessHeap(), 0, memory);
}

INT_PTR DIAMONDAPI FdiOpen(LPSTR, int, int) {
    if (!t_state) return -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < kMaxInputHandles; ++i) {
        if (!t_state->inputs[i].active) {
            t_state->inputs[i].active = true;
            t_state->inputs[i].offset = 0;
            return i + 1;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

UINT DIAMONDAPI FdiRead(INT_PTR handle, void* destination, UINT requested) {
    if (!t_state || !IsInputHandle(handle)) return 0;

    InputHandle& input = t_state->inputs[handle - 1];
    if (!input.active || input.offset >= t_state->cabSize) return 0;

    const size_t available = t_state->cabSize - input.offset;
    const UINT toRead = (requested < available) ? requested : static_cast<UINT>(available);
    if (toRead == 0) return 0;

    std::memcpy(destination, t_state->cabData + input.offset, toRead);

    // Unmask the 4-byte cabinet signature in-flight when reading offset 0..3.
    if (input.offset < 4) {
        const size_t limit = (std::min)(static_cast<size_t>(4) - input.offset, static_cast<size_t>(toRead));
        auto* bytes = static_cast<BYTE*>(destination);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < limit; ++i) {
            bytes[i] ^= kHeaderMask[input.offset + i];
        }
    }

    input.offset += toRead;
    return toRead;
}

UINT DIAMONDAPI FdiWrite(INT_PTR handle, void* source, UINT byteCount) {
    if (!t_state || byteCount == 0 || !IsOutputHandle(handle)) return 0;

    OutputHandle& output = t_state->outputs[handle - kOutputHandleBase];
    const size_t endPosition = output.position + byteCount;
    if (endPosition > output.data.size()) output.data.resize(endPosition);

    std::memcpy(output.data.data() + output.position, source, byteCount);
    output.position = endPosition;
    if (output.position > output.logicalSize) output.logicalSize = output.position;
    return byteCount;
}

int DIAMONDAPI FdiClose(INT_PTR handle) {
    if (!t_state) return -1;
    if (IsInputHandle(handle)) {
        t_state->inputs[handle - 1].active = false;
        return 0;
    }
    if (IsOutputHandle(handle)) {
        OutputHandle& output = t_state->outputs[handle - kOutputHandleBase];
        output.data.resize(output.logicalSize);
        output.position = output.logicalSize;
        output.complete = true;
        return 0;
    }
    return -1;
}

long DIAMONDAPI FdiSeek(INT_PTR handle, long distance, int origin) {
    if (!t_state) return -1;

    if (IsInputHandle(handle)) {
        InputHandle& input = t_state->inputs[handle - 1];
        if (!input.active) return -1;

        LONGLONG newOffset = 0;
        switch (origin) {
        case SEEK_SET: newOffset = distance; break;
        case SEEK_CUR: newOffset = static_cast<LONGLONG>(input.offset) + distance; break;
        case SEEK_END: newOffset = static_cast<LONGLONG>(t_state->cabSize) + distance; break;
        default: return -1;
        }
        if (newOffset < 0 || static_cast<size_t>(newOffset) > t_state->cabSize) return -1;
        input.offset = static_cast<size_t>(newOffset);
        return static_cast<long>(input.offset);
    }

    if (IsOutputHandle(handle)) {
        OutputHandle& output = t_state->outputs[handle - kOutputHandleBase];
        LONGLONG newOffset = 0;
        switch (origin) {
        case SEEK_SET: newOffset = distance; break;
        case SEEK_CUR: newOffset = static_cast<LONGLONG>(output.position) + distance; break;
        case SEEK_END: newOffset = static_cast<LONGLONG>(output.logicalSize) + distance; break;
        default: return -1;
        }
        if (newOffset < 0) return -1;
        output.position = static_cast<size_t>(newOffset);
        if (output.position > output.logicalSize) {
            output.logicalSize = output.position;
            output.data.resize(output.logicalSize);
        }
        return static_cast<long>(output.position);
    }

    return -1;
}

INT_PTR DIAMONDAPI FdiNotify(FDINOTIFICATIONTYPE type, PFDINOTIFICATION notification) {
    if (!t_state || !notification) return -1;

    if (type == fdintCOPY_FILE) {
        const std::wstring mapped = MapSlotName(notification->psz1);
        if (mapped.empty()) return -1;

        int index = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < kMaxOutputs; ++i) {
            if (!t_state->outputs[i].active) {
                index = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (index < 0) return -1;

        OutputHandle& output = t_state->outputs[index];
        output.active = true;
        output.complete = false;
        output.name = mapped;
        output.position = 0;
        output.logicalSize = 0;
        output.data.clear();
        if (notification->cb > 0) output.data.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(notification->cb));
        return kOutputHandleBase + index;
    }

    if (type == fdintCLOSE_FILE_INFO) {
        if (!IsOutputHandle(notification->hf)) return FALSE;
        OutputHandle& output = t_state->outputs[notification->hf - kOutputHandleBase];
        output.data.resize(output.logicalSize);
        output.position = output.logicalSize;
        output.complete = true;
        return TRUE;
    }

    return 0;
}

struct BmpCabinetSlice {
    const BYTE* data{nullptr};
    size_t size{0};
};

std::optional<BmpCabinetSlice> LocateEmbeddedCabinet() noexcept {
    const HRSRC resource = FindResourceW(nullptr, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDR_DRIVER_IMAGE), RT_RCDATA);
    if (!resource) return std::nullopt;

    const DWORD resourceSize = SizeofResource(nullptr, resource);
    if (resourceSize < 58) return std::nullopt;

    const HGLOBAL loaded = LoadResource(nullptr, resource);
    if (!loaded) return std::nullopt;

    const auto* raw = static_cast<const BYTE*>(LockResource(loaded));
    if (!raw || raw[0] != 0x42 || raw[1] != 0x4D) return std::nullopt;  // 'BM'

    DWORD cabSize = 0, offBits = 0;
    std::memcpy(&cabSize, raw + 6, sizeof(DWORD));   // bfReserved1 + bfReserved2
    std::memcpy(&offBits, raw + 10, sizeof(DWORD));  // bfOffBits

    if (offBits < 54 || cabSize < 4 || offBits > resourceSize || cabSize > resourceSize - offBits) {
        return std::nullopt;
    }
    if (std::memcmp(raw + offBits, kMaskedMagic, 4) != 0) return std::nullopt;

    return BmpCabinetSlice{raw + offBits, cabSize};
}

}  // namespace

bool HasEmbeddedPackage() noexcept {
    return LocateEmbeddedCabinet().has_value();
}

std::expected<std::vector<File>, std::wstring> Extract() {
    const auto slice = LocateEmbeddedCabinet();
    if (!slice) return std::unexpected(Text::Get(IDS_DRV_NO_PACKAGE_FOLDER));

    CabExtractionState state;
    state.cabData = slice->data;
    state.cabSize = slice->size;
    t_state = &state;

    ERF errorInfo{};
    const HFDI fdi = FDICreate(FdiAlloc, FdiFree, FdiOpen, FdiRead, FdiWrite, FdiClose, FdiSeek, cpuUNKNOWN, &errorInfo);
    if (!fdi) {
        t_state = nullptr;
        return std::unexpected(Text::Format(IDS_DRV_API, L"FDICreate", std::to_wstring(errorInfo.erfOper)));
    }

    char cabName[] = "package.cab";
    char cabPath[] = "";
    const BOOL extracted = FDICopy(fdi, cabName, cabPath, 0, FdiNotify, nullptr, nullptr);
    FDIDestroy(fdi);
    t_state = nullptr;

    if (!extracted) {
        return std::unexpected(Text::Format(IDS_DRV_API, L"FDICopy", std::to_wstring(errorInfo.erfOper)));
    }

    std::vector<File> files;
    for (OutputHandle& out : state.outputs) {
        if (out.active && out.complete && !out.name.empty() && !out.data.empty()) {
            files.push_back({std::move(out.name), std::move(out.data)});
        }
    }

    for (const wchar_t* required : {L"wsddntf.inf", L"wsddntf.cat", L"wsddntf.sys"}) {
        const bool found = std::ranges::any_of(files, [&](const File& f) { return f.name == required; });
        if (!found) return std::unexpected(Text::Format(IDS_DRV_NO_PACKAGE, required));
    }
    return files;
}

StagedFolder::~StagedFolder() {
    Cleanup();
}

StagedFolder::StagedFolder(StagedFolder&& other) noexcept : m_folder(std::move(other.m_folder)) {
    other.m_folder.clear();
}

StagedFolder& StagedFolder::operator=(StagedFolder&& other) noexcept {
    if (this != &other) {
        Cleanup();
        m_folder = std::move(other.m_folder);
        other.m_folder.clear();
    }
    return *this;
}

void StagedFolder::Cleanup() noexcept {
    if (m_folder.empty()) return;
    for (const wchar_t* name : {L"wsddntf.inf", L"wsddntf.cat", L"wsddntf.sys"}) {
        const std::wstring path = m_folder + L"\\" + name;
        SetFileAttributesW(path.c_str(), FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL);
        DeleteFileW(path.c_str());
    }
    RemoveDirectoryW(m_folder.c_str());
    m_folder.clear();
}

std::expected<StagedFolder, std::wstring> StagedFolder::Create() {
    auto files = Extract();
    if (!files) return std::unexpected(files.error());

    wchar_t tempBase[MAX_PATH]{};
    const DWORD len = GetTempPathW(MAX_PATH, tempBase);
    if (len == 0 || len >= MAX_PATH) {
        return std::unexpected(Text::Format(IDS_DRV_API, L"GetTempPath", FormatError()));
    }

    static std::atomic<uint32_t> s_seq{0};
    const std::wstring folder = std::format(L"{}WireScope_pkg_{}_{}_{}", tempBase, GetCurrentProcessId(), GetTickCount64(), ++s_seq);
    if (!CreateDirectoryW(folder.c_str(), nullptr)) {
        return std::unexpected(Text::Format(IDS_DRV_API, L"CreateDirectory", FormatError()));
    }

    StagedFolder staged(folder);
    for (const File& file : *files) {
        const std::wstring path = folder + L"\\" + file.name;
        const FileHandle h(CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr));
        if (!h) return std::unexpected(Text::Format(IDS_DRV_API, L"CreateFile", FormatError()));

        DWORD written = 0;
        const auto size = static_cast<DWORD>(file.data.size());
        if (!WriteFile(h.get(), file.data.data(), size, &written, nullptr) || written != size) {
            return std::unexpected(Text::Format(IDS_DRV_API, L"WriteFile", FormatError()));
        }
    }
    return staged;
}

}  // namespace WS::DriverPackage
```
