`src/core/DriverSetup.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/DriverSetup.h"
#include "core/DriverPackage.h"
#include "resources/resource.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <SetupAPI.h>
#include <netcfgx.h>
#include <wrl/client.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <format>

#pragma comment(lib, "setupapi.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "version.lib")

namespace WS::DriverSetup {

namespace {

using Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr;

// {5B035261-40F9-11D1-AAEC-00805FC1270E}: the coclass behind netcfg.exe (netcfgx.idl).
constexpr CLSID kNetCfg = {0x5B035261, 0x40F9, 0x11D1, {0xAA, 0xEC, 0x00, 0x80, 0x5F, 0xC1, 0x27, 0x0E}};
// GUID_DEVCLASS_NETSERVICE, the class of wsddntf.inf.
constexpr GUID kNetServiceClass = {0x4D36E974, 0xE325, 0x11CE, {0xBF, 0xC1, 0x08, 0x00, 0x2B, 0xE1, 0x03, 0x18}};
constexpr DWORD kLockTimeoutMs = 5000;
constexpr DWORD kServiceTimeoutMs = 15000;
constexpr DWORD kDeviceTimeoutMs = 15000;

// INetCfg wants a single-threaded apartment; a thread that has one already keeps it.
class Apartment {
public:
    Apartment() noexcept : m_hr(CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_APARTMENTTHREADED | COINIT_DISABLE_OLE1DDE)) {}
    ~Apartment() { if (SUCCEEDED(m_hr)) CoUninitialize(); }
    Apartment(const Apartment&) = delete;
    Apartment& operator=(const Apartment&) = delete;
    [[nodiscard]] bool Ready() const noexcept { return SUCCEEDED(m_hr); }
private:
    HRESULT m_hr;
};

std::wstring ApiError(const wchar_t* call, HRESULT hr) {
    std::wstring text = FormatError(static_cast<DWORD>(hr));
    if (text.empty() || text.starts_with(L"Unknown")) text = std::format(L"0x{:08X}", static_cast<uint32_t>(hr));
    return Text::Format(IDS_DRV_API, call, text);
}

std::wstring Win32Error(const wchar_t* call, DWORD code = GetLastError()) {
    return ApiError(call, HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(code));
}

// Opens INetCfg (with the write lock when `write`), runs f, and always closes it again.
template <class F>
auto WithNetCfg(bool write, F&& f) -> decltype(f(static_cast<INetCfg*>(nullptr))) {
    const Apartment apartment;
    if (!apartment.Ready()) return std::unexpected(Text::Get(IDS_DRV_APARTMENT));
    ComPtr<INetCfg> cfg;
    HRESULT hr = CoCreateInstance(kNetCfg, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(&cfg));
    if (FAILED(hr)) return std::unexpected(ApiError(L"CoCreateInstance(CNetCfg)", hr));
    ComPtr<INetCfgLock> lock;
    if (write) {
        if (hr = cfg.As(&lock); FAILED(hr)) return std::unexpected(ApiError(L"INetCfgLock", hr));
        LPWSTR holder = nullptr;
        hr = lock->AcquireWriteLock(kLockTimeoutMs, L"WireScope", &holder);
        const std::wstring who = holder ? holder : L"?";
        CoTaskMemFree(holder);
        if (hr == S_FALSE) return std::unexpected(Text::Format(IDS_DRV_LOCKED, who));
        if (FAILED(hr)) return std::unexpected(ApiError(L"INetCfgLock::AcquireWriteLock", hr));
    }
    if (hr = cfg->Initialize(nullptr); FAILED(hr)) {
        if (lock) lock->ReleaseWriteLock();
        return std::unexpected(ApiError(L"INetCfg::Initialize", hr));
    }
    auto result = f(cfg.Get());
    cfg->Uninitialize();
    if (lock) lock->ReleaseWriteLock();
    return result;
}

std::wstring TakeString(LPWSTR text) {
    std::wstring out = text ? text : L"";
    CoTaskMemFree(text);
    return out;
}

// Calls f(path) for every binding path below the component (one per adapter it can sit on).
template <class F>
HRESULT ForEachBinding(INetCfgComponent* component, F&& f) {
    ComPtr<INetCfgComponentBindings> bindings;
    if (HRESULT hr = component->QueryInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&bindings)); FAILED(hr)) return hr;
    ComPtr<IEnumNetCfgBindingPath> paths;
    if (HRESULT hr = bindings->EnumBindingPaths(EBP_BELOW, &paths); FAILED(hr)) return hr;
    ComPtr<INetCfgBindingPath> path;
    ULONG fetched = 0;
    while (paths->Next(1, path.ReleaseAndGetAddressOf(), &fetched) == S_OK) {
        if (HRESULT hr = f(path.Get()); FAILED(hr)) return hr;
    }
    return S_OK;
}

std::wstring AdapterOf(INetCfgBindingPath* path) {
    // The lowest component of the path is the adapter.
    std::wstring adapter;
    ComPtr<IEnumNetCfgBindingInterface> interfaces;
    if (FAILED(path->EnumBindingInterfaces(&interfaces))) return adapter;
    ComPtr<INetCfgBindingInterface> item;
    ULONG fetched = 0;
    while (interfaces->Next(1, item.ReleaseAndGetAddressOf(), &fetched) == S_OK) {
        ComPtr<INetCfgComponent> lower;
        LPWSTR name = nullptr;
        if (SUCCEEDED(item->GetLowerComponent(&lower)) && SUCCEEDED(lower->GetDisplayName(&name))) adapter = TakeString(name);
    }
    return adapter;
}

std::wstring WindowsFolder() {
    std::wstring path(MAX_PATH, L'\0');
    path.resize(GetWindowsDirectoryW(path.data(), MAX_PATH));
    return path;
}

// "\SystemRoot\System32\drivers\x.sys", "System32\drivers\x.sys" or "\??\C:\..." to a plain path.
std::wstring DriverFilePath(std::wstring image) {
    if (image.starts_with(L"\\??\\")) return image.substr(4);
    if (_wcsnicmp(image.c_str(), L"\\SystemRoot\\", 12) == 0) return WindowsFolder() + image.substr(11);
    if (image.size() > 1 && image[1] != L':') return WindowsFolder() + L"\\" + image;
    return image;
}

std::wstring FileVersion(const std::wstring& file) {
    DWORD ignored = 0;
    const DWORD size = GetFileVersionInfoSizeW(file.c_str(), &ignored);
    if (size == 0) return {};
    std::vector<BYTE> data(size);
    VS_FIXEDFILEINFO* info = nullptr;
    UINT length = 0;
    if (!GetFileVersionInfoW(file.c_str(), 0, size, data.data()) || !VerQueryValueW(data.data(), L"\\", reinterpret_cast<void**>(&info), &length) ||
        !info) {
        return {};
    }
    return std::format(L"{}.{}.{}.{}", HIWORD(info->dwFileVersionMS), LOWORD(info->dwFileVersionMS), HIWORD(info->dwFileVersionLS),
                       LOWORD(info->dwFileVersionLS));
}

// DriverVer of [Version] as written, "07/10/2025,3.2.26.2" (SetupQueryInfVersionInformation gives the date only).
std::wstring InfVersion(const std::wstring& path) {
    const HINF inf = SetupOpenInfFileW(path.c_str(), nullptr, INF_STYLE_WIN4, nullptr);
    if (inf == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return {};
    const ScopeExit close([&] { SetupCloseInfFile(inf); });
    INFCONTEXT line{};
    std::wstring value(256, L'\0');
    DWORD needed = 0;
    if (!SetupFindFirstLineW(inf, L"Version", L"DriverVer", &line) ||
        !SetupGetLineTextW(&line, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, value.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(value.size()), &needed)) {
        return {};
    }
    value.resize(needed ? needed - 1 : 0);
    return value;
}

std::vector<BYTE> InfInformation(const std::wstring& path) {
    DWORD size = 0;
    if (!SetupGetInfInformationW(path.c_str(), INFINFO_INF_NAME_IS_ABSOLUTE, nullptr, 0, &size) || size == 0) return {};
    std::vector<BYTE> buffer(size);
    if (!SetupGetInfInformationW(path.c_str(), INFINFO_INF_NAME_IS_ABSOLUTE, reinterpret_cast<SP_INF_INFORMATION*>(buffer.data()), size, nullptr)) {
        return {};
    }
    return buffer;
}

// Every copy of wsddntf.inf in the driver store, as pnputil /enum-drivers lists them.
std::vector<StagedPackage> Staged() {
    std::vector<StagedPackage> packages;
    const std::wstring folder = WindowsFolder() + L"\\INF\\";
    WIN32_FIND_DATAW found{};
    const FindHandle find(FindFirstFileW((folder + L"oem*.inf").c_str(), &found));
    if (!find) return packages;
    do {
        auto buffer = InfInformation(folder + found.cFileName);
        if (buffer.empty()) continue;
        auto* info = reinterpret_cast<SP_INF_INFORMATION*>(buffer.data());
        SP_ORIGINAL_FILE_INFO_W original{sizeof original};
        if (!SetupQueryInfOriginalFileInformationW(info, 0, nullptr, &original) || _wcsicmp(original.OriginalInfName, kInfName) != 0) continue;
        packages.push_back({found.cFileName, InfVersion(folder + found.cFileName)});
    } while (FindNextFileW(find.get(), &found));
    return packages;
}

ServiceHandle OpenDriverService(DWORD access) {
    const ServiceHandle manager(OpenSCManagerW(nullptr, nullptr, SC_MANAGER_CONNECT));
    if (!manager) return ServiceHandle();
    return ServiceHandle(OpenServiceW(manager.get(), kServiceName, access));
}

bool WaitForState(SC_HANDLE service, DWORD state, DWORD timeoutMs) {
    const uint64_t deadline = GetTickCount64() + timeoutMs;
    SERVICE_STATUS_PROCESS status{};
    DWORD needed = 0;
    while (QueryServiceStatusEx(service, SC_STATUS_PROCESS_INFO, reinterpret_cast<BYTE*>(&status), sizeof status, &needed)) {
        if (status.dwCurrentState == state) return true;
        if (GetTickCount64() >= deadline) return false;
        Sleep(100);
    }
    return false;
}

// Rejects a package that would not load: a mandatory filter that cannot start takes every adapter down.
std::expected<void, std::wstring> CheckPackage(const std::wstring& inf) {
    const std::wstring folder = inf.substr(0, inf.find_last_of(L'\\') + 1);
    for (const wchar_t* file : {kInfName, L"wsddntf.sys", L"wsddntf.cat"}) {
        if (GetFileAttributesW((folder + file).c_str()) == INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) {
            return std::unexpected(Text::Format(IDS_DRV_NO_PACKAGE, folder + file));
        }
    }
    for (const wchar_t* signedFile : {L"wsddntf.cat", L"wsddntf.sys"}) {
        const TrustReport trust = ProcessTrust::Verify(folder + signedFile);
        if (trust.signature != Signature::Signed) return std::unexpected(Text::Format(IDS_DRV_BAD_PACKAGE, folder + signedFile));
    }
    return {};
}

std::wstring SignatureText(const TrustReport& t) {
    switch (t.signature) {
    case Signature::Signed: return t.signer.empty() ? L"signed" : L"signed: " + t.signer;
    case Signature::Package: return L"app package";
    case Signature::Unsigned: return L"not signed";
    case Signature::Invalid: return L"signature does not verify";
    case Signature::Unknown: return L"cannot be read";
    case Signature::Pending: break;
    }
    return L"not checked";
}

const wchar_t* StateName(DWORD state) noexcept {
    switch (state) {
    case SERVICE_STOPPED: return L"stopped";
    case SERVICE_START_PENDING: return L"starting";
    case SERVICE_STOP_PENDING: return L"stopping";
    case SERVICE_RUNNING: return L"running";
    case SERVICE_CONTINUE_PENDING: return L"continuing";
    case SERVICE_PAUSE_PENDING: return L"pausing";
    case SERVICE_PAUSED: return L"paused";
    default: return L"unknown";
    }
}

struct EmbeddedInfo {
    std::wstring version;
    TrustReport trust{Signature::Unknown};
};

const EmbeddedInfo& GetEmbeddedInfo() {
    static const EmbeddedInfo info = [] {
        EmbeddedInfo out;
        if (auto staged = DriverPackage::StagedFolder::Create()) {
            out.version = InfVersion(staged->InfPath());
            out.trust = ProcessTrust::Verify(staged->CatPath());
        }
        return out;
    }();
    return info;
}

}  // namespace

bool Status::Attached() const noexcept {
    return std::ranges::any_of(bindings, [](const Binding& b) { return b.enabled; });
}

const wchar_t* StartTypeName(StartType type) noexcept {
    switch (type) {
    case StartType::Boot: return L"boot";
    case StartType::System: return L"system";
    case StartType::Automatic: return L"automatic";
    case StartType::Manual: return L"manual";
    case StartType::Disabled: return L"disabled";
    }
    return L"unknown";
}

std::optional<StartType> ParseStartType(std::wstring_view text) noexcept {
    for (StartType t : {StartType::System, StartType::Automatic, StartType::Manual, StartType::Disabled}) {
        if (_wcsicmp(std::wstring(text).c_str(), StartTypeName(t)) == 0) return t;
    }
    if (_wcsicmp(std::wstring(text).c_str(), L"auto") == 0) return StartType::Automatic;
    if (_wcsicmp(std::wstring(text).c_str(), L"demand") == 0) return StartType::Manual;
    return std::nullopt;
}

std::optional<std::wstring> FindPackage() {
    if (DriverPackage::HasEmbeddedPackage()) return kEmbeddedPackage;
    std::wstring exe(32768, L'\0');
    exe.resize(GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, exe.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(exe.size())));
    const std::wstring folder = exe.substr(0, exe.find_last_of(L'\\'));
    for (const std::wstring& base : {folder, folder.substr(0, folder.find_last_of(L'\\'))}) {
        const std::wstring candidate = base + L"\\" + kPackageFolder + L"\\" + kInfName;
        if (GetFileAttributesW(candidate.c_str()) == INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) continue;
        std::wstring full(32768, L'\0');
        full.resize(GetFullPathNameW(candidate.c_str(), static_cast<DWORD>(full.size()), full.data(), nullptr));
        return full;
    }
    return std::nullopt;
}

Status Query(bool deviceInUse) {
    Status s;
    // Network component and its bindings.
    auto component = WithNetCfg(false, [&](INetCfg* cfg) -> std::expected<void, std::wstring> {
        ComPtr<INetCfgComponent> c;
        const HRESULT hr = cfg->FindComponent(kComponentId, &c);
        if (FAILED(hr)) return std::unexpected(ApiError(L"INetCfg::FindComponent", hr));
        if (hr != S_OK) return {};
        s.installed = true;
        LPWSTR text = nullptr;
        if (SUCCEEDED(c->GetDisplayName(&text))) s.displayName = TakeString(text);
        if (SUCCEEDED(c->GetBindName(&text))) s.bindName = TakeString(text);
        GUID instance{};
        if (SUCCEEDED(c->GetInstanceGuid(&instance))) {
            wchar_t guid[64]{};
            StringFromGUID2(instance, guid, static_cast<int>(std::size(guid)));
            s.instanceId = guid;
        }
        ForEachBinding(c.Get(), [&](INetCfgBindingPath* path) {
            s.bindings.push_back({AdapterOf(path), path->IsEnabled() == S_OK});
            return S_OK;
        });
        return {};
    });
    if (!component) s.error = component.error();
    if (!s.instanceId.empty()) {
        // What the INF told NDIS about the filter (Ndi key of the network component).
        RegKey ndi;
        const std::wstring key = L"SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Network\\{4D36E974-E325-11CE-BFC1-08002BE10318}\\" + s.instanceId + L"\\Ndi";
        if (RegOpenKeyExW(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, key.c_str(), 0, KEY_READ, ndi.put()) == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
            DWORD size = sizeof(DWORD);
            RegGetValueW(ndi.get(), nullptr, L"FilterType", RRF_RT_REG_DWORD, nullptr, &s.filterType, &size);
            size = sizeof(DWORD);
            RegGetValueW(ndi.get(), nullptr, L"FilterRunType", RRF_RT_REG_DWORD, nullptr, &s.filterRunType, &size);
            wchar_t text[128]{};
            size = sizeof text;
            if (RegGetValueW(ndi.get(), nullptr, L"FilterClass", RRF_RT_REG_SZ, nullptr, text, &size) == ERROR_SUCCESS) s.filterClass = text;
        }
    }

    // Service.
    if (const ServiceHandle service = OpenDriverService(SERVICE_QUERY_STATUS | SERVICE_QUERY_CONFIG)) {
        s.service = true;
        SERVICE_STATUS_PROCESS status{};
        DWORD needed = 0;
        if (QueryServiceStatusEx(service.get(), SC_STATUS_PROCESS_INFO, reinterpret_cast<BYTE*>(&status), sizeof status, &needed)) {
            s.state = status.dwCurrentState;
        }
        QueryServiceConfigW(service.get(), nullptr, 0, &needed);
        std::vector<BYTE> buffer(needed);
        if (needed && QueryServiceConfigW(service.get(), reinterpret_cast<QUERY_SERVICE_CONFIGW*>(buffer.data()), needed, &needed)) {
            const auto* config = reinterpret_cast<const QUERY_SERVICE_CONFIGW*>(buffer.data());
            s.startType = static_cast<StartType>(config->dwStartType);
            if (config->lpBinaryPathName) s.file = DriverFilePath(config->lpBinaryPathName);
        }
        if (!s.file.empty()) {
            s.fileVersion = FileVersion(s.file);
            s.fileTrust = ProcessTrust::Verify(s.file);
        }
    }
    RegKey parameters;
    if (RegOpenKeyExW(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, L"SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\wsddntf\\Parameters", 0, KEY_READ, parameters.put()) ==
        ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        for (DWORD i = 0;; ++i) {
            wchar_t name[256]{};
            BYTE data[512]{};
            DWORD nameLength = static_cast<DWORD>(std::size(name)), type = 0, size = sizeof data;
            if (RegEnumValueW(parameters.get(), i, name, &nameLength, nullptr, &type, data, &size) != ERROR_SUCCESS) break;
            std::wstring value;
            if (type == REG_DWORD && size == sizeof(DWORD)) value = std::to_wstring(*reinterpret_cast<const DWORD*>(data));
            else if (type == REG_SZ || type == REG_EXPAND_SZ) value = std::wstring(reinterpret_cast<const wchar_t*>(data), size / sizeof(wchar_t)).c_str();
            else value = std::format(L"({} bytes, type {})", size, type);
            s.parameters.emplace_back(name, value);
        }
    }

    s.staged = Staged();

    // Control device.
    if (deviceInUse) {
        s.deviceOpens = true;
    } else {
        const FileHandle device(CreateFileW(kDevicePath, GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, nullptr));
        s.deviceOpens = static_cast<bool>(device);
        if (!device) s.deviceError = GetLastError();
    }

    // The embedded or side-by-side driver package.
    s.package = FindPackage();
    if (s.package) {
        if (*s.package == kEmbeddedPackage) {
            const EmbeddedInfo& embedded = GetEmbeddedInfo();
            s.packageVersion = embedded.version;
            s.packageTrust = embedded.trust;
        } else {
            s.packageVersion = InfVersion(*s.package);
            s.packageTrust = ProcessTrust::Verify(s.package->substr(0, s.package->find_last_of(L'\\') + 1) + L"wsddntf.cat");
        }
    }
    return s;
}

std::vector<std::pair<std::wstring, std::wstring>> Report(const Status& s) {
    std::vector<std::pair<std::wstring, std::wstring>> r;
    r.emplace_back(L"Component", s.installed ? std::format(L"{}  installed", kComponentId) : std::format(L"{}  not installed", kComponentId));
    if (s.installed) {
        r.emplace_back(L"  Name", s.displayName);
        r.emplace_back(L"  Instance", s.instanceId);
        r.emplace_back(L"  Bind name", s.bindName);
        if (s.filterRunType) {
            const wchar_t* type = s.filterType == 2 ? L"modifying" : s.filterType == 1 ? L"monitoring" : L"unknown type";
            const wchar_t* run = s.filterRunType == 1 ? L"mandatory: an adapter it is attached to carries no traffic without it"
                                                      : L"optional: traffic goes around it when it is not running";
            r.emplace_back(L"  Filter", std::format(L"{}, class {}, {}", type, s.filterClass, run));
        }
        const auto attached = std::ranges::count_if(s.bindings, [](const Binding& b) { return b.enabled; });
        r.emplace_back(L"  Bindings", s.bindings.empty() ? std::wstring(L"none reported")
                                                         : std::format(L"attached to {} of {} adapters", attached, s.bindings.size()));
    }
    if (s.service) {
        r.emplace_back(L"Service", std::format(L"{}  {}, start {}", kServiceName, StateName(s.state), StartTypeName(s.startType)));
        r.emplace_back(L"  File", s.fileVersion.empty() ? s.file : std::format(L"{}  {}", s.file, s.fileVersion));
        r.emplace_back(L"  Signature", SignatureText(s.fileTrust));
        for (const auto& [name, value] : s.parameters) r.emplace_back(L"  Parameter", std::format(L"{} = {}", name, value));
    } else {
        r.emplace_back(L"Service", std::format(L"{}  not present", kServiceName));
    }
    if (s.staged.empty()) r.emplace_back(L"Driver store", std::format(L"no copy of {}", kInfName));
    for (const StagedPackage& p : s.staged) r.emplace_back(L"Driver store", std::format(L"{}  {}", p.name, p.version));
    std::wstring device = L"opens";
    if (!s.deviceOpens) {
        // Without a running driver there is no device: that is the state, not an error.
        device = !s.installed  ? std::wstring(L"absent: the driver is not installed")
                 : !s.Running() ? std::wstring(L"absent while the driver is stopped")
                                : std::format(L"error {}: {}", s.deviceError, FormatError(s.deviceError));
    }
    r.emplace_back(L"Device", std::format(L"{}  {}", kDevicePath, device));
    if (s.package) {
        r.emplace_back(L"Package", std::format(L"{}  {}", *s.package, s.packageVersion));
        r.emplace_back(L"  Catalog", SignatureText(s.packageTrust));
    } else {
        r.emplace_back(L"Package", std::format(L"none in {}\\ next to WireScope.exe or one folder up", kPackageFolder));
    }
    if (!s.error.empty()) r.emplace_back(L"Incomplete", s.error);
    // Long and least telling (Windows keeps adapters that are gone): last, so the rest stays in view.
    if (!s.bindings.empty()) r.emplace_back(L"Bindings", std::format(L"{} adapters", s.bindings.size()));
    for (const Binding& b : s.bindings) r.emplace_back(L"  Adapter", std::format(L"{}  {}", b.enabled ? L"attached" : L"detached", b.adapter));
    return r;
}

bool WaitForDevice(DWORD timeoutMs) {
    const uint64_t deadline = GetTickCount64() + timeoutMs;
    for (;;) {
        const FileHandle device(CreateFileW(kDevicePath, GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, nullptr));
        if (device) return true;
        if (GetTickCount64() >= deadline) return false;
        Sleep(200);
    }
}

std::expected<Outcome, std::wstring> Install(const std::wstring& inf) {
    std::optional<DriverPackage::StagedFolder> staged;
    std::wstring actualInf = inf;
    if (actualInf.empty() || actualInf == kEmbeddedPackage) {
        auto extracted = DriverPackage::StagedFolder::Create();
        if (!extracted) return std::unexpected(extracted.error());
        staged = std::move(*extracted);
        actualInf = staged->InfPath();
    }
    if (auto ok = CheckPackage(actualInf); !ok) return std::unexpected(ok.error());
    std::wstring published(MAX_PATH, L'\0');
    if (!SetupCopyOEMInfW(actualInf.c_str(), nullptr, SPOST_PATH, 0, published.data(), MAX_PATH, nullptr, nullptr)) {
        return std::unexpected(Win32Error(L"SetupCopyOEMInf"));
    }
    published.resize(wcslen(published.c_str()));
    auto installed = WithNetCfg(true, [&](INetCfg* cfg) -> std::expected<Outcome, std::wstring> {
        ComPtr<INetCfgComponent> existing;
        if (cfg->FindComponent(kComponentId, &existing) == S_OK) return std::unexpected(Text::Get(IDS_DRV_ALREADY));
        ComPtr<INetCfgClassSetup> setup;
        HRESULT hr = cfg->QueryNetCfgClass(&kNetServiceClass, IID_PPV_ARGS(&setup));
        if (FAILED(hr)) return std::unexpected(ApiError(L"INetCfg::QueryNetCfgClass", hr));
        OBO_TOKEN obo{};
        obo.Type = OBO_USER;
        ComPtr<INetCfgComponent> component;
        hr = setup->Install(kComponentId, &obo, 0, 0, nullptr, nullptr, &component);
        if (FAILED(hr)) {
            cfg->Cancel();
            return std::unexpected(ApiError(L"INetCfgClassSetup::Install", hr));
        }
        Outcome out;
        out.reboot = hr == NETCFG_S_REBOOT;
        hr = cfg->Apply();
        if (FAILED(hr)) {
            cfg->Cancel();
            return std::unexpected(ApiError(L"INetCfg::Apply", hr));
        }
        out.reboot = out.reboot || hr == NETCFG_S_REBOOT;
        out.notes.push_back(Text::Format(IDS_DRV_STAGED, published.substr(published.find_last_of(L'\\') + 1)));
        return out;
    });
    if (!installed) return installed;
    // A mandatory filter that does not answer may keep the adapters down: take it out again.
    if (!installed->reboot && !WaitForDevice(kDeviceTimeoutMs)) {
        const DWORD error = GetLastError();
        auto undone = Uninstall();
        return std::unexpected(Text::Format(IDS_DRV_ROLLED_BACK, FormatError(error)) + (undone ? std::wstring() : L"\n" + undone.error()));
    }
    return installed;
}

std::expected<Outcome, std::wstring> Uninstall() {
    auto removed = WithNetCfg(true, [&](INetCfg* cfg) -> std::expected<Outcome, std::wstring> {
        Outcome out;
        ComPtr<INetCfgComponent> component;
        HRESULT hr = cfg->FindComponent(kComponentId, &component);
        if (FAILED(hr)) return std::unexpected(ApiError(L"INetCfg::FindComponent", hr));
        if (hr != S_OK) return out;  // not installed: only the driver store is left to clean
        ComPtr<INetCfgClassSetup> setup;
        if (hr = cfg->QueryNetCfgClass(&kNetServiceClass, IID_PPV_ARGS(&setup)); FAILED(hr)) {
            return std::unexpected(ApiError(L"INetCfg::QueryNetCfgClass", hr));
        }
        OBO_TOKEN obo{};
        obo.Type = OBO_USER;
        hr = setup->DeInstall(component.Get(), &obo, nullptr);
        if (FAILED(hr)) {
            cfg->Cancel();
            return std::unexpected(ApiError(L"INetCfgClassSetup::DeInstall", hr));
        }
        if (hr == NETCFG_S_STILL_REFERENCED) out.notes.push_back(Text::Get(IDS_DRV_STILL_REFERENCED));
        out.reboot = hr == NETCFG_S_REBOOT;
        hr = cfg->Apply();
        if (FAILED(hr)) {
            cfg->Cancel();
            return std::unexpected(ApiError(L"INetCfg::Apply", hr));
        }
        out.reboot = out.reboot || hr == NETCFG_S_REBOOT;
        return out;
    });
    if (!removed) return removed;
    // Complete cleanup: every staged copy, also those of older installations.
    for (const StagedPackage& p : Staged()) {
        if (SetupUninstallOEMInfW(p.name.c_str(), 0, nullptr)) {
            removed->notes.push_back(Text::Format(IDS_DRV_STORE_DELETED, p.name));
        } else {
            removed->notes.push_back(Text::Format(IDS_DRV_STORE_LEFT, p.name, FormatError()));
        }
    }
    return removed;
}

std::expected<Outcome, std::wstring> Attach(bool enabled) {
    return WithNetCfg(true, [&](INetCfg* cfg) -> std::expected<Outcome, std::wstring> {
        ComPtr<INetCfgComponent> component;
        HRESULT hr = cfg->FindComponent(kComponentId, &component);
        if (FAILED(hr)) return std::unexpected(ApiError(L"INetCfg::FindComponent", hr));
        if (hr != S_OK) return std::unexpected(Text::Get(IDS_DRV_NOT_INSTALLED));
        size_t changed = 0;
        hr = ForEachBinding(component.Get(), [&](INetCfgBindingPath* path) {
            if ((path->IsEnabled() == S_OK) == enabled) return S_OK;
            ++changed;
            return path->Enable(enabled ? TRUE : FALSE);
        });
        if (FAILED(hr)) {
            cfg->Cancel();
            return std::unexpected(ApiError(L"INetCfgBindingPath::Enable", hr));
        }
        Outcome out;
        if (changed == 0) return out;
        hr = cfg->Apply();
        if (FAILED(hr)) {
            cfg->Cancel();
            return std::unexpected(ApiError(L"INetCfg::Apply", hr));
        }
        out.reboot = hr == NETCFG_S_REBOOT;
        return out;
    });
}

namespace {

std::expected<void, std::wstring> ServiceStart() {
    const ServiceHandle service = OpenDriverService(SERVICE_START | SERVICE_QUERY_STATUS);
    if (!service) return std::unexpected(Win32Error(L"OpenService"));
    if (!StartServiceW(service.get(), 0, nullptr)) {
        const DWORD error = GetLastError();
        if (error == ERROR_SERVICE_DISABLED) return std::unexpected(Text::Get(IDS_DRV_DISABLED));
        if (error != ERROR_SERVICE_ALREADY_RUNNING) return std::unexpected(Win32Error(L"StartService", error));
    }
    if (!WaitForState(service.get(), SERVICE_RUNNING, kServiceTimeoutMs)) return std::unexpected(Text::Get(IDS_DRV_TIMEOUT));
    return {};
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> ServiceStop() {
    const ServiceHandle service = OpenDriverService(SERVICE_STOP | SERVICE_QUERY_STATUS);
    if (!service) return std::unexpected(Win32Error(L"OpenService"));
    SERVICE_STATUS status{};
    if (!ControlService(service.get(), SERVICE_CONTROL_STOP, &status)) {
        const DWORD error = GetLastError();
        if (error != ERROR_SERVICE_NOT_ACTIVE) return std::unexpected(Win32Error(L"ControlService(STOP)", error));
    }
    if (!WaitForState(service.get(), SERVICE_STOPPED, kServiceTimeoutMs)) return std::unexpected(Text::Get(IDS_DRV_TIMEOUT));
    return {};
}

}  // namespace

std::expected<Outcome, std::wstring> Start() {
    if (auto started = ServiceStart(); !started) return std::unexpected(started.error());
    auto attached = Attach(true);
    if (!attached) return attached;
    if (!attached->reboot && !WaitForDevice(kDeviceTimeoutMs)) return std::unexpected(Text::Get(IDS_DRV_SILENT));
    return attached;
}

std::expected<Outcome, std::wstring> Stop() {
    // Detached first: a mandatory filter that stops while still attached holds the adapters' traffic
    // (sc stop does exactly that). Detached, the adapters run without it and the network keeps working.
    auto detached = Attach(false);
    if (!detached) return detached;
    if (auto stopped = ServiceStop(); !stopped) return std::unexpected(stopped.error());
    return detached;
}

std::expected<Outcome, std::wstring> SetStartType(StartType type) {
    Outcome out;
    if (type == StartType::Disabled) {
        // Disabled but still attached, a mandatory filter could keep the adapters down at boot.
        auto stopped = Stop();
        if (!stopped) return stopped;
        out = *stopped;
    }
    const ServiceHandle service = OpenDriverService(SERVICE_CHANGE_CONFIG);
    if (!service) return std::unexpected(Win32Error(L"OpenService"));
    if (!ChangeServiceConfigW(service.get(), SERVICE_NO_CHANGE, static_cast<DWORD>(type), SERVICE_NO_CHANGE, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr,
                              nullptr, nullptr, nullptr)) {
        return std::unexpected(Win32Error(L"ChangeServiceConfig"));
    }
    return out;
}

} // namespace WS::DriverSetup
```

`src/core/DriverSetup.h`:

```h
// WireScope - Installs, removes, starts, stops and inspects the WinpkFilter network driver (wsddntf)
// through the Windows APIs that netcfg.exe, pnputil.exe and sc.exe wrap - no external program runs:
//
//   install     SetupCopyOEMInfW stages the package in the driver store       (netcfg -l wsddntf.inf)
//               INetCfgClassSetup::Install adds the NDIS filter                (netcfg -c s -i nt_wsddntf)
//   uninstall   INetCfgClassSetup::DeInstall removes the filter                (netcfg -u nt_wsddntf)
//               SetupUninstallOEMInfW deletes every staged copy of the package (pnputil /delete-driver oemNN.inf)
//   attach      INetCfgBindingPath::Enable on every adapter: the filter's tick in the adapter properties
//   start       the service starts, then the filter is attached again          (sc start wsddntf)
//   stop        the filter is detached from every adapter, then the service stops (sc stop wsddntf)
//   start type  ChangeServiceConfigW                                           (sc config wsddntf start= ...)
//
// Adding, removing, attaching or stopping a filter restarts the network adapters it sits on: the
// network is gone for a few seconds. wsddntf is a mandatory filter (FilterRunType 1): an adapter it is
// attached to carries no traffic without it: stopped while still attached (plain sc stop), it holds
// the network - measured: Wi-Fi stays associated, IP traffic stops until the driver starts again.
// Hence the rules here: an installation the driver does not answer is rolled back, Stop detaches
// the filter from every adapter before the service stops (the network keeps working without it),
// Start attaches it again, and "disabled" stops it that way first. Stopped and installed is a
// normal state; the filter stays detached, also across a reboot, until Start.
//
// The calls need administrator rights and a COM single-threaded apartment, which they set up for the
// calling thread. Everything but Query changes the system; the GUI runs them on a worker thread.
#pragma once
#include "core/ProcessTrust.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <expected>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace WS::DriverSetup {

inline constexpr wchar_t kComponentId[] = L"nt_wsddntf";
inline constexpr wchar_t kServiceName[] = L"wsddntf";
inline constexpr wchar_t kInfName[] = L"wsddntf.inf";
inline constexpr wchar_t kDevicePath[] = L"\\\\.\\wsddntf";
// Where the package is looked for: embedded inside WireScope.exe (WireScope.bmp), then next to
// WireScope.exe or one level up (bin\..\rsc in the repository).
inline constexpr wchar_t kEmbeddedPackage[] = L"embedded WireScope.bmp";
inline constexpr wchar_t kPackageFolder[] = L"rsc";

// SERVICE_*_START values.
enum class StartType : DWORD { Boot = 0, System = 1, Automatic = 2, Manual = 3, Disabled = 4 };

struct Binding {
    std::wstring adapter;
    bool enabled{false};
};

struct StagedPackage {
    std::wstring name;     // oemNN.inf
    std::wstring version;  // DriverVer: date,version
};

struct Status {
    // Network component (INetCfg)
    bool installed{false};
    std::wstring displayName, instanceId, bindName;
    std::wstring filterClass;  // Ndi: where NDIS puts it in the stack ("compression")
    DWORD filterType{0};       // 1 monitoring, 2 modifying
    DWORD filterRunType{0};    // 1 mandatory, 2 optional
    std::vector<Binding> bindings;
    // Service (SCM)
    bool service{false};
    DWORD state{0};  // SERVICE_RUNNING, SERVICE_STOPPED ...
    StartType startType{StartType::Disabled};
    std::wstring file, fileVersion;
    TrustReport fileTrust{Signature::Unknown};
    std::vector<std::pair<std::wstring, std::wstring>> parameters;  // ...\Services\wsddntf\Parameters
    // Driver store
    std::vector<StagedPackage> staged;
    // Control device
    bool deviceOpens{false};
    DWORD deviceError{0};
    // The package WireScope would install
    std::optional<std::wstring> package;
    std::wstring packageVersion;
    TrustReport packageTrust{Signature::Unknown};
    std::wstring error;  // what could not be read (INetCfg busy ...), empty when complete

    [[nodiscard]] bool Running() const noexcept { return service && state == SERVICE_RUNNING; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool Attached() const noexcept;  // enabled on at least one adapter
};

struct Outcome {
    bool reboot{false};               // Windows asks for a restart to finish
    std::vector<std::wstring> notes;  // things worth telling (staged as oemNN.inf, a copy left in the store ...)
};

[[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::wstring> FindPackage();
// Read-only; `deviceInUse` = WireScope itself holds the control device open (it then counts as opening).
[[nodiscard]] Status Query(bool deviceInUse = false);
// The engineering report: label, value. English, like the command line.
[[nodiscard]] std::vector<std::pair<std::wstring, std::wstring>> Report(const Status& status);

[[nodiscard]] std::expected<Outcome, std::wstring> Install(const std::wstring& inf);  // rolls back if the driver stays silent
[[nodiscard]] std::expected<Outcome, std::wstring> Uninstall();
[[nodiscard]] std::expected<Outcome, std::wstring> Attach(bool enabled);  // every adapter at once
[[nodiscard]] std::expected<Outcome, std::wstring> Start();  // service, attach, wait for the device
[[nodiscard]] std::expected<Outcome, std::wstring> Stop();   // detach, then stop the service
// Disabled detaches and stops the driver first (see above); the other types leave its state alone.
```

`src/core/FilterAbi.h`:

```h
// WireScope - WinpkFilter static filter ABI (IOCTL_SET_PACKET_FILTERS / IOCTL_GET_PACKET_FILTERS).
//
// The driver packs every structure to one byte, like INTERMEDIATE_BUFFER. The table that crosses the
// IOCTL boundary is a STATIC_FILTER_TABLE_HEADER followed by m_TableSize STATIC_FILTER entries.
// DriverBridge checks the size the driver reports against these definitions before trusting a table.
//
// Byte order: IPv4 addresses and masks are in network order (as inet_addr returns them), IPv6 as the
// 16 wire bytes, ports and ICMP types in host order.
#pragma once
#include <Windows.h>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>

namespace WS {

// STATIC_FILTER::m_ValidFields
inline constexpr DWORD DATA_LINK_LAYER_VALID = 0x00000001;
inline constexpr DWORD NETWORK_LAYER_VALID   = 0x00000002;
inline constexpr DWORD TRANSPORT_LAYER_VALID = 0x00000004;

// Union selectors
inline constexpr DWORD FILTER_LINK_ETH_802_3 = 0x00000001;
inline constexpr DWORD FILTER_NET_IPV4       = 0x00000001;
inline constexpr DWORD FILTER_NET_IPV6       = 0x00000002;
inline constexpr DWORD FILTER_TRANSPORT_TCPUDP = 0x00000001;
inline constexpr DWORD FILTER_TRANSPORT_ICMP   = 0x00000002;

// Address kinds
inline constexpr DWORD IP_SUBNET_TYPE = 0x00000001;
inline constexpr DWORD IP_RANGE_TYPE  = 0x00000002;

// IP_V4_FILTER / IP_V6_FILTER::m_ValidFields
inline constexpr DWORD IP_FILTER_SRC_ADDRESS  = 0x00000001;
inline constexpr DWORD IP_FILTER_DEST_ADDRESS = 0x00000002;
inline constexpr DWORD IP_FILTER_PROTOCOL     = 0x00000004;

// TCPUDP_FILTER::m_ValidFields
inline constexpr DWORD TCPUDP_SRC_PORT  = 0x00000001;
inline constexpr DWORD TCPUDP_DEST_PORT = 0x00000002;
inline constexpr DWORD TCPUDP_TCP_FLAGS = 0x00000004;

// ICMP_TYPE_FILTER::m_ValidFields
inline constexpr DWORD ICMP_FILTER_TYPE = 0x00000001;
inline constexpr DWORD ICMP_FILTER_CODE = 0x00000002;

#pragma pack(push, 1)

struct ETH_802_3_FILTER {
    DWORD m_ValidFields;
    BYTE  m_SrcAddress[6];
    BYTE  m_DestAddress[6];
    WORD  m_Protocol;
    WORD  Padding;
};
static_assert(sizeof(ETH_802_3_FILTER) == 20);

struct IP_SUBNET_V4 {
    DWORD m_Ip;
    DWORD m_IpMask;
};
struct IP_RANGE_V4 {
    DWORD m_StartIp;
    DWORD m_EndIp;
};
struct IP_ADDRESS_V4 {
    DWORD m_AddressType;
    union {
        IP_SUBNET_V4 m_IpSubnet;
        IP_RANGE_V4  m_IpRange;
    };
};
static_assert(sizeof(IP_ADDRESS_V4) == 12);

struct IP_V4_FILTER {
    DWORD         m_ValidFields;
    IP_ADDRESS_V4 m_SrcAddress;
    IP_ADDRESS_V4 m_DestAddress;
    BYTE          m_Protocol;
    BYTE          Padding[3];
};
static_assert(sizeof(IP_V4_FILTER) == 32);

struct IP_SUBNET_V6 {
    BYTE m_Ip[16];
    BYTE m_IpMask[16];
};
struct IP_RANGE_V6 {
    BYTE m_StartIp[16];
    BYTE m_EndIp[16];
};
struct IP_ADDRESS_V6 {
    DWORD m_AddressType;
    union {
        IP_SUBNET_V6 m_IpSubnet;
        IP_RANGE_V6  m_IpRange;
    };
};
static_assert(sizeof(IP_ADDRESS_V6) == 36);

struct IP_V6_FILTER {
    DWORD         m_ValidFields;
    IP_ADDRESS_V6 m_SrcAddress;
    IP_ADDRESS_V6 m_DestAddress;
    BYTE          m_Protocol;
    BYTE          Padding[3];
};
static_assert(sizeof(IP_V6_FILTER) == 80);

struct PORT_RANGE {
    WORD m_StartRange;
    WORD m_EndRange;
};

struct TCPUDP_FILTER {
    DWORD      m_ValidFields;
    PORT_RANGE m_SourcePort;
    PORT_RANGE m_DestPort;
    BYTE       m_TCPFlags;
};
static_assert(sizeof(TCPUDP_FILTER) == 13);

struct BYTE_RANGE {
    BYTE m_StartRange;
    BYTE m_EndRange;
};

struct ICMP_TYPE_FILTER {
    DWORD      m_ValidFields;
    BYTE_RANGE m_TypeRange;
    BYTE_RANGE m_CodeRange;
};
static_assert(sizeof(ICMP_TYPE_FILTER) == 8);

struct DATA_LINK_LAYER_FILTER {
    DWORD m_dwUnionSelector;
    union {
        ETH_802_3_FILTER m_Eth8023Filter;
    };
};
static_assert(sizeof(DATA_LINK_LAYER_FILTER) == 24);

struct NETWORK_LAYER_FILTER {
    DWORD m_dwUnionSelector;
    union {
        IP_V4_FILTER m_IPv4;
        IP_V6_FILTER m_IPv6;
    };
};
static_assert(sizeof(NETWORK_LAYER_FILTER) == 84);

struct TRANSPORT_LAYER_FILTER {
    DWORD m_dwUnionSelector;
    union {
        TCPUDP_FILTER    m_TcpUdp;
        ICMP_TYPE_FILTER m_Icmp;
    };
};
static_assert(sizeof(TRANSPORT_LAYER_FILTER) == 17);

struct STATIC_FILTER {
    uint64_t m_Adapter;           // +0x00 adapter handle widened to 64 bits; 0 = every adapter
    DWORD    m_dwDirectionFlags;  // +0x08 PACKET_FLAG_ON_SEND | PACKET_FLAG_ON_RECEIVE
    DWORD    m_FilterAction;      // +0x0C FILTER_ACTION_*
    DWORD    m_ValidFields;       // +0x10 *_LAYER_VALID

    // Statistics maintained by the driver (reset whenever the table is written)
    DWORD    m_LastReset;         // +0x14 seconds since 1 Jan 1980
    uint64_t m_PacketsIn;         // +0x18
    uint64_t m_BytesIn;           // +0x20
    uint64_t m_PacketsOut;        // +0x28
    uint64_t m_BytesOut;          // +0x30

    DATA_LINK_LAYER_FILTER m_DataLinkFilter;    // +0x38
    NETWORK_LAYER_FILTER   m_NetworkFilter;     // +0x50
    TRANSPORT_LAYER_FILTER m_TransportFilter;   // +0xA4
};
static_assert(sizeof(STATIC_FILTER) == 181, "STATIC_FILTER must match wsddntf.sys (181 bytes)");
static_assert(offsetof(STATIC_FILTER, m_ValidFields) == 0x10);
static_assert(offsetof(STATIC_FILTER, m_LastReset) == 0x14);
static_assert(offsetof(STATIC_FILTER, m_DataLinkFilter) == 0x38);
static_assert(offsetof(STATIC_FILTER, m_NetworkFilter) == 0x50);
static_assert(offsetof(STATIC_FILTER, m_TransportFilter) == 0xA4);

struct STATIC_FILTER_TABLE_HEADER {
    DWORD m_TableSize;  // number of STATIC_FILTER entries that follow at offset +0x04
};
static_assert(sizeof(STATIC_FILTER_TABLE_HEADER) == 4);

#pragma pack(pop)

} // namespace WS
```

`src/core/FrameView.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/FrameView.h"
#include <algorithm>

namespace WS {

namespace {

uint16_t Be16(std::span<const uint8_t> s, size_t at) noexcept {
    return static_cast<uint16_t>((s[at] << 8) | s[at + 1]);
}

uint32_t Be32(std::span<const uint8_t> s, size_t at) noexcept {
    return (static_cast<uint32_t>(s[at]) << 24) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(s[at + 1]) << 16) |
           (static_cast<uint32_t>(s[at + 2]) << 8) | s[at + 3];
}

void InspectTransport(std::span<const uint8_t> l4, FrameInfo& out) noexcept {
    if (out.fragment) return;
    switch (out.protocol) {
    case 6:   // TCP
    case 17:  // UDP
        if (l4.size() >= 4) {
            out.hasPorts = true;
            out.srcPort = Be16(l4, 0);
            out.dstPort = Be16(l4, 2);
        }
        break;
    case 1:   // ICMP
    case 58:  // ICMPv6
        if (l4.size() >= 2) {
            out.hasIcmp = true;
            out.icmpType = l4[0];
            out.icmpCode = l4[1];
        }
        break;
    default:
        break;
    }
}

} // namespace

FrameInfo InspectFrame(std::span<const uint8_t> frame) noexcept {
    FrameInfo out;
    if (frame.size() < 14) return out;
    size_t offset = 12;
    uint16_t etherType = Be16(frame, offset);
    offset += 2;
    // 802.1Q / 802.1ad tags (the driver normally strips them, but tolerate one or two)
    for (int tags = 0; tags < 2 && (etherType == 0x8100 || etherType == 0x88A8); ++tags) {
        if (frame.size() < offset + 4) return out;
        etherType = Be16(frame, offset + 2);
        offset += 4;
    }
    const auto l3 = frame.subspan(offset);

    if (etherType == 0x0800) {
        if (l3.size() < 20 || (l3[0] >> 4) != 4) return out;
        const size_t ihl = static_cast<size_t>(l3[0] & 0x0F) * 4;
        if (ihl < 20 || l3.size() < ihl) return out;
        out.ip = true;
        out.version = 4;
        out.protocol = l3[9];
        out.fragment = (Be16(l3, 6) & 0x1FFF) != 0;
        out.src4 = Be32(l3, 12);
        out.dst4 = Be32(l3, 16);
        InspectTransport(l3.subspan(ihl), out);
    } else if (etherType == 0x86DD) {
        if (l3.size() < 40 || (l3[0] >> 4) != 6) return out;
        out.ip = true;
        out.version = 6;
        std::copy_n(l3.begin() + 8, 16, out.src6.begin());
        std::copy_n(l3.begin() + 24, 16, out.dst6.begin());
        uint8_t next = l3[6];
        size_t at = 40;
        // Walk the common extension headers to the upper-layer protocol.
        for (int hops = 0; hops < 8; ++hops) {
            if (next == 0 || next == 43 || next == 60) {  // hop-by-hop, routing, destination options
                if (l3.size() < at + 8) return out;
                const uint8_t following = l3[at];
                at += (static_cast<size_t>(l3[at + 1]) + 1) * 8;
                next = following;
            } else if (next == 44) {  // fragment
                if (l3.size() < at + 8) return out;
                out.fragment = (Be16(l3, at + 2) & 0xFFF8) != 0;
                next = l3[at];
                at += 8;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        out.protocol = next;
        if (at <= l3.size()) InspectTransport(l3.subspan(at), out);
    }
    return out;
}

} // namespace WS

```

```h
// WireScope - Minimal, allocation-free view of the fields rules match on (L2 -> L4).
// Used on the data path (impairment selector), so it never throws and never allocates.
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>

namespace WS {

struct ProcessInfo;

struct FrameInfo {
    bool     ip{false};
    uint8_t  version{0};     // 4 or 6
    uint8_t  protocol{0};    // IP protocol / IPv6 upper-layer header
    bool     fragment{false};  // non-first fragment: no L4 header
    uint32_t src4{0};        // host byte order
    uint32_t dst4{0};
    std::array<uint8_t, 16> src6{};
    std::array<uint8_t, 16> dst6{};
    bool     hasPorts{false};
    uint16_t srcPort{0};
    uint16_t dstPort{0};
    bool     hasIcmp{false};
    uint8_t  icmpType{0};
    uint8_t  icmpCode{0};
    // Owning process, set by the packet engine from a ProcessMapper snapshot (nullptr = unknown).
    const ProcessInfo* process{nullptr};
};
```

`src/core/Impairment.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/Impairment.h"
#include "resources/resource.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <cmath>
#include <format>

namespace WS {

namespace {

constexpr ImpairmentPreset kPresets[] = {
    {IDS_PRESET_BROADBAND, 25, 5, 0.0, 100'000},
    {IDS_PRESET_WIFI, 60, 40, 2.0, 20'000},
    {IDS_PRESET_LTE, 70, 20, 0.5, 10'000},
    {IDS_PRESET_3G, 200, 80, 2.0, 384},
    {IDS_PRESET_INTERCONT, 180, 15, 0.1, 50'000},
    {IDS_PRESET_SATELLITE, 600, 50, 1.0, 2'000},
    {IDS_PRESET_LOSS5, 0, 0, 5.0, 0},
    {IDS_PRESET_LOSS15, 0, 0, 15.0, 0},
};

} // namespace

std::span<const ImpairmentPreset> ImpairmentPresets() noexcept {
    return kPresets;
}

std::expected<Selector, std::string> ImpairmentSelector(const ImpairmentProfile& p) {
    if (p.latencyMs > kMaxLatencyMs) return std::unexpected(ToUtf8(Text::Format(IDS_SIM_ERR_LATENCY, kMaxLatencyMs)));
    if (p.jitterMs > kMaxJitterMs) return std::unexpected(ToUtf8(Text::Format(IDS_SIM_ERR_JITTER, kMaxJitterMs)));
    if (!(p.lossPercent >= 0.0 && p.lossPercent <= 100.0)) return std::unexpected(ToUtf8(Text::Get(IDS_SIM_ERR_LOSS)));
    auto selector = ParseSelector(p.match);
    if (!selector) return std::unexpected(ToUtf8(Text::Format(IDS_SIM_ERR_MATCH, ToWide(selector.error()))));
    // The profile's own direction narrows the selector's.
    selector->dir = static_cast<Dir>(static_cast<uint8_t>(selector->dir) & static_cast<uint8_t>(p.dir));
    if (selector->dir == Dir::None) return std::unexpected(ToUtf8(Text::Get(IDS_SIM_ERR_DIRECTION)));
    return selector;
}

Impairer::Impairer() : m_rng(std::random_device{}()) {}

void Impairer::Configure(const ImpairmentProfile& profile, const Selector& match) {
    const bool timingChanged = profile.latencyMs != m_profile.latencyMs || profile.jitterMs != m_profile.jitterMs ||
                               profile.rateKbps != m_profile.rateKbps;
    m_profile = profile;
    m_match = match;
    m_all = match.dir == Dir::Both && match.MatchesAllFrames();
    if (timingChanged) ResetOrdering();
}

bool Impairer::Selects(const FrameInfo& frame, Dir dir) const noexcept {
    return m_all || Matches(m_match, frame, dir);
}

Impairer::Decision Impairer::Decide(Dir dir, size_t packetBytes, uint64_t nowUs) noexcept {
    Decision d;
    if (m_profile.lossPercent > 0.0 && m_unit(m_rng) * 100.0 < m_profile.lossPercent) {
        d.verdict = Verdict::Drop;
        return d;
    }

    const size_t dirIdx = (dir == Dir::Out) ? 1 : 0;
    uint64_t baseDue = nowUs;

    // Token bucket bandwidth shaper (paces packets according to configured rate in kbps)
    if (m_profile.rateKbps > 0) {
        uint64_t& nextAvail = m_nextAvailableUs[dirIdx];
        if (nextAvail < nowUs) {
            nextAvail = nowUs;
        }
        // Drop-tail buffer management: if queue depth exceeds 2000 ms, drop incoming packets
        constexpr uint64_t kMaxQueueDelayUs = 2'000'000ULL;
        if (nextAvail - nowUs > kMaxQueueDelayUs) {
            d.verdict = Verdict::Overflow;
            return d;
        }
        // transmitUs = (packetBytes * 8 * 1'000'000) / (rateKbps * 1000) = (packetBytes * 8'000) / rateKbps
        const uint64_t transmitUs = (static_cast<uint64_t>(packetBytes) * 8'000ULL) / m_profile.rateKbps;
        nextAvail += transmitUs;
        baseDue = nextAvail;
    }

    double delayMs = static_cast<double>(m_profile.latencyMs);
    if (m_profile.jitterMs > 0) delayMs += (m_unit(m_rng) * 2.0 - 1.0) * static_cast<double>(m_profile.jitterMs);
    if (delayMs <= 0.0 && m_profile.rateKbps == 0 && !m_profile.preserveOrder) return d;  // nothing to add

    uint64_t due = baseDue + static_cast<uint64_t>(std::llround(std::max(delayMs, 0.0) * 1000.0));
    uint64_t& last = m_lastDue[dirIdx];
    if (m_profile.preserveOrder) {
        if (due < last) due = last;
        last = due;
    }
    if (due <= nowUs) return d;  // no delay and nothing queued ahead of it
    d.verdict = Verdict::Delay;
    d.dueUs = due;
    d.delayUs = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::min<uint64_t>(due - nowUs, UINT32_MAX));
    return d;
}

} // namespace WS

```

`src/core/Impairment.h`:

```h
// WireScope - Network impairment simulator: latency, jitter and random loss for QA testing.
//
// Runs on the packet engine's worker thread while the adapter is in tunnel mode. Each packet that
// matches the profile's traffic selector is dropped with probability lossPercent, otherwise held in a
// DelayLine for latency +/- jitter (uniform) and re-injected when due. With preserveOrder the release
// times never go backwards within one direction, so jitter does not reorder a flow (like a real queue).
#pragma once
#include "core/PacketTypes.h"
#include "core/Rules.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <random>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace WS {

struct ImpairmentProfile {
    bool        enabled{false};
    uint32_t    latencyMs{0};
    uint32_t    jitterMs{0};
    double      lossPercent{0.0};  // 0..100
    uint32_t    rateKbps{0};       // 0 = unlimited, otherwise in kbps (e.g. 128, 1024)
    Dir         dir{Dir::Both};
    bool        preserveOrder{true};
    std::string match;             // selector text; empty = all traffic

    bool operator==(const ImpairmentProfile&) const = default;
};

inline constexpr uint32_t kMaxLatencyMs = 10'000;
inline constexpr uint32_t kMaxJitterMs = 5'000;

struct ImpairmentPreset {
    UINT name;  // string id
    uint32_t latencyMs;
    uint32_t jitterMs;
    double lossPercent;
    uint32_t rateKbps{0};
};
[[nodiscard]] std::span<const ImpairmentPreset> ImpairmentPresets() noexcept;

// Validates and parses the profile's selector.
[[nodiscard]] std::expected<Selector, std::string> ImpairmentSelector(const ImpairmentProfile& profile);

class Impairer {
public:
    enum class Verdict : uint8_t { Pass, Drop, Delay, Overflow };  // Overflow: the shaper's queue is full
    struct Decision {
        Verdict  verdict{Verdict::Pass};
        uint64_t dueUs{0};
        uint32_t delayUs{0};
    };

    Impairer();
    void Configure(const ImpairmentProfile& profile, const Selector& match);
    [[nodiscard]] bool Selects(const FrameInfo& frame, Dir dir) const noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] Decision Decide(Dir dir, size_t packetBytes, uint64_t nowUs) noexcept;  // for a selected packet
    void ResetOrdering() noexcept {
        m_lastDue[0] = m_lastDue[1] = 0;
        m_nextAvailableUs[0] = m_nextAvailableUs[1] = 0;
    }

private:
    ImpairmentProfile m_profile;
    Selector m_match;
    bool m_all{true};
    std::mt19937_64 m_rng;
    std::uniform_real_distribution<double> m_unit{0.0, 1.0};
    uint64_t m_lastDue[2]{};
    uint64_t m_nextAvailableUs[2]{};
};

// Time-ordered store of held packets. Buffers are recycled, so steady state allocates nothing.
class DelayLine {
public:
    using Buffer = std::unique_ptr<INTERMEDIATE_BUFFER>;

    explicit DelayLine(size_t capacity = 32768) : m_capacity(capacity) {}

    [[nodiscard]] Buffer Acquire() {
        if (m_pool.empty()) return std::make_unique<INTERMEDIATE_BUFFER>();
        Buffer b = std::move(m_pool.back());
        m_pool.pop_back();
        return b;
    }
    void Recycle(Buffer b) {
        if (b && m_pool.size() < 1024) m_pool.push_back(std::move(b));
    }

    // False when full; the caller keeps the buffer.
    [[nodiscard]] bool Push(uint64_t dueUs, Buffer& b) {
        if (m_heap.size() >= m_capacity) return false;
        m_heap.push_back({dueUs, m_seq++, std::move(b)});
        std::push_heap(m_heap.begin(), m_heap.end(), Later{});
        return true;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<uint64_t> NextDue() const noexcept {
        if (m_heap.empty()) return std::nullopt;
        return m_heap.front().due;
    }

    // Hands every packet due at nowUs (all of them with nowUs = UINT64_MAX) to sink(INTERMEDIATE_BUFFER&).
    template <class Sink>
    size_t Release(uint64_t nowUs, Sink&& sink) {
        size_t released = 0;
        while (!m_heap.empty() && m_heap.front().due <= nowUs) {
            std::pop_heap(m_heap.begin(), m_heap.end(), Later{});
            Item item = std::move(m_heap.back());
            m_heap.pop_back();
            sink(*item.buffer);
            Recycle(std::move(item.buffer));
            ++released;
        }
        return released;
    }

    void Clear() {
        for (auto& item : m_heap) Recycle(std::move(item.buffer));
        m_heap.clear();
    }
    [[nodiscard]] size_t Size() const noexcept { return m_heap.size(); }

private:
    struct Item {
        uint64_t due;
        uint64_t seq;
        Buffer buffer;
    };
    struct Later {
        bool operator()(const Item& a, const Item& b) const noexcept {
            return a.due != b.due ? a.due > b.due : a.seq > b.seq;
        }
    };
    std::vector<Item> m_heap;
    std::vector<Buffer> m_pool;
    size_t m_capacity;
    uint64_t m_seq{0};
};

} // namespace WS

```

```cpp
#include "core/FrameView.h"

constexpr size_t kBatch = 2048;       // packets per wake-up before the delay line is serviced
constexpr size_t kDrainAll = 65536;   // bound for "empty the queue" during a mode change
constexpr auto kStartTimeout = std::chrono::seconds(5);
constexpr auto kApplyTimeout = std::chrono::seconds(3);
constexpr size_t kMaxTracked = 4096;             // process instances kept in the traffic totals
constexpr uint64_t kForgetIdleUs = 600'000'000;  // beyond that, instances idle for 10 min are dropped

bool Tunnels(DWORD mode) noexcept {
    return (mode & MODE_TUNNEL) != 0;
}

bool NeedsApps(const EngineConfig& c) {
    if (c.capture || c.accounting) return true;  // the packet list shows the owner, the totals need it
    if (c.impairment.enabled && c.impairmentMatch.app.set) return true;
    if (c.firewall) {
        for (const Rule& r : c.rules) {
            if (r.match.app.set) return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

} // namespace

struct PacketEngine::Worker {
    HANDLE adapter{nullptr};
    DWORD mode{MODE_BYPASS};
    bool capture{true};
    bool kill{false};
    bool impair{false};
    bool firewall{false};
    RuleAction policy{RuleAction::Allow};
    std::vector<Rule> rules;
    size_t firstEngineRule{0};
    bool policyInKernel{false};
    bool needApps{false};  // a rule or the simulator matches processes, or the capture shows them
    bool account{false};
    std::shared_ptr<const ProcessMapper::Snapshot> apps;
    // Traffic of the current batch; the pointers live as long as `apps` (committed before it changes).
    std::unordered_map<const ProcessInfo*, TrafficCounters> traffic;
    Impairer impairer;
    DelayLine delay;
};

PacketEngine::PacketEngine(std::shared_ptr<DriverBridge> bridge)
    : m_bridge(std::move(bridge)), m_wake(CreateEventW(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr)) {
}

PacketEngine::~PacketEngine() {
    Stop();
}

bool PacketEngine::IsRunning() const noexcept {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_ctlMutex);
    return m_phase == Phase::Running;
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> PacketEngine::Start(HANDLE hAdapter, const EngineConfig& config) {
    if (!m_bridge || !m_bridge->IsConnected()) {
        return std::unexpected(L"Driver bridge is not connected");
    }
    if (!m_wake) return std::unexpected(L"Could not create the engine's wake-up event");

    Stop();
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_ctlMutex);
        m_phase = Phase::Starting;
        m_pending.reset();
        m_requested = m_applied = 0;
        m_ctlError.clear();
        m_finalMode = MODE_BYPASS;
    }
    m_worker = std::jthread([this, hAdapter, config](std::stop_token st) {
        WorkerMain(st, hAdapter, config);
    });

    std::wstring error;
    {
        std::unique_lock lock(m_ctlMutex);
        m_ctlCv.wait_for(lock, kStartTimeout, [this] { return m_phase != Phase::Starting; });
        if (m_phase == Phase::Running) return {};
        error = m_ctlError.empty() ? Text::Get(IDS_DP_ENGINE_START) : m_ctlError;
    }
    Stop();
    return std::unexpected(error);
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> PacketEngine::Reconfigure(const EngineConfig& config) {
    std::unique_lock lock(m_ctlMutex);
    if (m_phase != Phase::Running) return std::unexpected(L"The packet engine is not running");
    m_pending = config;
    const uint64_t ticket = ++m_requested;
    SetEvent(m_wake.get());
    if (!m_ctlCv.wait_for(lock, kApplyTimeout, [&] { return m_applied >= ticket || m_phase != Phase::Running; })) {
        return std::unexpected(Text::Get(IDS_DP_ENGINE_APPLY));
    }
    if (m_phase != Phase::Running) {
        return std::unexpected(m_ctlError.empty() ? Text::Get(IDS_DP_ENGINE_STOPPED) : m_ctlError);
    }
    if (!m_ctlError.empty()) {
        std::wstring error = std::move(m_ctlError);
        m_ctlError.clear();
        return std::unexpected(std::move(error));
    }
    return {};
}

void PacketEngine::Stop(DWORD finalMode) noexcept {
    if (!m_worker.joinable()) return;
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_ctlMutex);
        m_finalMode = finalMode;
    }
    m_worker.request_stop();
    if (m_wake) SetEvent(m_wake.get());
    m_worker.join();
    m_worker = std::jthread();
    std::lock_guard lock(m_ctlMutex);
    m_phase = Phase::Idle;
}

bool PacketEngine::StartPcap(const std::wstring& filePath) {
    return m_pcap.Open(filePath);
}

void PacketEngine::StopPcap() noexcept {
    m_pcap.Close();
}

void PacketEngine::SetPacketCallback(PacketCallback cb) {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    m_callback = std::move(cb);
}

void PacketEngine::ClearPackets() noexcept {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    m_recentPackets.clear();
    ++m_clearGeneration;
}

uint64_t PacketEngine::ClearGeneration() const noexcept {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    return m_clearGeneration;
}

EngineStats PacketEngine::GetStats() const {
    EngineStats stats;
    stats.TotalPackets = m_totalPackets.load();
    stats.TotalBytes = m_totalBytes.load();
    stats.DnsQueries = m_dnsCount.load();
    stats.TcpPackets = m_tcpCount.load();
    stats.UdpPackets = m_udpCount.load();
    stats.IcmpPackets = m_icmpCount.load();
    stats.Reinjected = m_reinjected.load();
    stats.SendErrors = m_sendErrors.load();
    stats.KillDropped = m_killDropped.load();
    stats.FirewallBlocked = m_fwBlocked.load();
    stats.FirewallAllowed = m_fwAllowed.load();
    stats.SimSelected = m_simSelected.load();
    stats.SimDelayed = m_simDelayed.load();
    stats.SimDropped = m_simDropped.load();
    stats.SimOverflow = m_simOverflow.load();
    stats.SimBytes = m_simBytes.load();
    stats.SimDelaySumUs = m_simDelaySumUs.load();
    stats.SimInFlight = m_simInFlight.load();
    stats.DroppedPackets = stats.SimDropped + stats.SimOverflow + stats.KillDropped + stats.FirewallBlocked;
    stats.HighResolutionTimer = m_highResolution.load();
    stats.Mode = m_mode.load();

    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    stats.PacketsPerSec = m_currentPps;
    stats.BytesPerSec = m_currentBps;
    return stats;
}

std::vector<PacketRef> PacketEngine::GetRecentPackets(size_t maxCount) const {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    const size_t count = std::min(maxCount, m_recentPackets.size());
    return std::vector<PacketRef>(m_recentPackets.end() - static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(count), m_recentPackets.end());
}

void PacketEngine::CopyPacketsAfter(uint64_t afterIndex, std::vector<PacketRef>& out) const {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    const auto first = std::upper_bound(m_recentPackets.begin(), m_recentPackets.end(), afterIndex,
                                        [](uint64_t index, const PacketRef& p) { return index < p->Index; });
    out.insert(out.end(), first, m_recentPackets.end());
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Worker thread
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void PacketEngine::WorkerMain(std::stop_token stopToken, HANDLE hAdapter, EngineConfig config) {
    auto fail = [this](std::wstring error) {
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(m_ctlMutex);
            m_ctlError = std::move(error);
            m_phase = Phase::Stopped;
        }
        m_ctlCv.notify_all();
    };

    Handle packetEvent(CreateEventW(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr));
    // A high-resolution timer releases held packets with ~1 ms precision instead of the 15.6 ms tick.
    Handle timer(CreateWaitableTimerExW(nullptr, nullptr, CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS));
    const bool highResolution = static_cast<bool>(timer);
    if (!timer) timer.reset(CreateWaitableTimerExW(nullptr, nullptr, 0, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS));
    if (!packetEvent || !timer) {
        fail(L"Could not create the engine's events: " + FormatError());
        return;
    }
    if (auto r = m_bridge->SetAdapterEvent(hAdapter, packetEvent.get()); !r) {
        fail(r.error());
        return;
    }
    if (auto r = m_bridge->SetAdapterMode(hAdapter, config.mode); !r) {
        (void)m_bridge->SetAdapterEvent(hAdapter, nullptr);
        fail(r.error());
        return;
    }

    auto w = std::make_unique<Worker>();
    w->adapter = hAdapter;
    w->mode = config.mode;
    w->capture = config.capture;
    w->kill = config.killSwitch;
    w->firewall = config.firewall;
    w->policy = config.policy;
    w->rules = config.rules;
    w->firstEngineRule = config.firstEngineRule;
    w->policyInKernel = config.policyInKernel;
    w->impair = config.impairment.enabled;
    w->needApps = NeedsApps(config);
    w->account = config.accounting;
    if (w->impair) w->impairer.Configure(config.impairment, config.impairmentMatch);
    m_mode = config.mode;
    m_accounting = w->account;
    m_highResolution = highResolution;
    m_lastCalcTimeUs = MonotonicMicroseconds();
    m_lastPacketsSnapshot = m_totalPackets.load();
    m_lastBytesSnapshot = m_totalBytes.load();
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_ctlMutex);
        m_phase = Phase::Running;
    }
    m_ctlCv.notify_all();

    const HANDLE waits[] = {packetEvent.get(), m_wake.get(), timer.get()};
    bool backlog = false;
    uint64_t armedFor = 0;
    while (!stopToken.stop_requested()) {
        const DWORD waited = WaitForMultipleObjects(static_cast<DWORD>(std::size(waits)), waits, FALSE, backlog ? 0 : 100);
        if (waited == WAIT_FAILED) break;

        ApplyPending(*w);
        CommitTraffic(*w);  // before the snapshot that owns its pointers is replaced
        if (w->needApps) w->apps = ProcessMapper::Instance().Current();  // one atomic load per batch
        backlog = Drain(*w, kBatch, w->mode) == kBatch;
        w->delay.Release(MonotonicMicroseconds(), [&](INTERMEDIATE_BUFFER& b) { Send(*w, b); });
        m_simInFlight = static_cast<uint32_t>(w->delay.Size());

        if (const auto next = w->delay.NextDue()) {
            const uint64_t now = MonotonicMicroseconds();
            if (*next <= now) {
                backlog = true;
            } else if (*next != armedFor) {
                LARGE_INTEGER due{};
                due.QuadPart = -static_cast<LONGLONG>((*next - now) * 10);  // relative, 100 ns units
                SetWaitableTimer(timer.get(), &due, 0, nullptr, nullptr, FALSE);
                armedFor = *next;
            }
        } else if (armedFor) {
            CancelWaitableTimer(timer.get());
            armedFor = 0;
        }
        UpdateRates();
    }

    DWORD finalMode = MODE_BYPASS;
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_ctlMutex);
        finalMode = m_finalMode;
    }
    Shutdown(*w, finalMode);
    CommitTraffic(*w);
    m_accounting = false;
    (void)m_bridge->SetAdapterEvent(hAdapter, nullptr);
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_ctlMutex);
        m_phase = Phase::Stopped;
    }
    m_ctlCv.notify_all();
}

size_t PacketEngine::Drain(Worker& w, size_t limit, DWORD semantics) {
    size_t count = 0;
    while (count < limit) {
        auto buffer = w.delay.Acquire();
        buffer->m_Length = 0;
        const auto read = m_bridge->ReadPacket(w.adapter, *buffer);
        if (!read || !*read) {
            w.delay.Recycle(std::move(buffer));
            break;
        }
        ++count;
        Process(w, buffer, semantics);
        if (buffer) w.delay.Recycle(std::move(buffer));
    }
    return count;
}

void PacketEngine::Process(Worker& w, std::unique_ptr<INTERMEDIATE_BUFFER>& buffer, DWORD semantics) {
    INTERMEDIATE_BUFFER& b = *buffer;
    b.m_Length = std::min<DWORD>(b.m_Length, static_cast<DWORD>(MAX_PACKET_SIZE));
    const bool outbound = (b.m_dwDeviceFlags & PACKET_FLAG_ON_SEND) != 0;  // m_Flags holds NDIS flags
    const Dir dir = outbound ? Dir::Out : Dir::In;
    // A packet is an original (ours to re-inject) when its direction is tunnelled.
    const bool original = (semantics & (outbound ? MODE_TUNNEL_SEND : MODE_TUNNEL_RECV)) != 0;
    const std::span<const uint8_t> frame(b.m_IBuffer, b.m_Length);
    FrameInfo info = InspectFrame(frame);
    if (w.needApps && w.apps && info.hasPorts) info.process = w.apps->Find(info.protocol, outbound ? info.srcPort : info.dstPort);
    if (w.account) w.traffic[info.process].Add(outbound, b.m_Length);

    const uint64_t index = ++m_totalPackets;
    m_totalBytes += b.m_Length;
    if (info.protocol == 6) {
        ++m_tcpCount;
    } else if (info.protocol == 17) {
        ++m_udpCount;
        if (info.hasPorts && (info.srcPort == 53 || info.dstPort == 53)) ++m_dnsCount;
    } else if (info.hasIcmp) {
        ++m_icmpCount;
    }

    std::shared_ptr<DecodedPacket> decoded;
    if (w.capture) {
        const uint64_t wallUs = GetCurrentTimestampMicroseconds();
        decoded = std::make_shared<DecodedPacket>(
            PacketParser::Parse(frame, outbound ? Direction::Outbound : Direction::Inbound, index, wallUs));
        if (info.process) decoded->Process = info.process->label;
        if (m_pcap.IsOpen()) m_pcap.WritePacket(frame, wallUs);
    }

    PacketFate fate = (original || w.firewall) ? PacketFate::Passed : PacketFate::Observed;
    uint32_t delayUs = 0;
    bool blocked = false;
    if (original && !w.kill && w.firewall) {
        const Rule* hit = nullptr;
        size_t hitIndex = w.rules.size();
        for (size_t i = 0; i < w.rules.size(); ++i) {
            if (Matches(w.rules[i].match, info, dir)) {
                hit = &w.rules[i];
                hitIndex = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        const bool countedInKernel = hit ? (hitIndex < w.firstEngineRule) : w.policyInKernel;
        if (!countedInKernel) {
            std::lock_guard lock(m_hitsMutex);
            m_ruleHits[hit ? hit->id : 0] += HitCounter{1, b.m_Length};
        }
        blocked = (hit ? hit->action : w.policy) == RuleAction::Block;
        ++(blocked ? m_fwBlocked : m_fwAllowed);
    }

    if (original) {
        if (w.kill) {
            fate = PacketFate::Killed;
            ++m_killDropped;
        } else if (blocked) {
            fate = PacketFate::Blocked;
        } else if (w.impair && w.impairer.Selects(info, dir)) {
            ++m_simSelected;
            const auto decision = w.impairer.Decide(dir, b.m_Length, MonotonicMicroseconds());
            switch (decision.verdict) {
            case Impairer::Verdict::Drop:
                fate = PacketFate::Dropped;
                ++m_simDropped;
                break;
            case Impairer::Verdict::Overflow:
                fate = PacketFate::Dropped;
                ++m_simOverflow;
                break;
            case Impairer::Verdict::Delay:
                if (w.delay.Push(decision.dueUs, buffer)) {  // takes the buffer
                    m_simBytes += b.m_Length;
                    fate = PacketFate::Delayed;
                    delayUs = decision.delayUs;
                    ++m_simDelayed;
                    m_simDelaySumUs += decision.delayUs;
                } else {
                    fate = PacketFate::Dropped;
                    ++m_simOverflow;
                }
                break;
            case Impairer::Verdict::Pass:
                m_simBytes += b.m_Length;
                Send(w, b);
                break;
            }
        } else {
            Send(w, b);
        }
    }

    if (decoded) {
        decoded->Fate = fate;
        decoded->DelayUs = delayUs;
        PacketCallback callback;
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
            if (m_recentPackets.size() >= m_maxRecentPackets) m_recentPackets.pop_front();
            m_recentPackets.push_back(decoded);
            callback = m_callback;
        }
        if (callback) callback(*decoded);
    }
}

void PacketEngine::Send(Worker& w, INTERMEDIATE_BUFFER& buffer) {
    if (m_bridge->Reinject(w.adapter, buffer)) {
        ++m_reinjected;
    } else {
        ++m_sendErrors;
    }
}

void PacketEngine::FlushDelayed(Worker& w, bool send) {
    if (send) {
        w.delay.Release(UINT64_MAX, [&](INTERMEDIATE_BUFFER& b) { Send(w, b); });
    } else {
        m_killDropped += w.delay.Size();
        w.delay.Clear();
    }
    w.impairer.ResetOrdering();
    m_simInFlight = 0;
}

void PacketEngine::ApplyPending(Worker& w) {
    std::optional<EngineConfig> config;
    uint64_t ticket = 0;
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_ctlMutex);
        if (!m_pending) return;
        config = std::move(m_pending);
        m_pending.reset();
        ticket = m_requested;
    }

    std::wstring error;
    if (config->mode != w.mode) {
        // Empty the queue under the old meaning, then switch. Stragglers that slipped in during the
        // switch are re-injected if either mode tunnelled them (a duplicate beats a lost packet).
        Drain(w, kDrainAll, w.mode);
        if (Tunnels(w.mode) && !Tunnels(config->mode)) FlushDelayed(w, !w.kill);
        if (auto r = m_bridge->SetAdapterMode(w.adapter, config->mode); !r) {
            error = r.error();
        } else {
            const DWORD old = w.mode;
            w.mode = config->mode;
            m_mode = w.mode;
            Drain(w, kDrainAll, old | w.mode);
        }
    }
    if (config->killSwitch && !w.kill) FlushDelayed(w, false);  // held packets die with the kill switch
    if (!config->impairment.enabled && w.impair) FlushDelayed(w, !config->killSwitch);
    w.kill = config->killSwitch;
    w.capture = config->capture;
    w.firewall = config->firewall;
    w.policy = config->policy;
    w.rules = std::move(config->rules);
    w.firstEngineRule = config->firstEngineRule;
    w.policyInKernel = config->policyInKernel;
    w.impair = config->impairment.enabled;
    w.needApps = NeedsApps(*config);
    w.account = config->accounting;
    m_accounting = w.account;
    if (w.impair) w.impairer.Configure(config->impairment, config->impairmentMatch);

    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_ctlMutex);
        m_applied = ticket;
        if (!error.empty()) m_ctlError = std::move(error);
    }
    m_ctlCv.notify_all();
}

void PacketEngine::CommitTraffic(Worker& w) {
    if (w.traffic.empty()) return;
    const uint64_t now = MonotonicMicroseconds();
    std::lock_guard lock(m_trafficMutex);
    for (const auto& [process, counters] : w.traffic) {
        auto [it, inserted] = m_traffic.try_emplace(process ? process->id : 0);
        if (inserted && process) it->second.process = process->shared_from_this();
        it->second.total += counters;
        it->second.lastPacketUs = now;
    }
    w.traffic.clear();
    if (m_traffic.size() > kMaxTracked) {
        std::erase_if(m_traffic, [&](const auto& entry) { return entry.first != 0 && now - entry.second.lastPacketUs > kForgetIdleUs; });
    }
}

void PacketEngine::Shutdown(Worker& w, DWORD finalMode) {
    Drain(w, kDrainAll, w.mode);
    FlushDelayed(w, !w.kill);
    if (finalMode != w.mode) {
        const DWORD old = w.mode;
        (void)m_bridge->SetAdapterMode(w.adapter, finalMode);
        w.mode = finalMode;
        Drain(w, kDrainAll, old | finalMode);
    }
    m_mode = finalMode;
}

void PacketEngine::UpdateRates() {
    const uint64_t now = MonotonicMicroseconds();
    const uint64_t elapsedUs = now - m_lastCalcTimeUs;
    if (elapsedUs < 500'000ULL) return;
    const double sec = static_cast<double>(elapsedUs) / 1'000'000.0;
    const uint64_t packets = m_totalPackets.load();
    const uint64_t bytes = m_totalBytes.load();
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
        m_currentPps = static_cast<double>(packets - m_lastPacketsSnapshot) / sec;
        m_currentBps = static_cast<double>(bytes - m_lastBytesSnapshot) / sec;
    }
    m_lastCalcTimeUs = now;
    m_lastPacketsSnapshot = packets;
    m_lastBytesSnapshot = bytes;
}

} // namespace WS

```

`src/core/PacketEngine.h`:

```h
// WireScope - Packet engine: the worker thread that owns one adapter's packet queue.
//
// Listen mode: the driver queues copies; the engine decodes them and never re-injects.
// Tunnel mode: the driver queues the originals; the engine must re-inject every packet it does not
// mean to drop. This is where the kill switch, the firewall rules and the impairment simulator act,
// in that order.
//
// Mode changes happen on the worker thread (Reconfigure), between two reads, so a packet is never
// re-injected twice or forgotten: the queue is drained with the old meaning, the delay line is
// flushed when tunnelling ends, then the new mode is set. TrafficController installs a "quiesce"
// filter table around the switch so that no packet enters the queue while its meaning changes.
#pragma once
#include "core/DriverBridge.h"
#include "core/Impairment.h"
#include "core/PacketParser.h"
#include "core/PcapWriter.h"
#include "core/ProcessTraffic.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include <atomic>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <deque>
#include <functional>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <optional>
#include <stop_token>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>

namespace WS {

struct EngineStats {
    uint64_t TotalPackets{0};   // every packet read from the driver
    uint64_t TotalBytes{0};
    double   PacketsPerSec{0.0};
    double   BytesPerSec{0.0};
    uint64_t DnsQueries{0};
    uint64_t TcpPackets{0};
    uint64_t UdpPackets{0};
    uint64_t IcmpPackets{0};
    uint64_t DroppedPackets{0};  // simulator + kill switch

    uint64_t Reinjected{0};
    uint64_t SendErrors{0};
    uint64_t KillDropped{0};
    uint64_t FirewallBlocked{0};
    uint64_t FirewallAllowed{0};

    uint64_t SimSelected{0};     // packets the simulator's match selected
    uint64_t SimDelayed{0};
    uint64_t SimDropped{0};
    uint64_t SimOverflow{0};     // dropped because the shaper queue or the delay line was full
    uint64_t SimBytes{0};        // bytes of selected packets let through (delayed or passed)
    uint64_t SimDelaySumUs{0};
    uint32_t SimInFlight{0};
    bool     HighResolutionTimer{false};
    DWORD    Mode{MODE_BYPASS};
};

struct EngineConfig {
    DWORD             mode{MODE_LISTEN};
    bool              capture{true};          // decode and keep packets for display / pcap
    bool              killSwitch{false};      // tunnel: drop everything that is read
    bool              firewall{false};        // tunnel: first matching rule decides, else the policy
    RuleAction        policy{RuleAction::Allow};
    std::vector<Rule> rules;                  // enabled rules, in order
    size_t            firstEngineRule{0};     // rules before this index are counted by the kernel table
    bool              policyInKernel{false};  // default policy is counted by the kernel table
    ImpairmentProfile impairment;             // tunnel: honoured when enabled
    Selector          impairmentMatch;
    bool              accounting{false};      // count traffic per process (user mode sees every packet)
};

using PacketCallback = std::function<void(const DecodedPacket&)>;
using PacketRef = std::shared_ptr<const DecodedPacket>;

class PacketEngine {
public:
    explicit PacketEngine(std::shared_ptr<DriverBridge> bridge);

    PacketEngine(const PacketEngine&) = delete;

    // Returns once the worker has set the adapter mode (or failed to).
```
