`src/core/PacketParser.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/PacketParser.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <format>
#include <winsock2.h>

namespace WS {

DecodedPacket PacketParser::Parse(std::span<const uint8_t> frame, Direction dir, uint64_t index, uint64_t timestampUs) {
    DecodedPacket out;
    out.Index = index;
    out.TimestampUs = timestampUs;
    out.Dir = dir;
    out.Length = static_cast<uint32_t>(frame.size());
    out.RawData.assign(frame.begin(), frame.end());

    if (frame.size() < sizeof(ETH_HEADER)) {
        out.Protocol = ProtocolType::Unknown;
        out.ProtocolName = "MALFORMED";
        out.Info = std::format("Truncated frame ({} bytes)", frame.size());
        return out;
    }

    const auto* eth = reinterpret_cast<const ETH_HEADER*>(frame.data());
    std::span<const uint8_t, 6> srcMac(eth->SrcMac, 6);
    std::span<const uint8_t, 6> dstMac(eth->DestMac, 6);
    out.Source = FormatMac(srcMac);
    out.Destination = FormatMac(dstMac);

    const uint16_t etherType = ntohs(eth->EtherType);
    auto payload = frame.subspan(sizeof(ETH_HEADER));

    switch (etherType) {
    case 0x0800: // IPv4
        ParseIpv4(payload, out);
        break;
    case 0x86DD: // IPv6
        ParseIpv6(payload, out);
        break;
    case 0x0806: // ARP
        ParseArp(payload, out);
        break;
    default:
        out.Protocol = ProtocolType::Unknown;
        out.ProtocolName = std::format("0x{:04X}", etherType);
        out.Info = std::format("Ethernet payload ({} bytes)", payload.size());
        break;
    }

    return out;
}

void PacketParser::ParseArp(std::span<const uint8_t> payload, DecodedPacket& out) {
    out.Protocol = ProtocolType::ARP;
    out.ProtocolName = "ARP";

    if (payload.size() < sizeof(ARP_HEADER)) {
        out.Info = "Truncated ARP packet";
        return;
    }

    const auto* arp = reinterpret_cast<const ARP_HEADER*>(payload.data());
    const uint16_t opcode = ntohs(arp->Opcode);

    const uint32_t srcIp = *reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(arp->SenderIp);
    const uint32_t dstIp = *reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(arp->TargetIp);
    out.Source = FormatIpv4(srcIp);
    out.Destination = FormatIpv4(dstIp);

    if (opcode == 1) {
        out.Info = std::format("Who has {}? Tell {}", FormatIpv4(dstIp), FormatIpv4(srcIp));
    } else if (opcode == 2) {
        std::span<const uint8_t, 6> senderMac(arp->SenderMac, 6);
        out.Info = std::format("{} is at {}", FormatIpv4(srcIp), FormatMac(senderMac));
    } else {
        out.Info = std::format("ARP Opcode {}", opcode);
    }
}

void PacketParser::ParseIpv4(std::span<const uint8_t> payload, DecodedPacket& out) {
    out.Protocol = ProtocolType::IPv4;
    out.ProtocolName = "IPv4";

    if (payload.size() < sizeof(IPV4_HEADER)) {
        out.Info = "Truncated IPv4 packet";
        return;
    }

    const auto* ip = reinterpret_cast<const IPV4_HEADER*>(payload.data());
    const uint8_t ihl = (ip->VersionAndIhl & 0x0F) * 4;
    if (ihl < sizeof(IPV4_HEADER) || payload.size() < ihl) {
        out.Info = "Malformed IPv4 header length";
        return;
    }

    out.Source = FormatIpv4(ip->SrcIp);
    out.Destination = FormatIpv4(ip->DestIp);
    auto l4Payload = payload.subspan(ihl);

    switch (ip->Protocol) {
    case 6: // TCP
        ParseTcp(l4Payload, out);
        break;
    case 17: // UDP
        ParseUdp(l4Payload, out);
        break;
    case 1: // ICMP
        ParseIcmp(l4Payload, out);
        break;
    default:
        out.ProtocolName = std::format("IP (0x{:02X})", ip->Protocol);
        out.Info = std::format("TTL={} Protocol={}", ip->Ttl, ip->Protocol);
        break;
    }
}

void PacketParser::ParseIpv6(std::span<const uint8_t> payload, DecodedPacket& out) {
    out.Protocol = ProtocolType::IPv6;
    out.ProtocolName = "IPv6";

    if (payload.size() < sizeof(IPV6_HEADER)) {
        out.Info = "Truncated IPv6 packet";
        return;
    }

    const auto* ip = reinterpret_cast<const IPV6_HEADER*>(payload.data());
    std::span<const uint8_t, 16> srcSpan(ip->SrcIp, 16);
    std::span<const uint8_t, 16> dstSpan(ip->DestIp, 16);
    out.Source = FormatIpv6(srcSpan);
    out.Destination = FormatIpv6(dstSpan);

    auto l4Payload = payload.subspan(sizeof(IPV6_HEADER));
    switch (ip->NextHeader) {
    case 6:
        ParseTcp(l4Payload, out);
        break;
    case 17:
        ParseUdp(l4Payload, out);
        break;
    case 58: // ICMPv6
        out.ProtocolName = "ICMPv6";
        out.Info = std::format("ICMPv6 packet ({} bytes)", l4Payload.size());
        break;
    default:
        out.ProtocolName = std::format("IPv6 ({})", ip->NextHeader);
        out.Info = std::format("NextHeader={}", ip->NextHeader);
        break;
    }
}

void PacketParser::ParseTcp(std::span<const uint8_t> payload, DecodedPacket& out) {
    out.Protocol = ProtocolType::TCP;
    out.ProtocolName = "TCP";

    if (payload.size() < sizeof(TCP_HEADER)) {
        out.Info = "Truncated TCP segment";
        return;
    }

    const auto* tcp = reinterpret_cast<const TCP_HEADER*>(payload.data());
    out.SourcePort = ntohs(tcp->SrcPort);
    out.DestPort = ntohs(tcp->DestPort);

    const uint8_t offset = ((tcp->DataOffset >> 4) & 0x0F) * 4;
    std::string flags;
    if (tcp->Flags & 0x02) flags += "SYN ";
    if (tcp->Flags & 0x10) flags += "ACK ";
    if (tcp->Flags & 0x01) flags += "FIN ";
    if (tcp->Flags & 0x04) flags += "RST ";
    if (tcp->Flags & 0x08) flags += "PSH ";
    if (!flags.empty()) flags.pop_back();

    out.Info = std::format("{} -> {} [{}] Len={}", out.SourcePort, out.DestPort, flags, payload.size());

    if (offset >= sizeof(TCP_HEADER) && payload.size() > offset) {
        auto appPayload = payload.subspan(offset);
        if (out.DestPort == 443 || out.SourcePort == 443) {
            TryParseTlsSni(appPayload, out);
        } else if (out.DestPort == 80 || out.SourcePort == 80 || out.DestPort == 8080 || out.SourcePort == 8080) {
            TryParseHttp(appPayload, out);
        }
    }
}

void PacketParser::ParseUdp(std::span<const uint8_t> payload, DecodedPacket& out) {
    out.Protocol = ProtocolType::UDP;
    out.ProtocolName = "UDP";

    if (payload.size() < sizeof(UDP_HEADER)) {
        out.Info = "Truncated UDP datagram";
        return;
    }

    const auto* udp = reinterpret_cast<const UDP_HEADER*>(payload.data());
    out.SourcePort = ntohs(udp->SrcPort);
    out.DestPort = ntohs(udp->DestPort);
    const uint16_t length = ntohs(udp->Length);

    out.Info = std::format("{} -> {} Len={}", out.SourcePort, out.DestPort, length);

    if (payload.size() > sizeof(UDP_HEADER)) {
        auto appPayload = payload.subspan(sizeof(UDP_HEADER));
        if (out.DestPort == 53 || out.SourcePort == 53) {
            TryParseDns(appPayload, out);
        } else if (out.DestPort == 67 || out.DestPort == 68 || out.SourcePort == 67 || out.SourcePort == 68) {
            out.ProtocolName = "DHCP";
            out.Info = std::format("DHCP message ({} bytes)", appPayload.size());
        } else if (out.DestPort == 123 || out.SourcePort == 123) {
            out.ProtocolName = "NTP";
            out.Info = "Network Time Protocol";
        }
    }
}

void PacketParser::ParseIcmp(std::span<const uint8_t> payload, DecodedPacket& out) {
    out.Protocol = ProtocolType::ICMP;
    out.ProtocolName = "ICMP";

    if (payload.size() < sizeof(ICMP_HEADER)) {
        out.Info = "Truncated ICMP packet";
        return;
    }

    const auto* icmp = reinterpret_cast<const ICMP_HEADER*>(payload.data());
    const uint16_t seq = ntohs(icmp->Sequence);
    const uint16_t id = ntohs(icmp->Id);

    switch (icmp->Type) {
    case 8:
        out.Info = std::format("Echo Request (Ping) id=0x{:04X} seq={}", id, seq);
        break;
    case 0:
        out.Info = std::format("Echo Reply (Pong) id=0x{:04X} seq={}", id, seq);
        break;
    case 3:
        out.Info = std::format("Destination Unreachable (code {})", icmp->Code);
        break;
    case 11:
        out.Info = "Time to Live Exceeded (TTL expired in transit)";
        break;
    default:
        out.Info = std::format("ICMP Type {} Code {}", icmp->Type, icmp->Code);
        break;
    }
}

void PacketParser::TryParseDns(std::span<const uint8_t> udpPayload, DecodedPacket& out) {
    if (udpPayload.size() < 12) return;

    const uint16_t flags = ntohs(*reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(udpPayload.data() + 2));
    const uint16_t qdCount = ntohs(*reinterpret_cast<const uint16_t*>(udpPayload.data() + 4));
    const bool isResponse = (flags & 0x8000) != 0;

    out.Protocol = ProtocolType::DNS;
    out.ProtocolName = "DNS";

    if (qdCount == 0) return;

    // Parse first Question QNAME
    size_t pos = 12;
    std::string qname;
    size_t jumps = 0;

    while (pos < udpPayload.size() && jumps < 20) {
        const uint8_t len = udpPayload[pos];
        if (len == 0) break;

        if ((len & 0xC0) == 0xC0) { // Pointer compression
            if (pos + 1 >= udpPayload.size()) break;
            const size_t ptr = ((len & 0x3F) << 8) | udpPayload[pos + 1];
            pos = ptr;
            jumps++;
            continue;
        }

        pos++;
        if (pos + len > udpPayload.size()) break;

        if (!qname.empty()) qname += '.';
        qname.append(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(udpPayload.data() + pos), len);
        pos += len;
    }

    if (!qname.empty()) {
        out.DomainOrHost = qname;
        if (isResponse) {
            out.Info = std::format("DNS Response for {}", qname);
        } else {
            out.Info = std::format("DNS Standard Query: {}", qname);
        }
    }
}

void PacketParser::TryParseTlsSni(std::span<const uint8_t> tcpPayload, DecodedPacket& out) {
    // Check for TLS Handshake (0x16), Version (0x03 0x01..0x03), Type ClientHello (0x01)
    if (tcpPayload.size() < 44) return;
    if (tcpPayload[0] != 0x16) return; // ContentType: Handshake
    if (tcpPayload[1] != 0x03) return; // Major version 3

    if (tcpPayload[5] != 0x01) return; // HandshakeType: ClientHello

    size_t pos = 43; // Skip past header + client random (32B)
    if (pos >= tcpPayload.size()) return;

    // Session ID length
    const uint8_t sessionLen = tcpPayload[pos];
    pos += 1 + sessionLen;
    if (pos + 2 >= tcpPayload.size()) return;

    // Cipher suites length
    const uint16_t cipherLen = static_cast<uint16_t>((tcpPayload[pos] << 8) | tcpPayload[pos + 1]);
    pos += 2 + cipherLen;
    if (pos + 1 >= tcpPayload.size()) return;

    // Compression methods length
    const uint8_t compLen = tcpPayload[pos];
    pos += 1 + compLen;
    if (pos + 2 >= tcpPayload.size()) return;

    // Extensions length
    const uint16_t extTotalLen = static_cast<uint16_t>((tcpPayload[pos] << 8) | tcpPayload[pos + 1]);
    pos += 2;

    const size_t extEnd = std::min(pos + extTotalLen, tcpPayload.size());
    while (pos + 4 <= extEnd) {
        const uint16_t extType = static_cast<uint16_t>((tcpPayload[pos] << 8) | tcpPayload[pos + 1]);
        const uint16_t extLen = static_cast<uint16_t>((tcpPayload[pos + 2] << 8) | tcpPayload[pos + 3]);
        pos += 4;

        if (pos + extLen > extEnd) break;

        if (extType == 0x0000) { // Server Name Indication (SNI)
            if (extLen >= 5) {
                // Skip server_name_list length (2 bytes) + name_type (1 byte)
                const uint16_t nameLen = static_cast<uint16_t>((tcpPayload[pos + 3] << 8) | tcpPayload[pos + 4]);
                if (pos + 5 + nameLen <= extEnd) {
                    std::string sni(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(tcpPayload.data() + pos + 5), nameLen);
                    out.DomainOrHost = sni;
                    out.Protocol = ProtocolType::TLS;
                    out.ProtocolName = "TLS";
                    out.Info = std::format("TLS ClientHello (SNI: {})", sni);
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
        pos += extLen;
    }
}

void PacketParser::TryParseHttp(std::span<const uint8_t> tcpPayload, DecodedPacket& out) {
    if (tcpPayload.size() < 10) return;
    std::string_view text(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(tcpPayload.data()), tcpPayload.size());

    if (text.starts_with("GET ") || text.starts_with("POST ") || text.starts_with("HEAD ") ||
        text.starts_with("PUT ") || text.starts_with("DELETE ") || text.starts_with("HTTP/1.")) {

        out.ProtocolName = "HTTP";
        // Find end of first line
        const size_t lineEnd = text.find("\r\n");
        if (lineEnd != std::string::npos) {
            out.Info = std::string(text.substr(0, lineEnd));
        }

        // Try to extract Host header
        const size_t hostPos = text.find("\r\nHost: ");
        if (hostPos != std::string::npos) {
            const size_t hostValStart = hostPos + 8;
            const size_t hostValEnd = text.find("\r\n", hostValStart);
            if (hostValEnd != std::string::npos) {
                out.DomainOrHost = std::string(text.substr(hostValStart, hostValEnd - hostValStart));
            }
        }
    }
}

} // namespace WS

namespace WS {

namespace {

uint16_t Get16(std::span<const uint8_t> s, size_t at) { return static_cast<uint16_t>((s[at] << 8) | s[at + 1]); }
uint32_t Get32(std::span<const uint8_t> s, size_t at) {
    return (static_cast<uint32_t>(s[at]) << 24) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(s[at + 1]) << 16) | (static_cast<uint32_t>(s[at + 2]) << 8) | s[at + 3];
}

const char* EtherTypeName(uint16_t type) {
    switch (type) {
    case 0x0800: return "IPv4";
    case 0x86DD: return "IPv6";
    case 0x0806: return "ARP";
    case 0x8100: return "802.1Q VLAN";
    case 0x88CC: return "LLDP";
    case 0x888E: return "802.1X EAPOL";
    default: return "unknown";
    }
}

const char* ProtocolName(uint8_t p) {
    switch (p) {
    case 1: return "ICMP";
    case 2: return "IGMP";
    case 6: return "TCP";
    case 17: return "UDP";
    case 41: return "IPv6-in-IPv4";
    case 47: return "GRE";
    case 50: return "ESP";
    case 58: return "ICMPv6";
    default: return "other";
    }
}

std::string TcpFlags(uint8_t f) {
    std::string out;
    struct Named {
        uint8_t bit;
        const char* name;
    };
    static constexpr Named names[] = {{0x80, "CWR"}, {0x40, "ECE"}, {0x20, "URG"}, {0x10, "ACK"},
                                      {0x08, "PSH"}, {0x04, "RST"}, {0x02, "SYN"}, {0x01, "FIN"}};
    for (const auto& [bit, name] : names) {
        if (f & bit) {
            if (!out.empty()) out += ' ';
            out += name;
        }
    }
    return std::format("0x{:02X}  {}", f, out.empty() ? std::string("none") : out);
}

void BreakdownTransport(uint8_t protocol, std::span<const uint8_t> l4, std::vector<HeaderField>& out) {
    if (protocol == 6 && l4.size() >= 20) {
        const size_t offset = static_cast<size_t>(l4[12] >> 4) * 4;
        out.push_back({"TCP", "Ports", std::format("{} → {}", Get16(l4, 0), Get16(l4, 2))});
        out.push_back({"TCP", "Sequence", std::to_string(Get32(l4, 4))});
        out.push_back({"TCP", "Acknowledgment", std::to_string(Get32(l4, 8))});
        out.push_back({"TCP", "Flags", TcpFlags(l4[13])});
        out.push_back({"TCP", "Window", std::to_string(Get16(l4, 14))});
        out.push_back({"TCP", "Header / payload", std::format("{} B / {} B", offset, l4.size() > offset ? l4.size() - offset : 0)});
    } else if (protocol == 17 && l4.size() >= 8) {
        out.push_back({"UDP", "Ports", std::format("{} → {}", Get16(l4, 0), Get16(l4, 2))});
        out.push_back({"UDP", "Length", std::format("{} B", Get16(l4, 4))});
        out.push_back({"UDP", "Checksum", std::format("0x{:04X}", Get16(l4, 6))});
    } else if ((protocol == 1 || protocol == 58) && l4.size() >= 4) {
        const char* layer = protocol == 1 ? "ICMP" : "ICMPv6";
        out.push_back({layer, "Type / code", std::format("{} / {}", l4[0], l4[1])});
        if (l4.size() >= 8 && (l4[0] == 0 || l4[0] == 8 || l4[0] == 128 || l4[0] == 129)) {
            out.push_back({layer, "Identifier / sequence", std::format("0x{:04X} / {}", Get16(l4, 4), Get16(l4, 6))});
        }
    }
}

} // namespace

std::vector<HeaderField> PacketParser::Breakdown(std::span<const uint8_t> frame) {
    std::vector<HeaderField> out;
    if (frame.size() < 14) return out;
    out.push_back({"Ethernet", "Destination", FormatMac(std::span<const uint8_t, 6>(frame.data(), 6))});
    out.push_back({"Ethernet", "Source", FormatMac(std::span<const uint8_t, 6>(frame.data() + 6, 6))});
    uint16_t type = Get16(frame, 12);
    size_t offset = 14;
    if (type == 0x8100 && frame.size() >= 18) {
        out.push_back({"Ethernet", "VLAN", std::format("{} (priority {})", Get16(frame, 14) & 0x0FFF, Get16(frame, 14) >> 13)});
        type = Get16(frame, 16);
        offset = 18;
    }
    out.push_back({"Ethernet", "Type", std::format("0x{:04X}  {}", type, EtherTypeName(type))});
    const auto l3 = frame.subspan(offset);

    if (type == 0x0800 && l3.size() >= 20) {
        const size_t ihl = static_cast<size_t>(l3[0] & 0x0F) * 4;
        const uint16_t flags = Get16(l3, 6);
        out.push_back({"IPv4", "Source", FormatIpv4(*reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(l3.data() + 12))});
        out.push_back({"IPv4", "Destination", FormatIpv4(*reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(l3.data() + 16))});
        out.push_back({"IPv4", "Protocol", std::format("{}  {}", l3[9], ProtocolName(l3[9]))});
        out.push_back({"IPv4", "TTL", std::to_string(l3[8])});
        out.push_back({"IPv4", "Total length", std::format("{} B (header {} B)", Get16(l3, 2), ihl)});
        out.push_back({"IPv4", "Identification", std::format("0x{:04X}", Get16(l3, 4))});
        out.push_back({"IPv4", "Flags / offset", std::format("{}{}/ {}", (flags & 0x4000) ? "DF " : "", (flags & 0x2000) ? "MF " : "",
                                                           (flags & 0x1FFF) * 8)});
        out.push_back({"IPv4", "DSCP / ECN", std::format("{} / {}", l3[1] >> 2, l3[1] & 3)});
        if (ihl >= 20 && l3.size() >= ihl && (flags & 0x1FFF) == 0) BreakdownTransport(l3[9], l3.subspan(ihl), out);
    } else if (type == 0x86DD && l3.size() >= 40) {
        out.push_back({"IPv6", "Source", FormatIpv6(std::span<const uint8_t, 16>(l3.data() + 8, 16))});
        out.push_back({"IPv6", "Destination", FormatIpv6(std::span<const uint8_t, 16>(l3.data() + 24, 16))});
        out.push_back({"IPv6", "Next header", std::format("{}  {}", l3[6], ProtocolName(l3[6]))});
        out.push_back({"IPv6", "Hop limit", std::to_string(l3[7])});
        out.push_back({"IPv6", "Payload length", std::format("{} B", Get16(l3, 4))});
        out.push_back({"IPv6", "Flow label", std::format("0x{:05X}", Get32(l3, 0) & 0xFFFFF)});
        BreakdownTransport(l3[6], l3.subspan(40), out);
    } else if (type == 0x0806 && l3.size() >= 28) {
        const uint16_t op = Get16(l3, 6);
        out.push_back({"ARP", "Operation", op == 1 ? "1  request" : op == 2 ? "2  reply" : std::to_string(op)});
        out.push_back({"ARP", "Sender", std::format("{}  {}", FormatIpv4(*reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(l3.data() + 14)),
                                                   FormatMac(std::span<const uint8_t, 6>(l3.data() + 8, 6)))});
        out.push_back({"ARP", "Target", std::format("{}  {}", FormatIpv4(*reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(l3.data() + 24)),
                                                   FormatMac(std::span<const uint8_t, 6>(l3.data() + 18, 6)))});
    }
    return out;
}

} // namespace WS
```

```h
// WireScope - Network packet and driver structures (Layer 2 - Layer 7)
#pragma once
#include <Windows.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <chrono>

namespace WS {

// IOCTL codes for wsddntf.sys / WinpkFilter (DeviceType 0x9300)
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_GET_VERSION                      = 0x930024C0;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_GET_TCPIP_INTERFACES             = 0x930024C4;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_SEND_PACKET_TO_ADAPTER           = 0x930024C8;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_SEND_PACKET_TO_MSTCP             = 0x930024CC;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_READ_PACKET                      = 0x930024D0;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_SET_ADAPTER_MODE                 = 0x930024D4;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_FLUSH_ADAPTER_PACKET_QUEUE       = 0x930024D8;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_SET_ADAPTER_EVENT                = 0x930024DC;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_FAST_SEND_PACKET_TO_ADAPTER      = 0x930024E0;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_FAST_SEND_PACKET_TO_MSTCP        = 0x930024E4;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_SET_PACKET_EVENT                 = 0x930024E8;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_SET_WAN_EVENT                    = 0x930024EC;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_GET_ADAPTER_PACKET_QUEUE_SIZE    = 0x930024F0;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_GET_ADAPTER_MODE                 = 0x930024F4;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_SET_PACKET_FILTERS               = 0x930024F8;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_RESET_PACKET_FILTERS             = 0x930024FC;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_GET_PACKET_FILTERS_TABLE_SIZE    = 0x93002500;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_GET_PACKET_FILTERS_TABLE         = 0x93002504;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_READ_PACKETS                     = 0x93002510;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_SEND_PACKETS_TO_ADAPTER          = 0x93002514;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_SEND_PACKETS_TO_MSTCP            = 0x93002518;
inline constexpr DWORD IOCTL_INITIALIZE_FAST_IO               = 0x93002520;

// Adapter Modes
inline constexpr DWORD MODE_BYPASS             = 0x00000000;
inline constexpr DWORD MODE_TUNNEL_SEND        = 0x00000001; // MSTCP_FLAG_SENT_TUNNEL
inline constexpr DWORD MODE_TUNNEL_RECV        = 0x00000002; // MSTCP_FLAG_RECV_TUNNEL
inline constexpr DWORD MODE_LISTEN_SEND        = 0x00000004; // MSTCP_FLAG_SENT_LISTEN
inline constexpr DWORD MODE_LISTEN_RECV        = 0x00000008; // MSTCP_FLAG_RECV_LISTEN
inline constexpr DWORD MODE_FILTER_DIRECT      = 0x00000010;
inline constexpr DWORD MODE_LOOPBACK_FILTER    = 0x00000020;
inline constexpr DWORD MODE_LOOPBACK_BLOCK     = 0x00000040;

// Packet direction flags in INTERMEDIATE_BUFFER::m_dwDeviceFlags
inline constexpr DWORD PACKET_FLAG_ON_SEND     = 0x00000001;
inline constexpr DWORD PACKET_FLAG_ON_RECEIVE  = 0x00000002;

// Static filter actions
inline constexpr DWORD FILTER_ACTION_PASS      = 0x00000001; // pass in the kernel, never queued for user mode
inline constexpr DWORD FILTER_ACTION_DROP      = 0x00000002; // drop in the kernel
inline constexpr DWORD FILTER_ACTION_REDIRECT  = 0x00000003; // queue for user mode (adapter mode decides copy or take)

inline constexpr DWORD MODE_LISTEN = MODE_LISTEN_SEND | MODE_LISTEN_RECV;
inline constexpr DWORD MODE_TUNNEL = MODE_TUNNEL_SEND | MODE_TUNNEL_RECV;

inline constexpr size_t MAX_ADAPTER_COUNT      = 32;
inline constexpr size_t MAX_PACKET_SIZE        = 1514; // 0x5EA
inline constexpr size_t INTERMEDIATE_BUF_SIZE  = 1566; // 0x61E

#pragma pack(push, 1)

// WinpkFilter raw intermediate buffer layout (exact 0x61E = 1566 bytes)
struct INTERMEDIATE_BUFFER {
    LIST_ENTRY m_qLink;         // 0x00 (16 bytes in x64)
    DWORD      m_dwDeviceFlags; // 0x10 (4 bytes - direction: PACKET_FLAG_ON_SEND or PACKET_FLAG_ON_RECEIVE)
    DWORD      m_Length;        // 0x14 (4 bytes - length of Ethernet frame)
    DWORD      m_Flags;         // 0x18 (4 bytes - NDIS packet flags, not the direction)
    BYTE       m_Reserved[24];  // 0x1C (24 bytes to reach 0x34)
    BYTE       m_IBuffer[MAX_PACKET_SIZE]; // 0x34 (1514 bytes of raw frame)
};
static_assert(sizeof(INTERMEDIATE_BUFFER) == INTERMEDIATE_BUF_SIZE, "INTERMEDIATE_BUFFER must be 1566 bytes");

// Request to send/read a single packet
struct ETH_REQUEST {
    HANDLE               hAdapterHandle; // 0x00 (8 bytes)
    INTERMEDIATE_BUFFER* Buffer;         // 0x08 (8 bytes)
};
static_assert(sizeof(ETH_REQUEST) == 16, "ETH_REQUEST must be 16 bytes");

// Request to configure adapter operational mode
struct ADAPTER_MODE {
    HANDLE hAdapterHandle; // 0x00 (8 bytes)
    DWORD  dwFlags;        // 0x08 (4 bytes)
};
static_assert(sizeof(ADAPTER_MODE) == 12, "ADAPTER_MODE must be 12 bytes");

// Parallel arrays structure returned by IOCTL_GET_TCPIP_INTERFACES (0x2284 = 8836 bytes)
struct TCP_ADAPTER_LIST {
    DWORD  m_nAdapterCount;                         // 0x0000 (4 bytes)
    char   m_szAdapterNameList[32][256];            // 0x0004 (8192 bytes)
    HANDLE m_nAdapterHandle[32];                    // 0x2004 (256 bytes)
    DWORD  m_nAdapterMediumList[32];                // 0x2104 (128 bytes)
    BYTE   m_czCurrentAddress[32][6];               // 0x2184 (192 bytes)
    WORD   m_usMTU[32];                             // 0x2244 (64 bytes)
};
static_assert(sizeof(TCP_ADAPTER_LIST) == 0x2284, "TCP_AdapterList must be 8836 bytes");

// Ethernet II Frame Header (14 bytes)
struct ETH_HEADER {
    BYTE  DestMac[6];
    BYTE  SrcMac[6];
    WORD  EtherType; // Big-endian (0x0800 = IPv4, 0x86DD = IPv6, 0x0806 = ARP)
};
static_assert(sizeof(ETH_HEADER) == 14, "ETH_HEADER must be 14 bytes");

// IPv4 Header (20 bytes min)
struct IPV4_HEADER {
    BYTE  VersionAndIhl; // Version (4 bits) + IHL (4 bits)
    BYTE  Tos;
    WORD  TotalLength;   // Big-endian
    WORD  Id;
    WORD  FlagsAndOffset;
    BYTE  Ttl;
    BYTE  Protocol;      // 1 = ICMP, 6 = TCP, 17 = UDP
    WORD  Checksum;
    DWORD SrcIp;         // Network order
    DWORD DestIp;        // Network order
};
static_assert(sizeof(IPV4_HEADER) == 20, "IPV4_HEADER must be 20 bytes");

// IPv6 Header (40 bytes)
struct IPV6_HEADER {
    DWORD VersionClassFlow;
    WORD  PayloadLength;
    BYTE  NextHeader;    // Protocol
    BYTE  HopLimit;
    BYTE  SrcIp[16];
    BYTE  DestIp[16];
};
static_assert(sizeof(IPV6_HEADER) == 40, "IPV6_HEADER must be 40 bytes");

// TCP Header (20 bytes min)
struct TCP_HEADER {
    WORD  SrcPort;       // Big-endian
    WORD  DestPort;      // Big-endian
    DWORD SeqNumber;
    DWORD AckNumber;
    BYTE  DataOffset;    // Data offset (4 bits) + Reserved (4 bits)
    BYTE  Flags;         // CWR, ECE, URG, ACK, PSH, RST, SYN, FIN
    WORD  Window;
    WORD  Checksum;
    WORD  UrgentPointer;
};
static_assert(sizeof(TCP_HEADER) == 20, "TCP_HEADER must be 20 bytes");

// UDP Header (8 bytes)
struct UDP_HEADER {
    WORD SrcPort;        // Big-endian
    WORD DestPort;       // Big-endian
    WORD Length;
    WORD Checksum;
};
static_assert(sizeof(UDP_HEADER) == 8, "UDP_HEADER must be 8 bytes");

// ICMP Header (8 bytes)
struct ICMP_HEADER {
    BYTE Type;
    BYTE Code;
    WORD Checksum;
    WORD Id;
    WORD Sequence;
};
static_assert(sizeof(ICMP_HEADER) == 8, "ICMP_HEADER must be 8 bytes");

// ARP Header (28 bytes)
struct ARP_HEADER {
    WORD HwType;
    WORD ProtoType;
    BYTE HwSize;
    BYTE ProtoSize;
    WORD Opcode;
    BYTE SenderMac[6];
    BYTE SenderIp[4];
    BYTE TargetMac[6];
    BYTE TargetIp[4];
};
static_assert(sizeof(ARP_HEADER) == 28, "ARP_HEADER must be 28 bytes");

#pragma pack(pop)

enum class ProtocolType : uint8_t {
    Unknown,
    ARP,
    IPv4,
    IPv6,
    TCP,
    UDP,
    ICMP,
    DNS,
    TLS
};

enum class Direction : uint8_t {
    Inbound,
    Outbound
};

// What the data plane did with a captured packet.
enum class PacketFate : uint8_t {
    Observed,  // listen mode: a copy, the original went on unchanged
    Passed,    // tunnel mode: re-injected at once
    Delayed,   // held back by the impairment simulator (DelayUs)
    Dropped,   // discarded by the impairment simulator
    Blocked,   // discarded by a firewall rule or the default policy
    Killed     // discarded by the kill switch
};

// Application-level representation of a decoded packet
struct DecodedPacket {
    uint64_t               Index{0};
    uint64_t               TimestampUs{0};
    Direction              Dir{Direction::Inbound};
    PacketFate             Fate{PacketFate::Observed};
    uint32_t               DelayUs{0};
    ProtocolType           Protocol{ProtocolType::Unknown};
    std::string            ProtocolName{"RAW"};
    std::string            Source;
    std::string            Destination;
    uint16_t               SourcePort{0};
    uint16_t               DestPort{0};
    uint32_t               Length{0};
    std::string            Info;
    std::string            DomainOrHost; // DNS query name or TLS SNI
    std::string            Process;      // Owning process name, e.g. "discord.exe"
    std::vector<uint8_t>   RawData;
};

// Network adapter metadata
struct AdapterDescription {
    uint32_t    Index{0};
    HANDLE      Handle{nullptr};
    std::string SystemName;
    std::string FriendlyName;
    std::string MacAddress;
    uint32_t    MTU{1500};
    DWORD       Medium{0};
    bool        IsUp{false};
    bool        HasGateway{false};
};

} // namespace WS
```

`src/core/PcapWriter.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/PcapWriter.h"

namespace WS {

namespace {

#pragma pack(push, 1)
struct PcapGlobalHeader {
    uint32_t magic_number{0xa1b2c3d4}; // microsecond timestamp format
    uint16_t version_major{2};
    uint16_t version_minor{4};
    int32_t  thiszone{0};
    uint32_t sigfigs{0};
    uint32_t snaplen{65535};
    uint32_t network{1};               // LINKTYPE_ETHERNET = 1
};
static_assert(sizeof(PcapGlobalHeader) == 24, "PcapGlobalHeader must be 24 bytes");

struct PcapPacketHeader {
    uint32_t ts_sec{0};
    uint32_t ts_usec{0};
    uint32_t incl_len{0};
    uint32_t orig_len{0};
};
static_assert(sizeof(PcapPacketHeader) == 16, "PcapPacketHeader must be 16 bytes");
#pragma pack(pop)

} // namespace

PcapWriter::PcapWriter() = default;

PcapWriter::~PcapWriter() {
    Close();
}

bool PcapWriter::Open(const std::wstring& filePath) {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    Close();

    m_file.open(filePath, std::ios::binary | std::ios::out | std::ios::trunc);
    if (!m_file.is_open()) {
        return false;
    }

    PcapGlobalHeader header{};
    m_file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&header), sizeof(header));
    if (!m_file.good()) {
        m_file.close();
        return false;
    }

    m_packetsWritten = 0;
    m_bytesWritten = sizeof(header);
    return true;
}

void PcapWriter::Close() noexcept {
    if (m_file.is_open()) {
        m_file.flush();
        m_file.close();
    }
}

bool PcapWriter::WritePacket(std::span<const uint8_t> frame, uint64_t timestampUs) {
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (!m_file.is_open() || frame.empty()) {
        return false;
    }

    PcapPacketHeader pHeader{};
    pHeader.ts_sec = static_cast<uint32_t>(timestampUs / 1'000'000ULL);
    pHeader.ts_usec = static_cast<uint32_t>(timestampUs % 1'000'000ULL);
    pHeader.incl_len = static_cast<uint32_t>(frame.size());
    pHeader.orig_len = static_cast<uint32_t>(frame.size());

    m_file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&pHeader), sizeof(pHeader));
    m_file.write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(frame.data()), frame.size());

    if (!m_file.good()) {
        return false;
    }

    m_packetsWritten++;
    m_bytesWritten += sizeof(pHeader) + frame.size();
    return true;
}

} // namespace WS
```

`src/core/ProcessMapper.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/ProcessMapper.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
#include <iphlpapi.h>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstring>

#pragma comment(lib, "iphlpapi.lib")

namespace WS {

namespace {

constexpr auto kRefresh = std::chrono::milliseconds(250);
constexpr uint64_t kIdleMs = 3000;      // no reader for this long: stop rebuilding the tables
constexpr uint64_t kForgetMs = 30'000;  // a pid without sockets for this long is forgotten

constexpr uint32_t Key(uint8_t protocol, uint16_t port) noexcept {
    return (static_cast<uint32_t>(protocol) << 16) | port;
}

uint64_t CreationTime(HANDLE process) noexcept {
    FILETIME created{}, exited{}, kernel{}, user{};
    if (!GetProcessTimes(process, &created, &exited, &kernel, &user)) return 0;
    return (static_cast<uint64_t>(created.dwHighDateTime) << 32) | created.dwLowDateTime;
}

// True when `pid` still names the process that was created at `started` (0 = cannot tell: assume so).
bool SameProcess(DWORD pid, uint64_t started) noexcept {
    if (started == 0) return true;
    const Handle process(OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, FALSE, pid));
    return !process || CreationTime(process.get()) == started;
}

// Calls add(row) for every row of one socket table.
template <class Table, class Query, class Add>
void ReadTable(Query query, Add add) {
    ULONG size = 0;
    if (query(nullptr, &size) != ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_BUFFER || size == 0) return;
    std::vector<BYTE> buffer(size + 4096);  // room for sockets opened meanwhile
    size = static_cast<ULONG>(buffer.size());
    if (query(buffer.data(), &size) != NO_ERROR) return;
    const auto* table = reinterpret_cast<const Table*>(buffer.data());
    for (DWORD i = 0; i < table->dwNumEntries; ++i) add(table->table[i]);
}

uint16_t Port(DWORD networkOrder) noexcept {
    return ntohs(static_cast<u_short>(networkOrder));
}

std::array<uint8_t, 16> V4(DWORD address) noexcept {
    std::array<uint8_t, 16> bytes{};
    std::memcpy(bytes.data(), &address, sizeof address);
    return bytes;
}

std::array<uint8_t, 16> V6(const UCHAR (&address)[16]) noexcept {
    std::array<uint8_t, 16> bytes{};
    std::memcpy(bytes.data(), address, bytes.size());
    return bytes;
}

} // namespace

const ProcessInfo* ProcessMapper::Snapshot::Find(uint8_t protocol, uint16_t localPort) const noexcept {
    const auto it = ports.find(Key(protocol, localPort));
    return it == ports.end() ? nullptr : processes[it->second].get();
}

ProcessMapper& ProcessMapper::Instance() {
    static ProcessMapper instance;
    return instance;
}

ProcessMapper::~ProcessMapper() {
    if (m_thread.joinable()) {
        m_thread.request_stop();
        m_wake.notify_all();
        m_thread.join();
    }
}

std::shared_ptr<const ProcessMapper::Snapshot> ProcessMapper::Current() {
    m_lastUse = GetTickCount64();
    std::call_once(m_started, [this] {
        m_current = Build();  // the first caller gets real data at once
        m_thread = std::jthread([this](std::stop_token stop) { Run(stop); });
    });
    return m_current.load();
}

bool ProcessMapper::Running(const ProcessInfo& process) noexcept {
    if (process.pid == 4) return true;
    const Handle handle(OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, FALSE, process.pid));
    if (!handle) return false;  // gone (a process we may not query at all never had a path either)
    DWORD code = 0;
    if (!GetExitCodeProcess(handle.get(), &code) || code != STILL_ACTIVE) return false;
    return process.started == 0 || CreationTime(handle.get()) == process.started;
}

void ProcessMapper::Run(std::stop_token stop) {
    std::unique_lock lock(m_wakeMutex);
    while (!stop.stop_requested()) {
        m_wake.wait_for(lock, stop, kRefresh, [] { return false; });
        if (stop.stop_requested()) break;
        if (GetTickCount64() - m_lastUse.load() > kIdleMs) continue;  // nobody is looking
        lock.unlock();
        m_current = Build();
        lock.lock();
    }
}

std::shared_ptr<const ProcessInfo> ProcessMapper::Describe(DWORD pid) {
    auto info = std::make_shared<ProcessInfo>();
    info->id = ++m_nextId;
    info->pid = pid;
    if (pid == 4) {
        info->name = "system";
        info->display = L"System";
        info->label = "System";
        return info;
    }
    if (const Handle process(OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, FALSE, pid)); process) {
        info->started = CreationTime(process.get());
        std::wstring path(32768, L'\0');  // long paths: the image name is not limited to MAX_PATH
        DWORD size = static_cast<DWORD>(path.size());
        if (QueryFullProcessImageNameW(process.get(), 0, path.data(), &size)) {
            path.resize(size);
            info->path = std::move(path);
        }
    }
    info->display = info->path.substr(info->path.find_last_of(L'\\') + 1);
    info->name = ToUtf8(FoldCase(info->display));
    info->pathKey = ToUtf8(FoldCase(info->path));
    info->label = info->display.empty() ? "pid " + std::to_string(pid) : ToUtf8(info->display);
    return info;
}

std::shared_ptr<const ProcessMapper::Snapshot> ProcessMapper::Build() {
    auto snapshot = std::make_shared<Snapshot>();
    const uint64_t now = GetTickCount64();
    // A pid missing from the previous build (or after a pause) may have been handed to a new process.
    const bool continuous = m_lastBuild != 0 && now - m_lastBuild < 2000;
    std::unordered_map<DWORD, uint32_t> indexOf;  // pid -> index into snapshot->processes

    auto owner = [&](DWORD pid) -> uint32_t {
        if (const auto it = indexOf.find(pid); it != indexOf.end()) return it->second;
        Known& known = m_known[pid];
        const bool fresh = continuous && known.lastSeen == m_lastBuild;
        if (!known.info || (!fresh && !SameProcess(pid, known.info->started))) known.info = Describe(pid);
        known.lastSeen = now;
        const auto index = static_cast<uint32_t>(snapshot->processes.size());
        snapshot->processes.push_back(known.info);
        indexOf.emplace(pid, index);
        return index;
    };
    auto add = [&](uint8_t protocol, DWORD pid, Endpoint e) {
        if (pid == 0) return;  // TIME_WAIT and closed sockets belong to no process
        e.process = owner(pid);
        e.protocol = protocol;
        snapshot->ports[Key(protocol, e.localPort)] = e.process;
        snapshot->endpoints.push_back(e);
    };

    ReadTable<MIB_TCPTABLE_OWNER_PID>(
        [](void* b, ULONG* s) { return GetExtendedTcpTable(b, s, FALSE, AF_INET, TCP_TABLE_OWNER_PID_ALL, 0); },
        [&](const MIB_TCPROW_OWNER_PID& r) {
            add(6, r.dwOwningPid, {.version = 4, .state = static_cast<uint8_t>(r.dwState), .localPort = Port(r.dwLocalPort),
                                   .remotePort = Port(r.dwRemotePort), .local = V4(r.dwLocalAddr), .remote = V4(r.dwRemoteAddr)});
        });
    ReadTable<MIB_TCP6TABLE_OWNER_PID>(
        [](void* b, ULONG* s) { return GetExtendedTcpTable(b, s, FALSE, AF_INET6, TCP_TABLE_OWNER_PID_ALL, 0); },
        [&](const MIB_TCP6ROW_OWNER_PID& r) {
            add(6, r.dwOwningPid, {.version = 6, .state = static_cast<uint8_t>(r.dwState), .localPort = Port(r.dwLocalPort),
                                   .remotePort = Port(r.dwRemotePort), .local = V6(r.ucLocalAddr), .remote = V6(r.ucRemoteAddr)});
        });
    ReadTable<MIB_UDPTABLE_OWNER_PID>(
        [](void* b, ULONG* s) { return GetExtendedUdpTable(b, s, FALSE, AF_INET, UDP_TABLE_OWNER_PID, 0); },
        [&](const MIB_UDPROW_OWNER_PID& r) {
            add(17, r.dwOwningPid, {.version = 4, .localPort = Port(r.dwLocalPort), .local = V4(r.dwLocalAddr)});
        });
    ReadTable<MIB_UDP6TABLE_OWNER_PID>(
        [](void* b, ULONG* s) { return GetExtendedUdpTable(b, s, FALSE, AF_INET6, UDP_TABLE_OWNER_PID, 0); },
        [&](const MIB_UDP6ROW_OWNER_PID& r) {
            add(17, r.dwOwningPid, {.version = 6, .localPort = Port(r.dwLocalPort), .local = V6(r.ucLocalAddr)});
        });

    std::erase_if(m_known, [&](const auto& entry) { return now - entry.second.lastSeen > kForgetMs; });
    m_lastBuild = now;
    return snapshot;
}

} // namespace WS
```

`src/core/ProcessMapper.h`:

```h
// WireScope - Which process owns a packet: local (protocol, port) -> process.
//
// The driver works below TCP/IP and knows nothing about processes, so the owner is looked up in the
// socket tables (GetExtendedTcpTable / GetExtendedUdpTable, IPv4 and IPv6). Building those tables
// takes milliseconds, far too long for the data path, so a background thread rebuilds an immutable
// Snapshot every 250 ms while someone uses it; readers take the current snapshot (one atomic load) and
// look ports up without locks or allocation.
//
// The key is the local port: an outbound packet's source port, an inbound packet's destination port.
// A port bound by several processes on different local addresses resolves to one of them.
//
// Every process instance is described once (ProcessInfo) and shared by the snapshots, the packets
// and the per-process traffic totals. A pid that Windows hands to a new process gets a new
// ProcessInfo: the creation time tells the two apart.
#pragma once
#include <Windows.h>
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <stop_token>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace WS {

struct ProcessInfo : std::enable_shared_from_this<ProcessInfo> {
    uint32_t     id{0};       // unique per process instance in this WireScope session
    DWORD        pid{0};
    uint64_t     started{0};  // creation time (FILETIME), 0 when Windows does not tell
    std::string  name;        // folded image name, "discord.exe"; "system" for pid 4; empty = unknown
    std::string  pathKey;     // folded full path, UTF-8: what an "app" rule with a path compares
    std::wstring path;        // full image path as reported; empty for protected or vanished processes
    std::wstring display;     // image name as written on disk, "Discord.exe"
    std::string  label;       // the same in UTF-8 for packet lists, or "pid 1234" when the name is unknown
};

// One socket from the tables: a TCP connection or listener, or a bound UDP port.
struct Endpoint {
    uint32_t process{0};    // index into Snapshot::processes
    uint8_t  protocol{0};   // 6 or 17
    uint8_t  version{4};    // 4 or 6
    uint8_t  state{0};      // MIB_TCP_STATE for TCP, 0 for UDP
    uint16_t localPort{0};  // host byte order
    uint16_t remotePort{0};
    std::array<uint8_t, 16> local{};   // IPv4 in the first four bytes, network order
    std::array<uint8_t, 16> remote{};
};

class ProcessMapper {
public:
    struct Snapshot {
        std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint32_t> ports;  // (protocol << 16 | port) -> index into processes
        std::vector<std::shared_ptr<const ProcessInfo>> processes;
        std::vector<Endpoint> endpoints;
        // nullptr when the port has no owner (closed, or in TIME_WAIT); valid while the snapshot lives.
        [[nodiscard]] const ProcessInfo* Find(uint8_t protocol, uint16_t localPort) const noexcept;
    };

    static ProcessMapper& Instance();
    ~ProcessMapper();

    ProcessMapper(const ProcessMapper&) = delete;
    ProcessMapper& operator=(const ProcessMapper&) = delete;

    // The newest snapshot; starts the refresher on first use. Never empty.
    [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<const Snapshot> Current();

    // False once the process has exited (a reused pid is a different process).
    [[nodiscard]] static bool Running(const ProcessInfo& process) noexcept;

private:
    struct Known {
        std::shared_ptr<const ProcessInfo> info;
        uint64_t lastSeen{0};  // GetTickCount64 of the last build that found a socket of this pid
    };

    ProcessMapper() = default;
    void Run(std::stop_token stop);
    std::shared_ptr<const Snapshot> Build();
    std::shared_ptr<const ProcessInfo> Describe(DWORD pid);

    std::atomic<std::shared_ptr<const Snapshot>> m_current{std::make_shared<const Snapshot>()};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> m_lastUse{0};  // GetTickCount64 of the last Current(): idle refresher sleeps
    std::once_flag m_started;
    std::mutex m_wakeMutex;
    std::condition_variable_any m_wake;
    // Refresher thread only:
    std::unordered_map<DWORD, Known> m_known;
    uint64_t m_lastBuild{0};
    uint32_t m_nextId{0};
    std::jthread m_thread;  // last member: joined before the rest is destroyed
};

} // namespace WS

```

`src/core/ProcessTraffic.h`:

```h
// WireScope - Traffic per process instance, counted by the packet engine while user mode sees every
// packet (capture, process monitor, firewall or simulator in the engine).
#pragma once
#include "core/ProcessMapper.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>

namespace WS {

struct TrafficCounters {
    uint64_t packetsIn{0}, packetsOut{0};
    uint64_t bytesIn{0}, bytesOut{0};

    TrafficCounters& operator+=(const TrafficCounters& o) noexcept {
        packetsIn += o.packetsIn;
        packetsOut += o.packetsOut;
        bytesIn += o.bytesIn;
        bytesOut += o.bytesOut;
        return *this;
    }
    void Add(bool outbound, uint32_t bytes) noexcept {
        if (outbound) {
            ++packetsOut;
            bytesOut += bytes;
        } else {
            ++packetsIn;
            bytesIn += bytes;
        }
    }
};

// One process instance; an empty `process` collects what no process owns (ARP, ICMP, packets to
// closed ports, connections already in TIME_WAIT).
struct ProcessTraffic {
    std::shared_ptr<const ProcessInfo> process;
    TrafficCounters total;
    uint64_t lastPacketUs{0};  // MonotonicMicroseconds of the newest packet
};

} // namespace WS
```

`src/core/ProcessTrust.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/ProcessTrust.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <ShlObj.h>
#include <wintrust.h>
#include <softpub.h>
#include <mscat.h>
#include <bcrypt.h>
#include <array>
#include <format>
#include <optional>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

#pragma comment(lib, "wintrust.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "crypt32.lib")

namespace WS {

namespace {

// Catalogs sign Windows components, which are far smaller; hashing a huge file for a catalog that
// cannot exist would only keep the verifier busy (and WireScope from exiting) for seconds.
constexpr LONGLONG kMaxCatalogFile = 256LL * 1024 * 1024;

// Names Windows components run under. Elsewhere than in the Windows folder they are an imitation.
constexpr std::wstring_view kSystemNames[] = {
    L"svchost.exe", L"lsass.exe",    L"csrss.exe",     L"smss.exe",       L"wininit.exe",  L"winlogon.exe",   L"services.exe",
    L"spoolsv.exe", L"dwm.exe",      L"taskhostw.exe", L"conhost.exe",    L"rundll32.exe", L"dllhost.exe",    L"explorer.exe",
    L"ctfmon.exe",  L"sihost.exe",   L"fontdrvhost.exe", L"wmiprvse.exe", L"lsaiso.exe",   L"runtimebroker.exe", L"taskmgr.exe",
    L"regsvr32.exe", L"mshta.exe",   L"cmd.exe",       L"powershell.exe", L"searchindexer.exe", L"audiodg.exe", L"wudfhost.exe",
};

std::wstring KnownFolder(REFKNOWNFOLDERID id) {
    PWSTR path = nullptr;
    std::wstring out;
    if (SUCCEEDED(SHGetKnownFolderPath(id, KF_FLAG_DEFAULT, nullptr, &path)) && path) out = path;
    CoTaskMemFree(path);
    return out;
}

// Folded folder prefixes ending in a backslash.
struct Places {
    std::wstring windows;
    std::wstring packages;                 // Program Files\WindowsApps: installed app packages
    std::array<std::wstring, 3> writable;  // user profiles, ProgramData, the Windows temporary folder

    Places() {
        auto folder = [](std::wstring path) {
            if (path.empty()) return path;
            if (path.back() != L'\\') path += L'\\';
            return FoldCase(path);
        };
        windows = folder(KnownFolder(FOLDERID_Windows));
        const std::wstring programs = folder(KnownFolder(FOLDERID_ProgramFiles));
        packages = programs.empty() ? std::wstring() : programs + L"windowsapps\\";
        writable = {folder(KnownFolder(FOLDERID_UserProfiles)), folder(KnownFolder(FOLDERID_ProgramData)),
                    windows.empty() ? std::wstring() : windows + L"temp\\"};
    }
};

const Places& Folders() {
    static const Places places;
    return places;
}

bool Under(std::wstring_view path, const std::wstring& folder) {
    return !folder.empty() && path.starts_with(folder);
}

uint32_t PlaceFlags(const std::wstring& path, const std::wstring& folded) {
    const Places& places = Folders();
    const bool windows = Under(folded, places.windows);
    uint32_t flags = 0;
    for (const auto& folder : places.writable) {
        if (Under(folded, folder)) flags |= TrustFlag::UserFolder;
    }
    if (const DWORD attributes = GetFileAttributesW(path.c_str());
        attributes != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES && (attributes & (FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN | FILE_ATTRIBUTE_SYSTEM)) && !windows) {
        flags |= TrustFlag::Hidden;
    }
    const std::wstring_view name = std::wstring_view(folded).substr(folded.find_last_of(L'\\') + 1);
    for (const auto system : kSystemNames) {
        if (name == system && !windows) flags |= TrustFlag::Imitation;
    }
    return flags;
}

// Store and MSIX apps carry no Authenticode signature in their files: the package as a whole is
// signed (AppxSignature.p7x) and checked by Windows when it is installed into WindowsApps, which only
// the system may write to. Returns the package publisher, or nullopt outside that folder.
std::optional<std::wstring> PackagePublisher(const std::wstring& path, const std::wstring& folded) {
    const std::wstring& packages = Folders().packages;
    if (!Under(folded, packages) || folded.size() != path.size()) return std::nullopt;
    const size_t end = folded.find(L'\\', packages.size());  // end of the package folder name
    if (end == std::wstring::npos) return std::nullopt;
    const std::wstring manifest = path.substr(0, end) + L"\\AppxManifest.xml";
    const FileHandle file(CreateFileW(manifest.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, nullptr));
    if (!file) return std::nullopt;
    std::string xml(64 * 1024, '\0');
    DWORD read = 0;
    if (!ReadFile(file.get(), xml.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(xml.size()), &read, nullptr)) return std::nullopt;
    xml.resize(read);

    // <Identity Name="..." Publisher="CN=Microsoft Corporation, O=..., C=US" .../>
    const size_t identity = xml.find("<Identity");
    const size_t close = identity == std::string::npos ? std::string::npos : xml.find('>', identity);
    const size_t attribute = identity == std::string::npos ? std::string::npos : xml.find(" Publisher=\"", identity);
    if (attribute == std::string::npos || attribute > close) return std::wstring();
    const size_t begin = attribute + 12;
    std::string publisher = xml.substr(begin, xml.find('"', begin) - begin);
    if (publisher.starts_with("CN=")) {  // the common name reads best
        publisher.erase(0, 3);
        if (const size_t comma = publisher.find(','); comma != std::string::npos) publisher.resize(comma);
    }
    return ToWide(publisher);
}

std::wstring SignerName(HANDLE state) {
    CRYPT_PROVIDER_DATA* provider = WTHelperProvDataFromStateData(state);
    if (!provider) return {};
    CRYPT_PROVIDER_SGNR* signer = WTHelperGetProvSignerFromChain(provider, 0, FALSE, 0);
    if (!signer || signer->csCertChain == 0 || !signer->pasCertChain || !signer->pasCertChain[0].pCert) return {};
    std::wstring name(256, L'\0');
    const DWORD n = CertGetNameStringW(signer->pasCertChain[0].pCert, CERT_NAME_SIMPLE_DISPLAY_TYPE, 0, nullptr, name.data(),
                                       static_cast<DWORD>(name.size()));
    name.resize(n > 0 ? n - 1 : 0);
    return name;
}

// WinVerifyTrust without any user interface or network access; fills `signer` on success.
LONG Verify(WINTRUST_DATA& data, std::wstring& signer) {
    GUID action = WINTRUST_ACTION_GENERIC_VERIFY_V2;
    data.cbStruct = sizeof data;
    data.dwUIChoice = WTD_UI_NONE;
    data.fdwRevocationChecks = WTD_REVOKE_NONE;
    data.dwStateAction = WTD_STATEACTION_VERIFY;
    data.dwProvFlags = WTD_CACHE_ONLY_URL_RETRIEVAL | WTD_REVOCATION_CHECK_NONE;
    const LONG status = WinVerifyTrust(static_cast<HWND>(INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE), &action, &data);
    if (status == ERROR_SUCCESS) signer = SignerName(data.hWVTStateData);
    data.dwStateAction = WTD_STATEACTION_CLOSE;
    WinVerifyTrust(static_cast<HWND>(INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE), &action, &data);
    return status;
}

// Windows components are signed in catalogs (.cat) rather than in the file itself.
std::optional<LONG> VerifyCatalog(const std::wstring& path, HANDLE file, const wchar_t* algorithm, std::wstring& signer) {
    HCATADMIN admin = nullptr;
    if (!CryptCATAdminAcquireContext2(&admin, nullptr, algorithm, nullptr, 0)) return std::nullopt;
    const ScopeExit releaseAdmin([&] { CryptCATAdminReleaseContext(admin, 0); });

    SetFilePointer(file, 0, nullptr, FILE_BEGIN);
    DWORD size = 0;
    CryptCATAdminCalcHashFromFileHandle2(admin, file, &size, nullptr, 0);
    if (size == 0) return std::nullopt;
    std::vector<BYTE> hash(size);
    SetFilePointer(file, 0, nullptr, FILE_BEGIN);
    if (!CryptCATAdminCalcHashFromFileHandle2(admin, file, &size, hash.data(), 0)) return std::nullopt;

    HCATINFO catalog = CryptCATAdminEnumCatalogFromHash(admin, hash.data(), size, 0, nullptr);
    if (!catalog) return std::nullopt;
    const ScopeExit releaseCatalog([&] { CryptCATAdminReleaseCatalogContext(admin, catalog, 0); });
    CATALOG_INFO info{sizeof info};
    if (!CryptCATCatalogInfoFromContext(catalog, &info, 0)) return std::nullopt;

    std::wstring tag;  // the catalog member is the hash in upper-case hex
    for (const BYTE b : hash) tag += std::format(L"{:02X}", b);
    WINTRUST_CATALOG_INFO member{sizeof member};
    member.pcwszCatalogFilePath = info.wszCatalogFile;
    member.pcwszMemberTag = tag.c_str();
    member.pcwszMemberFilePath = path.c_str();
    member.hMemberFile = file;
    member.pbCalculatedFileHash = hash.data();
    member.cbCalculatedFileHash = size;
    member.hCatAdmin = admin;
    WINTRUST_DATA data{};
    data.dwUnionChoice = WTD_CHOICE_CATALOG;
    data.pCatalog = &member;
    return Verify(data, signer);
}

TrustReport Inspect(const std::wstring& path, const std::wstring& folded) {
    TrustReport report;
    report.flags = PlaceFlags(path, folded);
    const FileHandle file(CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nullptr,
                                      OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_FLAG_SEQUENTIAL_SCAN, nullptr));
    if (!file) {
        report.signature = Signature::Unknown;
        return report;
    }
    WINTRUST_FILE_INFO fileInfo{sizeof fileInfo};
    fileInfo.pcwszFilePath = path.c_str();
    fileInfo.hFile = file.get();
    WINTRUST_DATA data{};
    data.dwUnionChoice = WTD_CHOICE_FILE;
    data.pFile = &fileInfo;
    const LONG embedded = Verify(data, report.signer);
    if (embedded == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        report.signature = Signature::Signed;
        return report;
    }
    if (embedded != TRUST_E_NOSIGNATURE && embedded != TRUST_E_SUBJECT_FORM_UNKNOWN && embedded != TRUST_E_PROVIDER_UNKNOWN) {
        report.signature = Signature::Invalid;  // a signature is there and does not hold
        return report;
    }
    LARGE_INTEGER size{};
    if (GetFileSizeEx(file.get(), &size) && size.QuadPart <= kMaxCatalogFile) {
        for (const wchar_t* algorithm : {BCRYPT_SHA256_ALGORITHM, BCRYPT_SHA1_ALGORITHM}) {
            if (const auto status = VerifyCatalog(path, file.get(), algorithm, report.signer)) {
                report.signature = *status == ERROR_SUCCESS ? Signature::Signed : Signature::Invalid;
                return report;
            }
        }
    }
    if (auto publisher = PackagePublisher(path, folded)) {
        report.signature = Signature::Package;
        report.signer = std::move(*publisher);
        return report;
    }
    report.signature = Signature::Unsigned;
    return report;
}

}  // namespace

Risk TrustReport::risk() const noexcept {
    const bool unsigned_ = signature == Signature::Unsigned;
    if ((flags & TrustFlag::Imitation) || signature == Signature::Invalid) return Risk::High;
    if (unsigned_ && (flags & (TrustFlag::UserFolder | TrustFlag::Hidden))) return Risk::High;
    if (unsigned_ || (flags & TrustFlag::Hidden)) return Risk::Notice;
    return Risk::None;
}

TrustReport ProcessTrust::Verify(const std::wstring& path) {
    if (path.empty()) return {Signature::Unknown};
    return Inspect(path, FoldCase(path));
}

ProcessTrust& ProcessTrust::Instance() {
    static ProcessTrust instance;
    return instance;
}

ProcessTrust::~ProcessTrust() {
    if (m_thread.joinable()) {
        m_thread.request_stop();
        m_wake.notify_all();
        m_thread.join();
    }
}

TrustReport ProcessTrust::Check(const std::wstring& path) {
    if (path.empty()) return {Signature::Unknown};
    std::call_once(m_started, [this] { m_thread = std::jthread([this](std::stop_token stop) { Run(stop); }); });
    std::wstring key = FoldCase(path);
    std::lock_guard lock(m_mutex);
    if (const auto it = m_cache.find(key); it != m_cache.end()) return it->second;
    m_cache.emplace(std::move(key), TrustReport{});
    m_queue.push_back(path);
    m_wake.notify_one();
    return {};
}

void ProcessTrust::Run(std::stop_token stop) {
    std::unique_lock lock(m_mutex);
    while (!stop.stop_requested()) {
        if (!m_wake.wait(lock, stop, [this] { return !m_queue.empty(); })) break;
        const std::wstring path = std::move(m_queue.front());
        m_queue.pop_front();
        lock.unlock();
        std::wstring key = FoldCase(path);
        TrustReport report = Inspect(path, key);
        lock.lock();
        m_cache[std::move(key)] = std::move(report);
    }
}

} // namespace WS

```

`src/core/ProcessTrust.h`:

```h
// WireScope - Is a program what it claims to be?
//
// For every image path the Processes page shows: the Authenticode signature (embedded, or a Windows
// catalog for system files) and a few facts about where the file lives. Verification hashes the
// file, which takes from milliseconds to seconds, so it runs on one background thread and is cached
// per path for the session. Revocation is never checked online: WireScope must not cause traffic
// while it watches traffic, and it may run with the network blocked.
//
// The verdict is a hint, not a malware scan: a signed program can misbehave and an unsigned one is
// often a harmless home-made tool. What raises the alarm is a combination that legitimate software
// rarely shows - unsigned code in a folder any program can write to, a hidden executable, a file
// named like a Windows component outside the Windows folder, or a signature that does not verify.
#pragma once
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstdint>
#include <deque>
#include <mutex>
#include <stop_token>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>

namespace WS {

enum class Signature : uint8_t {
    Pending,   // queued for verification
    Signed,    // valid signature from a trusted publisher
    Unsigned,  // no signature, embedded or in a catalog
    Invalid,   // signed, but the signature does not verify (altered file, untrusted or revoked certificate)
    Unknown,   // the file could not be read
    Package,   // part of an app package (MSIX) in the protected WindowsApps folder: the package is signed,
               // Windows verified it at installation, and only the system can write there
};

namespace TrustFlag {
inline constexpr uint32_t UserFolder = 1;  // under C:\Users, ProgramData or a temporary folder
inline constexpr uint32_t Hidden = 2;      // hidden or system file outside the Windows folder
inline constexpr uint32_t Imitation = 4;   // name of a Windows component, outside the Windows folder
}  // namespace TrustFlag

enum class Risk : uint8_t { None, Notice, High };

struct TrustReport {
    Signature signature{Signature::Pending};
    std::wstring signer;  // subject of the signing certificate, e.g. "Microsoft Windows"
    uint32_t flags{0};    // TrustFlag bits
    [[nodiscard]] Risk risk() const noexcept;
};

class ProcessTrust {
public:
    static ProcessTrust& Instance();
    ~ProcessTrust();

    ProcessTrust(const ProcessTrust&) = delete;
    ProcessTrust& operator=(const ProcessTrust&) = delete;

    // Never blocks: a path seen for the first time is queued and reported as Pending.
    [[nodiscard]] TrustReport Check(const std::wstring& path);
    // Verifies one file now, on the calling thread (the command line).
    [[nodiscard]] static TrustReport Verify(const std::wstring& path);

private:
    ProcessTrust() = default;
    void Run(std::stop_token stop);

    std::mutex m_mutex;
    std::condition_variable_any m_wake;
    std::unordered_map<std::wstring, TrustReport> m_cache;  // by folded path
    std::deque<std::wstring> m_queue;
    std::once_flag m_started;
    std::jthread m_thread;  // last member: joined before the rest is destroyed
};

} // namespace WS
```

`src/core/RuleCompiler.cpp`:

```cpp
// WireScope - Rule compiler: selectors to WinpkFilter STATIC_FILTER entries, and their description.
#include "core/PacketTypes.h"
#include "core/Rules.h"
#include "core/RulesDetail.h"
#include "resources/resource.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <bit>
#include <cstring>
#include <format>
#include <optional>
#include <utility>

namespace WS {

using namespace RulesDetail;

namespace {

int PrefixOfMask(uint32_t mask) {
    const int ones = std::popcount(mask);
    const uint32_t expected = ones == 0 ? 0 : 0xFFFFFFFFu << (32 - ones);
    return mask == expected ? ones : -1;
}

struct Block4 {
    uint32_t net;
    uint32_t mask;
};

std::vector<Block4> RangeToCidrs(uint32_t lo, uint32_t hi) {
    std::vector<Block4> out;
    uint64_t cur = lo;
    const uint64_t end = static_cast<uint64_t>(hi) + 1;
    while (cur < end) {
        int bits = cur == 0 ? 32 : std::countr_zero(static_cast<uint32_t>(cur));
        while (bits > 0 && cur + (1ULL << bits) > end) --bits;
        const uint32_t mask = bits >= 32 ? 0u : (0xFFFFFFFFu << bits);
        out.push_back({static_cast<uint32_t>(cur), mask});
        cur += 1ULL << bits;
    }
    return out;
}

STATIC_FILTER BaseEntry(DWORD action, HANDLE adapter, DWORD directionFlags) {
    STATIC_FILTER f{};
    f.m_Adapter = static_cast<uint64_t>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(adapter));
    f.m_dwDirectionFlags = directionFlags;
    f.m_FilterAction = action;
    return f;
}

void SetSubnetV4(IP_ADDRESS_V4& a, uint32_t net, uint32_t mask) {
    a.m_AddressType = IP_SUBNET_TYPE;
    a.m_IpSubnet.m_Ip = std::byteswap(net);  // network order in memory
    a.m_IpSubnet.m_IpMask = std::byteswap(mask);
}

void SetSubnetV6(IP_ADDRESS_V6& a, const AddressMatch& m) {
    a.m_AddressType = IP_SUBNET_TYPE;
    std::memcpy(a.m_IpSubnet.m_Ip, m.net6.data(), 16);
    const auto mask = MaskBytes(m.prefix6);
    std::memcpy(a.m_IpSubnet.m_IpMask, mask.data(), 16);
}

const char* ActionName(DWORD action) {
    switch (action) {
    case FILTER_ACTION_PASS: return "PASS";
    case FILTER_ACTION_DROP: return "DROP";
    case FILTER_ACTION_REDIRECT: return "REDIRECT";
    case 4: return "PASS+RDR";
    case 5: return "DROP+RDR";
    default: return "?";
    }
}

} // namespace

STATIC_FILTER CatchAll(DWORD action, HANDLE adapter) {
    return BaseEntry(action, adapter, PACKET_FLAG_ON_SEND | PACKET_FLAG_ON_RECEIVE);
}

std::expected<std::vector<STATIC_FILTER>, std::string> Compile(const Selector& s, DWORD action, HANDLE adapter) {
    std::vector<STATIC_FILTER> out;
    if (s.dir == Dir::None) return out;
    if (s.app.set) {
        return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_APP_KERNEL));  // the driver knows no processes
    }

    // Relative keywords resolve differently per direction, so each direction becomes its own pass.
    const bool relative = s.remote.set || s.local.set || s.rport.set || s.lport.set;
    std::vector<Dir> passes;
    if (relative) {
        if (Has(s.dir, Dir::Out)) passes.push_back(Dir::Out);
        if (Has(s.dir, Dir::In)) passes.push_back(Dir::In);
    } else {
        passes.push_back(s.dir);
    }

    for (const Dir pass : passes) {
        const DWORD flags = (Has(pass, Dir::Out) ? PACKET_FLAG_ON_SEND : 0) | (Has(pass, Dir::In) ? PACKET_FLAG_ON_RECEIVE : 0);
        if (s.MatchesAllFrames()) {
            out.push_back(BaseEntry(action, adapter, flags));
            continue;
        }
        const bool outbound = pass == Dir::Out;
        const AddressMatch src = s.src.set ? s.src : relative ? (outbound ? s.local : s.remote) : AddressMatch{};
        const AddressMatch dst = s.dst.set ? s.dst : relative ? (outbound ? s.remote : s.local) : AddressMatch{};
        const PortMatch sp = s.sport.set ? s.sport : relative ? (outbound ? s.lport : s.rport) : PortMatch{};
        const PortMatch dp = s.dport.set ? s.dport : relative ? (outbound ? s.rport : s.lport) : PortMatch{};

        std::vector<std::pair<PortMatch, PortMatch>> portVariants;
        if (s.port.set) portVariants = {{s.port, PortMatch{}}, {PortMatch{}, s.port}};
        else portVariants = {{sp, dp}};
        const bool anyPorts = s.port.set || sp.set || dp.set;

        std::vector<Family> families;
        if (s.family == Family::Any) families = {Family::V4, Family::V6};
        else families = {s.family};

        for (const Family family : families) {
            std::vector<int> protocols;
            switch (s.proto) {
            case Proto::Any: protocols = anyPorts ? std::vector<int>{6, 17} : std::vector<int>{-1}; break;
            case Proto::Tcp: protocols = {6}; break;
            case Proto::Udp: protocols = {17}; break;
            case Proto::TcpUdp: protocols = {6, 17}; break;
            case Proto::Icmp: protocols = {family == Family::V4 ? 1 : 58}; break;
            case Proto::Number: protocols = {s.protoNumber}; break;
            }

            std::vector<std::optional<Block4>> srcBlocks{std::nullopt}, dstBlocks{std::nullopt};
            if (family == Family::V4) {
                if (src.set) {
                    srcBlocks.clear();
                    for (const auto& b : RangeToCidrs(src.lo4, src.hi4)) srcBlocks.emplace_back(b);
                }
                if (dst.set) {
                    dstBlocks.clear();
                    for (const auto& b : RangeToCidrs(dst.lo4, dst.hi4)) dstBlocks.emplace_back(b);
                }
            }

            for (const int protocol : protocols) {
                for (const auto& sb : srcBlocks) {
                    for (const auto& db : dstBlocks) {
                        for (const auto& [ps, pd] : portVariants) {
                            STATIC_FILTER e = BaseEntry(action, adapter, flags);
                            e.m_ValidFields = NETWORK_LAYER_VALID;
                            if (family == Family::V4) {
                                e.m_NetworkFilter.m_dwUnionSelector = FILTER_NET_IPV4;
                                IP_V4_FILTER& ip = e.m_NetworkFilter.m_IPv4;
                                if (sb) {
                                    ip.m_ValidFields |= IP_FILTER_SRC_ADDRESS;
                                    SetSubnetV4(ip.m_SrcAddress, sb->net, sb->mask);
                                }
                                if (db) {
                                    ip.m_ValidFields |= IP_FILTER_DEST_ADDRESS;
                                    SetSubnetV4(ip.m_DestAddress, db->net, db->mask);
                                }
                                if (protocol >= 0) {
                                    ip.m_ValidFields |= IP_FILTER_PROTOCOL;
                                    ip.m_Protocol = static_cast<BYTE>(protocol);
                                }
                            } else {
                                e.m_NetworkFilter.m_dwUnionSelector = FILTER_NET_IPV6;
                                IP_V6_FILTER& ip = e.m_NetworkFilter.m_IPv6;
                                if (src.set) {
                                    ip.m_ValidFields |= IP_FILTER_SRC_ADDRESS;
                                    SetSubnetV6(ip.m_SrcAddress, src);
                                }
                                if (dst.set) {
                                    ip.m_ValidFields |= IP_FILTER_DEST_ADDRESS;
                                    SetSubnetV6(ip.m_DestAddress, dst);
                                }
                                if (protocol >= 0) {
                                    ip.m_ValidFields |= IP_FILTER_PROTOCOL;
                                    ip.m_Protocol = static_cast<BYTE>(protocol);
                                }
                            }
                            if (ps.set || pd.set) {
                                e.m_ValidFields |= TRANSPORT_LAYER_VALID;
                                e.m_TransportFilter.m_dwUnionSelector = FILTER_TRANSPORT_TCPUDP;
                                TCPUDP_FILTER& t = e.m_TransportFilter.m_TcpUdp;
                                if (ps.set) {
                                    t.m_ValidFields |= TCPUDP_SRC_PORT;
                                    t.m_SourcePort = {ps.lo, ps.hi};
                                }
                                if (pd.set) {
                                    t.m_ValidFields |= TCPUDP_DEST_PORT;
                                    t.m_DestPort = {pd.lo, pd.hi};
                                }
                            } else if (s.icmpTypeSet) {
                                e.m_ValidFields |= TRANSPORT_LAYER_VALID;
                                e.m_TransportFilter.m_dwUnionSelector = FILTER_TRANSPORT_ICMP;
                                e.m_TransportFilter.m_Icmp.m_ValidFields = ICMP_FILTER_TYPE;
                                e.m_TransportFilter.m_Icmp.m_TypeRange = {s.icmpType, s.icmpType};
                            }
                            out.push_back(e);
                            if (out.size() > kMaxEntriesPerSelector) {
                                return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_TOO_WIDE, kMaxEntriesPerSelector));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return out;
}

std::string DescribeFilter(const STATIC_FILTER& f) {
    const bool send = f.m_dwDirectionFlags & PACKET_FLAG_ON_SEND, recv = f.m_dwDirectionFlags & PACKET_FLAG_ON_RECEIVE;
    std::string text = std::format("{:<8} {:<4} ", ActionName(f.m_FilterAction), send && recv ? "both" : send ? "out" : recv ? "in" : "none");
    text += f.m_Adapter ? std::format("adapter 0x{:X}  ", f.m_Adapter) : std::string("all adapters  ");

    if (f.m_ValidFields & DATA_LINK_LAYER_VALID) text += "eth ";
    if (!(f.m_ValidFields & NETWORK_LAYER_VALID)) {
        text += "every frame";
    } else if (f.m_NetworkFilter.m_dwUnionSelector == FILTER_NET_IPV4) {
        const IP_V4_FILTER& ip = f.m_NetworkFilter.m_IPv4;
        text += "ip4";
        if (ip.m_ValidFields & IP_FILTER_PROTOCOL) text += std::format(" proto {}", ip.m_Protocol);
        auto address = [](const IP_ADDRESS_V4& a) {
            if (a.m_AddressType == IP_RANGE_TYPE) {
                return FormatIpv4Host(std::byteswap(a.m_IpRange.m_StartIp)) + "-" + FormatIpv4Host(std::byteswap(a.m_IpRange.m_EndIp));
            }
            const uint32_t mask = std::byteswap(a.m_IpSubnet.m_IpMask);
            const int prefix = PrefixOfMask(mask);
            const std::string ip4 = FormatIpv4Host(std::byteswap(a.m_IpSubnet.m_Ip));
            return prefix == 32 ? ip4 : prefix >= 0 ? std::format("{}/{}", ip4, prefix) : ip4 + " mask " + FormatIpv4Host(mask);
        };
        if (ip.m_ValidFields & IP_FILTER_SRC_ADDRESS) text += " src " + address(ip.m_SrcAddress);
        if (ip.m_ValidFields & IP_FILTER_DEST_ADDRESS) text += " dst " + address(ip.m_DestAddress);
    } else if (f.m_NetworkFilter.m_dwUnionSelector == FILTER_NET_IPV6) {
        const IP_V6_FILTER& ip = f.m_NetworkFilter.m_IPv6;
        text += "ip6";
        if (ip.m_ValidFields & IP_FILTER_PROTOCOL) text += std::format(" proto {}", ip.m_Protocol);
        auto address = [](const IP_ADDRESS_V6& a) {
            if (a.m_AddressType == IP_RANGE_TYPE) return FormatIpv6Bytes(a.m_IpRange.m_StartIp) + "-" + FormatIpv6Bytes(a.m_IpRange.m_EndIp);
            int prefix = 0;
            for (const BYTE b : a.m_IpSubnet.m_IpMask) prefix += std::popcount(static_cast<unsigned>(b));
            return FormatIpv6Bytes(a.m_IpSubnet.m_Ip) + (prefix < 128 ? std::format("/{}", prefix) : std::string());
        };
        if (ip.m_ValidFields & IP_FILTER_SRC_ADDRESS) text += " src " + address(ip.m_SrcAddress);
        if (ip.m_ValidFields & IP_FILTER_DEST_ADDRESS) text += " dst " + address(ip.m_DestAddress);
    } else {
        text += std::format("network selector {}", f.m_NetworkFilter.m_dwUnionSelector);
    }
    if (f.m_ValidFields & TRANSPORT_LAYER_VALID) {
        if (f.m_TransportFilter.m_dwUnionSelector == FILTER_TRANSPORT_TCPUDP) {
            const TCPUDP_FILTER& t = f.m_TransportFilter.m_TcpUdp;
            auto range = [](const PORT_RANGE& r) {
                return r.m_StartRange == r.m_EndRange ? std::to_string(r.m_StartRange) : std::format("{}-{}", r.m_StartRange, r.m_EndRange);
            };
            if (t.m_ValidFields & TCPUDP_SRC_PORT) text += " sport " + range(t.m_SourcePort);
            if (t.m_ValidFields & TCPUDP_DEST_PORT) text += " dport " + range(t.m_DestPort);
            if (t.m_ValidFields & TCPUDP_TCP_FLAGS) text += std::format(" flags 0x{:02X}", t.m_TCPFlags);
        } else if (f.m_TransportFilter.m_dwUnionSelector == FILTER_TRANSPORT_ICMP) {
            const ICMP_TYPE_FILTER& i = f.m_TransportFilter.m_Icmp;
            if (i.m_ValidFields & ICMP_FILTER_TYPE) text += std::format(" type {}-{}", i.m_TypeRange.m_StartRange, i.m_TypeRange.m_EndRange);
            if (i.m_ValidFields & ICMP_FILTER_CODE) text += std::format(" code {}-{}", i.m_CodeRange.m_StartRange, i.m_CodeRange.m_EndRange);
        }
    }
    text += std::format("   [in {} pkt / {} B, out {} pkt / {} B]", f.m_PacketsIn, f.m_BytesIn, f.m_PacketsOut, f.m_BytesOut);
    return text;
}

} // namespace WS
```
