`src/core/Rules.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/Rules.h"
#include "core/ProcessMapper.h"
#include "core/RulesDetail.h"
#include "resources/resource.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2ipdef.h>
#include <winternl.h>  // NTSTATUS for ip2string.h
#include <ip2string.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <bit>
#include <cctype>
#include <charconv>
#include <cstring>
#include <format>
#include <optional>
#include <type_traits>
#include <utility>

#pragma comment(lib, "ntdll.lib")

namespace WS {

using namespace RulesDetail;

namespace {

std::string Lower(std::string_view s) {
    std::string out(s);
    for (char& c : out) c = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
    return out;
}

std::string_view Trim(std::string_view s) {
    while (!s.empty() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(s.front()))) s.remove_prefix(1);
    while (!s.empty() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(s.back()))) s.remove_suffix(1);
    return s;
}

bool Separator(char c) noexcept {
    return std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)) || c == ',';
}

// Words separated by blanks or commas; "a quoted value" is one token (without the quotes), so
// program names and paths may contain spaces. Windows names never contain a quote.
std::vector<std::string_view> Tokenize(std::string_view text) {
    std::vector<std::string_view> tokens;
    size_t i = 0;
    while (i < text.size()) {
        while (i < text.size() && Separator(text[i])) ++i;
        if (i < text.size() && text[i] == '"') {
            const size_t start = ++i;
            while (i < text.size() && text[i] != '"') ++i;
            tokens.push_back(text.substr(start, i - start));
            if (i < text.size()) ++i;  // closing quote
            continue;
        }
        const size_t start = i;
        while (i < text.size() && !Separator(text[i])) ++i;
        if (i > start) tokens.push_back(text.substr(start, i - start));
    }
    return tokens;
}

std::optional<uint32_t> ParseNumber(std::string_view s, uint32_t max) {
    uint32_t value = 0;
    if (s.empty()) return std::nullopt;
    const auto [end, ec] = std::from_chars(s.data(), s.data() + s.size(), value);
    if (ec != std::errc{} || end != s.data() + s.size() || value > max) return std::nullopt;
    return value;
}

std::optional<uint32_t> ParseIpv4(std::string_view s) {
    uint32_t value = 0;
    for (int part = 0; part < 4; ++part) {
        const size_t dot = s.find('.');
        const std::string_view piece = part < 3 ? s.substr(0, dot) : s;
        if (part < 3 && dot == std::string_view::npos) return std::nullopt;
        if (piece.empty() || piece.size() > 3) return std::nullopt;
        const auto octet = ParseNumber(piece, 255);
        if (!octet) return std::nullopt;
        value = (value << 8) | *octet;
        if (part < 3) s.remove_prefix(dot + 1);
    }
    return value;
}

bool ParseIpv6(std::string_view s, std::array<uint8_t, 16>& out) {
    if (s.empty() || s.size() > 63 || s.find(':') == std::string_view::npos) return false;
    const std::string z(s);
    in6_addr address{};
    PCSTR terminator = nullptr;
    if (RtlIpv6StringToAddressA(z.c_str(), &terminator, &address) != 0 || !terminator || *terminator != '\0') return false;
    std::memcpy(out.data(), address.u.Byte, 16);
    return true;
}

std::expected<AddressMatch, std::string> ParseAddress(std::string_view token) {
    AddressMatch m;
    const std::string lower = Lower(token);
    if (lower == "any" || lower == "*") return m;
    m.set = true;

    if (const size_t dash = token.find('-'); dash != std::string_view::npos && token.find(':') == std::string_view::npos) {
        const auto lo = ParseIpv4(token.substr(0, dash));
        const auto hi = ParseIpv4(token.substr(dash + 1));
        if (!lo || !hi) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_BAD_RANGE, token));
        if (*lo > *hi) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_RANGE_ORDER, token));
        m.family = Family::V4;
        m.lo4 = *lo;
        m.hi4 = *hi;
        return m;
    }

    std::string_view address = token;
    std::optional<uint32_t> prefix;
    if (const size_t slash = token.find('/'); slash != std::string_view::npos) {
        prefix = ParseNumber(token.substr(slash + 1), 128);
        if (!prefix) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_BAD_PREFIX, token));
        address = token.substr(0, slash);
    }
    if (const auto v4 = ParseIpv4(address)) {
        if (prefix && *prefix > 32) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_PREFIX_V4, token));
        const uint32_t bits = prefix.value_or(32);
        const uint32_t mask = bits == 0 ? 0 : 0xFFFFFFFFu << (32 - bits);
        m.family = Family::V4;
        m.lo4 = *v4 & mask;
        m.hi4 = m.lo4 | ~mask;
        return m;
    }
    std::array<uint8_t, 16> v6{};
    if (ParseIpv6(address, v6)) {
        const uint32_t bits = prefix.value_or(128);
        MaskV6(v6, bits);
        m.family = Family::V6;
        m.net6 = v6;
        m.prefix6 = static_cast<uint8_t>(bits);
        return m;
    }
    return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_BAD_ADDRESS, token));
}

std::expected<PortMatch, std::string> ParsePorts(std::string_view token) {
    PortMatch p;
    const std::string lower = Lower(token);
    if (lower == "any" || lower == "*") return p;
    const size_t dash = token.find('-');
    const auto lo = ParseNumber(token.substr(0, dash), 65535);
    const auto hi = dash == std::string_view::npos ? lo : ParseNumber(token.substr(dash + 1), 65535);
    if (!lo || !hi) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_BAD_PORT, token));
    if (*lo > *hi) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_PORT_ORDER, token));
    p.set = true;
    p.lo = static_cast<uint16_t>(*lo);
    p.hi = static_cast<uint16_t>(*hi);
    return p;
}

std::optional<uint8_t> ParseProtocolName(std::string_view token) {
    const std::string t = Lower(token);
    struct Named {
        std::string_view name;
        uint8_t number;
    };
    static constexpr Named kNames[] = {
        {"tcp", 6}, {"udp", 17}, {"icmp", 1}, {"igmp", 2}, {"gre", 47},
        {"esp", 50}, {"ah", 51}, {"icmp6", 58}, {"icmpv6", 58}, {"sctp", 132},
    };
    for (const auto& [name, number] : kNames) {
        if (t == name) return number;
    }
    if (const auto n = ParseNumber(token, 255)) return static_cast<uint8_t>(*n);
    return std::nullopt;
}

std::string FormatAddress(const AddressMatch& a) {
    if (a.family == Family::V6) {
        std::string text = FormatIpv6Bytes(a.net6.data());
        if (a.prefix6 < 128) text += std::format("/{}", a.prefix6);
        return text;
    }
    if (a.lo4 == a.hi4) return FormatIpv4Host(a.lo4);
    const uint64_t size = static_cast<uint64_t>(a.hi4) - a.lo4 + 1;
    if (std::has_single_bit(size) && (a.lo4 & (size - 1)) == 0) {
        return std::format("{}/{}", FormatIpv4Host(a.lo4), 32 - std::countr_zero(size));
    }
    return FormatIpv4Host(a.lo4) + "-" + FormatIpv4Host(a.hi4);
}

std::string FormatPorts(const PortMatch& p) {
    return p.lo == p.hi ? std::to_string(p.lo) : std::format("{}-{}", p.lo, p.hi);
}

bool UsesPorts(const Selector& s) {
    return s.sport.set || s.dport.set || s.rport.set || s.lport.set || s.port.set;
}

} // namespace

namespace RulesDetail {

std::string FormatIpv4Host(uint32_t ip) {
    return std::format("{}.{}.{}.{}", (ip >> 24) & 0xFF, (ip >> 16) & 0xFF, (ip >> 8) & 0xFF, ip & 0xFF);
}

std::string FormatIpv6Bytes(const uint8_t* bytes) {
    in6_addr address{};
    std::memcpy(address.u.Byte, bytes, 16);
    char text[64]{};
    RtlIpv6AddressToStringA(&address, text);
    return text;
}

void MaskV6(std::array<uint8_t, 16>& bytes, uint32_t prefix) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
        const uint32_t bits = prefix > i * 8 ? std::min<uint32_t>(prefix - i * 8, 8) : 0;
        const uint8_t mask = bits == 0 ? 0 : static_cast<uint8_t>(0xFFu << (8 - bits));
        bytes[i] &= mask;
    }
}

std::array<uint8_t, 16> MaskBytes(uint32_t prefix) {
    std::array<uint8_t, 16> mask;
    mask.fill(0xFF);
    MaskV6(mask, prefix);
    return mask;
}

} // namespace RulesDetail

bool AddressMatch::Contains6(const std::array<uint8_t, 16>& ip) const noexcept {
    uint32_t bits = prefix6;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 16 && bits > 0; ++i) {
        const uint32_t take = std::min<uint32_t>(bits, 8);
        const uint8_t mask = static_cast<uint8_t>(0xFFu << (8 - take));
        if ((ip[i] & mask) != (net6[i] & mask)) return false;
        bits -= take;
    }
    return true;
}

bool Selector::MatchesAllFrames() const noexcept {
    return family == Family::Any && proto == Proto::Any && !src.set && !dst.set && !remote.set && !local.set &&
           !sport.set && !dport.set && !rport.set && !lport.set && !port.set && !icmpTypeSet && !app.set;
}

std::expected<Selector, std::string> ParseSelector(std::string_view text) {
    const auto tokens = Tokenize(text);
    Selector s;
    bool dirSet = false, familySet = false, protoSet = false;

    auto value = [&](size_t& i, const std::string& keyword) -> std::expected<std::string_view, std::string> {
        if (i + 1 >= tokens.size()) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_NEEDS_VALUE, keyword));
        return tokens[++i];
    };
    auto setDir = [&](Dir d) -> std::optional<std::string> {
        if (dirSet && s.dir != d) return Msg(IDS_RULE_DIRECTIONS);
        s.dir = d;
        dirSet = true;
        return std::nullopt;
    };
    auto setFamily = [&](Family f) -> std::optional<std::string> {
        if (familySet && s.family != f) return Msg(IDS_RULE_FAMILIES);
        s.family = f;
        familySet = true;
        return std::nullopt;
    };
    auto setProto = [&](Proto p, uint8_t number) -> std::optional<std::string> {
        if (protoSet) {
            const bool tcpUdp = (s.proto == Proto::Tcp && p == Proto::Udp) || (s.proto == Proto::Udp && p == Proto::Tcp);
            if (tcpUdp) {
                s.proto = Proto::TcpUdp;
                return std::nullopt;
            }
            if (s.proto != p || s.protoNumber != number) return Msg(IDS_RULE_PROTOCOLS);
        }
        s.proto = p;
        s.protoNumber = number;
        protoSet = true;
        return std::nullopt;
    };

    for (size_t i = 0; i < tokens.size(); ++i) {
        const std::string t = Lower(tokens[i]);
        std::optional<std::string> error;
        AddressMatch* address = nullptr;
        PortMatch* ports = nullptr;

        if (t == "in" || t == "inbound" || t == "incoming") error = setDir(Dir::In);
        else if (t == "out" || t == "outbound" || t == "outgoing") error = setDir(Dir::Out);
        else if (t == "both" || t == "inout") error = setDir(Dir::Both);
        else if (t == "ip4" || t == "ipv4") error = setFamily(Family::V4);
        else if (t == "ip6" || t == "ipv6") error = setFamily(Family::V6);
        else if (t == "ip" || t == "all" || t == "any" || t == "*") continue;
        else if (t == "tcp") error = setProto(Proto::Tcp, 6);
        else if (t == "udp") error = setProto(Proto::Udp, 17);
        else if (t == "icmp") error = setProto(Proto::Icmp, 0);
        else if (t == "icmp6" || t == "icmpv6") {
            error = setProto(Proto::Icmp, 0);
            if (!error) error = setFamily(Family::V6);
        } else if (t == "proto" || t == "protocol") {
            auto v = value(i, t);
            if (!v) return std::unexpected(v.error());
            const auto number = ParseProtocolName(*v);
            if (!number) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_BAD_PROTOCOL, *v));
            if (*number == 6) error = setProto(Proto::Tcp, 6);
            else if (*number == 17) error = setProto(Proto::Udp, 17);
            else if (*number == 1 || *number == 58) error = setProto(Proto::Icmp, 0);
            else error = setProto(Proto::Number, *number);
        } else if (t == "from" || t == "src") address = &s.src;
        else if (t == "to" || t == "dst") address = &s.dst;
        else if (t == "remote" || t == "host" || t == "peer") address = &s.remote;
        else if (t == "local") address = &s.local;
        else if (t == "sport" || t == "srcport") ports = &s.sport;
        else if (t == "dport" || t == "dstport") ports = &s.dport;
        else if (t == "rport") ports = &s.rport;
        else if (t == "lport") ports = &s.lport;
        else if (t == "port") ports = &s.port;
        else if (t == "app" || t.starts_with("app:")) {
            std::string name;
            if (t.starts_with("app:")) {
                name = std::string(tokens[i].substr(4));
            } else {
                auto v = value(i, t);
                if (!v) return std::unexpected(v.error());
                name = std::string(*v);
            }
            if (s.app.set) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_TWICE, "app"));
            if (name.empty()) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_NEEDS_VALUE, "app"));
            s.app.set = true;
            s.app.name = FoldCase(name);  // also folds letters beyond ASCII, as ProcessMapper does
            s.app.path = s.app.name.find_first_of("\\/:") != std::string::npos;
            if (s.app.path) std::replace(s.app.name.begin(), s.app.name.end(), '/', '\\');
            else if (s.app.name.find('.') == std::string::npos) s.app.name += ".exe";  // "app discord" = discord.exe
        } else if (t == "type") {
            auto v = value(i, t);
            if (!v) return std::unexpected(v.error());
            const auto type = ParseNumber(*v, 255);
            if (!type) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_BAD_TYPE, *v));
            if (s.icmpTypeSet) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_TWICE, "type"));
            s.icmpTypeSet = true;
            s.icmpType = static_cast<uint8_t>(*type);
        } else {
            // A bare address means "this host", whichever side of the conversation it is on.
            const auto bare = ParseAddress(tokens[i]);
            if (!bare || !bare->set) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_UNEXPECTED, tokens[i]));
            if (s.remote.set) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_REMOTES));
            s.remote = *bare;
            continue;
        }

        if (error) return std::unexpected(*error);
        if (address) {
            auto v = value(i, t);
            if (!v) return std::unexpected(v.error());
            if (address->set) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_TWICE, t));
            auto parsed = ParseAddress(*v);
            if (!parsed) return std::unexpected(parsed.error());
            *address = *parsed;
        } else if (ports) {
            auto v = value(i, t);
            if (!v) return std::unexpected(v.error());
            if (ports->set) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_TWICE, t));
            auto parsed = ParsePorts(*v);
            if (!parsed) return std::unexpected(parsed.error());
            *ports = *parsed;
        }
    }

    // Consistency
    if ((s.src.set || s.dst.set) && (s.remote.set || s.local.set)) {
        return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_MIX_ADDRESS));
    }
    if ((s.sport.set || s.dport.set) && (s.rport.set || s.lport.set)) {
        return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_MIX_PORTS));
    }
    if (s.port.set && (s.sport.set || s.dport.set || s.rport.set || s.lport.set)) {
        return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_PORT_EITHER));
    }
    if (UsesPorts(s) && (s.proto == Proto::Icmp || s.proto == Proto::Number)) {
        return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_PORT_PROTO));
    }
    if (s.icmpTypeSet) {
        if (s.proto == Proto::Any) s.proto = Proto::Icmp;
        else if (s.proto != Proto::Icmp) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_TYPE_PROTO));
    }
    Family addressFamily = Family::Any;
    for (const AddressMatch* a : {&s.src, &s.dst, &s.remote, &s.local}) {
        if (!a->set) continue;
        if (addressFamily != Family::Any && addressFamily != a->family) {
            return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_MIX_FAMILY));
        }
        addressFamily = a->family;
    }
    if (addressFamily != Family::Any) {
        if (familySet && s.family != addressFamily) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_FAMILY_CONFLICT));
        s.family = addressFamily;
    }
    return s;
}

std::expected<Rule, std::string> ParseRule(std::string_view text) {
    const auto tokens = Tokenize(text);
    if (tokens.empty()) return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_EMPTY));
    Rule rule;
    const std::string action = Lower(tokens.front());
    if (action == "allow" || action == "pass" || action == "permit" || action == "accept") rule.action = RuleAction::Allow;
    else if (action == "block" || action == "drop" || action == "deny" || action == "reject") rule.action = RuleAction::Block;
    else return std::unexpected(Msg(IDS_RULE_ACTION, tokens.front()));

    std::string selectorText;
    for (size_t i = 1; i < tokens.size(); ++i) {
        if (!selectorText.empty()) selectorText += ' ';
        selectorText += QuoteToken(Lower(tokens[i]));
    }
    auto selector = ParseSelector(selectorText);
    if (!selector) return std::unexpected(selector.error());
    rule.match = *selector;
    rule.text = selectorText.empty() ? std::string("all") : selectorText;
    return rule;
}

std::string QuoteToken(std::string_view value) {
    if (!value.empty() && std::ranges::none_of(value, Separator)) return std::string(value);
    return '"' + std::string(value) + '"';
}

std::string RuleText(const Rule& rule) {
    return std::string(rule.action == RuleAction::Allow ? "allow " : "block ") + (rule.text.empty() ? "all" : rule.text);
}

std::string Summarize(const Selector& s) {
    std::vector<std::string> parts;
    parts.push_back(Msg(s.dir == Dir::In ? IDS_DIR_IN : s.dir == Dir::Out ? IDS_DIR_OUT : IDS_SUM_BOTH));
    if (s.family == Family::V4) parts.emplace_back("IPv4");
    else if (s.family == Family::V6) parts.emplace_back("IPv6");
    switch (s.proto) {
    case Proto::Tcp: parts.emplace_back("TCP"); break;
    case Proto::Udp: parts.emplace_back("UDP"); break;
    case Proto::TcpUdp: parts.emplace_back("TCP+UDP"); break;
    case Proto::Icmp: parts.push_back(s.icmpTypeSet ? Msg(IDS_SUM_ICMP_TYPE, s.icmpType) : std::string("ICMP")); break;
    case Proto::Number: parts.push_back(Msg(IDS_SUM_PROTO, s.protoNumber)); break;
    case Proto::Any: if (s.MatchesAllFrames()) parts.push_back(Msg(IDS_SUM_ALL)); break;
    }
    if (s.src.set) parts.push_back(Msg(IDS_SUM_FROM, FormatAddress(s.src)));
    if (s.dst.set) parts.push_back(Msg(IDS_SUM_TO, FormatAddress(s.dst)));
    if (s.remote.set) parts.push_back(Msg(IDS_SUM_REMOTE, FormatAddress(s.remote)));
    if (s.local.set) parts.push_back(Msg(IDS_SUM_LOCAL, FormatAddress(s.local)));
    if (s.sport.set) parts.push_back(Msg(IDS_SUM_SPORT, FormatPorts(s.sport)));
    if (s.dport.set) parts.push_back(Msg(IDS_SUM_DPORT, FormatPorts(s.dport)));
    if (s.rport.set) parts.push_back(Msg(IDS_SUM_RPORT, FormatPorts(s.rport)));
    if (s.lport.set) parts.push_back(Msg(IDS_SUM_LPORT, FormatPorts(s.lport)));
    if (s.port.set) parts.push_back(Msg(IDS_SUM_PORT, FormatPorts(s.port)));
    if (s.app.set) parts.push_back(Msg(IDS_SUM_APP, s.app.name));
    std::string out;
    for (const auto& p : parts) {
        if (!out.empty()) out += " · ";
        out += p;
    }
    return out;
}

bool Matches(const Selector& s, const FrameInfo& f, Dir d) noexcept {
    if (!Has(s.dir, d)) return false;
    if (s.MatchesAllFrames()) return true;
    if (!f.ip) return false;
    if ((s.family == Family::V4 && f.version != 4) || (s.family == Family::V6 && f.version != 6)) return false;

    const bool ports = UsesPorts(s);
    switch (s.proto) {
    case Proto::Any:
        if (ports && f.protocol != 6 && f.protocol != 17) return false;
        break;
    case Proto::Tcp: if (f.protocol != 6) return false; break;
    case Proto::Udp: if (f.protocol != 17) return false; break;
    case Proto::TcpUdp: if (f.protocol != 6 && f.protocol != 17) return false; break;
    case Proto::Icmp: if (f.protocol != (f.version == 4 ? 1 : 58)) return false; break;
    case Proto::Number: if (f.protocol != s.protoNumber) return false; break;
    }

    const bool outbound = d == Dir::Out;
    const AddressMatch& srcA = s.src.set ? s.src : (outbound ? s.local : s.remote);
    const AddressMatch& dstA = s.dst.set ? s.dst : (outbound ? s.remote : s.local);
    auto addressOk = [&](const AddressMatch& a, bool source) {
        if (!a.set) return true;
        if (a.family == Family::V4) return f.version == 4 && a.Contains4(source ? f.src4 : f.dst4);
        return f.version == 6 && a.Contains6(source ? f.src6 : f.dst6);
    };
    if (!addressOk(srcA, true) || !addressOk(dstA, false)) return false;

    if (ports) {
        if (!f.hasPorts) return false;
        const PortMatch& sp = s.sport.set ? s.sport : (outbound ? s.lport : s.rport);
        const PortMatch& dp = s.dport.set ? s.dport : (outbound ? s.rport : s.lport);
        if (sp.set && !sp.Contains(f.srcPort)) return false;
        if (dp.set && !dp.Contains(f.dstPort)) return false;
        if (s.port.set && !s.port.Contains(f.srcPort) && !s.port.Contains(f.dstPort)) return false;
    }
    if (s.app.set) {  // the owner is resolved once per packet by the engine
        if (!f.process || (s.app.path ? f.process->pathKey : f.process->name) != s.app.name) return false;
    }
    if (s.icmpTypeSet && (!f.hasIcmp || f.icmpType != s.icmpType)) return false;
    return true;
}

std::expected<std::vector<Rule>, RulesTextError> ParseRulesText(std::string_view text) {
    std::vector<Rule> rules;
    size_t lineNumber = 0;
    while (!text.empty()) {
        ++lineNumber;
        const size_t end = text.find('\n');
        std::string_view line = Trim(text.substr(0, end));
        text = end == std::string_view::npos ? std::string_view() : text.substr(end + 1);
        if (line.empty()) continue;
        bool enabled = true;
        if (line.front() == '#') {
            const std::string lower = Lower(line.substr(0, std::min<size_t>(line.size(), 8)));
            if (!lower.starts_with("# off:") && !lower.starts_with("#off:")) continue;  // comment
            line = Trim(line.substr(line.find(':') + 1));
            enabled = false;
        }
        auto rule = ParseRule(line);
        if (!rule) return std::unexpected(RulesTextError{lineNumber, rule.error()});
        rule->enabled = enabled;
        rules.push_back(std::move(*rule));
    }
    return rules;
}

std::string FormatRulesText(std::span<const Rule> rules) {
    std::string out = "# WireScope firewall rules: first match wins. \"# off:\" keeps a disabled rule.\n";
    for (const Rule& r : rules) {
        if (!r.enabled) out += "# off: ";
        out += RuleText(r);
        out += '\n';
    }
    return out;
}

std::string RulesHelp() {
    return ToUtf8(Text::Get(IDS_RULE_HELP));
}

} // namespace WS
```

`src/core/Rules.h`:

```h
// WireScope - Traffic selectors and firewall rules.
//
// One small language serves the firewall ("block out tcp dport 443"), the impairment simulator's
// traffic match ("udp rport 27015-27030") and the rules files. A selector is matched in user mode
// against FrameInfo, and compiled into WinpkFilter STATIC_FILTER entries for the kernel.
//
//   rule      := action selector
//   action    := allow | pass | permit | block | drop | deny
//   selector  := { direction | family | protocol | address | port | "type" N | "all" }
//   direction := in | out | both
//   family    := ip4 | ip6
//   protocol  := tcp | udp | icmp | "proto" N
//   address   := (from | to | remote | local | host) ADDR      ADDR: a.b.c.d[/n] | a.b.c.d-e.f.g.h | v6[/n]
//   port      := (sport | dport | rport | lport | port) P       P: n | n-m
//   app       := "app" NAME | "app" PATH                         a value with spaces goes in "quotes"
//
// "remote"/"local" (and rport/lport) are relative to the packet direction: for outbound traffic the
// remote side is the destination, for inbound traffic it is the source.
#pragma once
#include "core/FilterAbi.h"
#include "core/FrameView.h"
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <expected>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace WS {

enum class Dir : uint8_t { None = 0, In = 1, Out = 2, Both = 3 };
[[nodiscard]] constexpr bool Has(Dir set, Dir d) noexcept {
    return (static_cast<uint8_t>(set) & static_cast<uint8_t>(d)) != 0;
}

enum class Family : uint8_t { Any, V4, V6 };
enum class Proto : uint8_t { Any, Tcp, Udp, TcpUdp, Icmp, Number };

struct AddressMatch {
    bool     set{false};
    Family   family{Family::Any};
    uint32_t lo4{0}, hi4{0};          // IPv4, host order, inclusive range
    std::array<uint8_t, 16> net6{};   // IPv6 network (masked)
    uint8_t  prefix6{128};

    [[nodiscard]] bool Contains4(uint32_t ip) const noexcept { return ip >= lo4 && ip <= hi4; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool Contains6(const std::array<uint8_t, 16>& ip) const noexcept;
};

struct PortMatch {
    bool     set{false};
    uint16_t lo{0}, hi{65535};
    [[nodiscard]] bool Contains(uint16_t p) const noexcept { return p >= lo && p <= hi; }
};

struct AppMatch {
    bool        set{false};
    bool        path{false};  // `name` is a full image path (a program in one folder only)
    std::string name;         // folded process name ("discord.exe") or path ("c:\tools\nc.exe")
};

struct Selector {
    Dir      dir{Dir::Both};
    Family   family{Family::Any};
    Proto    proto{Proto::Any};
    uint8_t  protoNumber{0};
    AddressMatch src, dst, remote, local;
    PortMatch    sport, dport, rport, lport, port;
    AppMatch     app;
    bool     icmpTypeSet{false};
    uint8_t  icmpType{0};

    // True when only the direction restricts the selector (it matches every frame, ARP included).
    [[nodiscard]] bool MatchesAllFrames() const noexcept;
};

enum class RuleAction : uint8_t { Allow, Block };

struct HitCounter {
    uint64_t packets{0};
    uint64_t bytes{0};
    HitCounter& operator+=(const HitCounter& o) noexcept {
        packets += o.packets;
        bytes += o.bytes;
        return *this;
    }
};

struct Rule {
    uint64_t   id{0};          // assigned by the owner; stable while the rule lives
    bool       enabled{true};
    RuleAction action{RuleAction::Block};
    Selector   match;
    std::string text;          // normalised selector text, without the action word
};

[[nodiscard]] std::expected<Selector, std::string> ParseSelector(std::string_view text);
[[nodiscard]] std::expected<Rule, std::string> ParseRule(std::string_view text);
[[nodiscard]] std::string RuleText(const Rule& rule);          // "block out tcp dport 443"
[[nodiscard]] std::string Summarize(const Selector& selector);  // "Outbound · TCP · remote port 443"
// One value as the rule language writes it: in quotes when it holds a space or a comma.
[[nodiscard]] std::string QuoteToken(std::string_view value);

// User-mode match (data path: noexcept, no allocation).
[[nodiscard]] bool Matches(const Selector& selector, const FrameInfo& frame, Dir packetDir) noexcept;

// Driver entries equivalent to the selector, each with `action` (FILTER_ACTION_*).
[[nodiscard]] std::expected<std::vector<STATIC_FILTER>, std::string> Compile(const Selector& selector, DWORD action,
                                                                             HANDLE adapter);
[[nodiscard]] STATIC_FILTER CatchAll(DWORD action, HANDLE adapter);  // matches every frame, both directions
[[nodiscard]] std::string DescribeFilter(const STATIC_FILTER& filter);  // one line for --firewall-show

// Rules files and the stored rule list: one rule per line, '#' starts a comment and
// "# off: <rule>" keeps a disabled rule.
struct RulesTextError {
    size_t line{0};
    std::string message;
};
[[nodiscard]] std::expected<std::vector<Rule>, RulesTextError> ParseRulesText(std::string_view text);
[[nodiscard]] std::string FormatRulesText(std::span<const Rule> rules);

[[nodiscard]] std::string RulesHelp();  // from the string table

} // namespace WS
```

```h
// WireScope - Internal to Rules.cpp and RuleCompiler.cpp: address formatting, masks, messages.
#pragma once
#include "support/Language.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <type_traits>

namespace WS::RulesDetail {

inline constexpr size_t kMaxEntriesPerSelector = 1024;

[[nodiscard]] std::string FormatIpv4Host(uint32_t ip);  // host byte order
[[nodiscard]] std::string FormatIpv6Bytes(const uint8_t* bytes);
void MaskV6(std::array<uint8_t, 16>& bytes, uint32_t prefix);
[[nodiscard]] std::array<uint8_t, 16> MaskBytes(uint32_t prefix);

// Localised message as UTF-8 (the rule layer works in UTF-8); arguments are UTF-8 or numbers.
template <class... Args>
[[nodiscard]] std::string Msg(UINT id, const Args&... args) {
    auto widen = [](const auto& a) {
        if constexpr (std::is_convertible_v<decltype(a), std::string_view>) return ToWide(std::string_view(a));
        else return a;
    };
    return ToUtf8(Text::Format(id, widen(args)...));
}

} // namespace WS::RulesDetail
```

`src/core/Safety.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/Safety.h"
#include "resources/resource.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2ipdef.h>
#include <winternl.h>  // NTSTATUS for ip2string.h
#include <ip2string.h>
#include <iphlpapi.h>
#include <vector>

#pragma comment(lib, "iphlpapi.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "ntdll.lib")

namespace WS {

namespace {

// The IPv4 DNS servers Windows uses (host byte order); a public resolver when none is configured.
std::vector<uint32_t> DnsServers() {
    std::vector<uint32_t> servers;
    ULONG size = 0;
    if (GetNetworkParams(nullptr, &size) == ERROR_BUFFER_OVERFLOW && size) {
        std::vector<uint8_t> buffer(size);
        auto* info = reinterpret_cast<FIXED_INFO*>(buffer.data());
        if (GetNetworkParams(info, &size) == NO_ERROR) {
            for (const IP_ADDR_STRING* a = &info->DnsServerList; a; a = a->Next) {
                in_addr address{};
                PCSTR end = nullptr;
                if (RtlIpv4StringToAddressA(a->IpAddress.String, TRUE, &end, &address) == 0 && end && *end == '\0' &&
                    address.s_addr != 0) {
                    servers.push_back(ntohl(address.s_addr));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (servers.empty()) servers.push_back(0x08080808);  // 8.8.8.8
    return servers;
}

FrameInfo Flow(uint8_t protocol, uint32_t src, uint16_t sport, uint32_t dst, uint16_t dport) {
    FrameInfo f;
    f.ip = true;
    f.version = 4;
    f.protocol = protocol;
    f.src4 = src;
    f.dst4 = dst;
    f.hasPorts = true;
    f.srcPort = sport;
    f.dstPort = dport;
    return f;
}

// The rule that decides the flow, or nullptr when the default policy does. `blocked` reports the verdict.
const Rule* Decide(std::span<const Rule> rules, RuleAction policy, const FrameInfo& f, Dir dir, bool& blocked) {
    for (const Rule& r : rules) {
        if (r.enabled && Matches(r.match, f, dir)) {
            blocked = r.action == RuleAction::Block;
            return &r;
        }
    }
    blocked = policy == RuleAction::Block;
    return nullptr;
}

} // namespace

std::vector<LockoutRisk> LockoutRisks(std::span<const Rule> rules, RuleAction policy) {
    constexpr uint32_t kLocal = 0xC0A80064;   // 192.168.0.100, a typical LAN address of this machine
    constexpr uint32_t kPeer = 0x0A000002;    // 10.0.0.2, a remote desktop client
    constexpr uint32_t kWeb = 0x01010101;     // 1.1.1.1, any web server
    std::vector<LockoutRisk> risks;
    auto check = [&](UINT name, const FrameInfo& f, Dir dir) {
        bool blocked = false;
        const Rule* rule = Decide(rules, policy, f, dir, blocked);
        if (blocked) risks.push_back({name, rule});
        return blocked;
    };
    for (uint32_t dns : DnsServers()) {
        if (check(IDS_RISK_DNS, Flow(17, kLocal, 50353, dns, 53), Dir::Out)) break;
    }
    check(IDS_RISK_WEB, Flow(6, kLocal, 50443, kWeb, 443), Dir::Out);
    check(IDS_RISK_RDP, Flow(6, kPeer, 50389, kLocal, 3389), Dir::In);
    return risks;
}

std::wstring DescribeRisks(std::span<const LockoutRisk> risks) {
    std::wstring out;
    for (const LockoutRisk& r : risks) {
        if (!out.empty()) out += L", ";
        out += Text::Get(r.name);
    }
    return out;
}

} // namespace WS
```

`src/core/Safety.h`:

```h
// WireScope - Lock-out check: would these firewall rules cut the user off?
//
// The rules are evaluated (first match wins, then the default policy) against a few flows every
// session depends on: name resolution to the system's own DNS servers, outgoing HTTPS and incoming
// Remote Desktop. The GUI asks before applying such rules and arms the automatic undo; the command
// line prints a warning.
#pragma once
#include "core/Rules.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <span>
#include <vector>

namespace WS {

struct LockoutRisk {
    UINT name;                 // string id: IDS_RISK_DNS, IDS_RISK_WEB, IDS_RISK_RDP
    const Rule* rule{nullptr}; // the blocking rule, nullptr = the default policy
};

[[nodiscard]] std::vector<LockoutRisk> LockoutRisks(std::span<const Rule> rules, RuleAction policy);

// "name resolution (DNS), web traffic (HTTPS)" in the current language.
[[nodiscard]] std::wstring DescribeRisks(std::span<const LockoutRisk> risks);

} // namespace WS
```

`src/core/TrafficController.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/TrafficController.h"
#include "resources/resource.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <cstring>
#include <format>

namespace WS {

namespace {

constexpr wchar_t kMutexName[] = L"Global\\WireScope.DataPlane";
constexpr wchar_t kLocalMutexName[] = L"Local\\WireScope.DataPlane";
constexpr wchar_t kRecoveryValue[] = L"DataPlaneRecovery";

constexpr int64_t kOwnerKill = -1;
constexpr int64_t kOwnerSelector = -2;
constexpr int64_t kOwnerForeign = -3;
constexpr int64_t kOwnerPolicy = -4;
constexpr int64_t kOwnerEngine = -5;  // from the first process rule on, the engine decides

#pragma pack(push, 1)
struct RecoveryRecord {
    uint32_t magic;       // 'WSDP'
    uint32_t version;
    uint64_t bootTime;    // the driver forgets everything on reboot
    uint64_t adapter;     // adapter whose mode WireScope changed, 0 = none
    uint32_t tableSet;    // WireScope's table is in the driver
    uint32_t foreignCount;
    // followed by foreignCount STATIC_FILTER entries
};
#pragma pack(pop)
constexpr uint32_t kRecoveryMagic = 0x50445357;

bool SameEntry(const STATIC_FILTER& a, const STATIC_FILTER& b) noexcept {
    return a.m_Adapter == b.m_Adapter && a.m_dwDirectionFlags == b.m_dwDirectionFlags && a.m_FilterAction == b.m_FilterAction &&
           a.m_ValidFields == b.m_ValidFields &&
           std::memcmp(&a.m_DataLinkFilter, &b.m_DataLinkFilter, sizeof(a.m_DataLinkFilter)) == 0 &&
           std::memcmp(&a.m_NetworkFilter, &b.m_NetworkFilter, sizeof(a.m_NetworkFilter)) == 0 &&
           std::memcmp(&a.m_TransportFilter, &b.m_TransportFilter, sizeof(a.m_TransportFilter)) == 0;
}

bool SameTable(const std::vector<STATIC_FILTER>& a, const std::vector<STATIC_FILTER>& b) noexcept {
    if (a.size() != b.size()) return false;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); ++i) {
        if (!SameEntry(a[i], b[i])) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

} // namespace

TrafficController::TrafficController(std::shared_ptr<DriverBridge> bridge)
    : m_bridge(std::move(bridge)), m_engine(std::make_unique<PacketEngine>(m_bridge)) {
}

TrafficController::~TrafficController() {
    Shutdown();
}

std::wstring TrafficController::Attach() {
    if (!m_mutex) m_mutex.reset(CreateMutexW(nullptr, FALSE, kMutexName));
    if (!m_mutex) m_mutex.reset(CreateMutexW(nullptr, FALSE, kLocalMutexName));
    if (m_mutex && !m_control) {
        const DWORD waited = WaitForSingleObject(m_mutex.get(), 0);
        m_control = waited == WAIT_OBJECT_0 || waited == WAIT_ABANDONED;  // abandoned: a session crashed
    }
    if (!m_control) {
        return Text::Get(IDS_DP_OTHER_INSTANCE);
    }
    return Recover();
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> TrafficController::FilterSupport() {
    if (!m_bridge->IsConnected()) return std::unexpected(L"Driver not connected");
    if (!m_filterSupport) {
        auto count = m_bridge->GetStaticFilterCount();
        if (!count) {
            m_filterSupport = std::unexpected(count.error());
        } else if (*count > 0) {
            // A non-empty table lets us verify the entry layout before writing anything.
            auto table = m_bridge->ReadStaticFilters();
            m_filterSupport = table ? std::expected<void, std::wstring>() : std::unexpected(table.error());
        } else {
            m_filterSupport = std::expected<void, std::wstring>();
        }
    }
    return *m_filterSupport;
}

std::expected<size_t, std::wstring> TrafficController::ForeignFilterCount() {
    if (m_tableInstalled) return m_foreign.size();
    if (auto support = FilterSupport(); !support) return std::unexpected(support.error());
    auto table = m_bridge->ReadStaticFilters();
    if (!table) return std::unexpected(table.error());
    return table->size();
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> TrafficController::SetAdapter(HANDLE adapter) {
    if (adapter == m_adapter) return {};
    if (AdapterLocked()) {
        return std::unexpected(Text::Get(IDS_DP_ADAPTER_BUSY));
    }
    const bool monitor = m_state.monitor;
    if (monitor) {
        if (auto r = SetMonitor(false); !r) return r;
    }
    m_adapter = adapter;
    if (monitor) return SetMonitor(true);
    return {};
}

bool TrafficController::Active() const noexcept {
    return AdapterLocked() || m_state.monitor;
}

bool TrafficController::AdapterLocked() const noexcept {
    return m_state.capture || m_state.kill || m_state.firewall || m_state.impairment.enabled;
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> TrafficController::SetCapture(bool on) {
    if (on == m_state.capture) return {};
    State next = m_state;
    next.capture = on;
    return Transition(std::move(next));
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> TrafficController::SetMonitor(bool on) {
    if (on == m_state.monitor) return {};
    State next = m_state;
    next.monitor = on;
    return Transition(std::move(next));
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> TrafficController::SetKillSwitch(bool on) {
    if (on == m_state.kill) return {};
    State next = m_state;
    next.kill = on;
    return Transition(std::move(next));
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> TrafficController::SetFirewall(bool on) {
    if (on == m_state.firewall) return {};
    State next = m_state;
    next.firewall = on;
    return Transition(std::move(next));
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> TrafficController::SetRules(std::vector<Rule> rules) {
    for (Rule& r : rules) {
        if (r.id == 0) r.id = m_nextRuleId++;
        else if (r.id >= m_nextRuleId) m_nextRuleId = r.id + 1;
    }
    State next = m_state;
    next.rules = std::move(rules);
    if (!m_state.firewall) {
        m_state = std::move(next);
        return {};
    }
    return Transition(std::move(next));
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> TrafficController::SetPolicy(RuleAction policy) {
    if (policy == m_state.policy) return {};
    State next = m_state;
    next.policy = policy;
    if (!m_state.firewall) {
        m_state = std::move(next);
        return {};
    }
    return Transition(std::move(next));
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> TrafficController::SetKernelOffload(bool on) {
    if (on == m_state.kernelOffload) return {};
    State next = m_state;
    next.kernelOffload = on;
    if (!m_state.firewall && !m_state.kill) {
        m_state = std::move(next);
        return {};
    }
    return Transition(std::move(next));
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> TrafficController::SetImpairment(const ImpairmentProfile& profile) {
    auto selector = ImpairmentSelector(profile);
    if (!selector) return std::unexpected(ToWide(selector.error()));
    State next = m_state;
    next.impairment = profile;
    next.impairmentMatch = *selector;
    if (!profile.enabled && !m_state.impairment.enabled) {
        m_state = std::move(next);
        return {};
    }
    return Transition(std::move(next));
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Planning
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
std::expected<void, std::wstring> TrafficController::Compose(const State& s, bool userAll, bool userSelected, bool withForeign,
                                                             std::vector<STATIC_FILTER>& table, std::vector<int64_t>& owners) const {
    auto append = [&](const std::vector<STATIC_FILTER>& entries, int64_t owner) {
        table.insert(table.end(), entries.begin(), entries.end());
        owners.insert(owners.end(), entries.size(), owner);
    };
    const bool offload = s.kernelOffload;
    const bool quiesce = !userAll && !userSelected && !withForeign;
    if (s.kill && (offload || quiesce)) append({CatchAll(FILTER_ACTION_DROP, m_adapter)}, kOwnerKill);
    if (s.firewall && offload) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < s.rules.size(); ++i) {
            const Rule& rule = s.rules[i];
            if (!rule.enabled) continue;
            if (rule.match.app.set || rule.match.icmpTypeSet) {
                // The driver knows no processes and does not inspect ICMP type codes. First match wins,
                // so this rule and every rule after it must be judged by the engine: send the rest of
                // the traffic to user mode.
                append({CatchAll(FILTER_ACTION_REDIRECT, m_adapter)}, kOwnerEngine);
                break;
            }
            const DWORD action = rule.action == RuleAction::Block ? FILTER_ACTION_DROP
                                 : userAll                       ? FILTER_ACTION_REDIRECT
                                                                 : FILTER_ACTION_PASS;
            auto entries = Compile(rule.match, action, m_adapter);
            if (!entries) {
                return std::unexpected(Text::Format(IDS_DP_RULE, i + 1, ToWide(RuleText(rule)), ToWide(entries.error())));
            }
            append(*entries, static_cast<int64_t>(rule.id));
        }
    }
    if (userSelected) {
        auto entries = Compile(s.impairmentMatch, FILTER_ACTION_REDIRECT, m_adapter);
        if (!entries) return std::unexpected(Text::Format(IDS_DP_MATCH, ToWide(entries.error())));
        append(*entries, kOwnerSelector);
    }
    if (withForeign) append(m_foreign, kOwnerForeign);
    const DWORD policy = (s.firewall && offload && s.policy == RuleAction::Block) ? FILTER_ACTION_DROP
                         : userAll                                               ? FILTER_ACTION_REDIRECT
                                                                                 : FILTER_ACTION_PASS;
    append({CatchAll(policy, m_adapter)}, kOwnerPolicy);
    return {};
}

std::expected<TrafficController::Plan, std::wstring> TrafficController::MakePlan(const State& s) {
    const bool filters = FilterSupport().has_value();
    if (s.kernelOffload && (s.firewall || s.kill) && !filters) {
        return std::unexpected(Text::Format(IDS_DP_OFFLOAD, FilterSupport().error()));
    }
    if (filters && !m_tableInstalled) {
        // Fresh snapshot of what other applications have in the table, to keep and restore it.
        auto table = m_bridge->ReadStaticFilters();
        if (!table) return std::unexpected(table.error());
        m_foreign = std::move(*table);
    }

    const Selector& match = s.impairmentMatch;
    const bool selectsAll = match.dir == Dir::Both && match.MatchesAllFrames();
    const bool selectsApp = match.app.set || match.icmpTypeSet;  // the kernel cannot select by process or ICMP type
    const bool offload = s.kernelOffload && filters;

    size_t firstEngineRule = 0;
    bool needsEngineFirewall = false;
    for (const Rule& r : s.rules) {
        if (!r.enabled) continue;
        if (r.match.app.set || r.match.icmpTypeSet) {
            needsEngineFirewall = true;
            break;
        }
        if (offload) ++firstEngineRule;
    }
    const bool kernelEnforcesAll = offload && (!s.firewall || !needsEngineFirewall) && !s.impairment.enabled;

    // User mode sees everything while capturing or monitoring, while the engine enforces the firewall
    // or the kill switch, or when the simulator cannot leave the selection to the kernel.
    const bool userAll = s.capture || s.monitor || ((s.firewall || s.kill) && !kernelEnforcesAll) ||
                         (s.impairment.enabled && (selectsAll || selectsApp || s.firewall || !filters));
    const bool userSelected = s.impairment.enabled && !userAll;

    Plan p;
    // wsddntf evaluates static filters in both MODE_TUNNEL (0x03) and MODE_LISTEN (0x0C). When kernel
    // offload covers every active rule and the simulator is off, MODE_LISTEN lets the driver drop
    // blocked packets and pass allowed packets at DISPATCH_LEVEL without user-mode re-injection.
    const bool tunnel = s.impairment.enabled || ((s.kill || s.firewall) && !kernelEnforcesAll);
    const bool listen = s.capture || s.monitor || ((s.kill || s.firewall) && kernelEnforcesAll);
    p.engine = tunnel || listen;
    p.mode = tunnel ? MODE_TUNNEL : listen ? MODE_LISTEN : MODE_BYPASS;

    p.config.mode = p.mode;
    p.config.capture = s.capture;
    p.config.killSwitch = s.kill;
    p.config.firewall = s.firewall;
    p.config.policy = s.policy;
    for (const Rule& r : s.rules) {
        if (r.enabled) p.config.rules.push_back(r);
    }
    p.config.firstEngineRule = offload ? firstEngineRule : 0;
    p.config.policyInKernel = offload && !needsEngineFirewall;
    p.config.impairment = s.impairment;
    p.config.impairmentMatch = s.impairmentMatch;
    p.config.accounting = s.capture || s.monitor || (tunnel && userAll);  // partial traffic would give wrong totals

    p.ownTable = filters && ((offload && (s.kill || s.firewall)) || userSelected);
    if (p.ownTable) {
        if (auto r = Compose(s, userAll, userSelected, true, p.table, p.owners); !r) return std::unexpected(r.error());
    }
    if (filters) {
        if (auto r = Compose(s, false, false, false, p.quiesce, p.quiesceOwners); !r) return std::unexpected(r.error());
    }
    return p;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Execution
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
std::expected<void, std::wstring> TrafficController::Transition(State next) {
    if (!m_bridge->IsConnected()) return std::unexpected(Text::Get(IDS_DP_NOT_CONNECTED));
    if (!m_adapter && (next.capture || next.monitor || next.kill || next.firewall || next.impairment.enabled)) {
        return std::unexpected(Text::Get(IDS_DP_NO_ADAPTER));
    }
    const bool control = next.kill || next.firewall || next.impairment.enabled;
    if (control && !m_control) {
        return std::unexpected(Text::Get(IDS_DP_OTHER_INSTANCE_CLOSE));
    }

    auto plan = MakePlan(next);
    if (!plan) return std::unexpected(plan.error());
    auto result = Execute(*plan);
    if (result) {
        m_state = std::move(next);
        WriteRecovery();
        return {};
    }

    // Put the previous state back; if even that fails, turn everything off so a half-applied
    // change can never leave the network closed.
    if (auto back = MakePlan(m_state); !back || !Execute(*back)) {
        State off;
        off.rules = m_state.rules;
        off.policy = m_state.policy;
        off.impairment = m_state.impairment;
        off.impairment.enabled = false;
        if (auto offPlan = MakePlan(off); offPlan) (void)Execute(*offPlan);
        m_state = std::move(off);
    }
    WriteRecovery();
    return result;
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> TrafficController::Execute(const Plan& p) {
    const bool running = m_engine->IsRunning();
    auto quiesce = [&]() -> std::expected<void, std::wstring> {
        if (p.quiesce.empty()) return {};  // no filter support: the engine copes with the race
        return WriteTable(p.quiesce, p.quiesceOwners);
    };
    auto table = [&]() -> std::expected<void, std::wstring> {
        return p.ownTable ? WriteTable(p.table, p.owners) : RestoreForeign();
    };

    if (p.engine) {
        if (!running) {
            // The record exists before the adapter leaves bypass mode.
            m_modeAdapter = m_adapter;
            WriteRecovery();
            if (auto r = m_engine->Start(m_adapter, p.config); !r) {
                m_modeAdapter = nullptr;
                return r;
            }
        } else {
            if (p.mode != m_engine->Mode()) {
                if (auto r = quiesce(); !r) return r;
            }
            if (auto r = m_engine->Reconfigure(p.config); !r) return r;
        }
        return table();
    }

    if (running) {
        if (auto r = quiesce(); !r) return r;
        m_engine->Stop(MODE_BYPASS);  // drains and re-injects what is queued or held
        m_modeAdapter = nullptr;
    }
    return table();
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> TrafficController::WriteTable(const std::vector<STATIC_FILTER>& table,
                                                                const std::vector<int64_t>& owners) {
    if (m_tableInstalled && SameTable(table, m_installed)) {
        m_owners = owners;
        return {};
    }
    HarvestCounters();
    if (!m_tableInstalled) {
        m_tableInstalled = true;  // the record must exist before the driver holds our table
        WriteRecovery();
    }
    if (auto r = m_bridge->WriteStaticFilters(table); !r) {
        // WriteStaticFilters cleared the table; put the other applications' filters back.
        (void)m_bridge->WriteStaticFilters(m_foreign);
        m_installed.clear();
        m_owners.clear();
        m_tableInstalled = false;
        WriteRecovery();
        m_filterSupport.reset();
        return std::unexpected(r.error());
    }
    m_installed = table;
    m_owners = owners;
    return {};
}

std::expected<void, std::wstring> TrafficController::RestoreForeign() {
    if (!m_tableInstalled) return {};
    HarvestCounters();
    if (auto r = m_bridge->WriteStaticFilters(m_foreign); !r) return r;
    m_tableInstalled = false;
    m_installed.clear();
    m_owners.clear();
    return {};
}

void TrafficController::HarvestCounters() {
    if (!m_tableInstalled || m_installed.empty()) return;
    auto table = m_bridge->ReadStaticFilters();
    if (!table || table->size() != m_owners.size()) return;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < table->size(); ++i) {
        const STATIC_FILTER& f = (*table)[i];
        m_totals[m_owners[i]] += HitCounter{f.m_PacketsIn + f.m_PacketsOut, f.m_BytesIn + f.m_BytesOut};
    }
}

FirewallStatus TrafficController::PollFirewall() {
    FirewallStatus status;
    status.installed = m_tableInstalled;
    status.foreignEntries = m_foreign.size();
    auto totals = m_totals;
    if (m_tableInstalled) {
        status.ownEntries = m_installed.size() >= m_foreign.size() ? m_installed.size() - m_foreign.size() : m_installed.size();
        if (auto table = m_bridge->ReadStaticFilters(); table && table->size() == m_owners.size()) {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < table->size(); ++i) {
                const STATIC_FILTER& f = (*table)[i];
                totals[m_owners[i]] += HitCounter{f.m_PacketsIn + f.m_PacketsOut, f.m_BytesIn + f.m_BytesOut};
            }
        }
    }
    for (const auto& [owner, hits] : totals) {
        if (hits.packets && owner != kOwnerForeign) status.kernelCounters = true;
    }
    // The engine's own counters: authoritative whenever it enforces the rules.
    const auto engine = m_engine->RuleHits();
    for (const Rule& r : m_state.rules) {
        HitCounter hits = totals[static_cast<int64_t>(r.id)];
        if (const auto it = engine.find(r.id); it != engine.end()) hits += it->second;
        status.rules[r.id] = hits;
    }
    status.policy = totals[kOwnerPolicy];
    if (const auto it = engine.find(0); it != engine.end()) status.policy += it->second;
    status.killSwitch = totals[kOwnerKill];
    return status;
}

void TrafficController::Shutdown() noexcept {
    try {
        if (m_bridge && m_bridge->IsConnected() && Active()) {
            State off;
            off.rules = m_state.rules;
            off.policy = m_state.policy;
            off.impairment = m_state.impairment;
            off.impairment.enabled = false;
            if (auto plan = MakePlan(off); plan) (void)Execute(*plan);
            m_state = std::move(off);
        }
        // Whatever the plan could not do, do directly.
        if (m_engine && m_engine->IsRunning()) m_engine->Stop(MODE_BYPASS);
        if (m_bridge && m_bridge->IsConnected()) {
            (void)RestoreForeign();
            if (m_modeAdapter) (void)m_bridge->SetAdapterMode(m_modeAdapter, MODE_BYPASS);
            m_modeAdapter = nullptr;
        }
        WriteRecovery();
    } catch (...) {
    }
    if (m_control && m_mutex) ReleaseMutex(m_mutex.get());
    m_control = false;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Crash recovery
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void TrafficController::WriteRecovery() {
    const bool modeChanged = m_modeAdapter != nullptr;
    if (!m_tableInstalled && !modeChanged) {
        Settings::Delete(kRecoveryValue);
        return;
    }
    std::vector<uint8_t> data(sizeof(RecoveryRecord) + m_foreign.size() * sizeof(STATIC_FILTER));
    RecoveryRecord record{};
    record.magic = kRecoveryMagic;
    record.version = 1;
    record.bootTime = BootTimeSeconds();
    record.adapter = modeChanged ? static_cast<uint64_t>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(m_modeAdapter)) : 0;
    record.tableSet = m_tableInstalled ? 1u : 0u;
    record.foreignCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(m_foreign.size());
    std::memcpy(data.data(), &record, sizeof(record));
    if (!m_foreign.empty()) std::memcpy(data.data() + sizeof(record), m_foreign.data(), m_foreign.size() * sizeof(STATIC_FILTER));
    Settings::WriteBinary(kRecoveryValue, data);
}

std::wstring TrafficController::Recover() {
    const auto data = Settings::ReadBinary(kRecoveryValue);
    if (!data) return {};
    Settings::Delete(kRecoveryValue);
    if (data->size() < sizeof(RecoveryRecord)) return {};
    RecoveryRecord record{};
    std::memcpy(&record, data->data(), sizeof(record));
    if (record.magic != kRecoveryMagic || data->size() != sizeof(record) + record.foreignCount * sizeof(STATIC_FILTER)) return {};
    // After a reboot the driver starts clean; the record is stale.
    const uint64_t boot = BootTimeSeconds();
    if ((boot > record.bootTime ? boot - record.bootTime : record.bootTime - boot) > 120) return {};

    bool mode = false, table = false;
    if (record.adapter) {
        mode = m_bridge->SetAdapterMode(reinterpret_cast<HANDLE>(static_cast<uintptr_t>(record.adapter)), MODE_BYPASS).has_value();
    }
    if (record.tableSet) {
        std::vector<STATIC_FILTER> foreign(record.foreignCount);
        if (record.foreignCount) {
            std::memcpy(foreign.data(), data->data() + sizeof(record), record.foreignCount * sizeof(STATIC_FILTER));
        }
        table = m_bridge->WriteStaticFilters(foreign).has_value();
    }
    if (mode && table) return Text::Get(IDS_DP_RECOVERED_BOTH);
    if (mode) return Text::Get(IDS_DP_RECOVERED_MODE);
    if (table) return Text::Get(IDS_DP_RECOVERED_TABLE);
    return {};
}

} // namespace WS

```

`src/core/TrafficController.h`:

```h
// WireScope - Data plane coordinator for one adapter.
//
// Capture, firewall, impairment simulator and kill switch all need the adapter mode and the
// driver's (single, global) static filter table. This class is their only owner: every change is a
// transition from one complete State to the next, computed as a Plan (adapter mode, engine config,
// filter table) and carried out in an order that never lets a packet slip through a half-applied
// state:
//
//   * The driver evaluates static filters in both tunnel mode and listen mode. When kernel offload
//     covers every active firewall rule and the simulator is off, listen mode lets wsddntf drop
//     blocked packets and pass allowed packets directly at DISPATCH_LEVEL; tunnelling is used only
//     when user mode must judge process rules, run the link simulator, or enforce without offload.
//   * Before the engine changes or leaves its mode, a "quiesce" table (the same rules without any
//     REDIRECT) stops new packets from entering the queue; the engine then drains it.
//   * Firewall "allow" rules become REDIRECT while user mode needs the traffic (capture, monitor,
//     simulator), PASS otherwise; the default policy is the last entry.
//
// Static filters of other applications are kept behind WireScope's entries and restored when it is
// done. A registry record (HKCU\Software\WireScope) lets the next start repair the driver state if a
// session ends without cleaning up, and a global mutex keeps two instances from fighting over it.
#pragma once
#include "core/DriverBridge.h"
#include "core/Impairment.h"
#include "core/PacketEngine.h"
#include "core/Rules.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <expected>
#include <memory>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

namespace WS {

struct FirewallStatus {
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, HitCounter> rules;  // by Rule::id
    HitCounter policy;                               // packets that met the default policy
    HitCounter killSwitch;
    bool kernelCounters{false}; // the driver reported hits for WireScope's entries
    size_t ownEntries{0};      // driver entries WireScope installed
    size_t foreignEntries{0};  // entries of other applications kept in the table
    bool installed{false};
};

class TrafficController {
public:
    explicit TrafficController(std::shared_ptr<DriverBridge> bridge);
    ~TrafficController();

    TrafficController(const TrafficController&) = delete;
    TrafficController& operator=(const TrafficController&) = delete;

    // Call once the bridge is connected. Takes the data-plane lock and repairs what a session that
    // crashed left in the driver. Returns a message for the user, or an empty string.
    std::wstring Attach();

    [[nodiscard]] PacketEngine& Engine() noexcept { return *m_engine; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool CanControl() const noexcept { return m_control; }
    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<void, std::wstring> FilterSupport();
    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<size_t, std::wstring> ForeignFilterCount();

    [[nodiscard]] HANDLE Adapter() const noexcept { return m_adapter; }
    // The process monitor follows the new adapter; every other feature must be off first.
    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<void, std::wstring> SetAdapter(HANDLE adapter);
    [[nodiscard]] bool Active() const noexcept;         // anything uses the adapter
    [[nodiscard]] bool AdapterLocked() const noexcept;  // a feature that keeps the adapter from changing

    [[nodiscard]] bool Capturing() const noexcept { return m_state.capture; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool Monitoring() const noexcept { return m_state.monitor; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool KillSwitch() const noexcept { return m_state.kill; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool FirewallEnabled() const noexcept { return m_state.firewall; }
    [[nodiscard]] RuleAction Policy() const noexcept { return m_state.policy; }
    [[nodiscard]] const std::vector<Rule>& Rules() const noexcept { return m_state.rules; }
    [[nodiscard]] const ImpairmentProfile& Impairment() const noexcept { return m_state.impairment; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool KernelOffload() const noexcept { return m_state.kernelOffload; }

    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<void, std::wstring> SetCapture(bool on);
    // Counts traffic per process: listen mode (copies only, traffic is never changed) unless a feature
    // already brings every packet to user mode.
    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<void, std::wstring> SetMonitor(bool on);
    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<void, std::wstring> SetKillSwitch(bool on);
    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<void, std::wstring> SetFirewall(bool on);
    // Rules with id 0 get a fresh id; on failure the previous rules stay in force.
    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<void, std::wstring> SetRules(std::vector<Rule> rules);
    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<void, std::wstring> SetPolicy(RuleAction policy);
    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<void, std::wstring> SetImpairment(const ImpairmentProfile& profile);
    // Compiles L2/L3/L4 firewall rules into the driver's 181-byte STATIC_FILTER table for kernel-mode
    // enforcement at DISPATCH_LEVEL; process rules (app=) are redirected to the user-mode engine.
    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<void, std::wstring> SetKernelOffload(bool on);
    [[nodiscard]] uint64_t NewRuleId() noexcept { return m_nextRuleId++; }

    // Everything off; the driver table and the adapter mode are returned to how they were found.
    void Shutdown() noexcept;

    [[nodiscard]] FirewallStatus PollFirewall();

private:
    struct State {
        bool capture{false};
        bool monitor{false};
        bool kill{false};
        bool firewall{false};
        bool kernelOffload{true};
        RuleAction policy{RuleAction::Allow};
        std::vector<Rule> rules;
        ImpairmentProfile impairment;
        Selector impairmentMatch;
    };
    struct Plan {
        DWORD mode{MODE_BYPASS};
        bool engine{false};
        EngineConfig config;
        bool ownTable{false};
        std::vector<STATIC_FILTER> table;
        std::vector<int64_t> owners;
        std::vector<STATIC_FILTER> quiesce;
        std::vector<int64_t> quiesceOwners;
    };

    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<void, std::wstring> Transition(State next);
    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<Plan, std::wstring> MakePlan(const State& s);
    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<void, std::wstring> Compose(const State& s, bool userAll, bool userSelected, bool withForeign,
                                                            std::vector<STATIC_FILTER>& table, std::vector<int64_t>& owners) const;
    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<void, std::wstring> Execute(const Plan& plan);
    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<void, std::wstring> WriteTable(const std::vector<STATIC_FILTER>& table,
                                                               const std::vector<int64_t>& owners);
    [[nodiscard]] std::expected<void, std::wstring> RestoreForeign();
    void HarvestCounters();
    void WriteRecovery();
    std::wstring Recover();

    std::shared_ptr<DriverBridge> m_bridge;
    std::unique_ptr<PacketEngine> m_engine;
    HANDLE m_adapter{nullptr};
    State m_state;
    HANDLE m_modeAdapter{nullptr};  // adapter whose mode WireScope changed (for recovery)

    std::optional<std::expected<void, std::wstring>> m_filterSupport;
    bool m_tableInstalled{false};
    std::vector<STATIC_FILTER> m_installed;
    std::vector<int64_t> m_owners;
    std::vector<STATIC_FILTER> m_foreign;  // what the table held before WireScope wrote to it
    std::unordered_map<int64_t, HitCounter> m_totals;

    Handle m_mutex;
    bool m_control{false};
    uint64_t m_nextRuleId{1};
};

} // namespace WS
```
