`src/gui/Dialogs.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "gui/Dialogs.h"
#include "gui/Theme.h"
#include "gui/Widgets.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include <CommCtrl.h>
#include <ShObjIdl.h>
#include <uxtheme.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <unordered_map>

#pragma comment(lib, "ole32.lib")

namespace WS::Ui {
namespace {

constexpr wchar_t kClass[] = L"WireScope.Dialog";
constexpr int kExtra = 3, kFieldBase = 100, kMonospace = 300;

Gdi<HFONT> MakeGdiFont(const Fonts& f, const wchar_t* family, float pixels) {
    return Gdi<HFONT>(CreateFontW(-static_cast<int>(f.F(pixels) + 0.5f), 0, 0, 0, FW_NORMAL, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, DEFAULT_CHARSET,
                                  OUT_DEFAULT_PRECIS, CLIP_DEFAULT_PRECIS, CLEARTYPE_QUALITY, DEFAULT_PITCH | FF_DONTCARE, family));
}

class Dialog {
public:
    Dialog(HWND owner, const DialogSpec& spec) : m_owner(owner), m_spec(spec) {}

    DialogResult Run() {
        RegisterOnce();
        m_fonts.Create(GetDpiForWindow(m_owner));
        m_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_DLGMODALFRAME, kClass, L"WireScope", WS_POPUP | WS_CAPTION | WS_SYSMENU | WS_CLIPCHILDREN,
                                 0, 0, 100, 100, m_owner, nullptr, GetModuleHandleW(nullptr), this);
        if (!m_hwnd) return {};
        const bool ownerWasEnabled = !EnableWindow(m_owner, FALSE);
        ShowWindow(m_hwnd, SW_SHOW);
        if (!m_edits.empty()) {
            SetFocus(m_edits.front());
            SendMessageW(m_edits.front(), EM_SETSEL, 0, -1);
        } else {
            SetFocus(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, m_spec.cancelButton ? IDCANCEL : IDOK));
        }
        MSG msg;
        while (!m_done) {
            const BOOL got = GetMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0);
            if (got <= 0) {
                if (got == 0) PostQuitMessage(static_cast<int>(msg.wParam));
                break;
            }
            if (!IsDialogMessageW(m_hwnd, &msg)) {
                TranslateMessage(&msg);
                DispatchMessageW(&msg);
            }
        }
        if (ownerWasEnabled) EnableWindow(m_owner, TRUE);  // before destroying, so activation returns to the owner
        DestroyWindow(m_hwnd);
        return m_result;
    }

private:
    static void RegisterOnce() {
        WNDCLASSEXW wc{sizeof wc};
        if (GetClassInfoExW(GetModuleHandleW(nullptr), kClass, &wc)) return;
        wc.lpfnWndProc = Proc;
        wc.hInstance = GetModuleHandleW(nullptr);
        wc.hCursor = LoadCursorW(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
        wc.hbrBackground = static_cast<HBRUSH>(GetStockObject(BLACK_BRUSH));
        wc.lpszClassName = kClass;
        RegisterClassExW(&wc);
    }

    static LRESULT CALLBACK Proc(HWND hwnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
        Dialog* self = nullptr;
        if (message == WM_NCCREATE) {
            self = static_cast<Dialog*>(reinterpret_cast<CREATESTRUCTW*>(lParam)->lpCreateParams);
            self->m_hwnd = hwnd;
            SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA, reinterpret_cast<LONG_PTR>(self));
        } else {
            self = reinterpret_cast<Dialog*>(GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA));
        }
        if (message == WM_NCDESTROY) SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA, 0);
        return self ? self->Handle(message, wParam, lParam) : DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
    }

    void Build() {
        ApplyBackdrop(m_hwnd);
        auto& g = Graphics::Get();
        m_fieldBrush.reset(CreateSolidBrush(g.GdiSurface(Color::Control)));
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_spec.fields.size(); ++i) {
            const auto& field = m_spec.fields[i];
            HWND edit = CreateWindowExW(0, L"EDIT", field.value.c_str(), WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | WS_TABSTOP | ES_AUTOHSCROLL, 0, 0, 10,
                                        10, m_hwnd, reinterpret_cast<HMENU>(static_cast<INT_PTR>(kFieldBase + i)), nullptr, nullptr);
            if (!field.cue.empty()) SendMessageW(edit, EM_SETCUEBANNER, TRUE, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(field.cue.c_str()));
            SendMessageW(edit, EM_SETLIMITTEXT, 4096, 0);
            m_edits.push_back(edit);
        }
        if (!m_spec.monospace.empty()) {
            m_mono = CreateWindowExW(0, L"EDIT", nullptr,
                                     WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | WS_TABSTOP | WS_VSCROLL | ES_MULTILINE | ES_READONLY | ES_AUTOVSCROLL, 0, 0,
                                     10, 10, m_hwnd, reinterpret_cast<HMENU>(static_cast<INT_PTR>(kMonospace)), nullptr, nullptr);
            SetWindowTheme(m_mono, L"DarkMode_Explorer", nullptr);
            std::wstring text;
            for (wchar_t c : m_spec.monospace) {  // the EDIT control wants CRLF
                if (c == L'\n') text += L'\r';
                text += c;
            }
            SetWindowTextW(m_mono, text.c_str());
        }
        auto button = [&](int id, const std::wstring& text, ButtonKind kind) {
            HWND b = CreateButton(m_hwnd, id, text.c_str());
            m_looks[b] = {kind, 0, false};
            m_buttons.push_back(b);
        };
        if (!m_spec.extra.empty()) button(kExtra, m_spec.extra, ButtonKind::Standard);
        button(IDOK, m_spec.ok.empty() ? Text::Get(IDS_OK) : m_spec.ok, ButtonKind::Accent);
        if (m_spec.cancelButton) button(IDCANCEL, m_spec.cancel.empty() ? Text::Get(IDS_CANCEL) : m_spec.cancel, ButtonKind::Standard);
        Layout();
        Revalidate();
    }

    void Layout() {
        const auto& f = m_fonts;
        m_editFont = MakeGdiFont(f, f.UiFamily(), 13.0f);
        m_monoFont = MakeGdiFont(f, f.MonoFamily(), 12.0f);
        // One width for every button, wide enough for the longest label (translations run longer);
        // the dialog grows when the buttons need it.
        const float pad = f.F(24), gapX = f.F(8);
        float bw = f.F(124);
        for (HWND b : m_buttons) {
            wchar_t text[128]{};
            GetWindowTextW(b, text, static_cast<int>(std::size(text)));
            bw = std::max(bw, std::ceil(TextWidth(f, Font::Body, text) + f.F(40)));
        }
        const float buttons = static_cast<float>(m_buttons.size());
        const float width = std::max(f.F(static_cast<float>(m_spec.width)), 2 * pad + buttons * bw + (buttons - 1) * gapX);
        const float inner = width - 2 * pad;
        float y = pad;
        m_headingRect = {pad, y, width - pad, y + f.F(28)};
        y += f.F(38);
        if (!m_spec.message.empty()) {
            const float h = TextHeight(f, Font::Body, m_spec.message, inner);
            m_messageRect = {pad, y, width - pad, y + h};
            y += h + f.F(16);
        }
        m_fieldRects.clear();
        m_labelRects.clear();
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_edits.size(); ++i) {
            m_labelRects.push_back({pad, y, width - pad, y + f.F(18)});
            y += f.F(22);
            const D2D1_RECT_F box{pad, y, width - pad, y + f.F(34)};
            m_fieldRects.push_back(box);
            const int lineH = f.S(19);
            SetWindowPos(m_edits[i], nullptr, static_cast<int>(box.left + f.F(10)), static_cast<int>((box.top + box.bottom) / 2) - lineH / 2,
                         static_cast<int>(box.right - box.left - f.F(20)), lineH, SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
            SendMessageW(m_edits[i], WM_SETFONT, reinterpret_cast<WPARAM>(m_spec.fields[i].mono ? m_monoFont.get() : m_editFont.get()), TRUE);
            y += f.F(34) + f.F(8);
        }
        m_previewRect = {pad, y, width - pad, y + f.F(20)};
        y += m_edits.empty() ? 0 : f.F(26);
        if (m_mono) {
            const D2D1_RECT_F box{pad, y, width - pad, y + f.F(static_cast<float>(m_spec.monospaceHeight))};
            m_monoRect = box;
            SetWindowPos(m_mono, nullptr, static_cast<int>(box.left + f.F(8)), static_cast<int>(box.top + f.F(6)),
                         static_cast<int>(box.right - box.left - f.F(10)), static_cast<int>(box.bottom - box.top - f.F(12)),
                         SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
            SendMessageW(m_mono, WM_SETFONT, reinterpret_cast<WPARAM>(m_monoFont.get()), TRUE);
            y = box.bottom + f.F(16);
        }
        // Footer with the buttons, right-aligned, all the same width.
        const float footer = f.F(72);
        m_footer = {0, y, width, y + footer};
        const float bh = f.F(32);
        float x = width - pad;
        for (auto it = m_buttons.rbegin(); it != m_buttons.rend(); ++it) {
            x -= bw;
            SetWindowPos(*it, nullptr, static_cast<int>(x), static_cast<int>(y + (footer - bh) / 2), static_cast<int>(bw),
                         static_cast<int>(bh), SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
            x -= gapX;
        }
        RECT rc{0, 0, static_cast<LONG>(width), static_cast<LONG>(y + footer)};
        AdjustWindowRectExForDpi(&rc, static_cast<DWORD>(GetWindowLongPtrW(m_hwnd, GWL_STYLE)), FALSE,
                                 static_cast<DWORD>(GetWindowLongPtrW(m_hwnd, GWL_EXSTYLE)), f.dpi());
        RECT owner{};
        GetWindowRect(m_owner, &owner);
        const int w = rc.right - rc.left, h = rc.bottom - rc.top;
        SetWindowPos(m_hwnd, nullptr, owner.left + (owner.right - owner.left - w) / 2, owner.top + (owner.bottom - owner.top - h) / 3, w,
                     h, SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
    }

    std::vector<std::wstring> Values() const {
        std::vector<std::wstring> values;
        for (HWND e : m_edits) {
            const int n = GetWindowTextLengthW(e);
            std::wstring v(static_cast<std::size_t>(n) + 1, L'\0');
            GetWindowTextW(e, v.data(), n + 1);
            v.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(n));
            const auto first = v.find_first_not_of(L" \t\"");
            const auto last = v.find_last_not_of(L" \t\"");
            values.push_back(first == std::wstring::npos ? std::wstring() : v.substr(first, last - first + 1));
        }
        return values;
    }

    void Revalidate() {
        const auto values = Values();
        m_error.clear();
        m_previewText.clear();
        if (m_spec.validate) {
            if (auto error = m_spec.validate(values)) m_error = *error;
        }
        if (m_error.empty() && m_spec.preview) m_previewText = m_spec.preview(values);
        EnableWindow(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, IDOK), m_error.empty());
        const RECT r = ToRect(m_previewRect);
        InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, &r, FALSE);
    }

    void PaintSurface() {
        PaintScope ps(m_hwnd);
        RECT client{};
        GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
        const auto& f = m_fonts;
        HWND focus = GetFocus();
        Paint(
            ps.dc(), client, f,
            [&](Canvas& c) {
                c.Clear(Graphics::Get().Base());
                c.Text(m_spec.heading, m_headingRect, Font::Title, m_spec.danger ? Color::Critical : Color::Text);
                if (!m_spec.message.empty()) c.Paragraph(m_spec.message, m_messageRect, Font::Body, Color::Text2);
                for (std::size_t i = 0; i < m_fieldRects.size(); ++i) {
                    c.Text(m_spec.fields[i].label, m_labelRects[i], Font::Caption, Color::Text2);
                    const D2D1_RECT_F& box = m_fieldRects[i];
                    c.Fill(box, Color::Control, f.F(4));
                    c.Stroke(box, Color::ControlStroke, f.F(4));
                    const bool focused = focus == m_edits[i];
                    c.Fill({box.left + f.F(1), box.bottom - f.F(focused ? 2.0f : 1.0f), box.right - f.F(1), box.bottom},
                           focused ? Color::AccentText : White(0.30f));
                }
                if (!m_error.empty()) c.Text(m_error, m_previewRect, Font::Caption, Color::Critical);
                else if (!m_previewText.empty()) c.Text(m_previewText, m_previewRect, Font::Caption, Color::AccentText);
                if (m_mono) {
                    c.Fill(m_monoRect, Color::Control, f.F(4));
                    c.Stroke(m_monoRect, Color::ControlStroke, f.F(4));
                }
                c.Fill(m_footer, Black(0.18f));
                c.Line({m_footer.left, m_footer.top + 0.5f}, {m_footer.right, m_footer.top + 0.5f}, White(0.06f));
            },
            [&](HDC dc) {
                // The EDIT controls paint with GDI; the padding around them is filled the same way so
                // field and control are one surface.
                for (const auto& box : m_fieldRects) {
                    const RECT r{static_cast<LONG>(box.left + f.F(3)), static_cast<LONG>(box.top + f.F(3)),
                                 static_cast<LONG>(box.right - f.F(3)), static_cast<LONG>(box.bottom - f.F(3))};
                    FillRect(dc, &r, m_fieldBrush.get());
                }
                if (m_mono) {
                    const RECT r{static_cast<LONG>(m_monoRect.left + f.F(3)), static_cast<LONG>(m_monoRect.top + f.F(3)),
                                 static_cast<LONG>(m_monoRect.right - f.F(3)), static_cast<LONG>(m_monoRect.bottom - f.F(3))};
                    FillRect(dc, &r, m_fieldBrush.get());
                }
            });
    }

    void Finish(int button) {
        auto values = Values();
        if (button == 1 && m_spec.validate) {
            if (auto error = m_spec.validate(values)) {
                m_error = *error;
                InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
                return;
            }
        }
        m_result = {button, std::move(values)};
        m_done = true;
    }

    LRESULT Handle(UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
        switch (message) {
        case WM_CREATE:
            Build();
            return 0;
        case WM_ERASEBKGND:
            return 1;
        case WM_PAINT:
            PaintSurface();
            return 0;
        case WM_DPICHANGED:
            m_fonts.Create(HIWORD(wParam));
            Layout();
            InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, TRUE);
            return 0;
        case WM_CTLCOLOREDIT:
        case WM_CTLCOLORSTATIC: {
            HDC dc = reinterpret_cast<HDC>(wParam);
            SetTextColor(dc, ToColorRef(Color::Text));
            SetBkColor(dc, Graphics::Get().GdiSurface(Color::Control));
            return reinterpret_cast<LRESULT>(m_fieldBrush.get());
        }
        case WM_DRAWITEM: {
            const auto& dis = *reinterpret_cast<const DRAWITEMSTRUCT*>(lParam);
            if (auto it = m_looks.find(dis.hwndItem); it != m_looks.end()) DrawButton(dis, m_fonts, it->second);
            return TRUE;
        }
        case DM_GETDEFID:
            return MAKELRESULT(IDOK, DC_HASDEFID);
        case WM_COMMAND: {
            const int id = LOWORD(wParam), code = HIWORD(wParam);
            if (id >= kFieldBase && id < kFieldBase + 100) {
                if (code == EN_SETFOCUS || code == EN_KILLFOCUS) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
                if (code == EN_CHANGE) Revalidate();
                return 0;
            }
            if (id == IDOK) Finish(1);
            else if (id == IDCANCEL) Finish(m_spec.cancelButton ? 0 : 1);
            else if (id == kExtra) Finish(2);
            return 0;
        }
        case WM_CLOSE:
            Finish(m_spec.cancelButton ? 0 : 1);
            return 0;
        }
        return DefWindowProcW(m_hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
    }

    HWND m_owner;
    const DialogSpec& m_spec;
    HWND m_hwnd = nullptr;
    Fonts m_fonts;
    Gdi<HFONT> m_editFont, m_monoFont;
    Gdi<HBRUSH> m_fieldBrush;
    std::vector<HWND> m_edits, m_buttons;
    HWND m_mono = nullptr;
    std::unordered_map<HWND, ButtonLook> m_looks;
    D2D1_RECT_F m_headingRect{}, m_messageRect{}, m_monoRect{}, m_previewRect{}, m_footer{};
    std::vector<D2D1_RECT_F> m_fieldRects, m_labelRects;
    std::wstring m_error, m_previewText;
    DialogResult m_result;
    bool m_done = false;
};

}  // namespace

DialogResult RunDialog(HWND owner, const DialogSpec& spec) {
    Dialog dialog(owner, spec);
    return dialog.Run();
}

bool Confirm(HWND owner, std::wstring heading, std::wstring message, std::wstring ok, bool danger) {
    DialogSpec spec;
    spec.heading = std::move(heading);
    spec.message = std::move(message);
    spec.ok = std::move(ok);
    spec.danger = danger;
    return RunDialog(owner, spec).button == 1;
}

std::optional<std::wstring> PickFile(HWND owner, bool save, const std::vector<FileFilter>& filters, const std::wstring& fileName,
                                     const wchar_t* extension) {
    ComPtr<IFileDialog> dialog;
    if (FAILED(CoCreateInstance(save ? CLSID_FileSaveDialog : CLSID_FileOpenDialog, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER,
                                IID_PPV_ARGS(dialog.GetAddressOf())))) {
        return std::nullopt;
    }
    std::vector<COMDLG_FILTERSPEC> specs;
    for (const auto& f : filters) specs.push_back({f.name.c_str(), f.pattern.c_str()});
    if (!specs.empty()) dialog->SetFileTypes(static_cast<UINT>(specs.size()), specs.data());
    if (extension) dialog->SetDefaultExtension(extension);
    if (!fileName.empty()) dialog->SetFileName(fileName.c_str());
    DWORD options = 0;
    dialog->GetOptions(&options);
    dialog->SetOptions(options | FOS_FORCEFILESYSTEM | (save ? FOS_OVERWRITEPROMPT : FOS_FILEMUSTEXIST));
    if (FAILED(dialog->Show(owner))) return std::nullopt;
    ComPtr<IShellItem> item;
    if (FAILED(dialog->GetResult(item.GetAddressOf()))) return std::nullopt;
    PWSTR path = nullptr;
    if (FAILED(item->GetDisplayName(SIGDN_FILESYSPATH, &path)) || !path) return std::nullopt;
    std::wstring result(path);
    CoTaskMemFree(path);
    return result;
}

void Inform(HWND owner, std::wstring heading, std::wstring message, bool danger) {
    DialogSpec spec;
    spec.heading = std::move(heading);
    spec.message = std::move(message);
    spec.cancelButton = false;
    spec.danger = danger;
    RunDialog(owner, spec);
}

}  // namespace WS::Ui
```

`src/gui/Dialogs.h`:

```h
// WireScope - Modal dialogs in the same Mica style as the main window (instead of light MessageBox windows).
#pragma once
#include <Windows.h>
#include <functional>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace WS::Ui {

struct DialogField {
    std::wstring label;
    std::wstring value;
    std::wstring cue;      // placeholder text
    bool mono = false;     // monospace input (rules, filters)
};

struct DialogSpec {
    std::wstring heading;
    std::wstring message;    // wrapped paragraph, may be empty
    std::wstring monospace;  // scrollable read-only text block (help), may be empty
    int monospaceHeight = 220;  // DIP
    std::vector<DialogField> fields;
    std::wstring ok;           // empty = "OK" in the current language
    std::wstring cancel;       // empty = "Cancel" in the current language
    bool cancelButton = true;  // false: only OK (and the extra button)
    std::wstring extra;        // optional third button (result 2)
    bool danger = false;       // heading in the critical colour
    int width = 480;           // DIP
    // Called while typing and on OK: returns an error to show (OK stays) or nullopt.
    std::function<std::optional<std::wstring>(const std::vector<std::wstring>&)> validate;
    // Shown under the fields while the values are valid (e.g. what a rule means).
    std::function<std::wstring(const std::vector<std::wstring>&)> preview;
};

struct DialogResult {
    int button = 0;  // 0 = cancel / closed, 1 = ok, 2 = extra
    std::vector<std::wstring> values;
};

DialogResult RunDialog(HWND owner, const DialogSpec& spec);

bool Confirm(HWND owner, std::wstring heading, std::wstring message, std::wstring ok, bool danger = false);

// Windows file dialog (IFileOpenDialog / IFileSaveDialog). `extension` is the default for saving.
struct FileFilter {
    std::wstring name;
    std::wstring pattern;  // "*.pcap" or "*.rules;*.txt"
};
std::optional<std::wstring> PickFile(HWND owner, bool save, const std::vector<FileFilter>& filters, const std::wstring& fileName = {},
                                     const wchar_t* extension = nullptr);
void Inform(HWND owner, std::wstring heading, std::wstring message, bool danger = false);

}  // namespace WS::Ui
```

```cpp
// WireScope - Main window: creation, message loop and window procedure.
#include "gui/MainWindow.h"
#include "gui/MainWindowDetail.h"
#include "resources/resource.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include <CommCtrl.h>
#include <windowsx.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

#pragma comment(lib, "comctl32.lib")

namespace WS::Ui {
using namespace MainWindowDetail;

MainWindow::MainWindow(HINSTANCE instance)
    : m_instance(instance),
      m_bridge(std::make_shared<DriverBridge>()),
      m_ctl(std::make_unique<TrafficController>(m_bridge)) {
}

MainWindow::~MainWindow() {
    if (m_ctl) m_ctl->Shutdown();
}

bool MainWindow::Create(int showCommand) {
    Text::UseSaved();
    INITCOMMONCONTROLSEX icex{sizeof icex, ICC_STANDARD_CLASSES};
    InitCommonControlsEx(&icex);
    if (!Graphics::Get().Ready()) return false;

    WNDCLASSEXW wc{sizeof wc};
    wc.lpfnWndProc = Proc;
    wc.hInstance = m_instance;
    wc.hCursor = LoadCursorW(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
    wc.hbrBackground = static_cast<HBRUSH>(GetStockObject(BLACK_BRUSH));  // transparent on Mica
    wc.lpszClassName = kClassName;
    LoadIconWithScaleDown(m_instance, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDI_APP), GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXICON), GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYICON), m_icon.put());
    LoadIconWithScaleDown(m_instance, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(IDI_APP), GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSMICON), GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSMICON),
                          m_smallIcon.put());
    wc.hIcon = m_icon ? m_icon.get() : LoadIconW(nullptr, IDI_APPLICATION);
    wc.hIconSm = m_smallIcon.get();
    if (!RegisterClassExW(&wc)) return false;

    const std::wstring title = std::wstring(L"WireScope v ") + kAppVersion + L" - \u00A9 WESMAR Marek Weso\u0142owski - (2026)";
    m_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(0, kClassName, title.c_str(), WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW | WS_CLIPCHILDREN, CW_USEDEFAULT, CW_USEDEFAULT, 1280, 800,
                             nullptr, nullptr, m_instance, this);
    if (!m_hwnd) return false;
    RestorePlacement(showCommand);
    return true;
}

int MainWindow::Run() {
    MSG msg{};
    while (GetMessageW(&msg, nullptr, 0, 0) > 0) {
        if (m_accel && TranslateAcceleratorW(m_hwnd, m_accel.get(), &msg)) continue;
        if (IsDialogMessageW(m_hwnd, &msg)) continue;
        TranslateMessage(&msg);
        DispatchMessageW(&msg);
    }
    return static_cast<int>(msg.wParam);
}

LRESULT CALLBACK MainWindow::Proc(HWND hwnd, UINT msg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    MainWindow* self = nullptr;
    if (msg == WM_NCCREATE) {
        self = static_cast<MainWindow*>(reinterpret_cast<CREATESTRUCTW*>(lParam)->lpCreateParams);
        self->m_hwnd = hwnd;
        SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA, reinterpret_cast<LONG_PTR>(self));
    } else {
        self = reinterpret_cast<MainWindow*>(GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA));
    }
    if (msg == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA, 0);
        return DefWindowProcW(hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
    }
    return self ? self->Handle(msg, wParam, lParam) : DefWindowProcW(hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
}

void MainWindow::BuildAccelerators() {
    ACCEL keys[] = {
        {FVIRTKEY, VK_F5, static_cast<WORD>(CmdToggleCapture)},
        {FVIRTKEY | FSHIFT, VK_F5, static_cast<WORD>(CmdStop)},
        {FVIRTKEY | FCONTROL, 'L', static_cast<WORD>(CmdClear)},
        {FVIRTKEY | FCONTROL, 'S', static_cast<WORD>(CmdSave)},
        {FVIRTKEY | FCONTROL, 'F', static_cast<WORD>(CmdFocusFilter)},
        {FVIRTKEY | FCONTROL, '1', static_cast<WORD>(CmdPageCapture)},
        {FVIRTKEY | FCONTROL, '2', static_cast<WORD>(CmdPageProcesses)},
        {FVIRTKEY | FCONTROL, '3', static_cast<WORD>(CmdPageFirewall)},
        {FVIRTKEY | FCONTROL, '4', static_cast<WORD>(CmdPageSimulator)},
        {FVIRTKEY | FCONTROL, '5', static_cast<WORD>(CmdPageDriver)},
        {FVIRTKEY | FCONTROL, 'N', static_cast<WORD>(CmdFwAdd)},
        {FVIRTKEY | FCONTROL | FSHIFT, 'K', static_cast<WORD>(CmdKill)},
    };
    m_accel.reset(CreateAcceleratorTableW(keys, static_cast<int>(std::size(keys))));
}

void MainWindow::CreateFieldResources() {
    const auto& g = Graphics::Get();
    m_fieldBrush.reset(CreateSolidBrush(g.GdiSurface(Color::Control)));
    m_cardFieldBrush.reset(CreateSolidBrush(g.GdiSurface(Color::FieldOnCard)));
    m_editFont.reset(CreateFontW(-static_cast<int>(m_fonts.F(13.0f) + 0.5f), 0, 0, 0, FW_NORMAL, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, DEFAULT_CHARSET,
                                 OUT_DEFAULT_PRECIS, CLIP_DEFAULT_PRECIS, CLEARTYPE_QUALITY, DEFAULT_PITCH | FF_DONTCARE, m_fonts.UiFamily()));
    m_monoFont.reset(CreateFontW(-static_cast<int>(m_fonts.F(12.5f) + 0.5f), 0, 0, 0, FW_NORMAL, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, DEFAULT_CHARSET,
                                 OUT_DEFAULT_PRECIS, CLIP_DEFAULT_PRECIS, CLEARTYPE_QUALITY, FIXED_PITCH | FF_MODERN, m_fonts.MonoFamily()));
    if (m_filterEdit) SendMessageW(m_filterEdit, WM_SETFONT, reinterpret_cast<WPARAM>(m_editFont.get()), TRUE);
    if (m_matchEdit) SendMessageW(m_matchEdit, WM_SETFONT, reinterpret_cast<WPARAM>(m_monoFont.get()), TRUE);
}

void MainWindow::OnCreate() {
    ApplyBackdrop(m_hwnd);
    m_fonts.Create(GetDpiForWindow(m_hwnd));
    BuildAccelerators();

    // Creation order is the Tab order.
    for (const ButtonSpec& b : kButtons) {
        CreateButton(m_hwnd, static_cast<int>(b.id), b.text ? Text::Get(b.text).c_str() : L"");
        m_looks[b.id] = b.look;
        if (b.id == CmdSave) {
            m_filterEdit = CreateWindowExW(0, L"EDIT", L"", WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | WS_TABSTOP | ES_AUTOHSCROLL, 0, 0, 10, 10, m_hwnd,
                                           reinterpret_cast<HMENU>(static_cast<INT_PTR>(kIdFilter)), m_instance, nullptr);
            SendMessageW(m_filterEdit, EM_SETCUEBANNER, TRUE, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(Text::Get(IDS_FILTER_CUE).c_str()));
            m_list.Create(m_hwnd, kIdPackets);
            m_details.Create(m_hwnd, kIdDetails);
        } else if (b.id == CmdProcReset) {
            m_procList.Create(m_hwnd, kIdProcesses);
        } else if (b.id == CmdFwExport) {
            m_rules.Create(m_hwnd, kIdRules);
        } else if (b.id == CmdSimReset) {
            m_latency.Create(m_hwnd, kIdLatency, 0, 2000, 1, 2.0);
            m_jitter.Create(m_hwnd, kIdJitter, 0, 500, 1, 2.0);
            m_loss.Create(m_hwnd, kIdLoss, 0, 100, 0.1, 2.5);
            m_rate.Create(m_hwnd, kIdRate, 0, 1'000'000, 1, 3.0);  // kbit/s, 0 = unlimited
        } else if (b.id == CmdDirOut) {
            m_matchEdit = CreateWindowExW(0, L"EDIT", L"", WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | WS_TABSTOP | ES_AUTOHSCROLL, 0, 0, 10, 10, m_hwnd,
                                          reinterpret_cast<HMENU>(static_cast<INT_PTR>(kIdMatch)), m_instance, nullptr);
            SendMessageW(m_matchEdit, EM_SETCUEBANNER, TRUE, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(Text::Get(IDS_MATCH_CUE).c_str()));
            SendMessageW(m_matchEdit, EM_SETLIMITTEXT, 512, 0);
        }
    }
    SendMessageW(m_filterEdit, EM_SETLIMITTEXT, 256, 0);
    CreateFieldResources();
    m_list.SetPlaceholder(Text::Get(IDS_LIST_EMPTY));
    m_procList.SetPlaceholder(Text::Get(IDS_PROC_EMPTY));

    LoadSettings();
    SyncSimulatorControls();
    ConnectDriver();
    RestoreMonitor();
    RefreshRuleRows();
    ShowPage(m_page);
    UpdateControls();
    SetTimer(m_hwnd, kUiTimer, kUiTimerMs, nullptr);
}

LRESULT MainWindow::Handle(UINT msg, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    switch (msg) {
    case WM_CREATE:
        OnCreate();
        return 0;
    case WM_ERASEBKGND:
        return 1;
    case WM_PAINT:
        Paint();
        return 0;
    case WM_SIZE:
        if (wParam != SIZE_MINIMIZED) Layout();
        return 0;
    case WM_GETMINMAXINFO: {
        auto* info = reinterpret_cast<MINMAXINFO*>(lParam);
        RECT r{0, 0, MinClientWidth(), MinClientHeight()};
        AdjustWindowRectExForDpi(&r, WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, FALSE, 0, m_fonts.dpi());
        info->ptMinTrackSize = {r.right - r.left, r.bottom - r.top};
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_DPICHANGED: {
        m_fonts.Create(HIWORD(wParam));
        CreateFieldResources();
        m_list.Relayout();
        m_details.Relayout();
        m_rules.Relayout();
        m_procList.Relayout();
        const RECT* r = reinterpret_cast<const RECT*>(lParam);
        SetWindowPos(m_hwnd, nullptr, r->left, r->top, r->right - r->left, r->bottom - r->top, SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
        Layout();
        RedrawWindow(m_hwnd, nullptr, nullptr, RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_SETTINGCHANGE:
    case WM_THEMECHANGED:
    case WM_DWMCOMPOSITIONCHANGED:
        ApplyBackdrop(m_hwnd);
        CreateFieldResources();
        RedrawWindow(m_hwnd, nullptr, nullptr, RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
        return 0;
    case WM_MEASUREITEM: {
        auto& mis = *reinterpret_cast<MEASUREITEMSTRUCT*>(lParam);
        if (mis.CtlType == ODT_MENU) PopupMenu::Measure(mis);
        return TRUE;
    }
    case WM_DRAWITEM: {
        const auto& dis = *reinterpret_cast<const DRAWITEMSTRUCT*>(lParam);
        if (dis.CtlType == ODT_MENU) PopupMenu::Draw(dis);
        else if (auto it = m_looks.find(dis.CtlID); it != m_looks.end()) DrawButton(dis, m_fonts, it->second);
        return TRUE;
    }
    case WM_CTLCOLOREDIT: {
        HDC dc = reinterpret_cast<HDC>(wParam);
        const bool onCard = reinterpret_cast<HWND>(lParam) == m_matchEdit;
        SetTextColor(dc, ToColorRef(Color::Text));
        SetBkColor(dc, Graphics::Get().GdiSurface(onCard ? Color::FieldOnCard : Color::Control));
        return reinterpret_cast<LRESULT>(onCard ? m_cardFieldBrush.get() : m_fieldBrush.get());
    }
    case WM_COMMAND:
        OnCommand(LOWORD(wParam), HIWORD(wParam), reinterpret_cast<HWND>(lParam));
        return 0;
    case WM_CONTEXTMENU: {
        HWND target = reinterpret_cast<HWND>(wParam);
        POINT p{GET_X_LPARAM(lParam), GET_Y_LPARAM(lParam)};
        if (p.x == -1 && p.y == -1) {  // keyboard: near the focused control
            RECT r{};
            GetWindowRect(target, &r);
            p = {r.left + m_fonts.S(40), r.top + m_fonts.S(40)};
        }
        ShowContextMenu(target, p);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_TIMER:
        if (wParam == kUiTimer) OnTimer();
        return 0;
    case kDriverJobDone:
        OnDriverJobDone(lParam);
        return 0;
    case WM_SETCURSOR: {
        POINT p{};
        GetCursorPos(&p);
        ScreenToClient(m_hwnd, &p);
        const float x = static_cast<float>(p.x), y = static_cast<float>(p.y);
        if (m_page == Page::Capture && LOWORD(lParam) == HTCLIENT && x >= m_splitter.left && x < m_splitter.right && y >= m_splitter.top &&
            y < m_splitter.bottom) {
            SetCursor(LoadCursorW(nullptr, IDC_SIZENS));
            return TRUE;
        }
        break;
    }
    case WM_LBUTTONDOWN: {
        const float x = static_cast<float>(GET_X_LPARAM(lParam)), y = static_cast<float>(GET_Y_LPARAM(lParam));
        if (m_page == Page::Capture && x >= m_splitter.left && x < m_splitter.right && y >= m_splitter.top && y < m_splitter.bottom) {
            m_dragSplit = true;
            SetCapture(m_hwnd);
        }
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_MOUSEMOVE:
        if (m_dragSplit) {
            const float y = static_cast<float>(GET_Y_LPARAM(lParam));
            const float top = m_listCard.top, bottom = m_detailsCard.bottom;
            if (bottom - top > 1) m_split = std::clamp((y - top) / (bottom - top), 0.25f, 0.85f);
            Layout();
        }
        return 0;
    case WM_LBUTTONUP:
        if (m_dragSplit) {
            m_dragSplit = false;
            ReleaseCapture();
            Settings::WriteDword(L"Split", static_cast<DWORD>(std::lround(m_split * 1000)));
        }
        return 0;
    case WM_CAPTURECHANGED:
        m_dragSplit = false;
        return 0;
    case WM_CLOSE:
        if (m_drvDoing) {  // a driver change must not be cut in half
            SetStatus(Level::Warning, Text::Get(IDS_DRV_BUSY));
            return 0;
        }
        m_closing = true;
        SavePlacement();
        DestroyWindow(m_hwnd);
        return 0;
    case WM_DESTROY:
        KillTimer(m_hwnd, kUiTimer);
        if (m_ctl) m_ctl->Shutdown();  // restore the adapter mode and the driver table before exiting
        PostQuitMessage(0);
        return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(m_hwnd, msg, wParam, lParam);
}

}  // namespace WS::Ui
```

```h
    // Automatic undo
    Guarded m_guarded{Guarded::None};
    std::function<void()> m_undo;
    uint64_t m_revertAt{0};  // GetTickCount64 deadline, 0 = nothing pending

    // Status strip
    Level m_statusLevel{Level::Info};
    std::wstring m_statusText;
    uint64_t m_statusUntil{0};

    // Network driver
    DriverSetup::Status m_drvStatus;
    bool m_drvKnown{false};
    UINT m_drvDoing{0};       // string id of the running job, 0 = idle
    std::jthread m_drvThread;  // last member: joined before the rest is destroyed
};

}  // namespace WS::Ui

```

`src/gui/MainWindowCommands.cpp`:

```cpp
// WireScope - Main window: commands of the capture, firewall and simulator pages and the kill switch.
#include "gui/Dialogs.h"
#include "gui/MainWindow.h"
#include "gui/MainWindowDetail.h"
#include "core/Safety.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <format>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>

namespace WS::Ui {
using namespace MainWindowDetail;

namespace {

std::wstring EditText(HWND edit) {
    const int n = GetWindowTextLengthW(edit);
    std::wstring text(static_cast<size_t>(n) + 1, L'\0');
    GetWindowTextW(edit, text.data(), n + 1);
    text.resize(static_cast<size_t>(n));
    return text;
}

}  // namespace

void MainWindow::OnCommand(UINT id, UINT code, HWND /*control*/) {
    switch (id) {
    case CmdPageCapture: ShowPage(Page::Capture); return;
    case CmdPageProcesses: ShowPage(Page::Processes); return;
    case CmdPageDriver: ShowPage(Page::Driver); return;
    case CmdDrvInstall:
    case CmdDrvUninstall:
    case CmdDrvStart:
    case CmdDrvStop:
    case CmdDrvRefresh:
    case CmdDrvCopy: DriverAction(id); return;
    case CmdDrvStartType: ShowStartTypeMenu(); return;
    case CmdPageFirewall: ShowPage(Page::Firewall); return;
    case CmdPageSimulator: ShowPage(Page::Simulator); return;
    case CmdAdapter: ShowAdapterMenu(); return;
    case CmdKill: ToggleKillSwitch(); return;
    case CmdLanguage: ShowLanguageMenu(); return;
    case CmdAbout: ShowAbout(); return;
    case CmdElevate: RestartElevated(); return;
    case CmdKeepChanges: KeepChanges(); return;
    case CmdUndoChanges: UndoChanges(false); return;

    case CmdStart: SetCapture(true); return;
    case CmdStop: SetCapture(false); return;
    case CmdToggleCapture: SetCapture(!m_ctl->Capturing()); return;
    case CmdClear: ClearCapture(); return;
    case CmdSave: SavePcap(false); return;
    case CmdSaveSelected: SavePcap(true); return;
    case CmdSelectAll: m_list.SelectAll(); return;
    case CmdFocusFilter:
        if (m_page != Page::Capture) ShowPage(Page::Capture);
        SetFocus(m_filterEdit);
        SendMessageW(m_filterEdit, EM_SETSEL, 0, -1);
        return;
    case kIdFilter:
        if (code == EN_CHANGE) {
            m_filter = EditText(m_filterEdit);
            RebuildView();
        }
        if (code == EN_SETFOCUS || code == EN_KILLFOCUS || code == EN_CHANGE) InvalidateArea(m_filterBox);
        return;
    case kIdPackets:
        if (code == LBN_SELCHANGE) m_details.SetPacket(m_list.Selected(), m_baseTime);
        else if (code == PacketListCopy) CopySummaries();
        return;

    case CmdProcMonitor: ToggleMonitor(); return;
    case CmdProcReset: ResetProcessCounters(); return;
    case CmdProcBlock: BlockProcess(); return;
    case CmdProcLimit: LimitProcess(); return;
    case CmdProcImpair: ImpairProcess(); return;
    case CmdProcPackets: ShowProcessPackets(); return;
    case CmdProcFolder: OpenProcessFolder(); return;
    case CmdProcCopyPath: CopyProcessPath(); return;
    case kIdProcesses:
        if (code == LBN_SELCHANGE) {
            UpdateControls();
            InvalidateArea(m_procDetailsCard);
        } else if (code == LBN_DBLCLK) {
            ShowProcessPackets();
        }
        return;

    case CmdFwToggle: ToggleFirewall(); return;
    case CmdFwPolicy: ShowPolicyMenu(); return;
    case CmdFwAdd:
        if (m_page != Page::Firewall) ShowPage(Page::Firewall);
        AddRule();
        return;
    case CmdFwImport: ImportRules(); return;
    case CmdFwExport: ExportRules(); return;
    case CmdFwEdit: EditRule(); return;
    case CmdFwRemove: RemoveRule(); return;
    case CmdFwUp: MoveRule(-1); return;
    case CmdFwDown: MoveRule(1); return;
    case CmdFwOffload: ToggleOffload(); return;
    case kIdRules:
        switch (code) {
        case LBN_SELCHANGE: UpdateControls(); break;
        case LBN_DBLCLK: EditRule(); break;
        case RuleListToggle: ToggleRule(); break;
        case RuleListDelete: RemoveRule(); break;
        case RuleListMoveUp: MoveRule(-1); break;
        case RuleListMoveDown: MoveRule(1); break;
        }
        return;

    case CmdSimToggle: ToggleSimulator(); return;
    case CmdSimPreset: ShowPresetMenu(); return;
    case CmdSimReset: ResetSimulator(); return;
    case CmdDirBoth: SetDirection(Dir::Both); return;
    case CmdDirIn: SetDirection(Dir::In); return;
    case CmdDirOut: SetDirection(Dir::Out); return;
    case CmdSimOrder:
        m_profile.preserveOrder = !m_profile.preserveOrder;
        m_profileDirty = true;
        UpdateControls();
        return;
    case kIdLatency:
    case kIdJitter:
    case kIdLoss:
    case kIdRate:
        if (code == SliderChanged) {
            m_profile.latencyMs = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::lround(m_latency.Value()));
            m_profile.jitterMs = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::lround(m_jitter.Value()));
            m_profile.lossPercent = std::round(m_loss.Value() * 10.0) / 10.0;
            m_profile.rateKbps = RoundRate(m_rate.Value());
            m_profileDirty = true;  // applied by the UI timer, so a drag does not reconfigure on every pixel
            InvalidateArea(m_condCard);
        }
        return;
    case kIdMatch:
        if (code == EN_CHANGE) OnMatchChanged();
        if (code == EN_SETFOCUS || code == EN_KILLFOCUS) InvalidateArea(m_matchBox);
        return;
    case CmdRefreshAdapters: RefreshAdapters(); return;
    }
    if (id >= CmdAdapterFirst && id <= CmdAdapterLast) SelectAdapter(id - CmdAdapterFirst);
    else if (id >= CmdPresetFirst && id <= CmdPresetLast) ApplyPreset(id - CmdPresetFirst);
    else if (id >= CmdLanguageAuto && id <= CmdLanguageLast) SetLanguage(id);
    else if (id >= CmdDrvTypeFirst && id <= CmdDrvTypeLast) DriverAction(id);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Adapter, capture, kill switch
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void MainWindow::SelectAdapter(size_t index) {
    if (index >= m_adapters.size()) return;
    if (auto r = m_ctl->SetAdapter(m_adapters[index].Handle); !r) {
        Report(r, Text::Get(IDS_ERR_ADAPTER).c_str());
        return;
    }
    m_adapterIndex = index;
    const auto& a = m_adapters[index];
    Settings::Write(L"Adapter", ToWide(a.SystemName));
    SetWindowTextW(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdAdapter), std::format(L"{}  ·  {}", ToWide(a.FriendlyName), ToWide(a.MacAddress)).c_str());
    UpdateControls();
    InvalidateArea(m_status);
}

void MainWindow::SetCapture(bool on) {
    if (on == m_ctl->Capturing()) return;
    if (!Report(m_ctl->SetCapture(on), Text::Get(IDS_ERR_CAPTURE).c_str())) return;
    if (on) {
        if (m_list.Count() == 0) m_baseTime = 0;
        SetStatus(Level::Success, Text::Format(IDS_MSG_CAPTURE_ON, ToWide(m_adapters[m_adapterIndex].FriendlyName)));
        SetFocus(m_list.hwnd());
    } else {
        SetStatus(Level::Info, Text::Get(IDS_MSG_CAPTURE_OFF));
    }
}

void MainWindow::ClearCapture() {
    m_ctl->Engine().ClearPackets();
    m_clearGeneration = m_ctl->Engine().ClearGeneration();
    m_list.Clear();
    m_details.SetPacket(nullptr, 0);
    m_baseTime = 0;
    UpdateControls();
}

void MainWindow::SavePcap(bool selected) {
    // Selected packets go out in capture order whatever the list shows: pcap readers expect time order.
    const auto packets = selected ? m_list.Marked() : m_ctl->Engine().GetRecentPackets();
    if (packets.empty()) {
        SetStatus(Level::Warning, Text::Get(IDS_MSG_NOTHING_TO_SAVE));
        return;
    }
    const auto path = PickFile(m_hwnd, true, {{Text::Get(IDS_FILE_PCAP), L"*.pcap"}, {Text::Get(IDS_FILE_ALL), L"*.*"}},
                               selected ? L"selection.pcap" : L"capture.pcap", L"pcap");
    if (!path) return;
    PcapWriter writer;
    bool ok = writer.Open(*path);
    for (const auto& p : packets) ok = ok && writer.WritePacket(p->RawData, p->TimestampUs);
    writer.Close();
    if (ok) SetStatus(Level::Success, Text::Format(IDS_MSG_SAVED, FormatCount(packets.size()), *path));
    else Inform(m_hwnd, Text::Format(IDS_MSG_SAVE_FAILED, *path), FormatError(), true);
}

void MainWindow::ToggleKillSwitch() {
    // An emergency control: no question first. It cuts every connection, a remote session included,
    // so it is undone by itself unless the user keeps it.
    const bool on = !m_ctl->KillSwitch();
    const std::wstring adapter = m_adapters.empty() ? std::wstring() : ToWide(m_adapters[m_adapterIndex].FriendlyName);
    if (!Report(m_ctl->SetKillSwitch(on), Text::Get(IDS_ERR_KILL).c_str())) return;
    SetStatus(on ? Level::Warning : Level::Success, on ? Text::Format(IDS_MSG_KILL_ON, adapter) : Text::Get(IDS_MSG_KILL_OFF));
    if (on) {
        ArmRevert(Guarded::KillSwitch, [this] { (void)m_ctl->SetKillSwitch(false); });
    } else if (m_guarded == Guarded::KillSwitch) {
        KeepChanges();
    }
    Layout();  // the banner
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Automatic undo
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void MainWindow::ArmRevert(Guarded what, std::function<void()> undo) {
    m_guarded = what;
    m_undo = std::move(undo);
    m_revertAt = GetTickCount64() + kRevertSeconds * 1000ULL;
    Layout();
    SetFocus(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdKeepChanges));
}

void MainWindow::KeepChanges() {
    if (!m_revertAt) return;
    m_revertAt = 0;
    m_guarded = Guarded::None;
    m_undo = nullptr;
    SetStatus(Level::Success, Text::Get(IDS_MSG_KEPT));
    Layout();
}

void MainWindow::UndoChanges(bool automatic) {
    if (!m_revertAt) return;
    auto undo = std::move(m_undo);
    m_revertAt = 0;
    m_guarded = Guarded::None;
    m_undo = nullptr;
    if (undo) undo();
    if (automatic) SetStatus(Level::Warning, Text::Format(IDS_MSG_REVERTED, kRevertSeconds));
    RefreshRuleRows();
    UpdateControls();
    Layout();
}

bool MainWindow::ConfirmRisks(const std::vector<Rule>& rules, RuleAction policy) {
    const auto risks = LockoutRisks(rules, policy);
    if (risks.empty()) return true;
    return Confirm(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_DLG_RISK), Text::Format(IDS_DLG_RISK_MESSAGE, DescribeRisks(risks), kRevertSeconds),
                   Text::Get(IDS_DLG_RISK_OK), true);
}

void MainWindow::RestartElevated() {
    std::wstring self(MAX_PATH, L'\0');
    self.resize(GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, self.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(self.size())));
    SHELLEXECUTEINFOW info{sizeof info};
    info.lpVerb = L"runas";
    info.lpFile = self.c_str();
    info.nShow = SW_SHOWNORMAL;
    if (ShellExecuteExW(&info)) PostMessageW(m_hwnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
}

void MainWindow::CopySummaries() {
    // Every selected packet, one line each, in capture order; the focused one when nothing is marked.
    std::vector<PacketRef> packets = m_list.Marked();
    if (packets.empty() && m_list.Selected()) packets.push_back(m_list.Selected());
    std::wstring text;
    for (const PacketRef& p : packets) {
        if (!text.empty()) text += L"\r\n";
        text += std::format(L"#{}  {}  {}:{} -> {}:{}  {} B  {}", p->Index, ToWide(p->ProtocolName), ToWide(p->Source), p->SourcePort,
                            ToWide(p->Destination), p->DestPort, p->Length, ToWide(p->Info));
    }
    if (!text.empty()) CopyToClipboard(m_hwnd, text);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Firewall
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
bool MainWindow::PushRules(std::vector<Rule> rules) {
    // With the firewall on, a change that newly cuts DNS, HTTPS or Remote Desktop is confirmed and guarded.
    const bool guard = m_ctl->FirewallEnabled() && LockoutRisks(m_ruleSet, m_policy).empty() && !LockoutRisks(rules, m_policy).empty();
    if (guard && !ConfirmRisks(rules, m_policy)) return false;
    std::vector<Rule> previous = m_ruleSet;
    if (!Report(m_ctl->SetRules(std::move(rules)), Text::Get(IDS_ERR_FIREWALL).c_str())) return false;
    if (guard) {
        ArmRevert(Guarded::Firewall, [this, previous] {
            (void)m_ctl->SetRules(previous);
            m_ruleSet = m_ctl->Rules();
            SaveRules();
        });
    }
    m_ruleSet = m_ctl->Rules();  // with the ids the controller assigned
    SaveRules();
    RefreshRuleRows();
    UpdateControls();
    InvalidateArea(m_rulesCard);
    return true;
}

void MainWindow::ToggleFirewall() {
    const bool on = !m_ctl->FirewallEnabled();
    const bool risky = on && !LockoutRisks(m_ruleSet, m_policy).empty();
    if (risky && !ConfirmRisks(m_ruleSet, m_policy)) return;
    if (on && m_offload) {
        if (auto foreign = m_ctl->ForeignFilterCount(); foreign && *foreign > 0 &&
            !Confirm(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_DLG_FOREIGN), Text::Format(IDS_DLG_FOREIGN_MESSAGE, *foreign), Text::Get(IDS_CONTINUE))) {
            return;
        }
    }
    if (!Report(m_ctl->SetFirewall(on), Text::Get(IDS_ERR_FIREWALL).c_str())) return;
    if (risky) ArmRevert(Guarded::Firewall, [this] { (void)m_ctl->SetFirewall(false); });
    else if (!on && m_guarded == Guarded::Firewall) KeepChanges();
    SetStatus(on ? Level::Success : Level::Info,
              on ? Text::Format(IDS_MSG_FW_ON, m_ruleSet.size(), Text::Get(m_policy == RuleAction::Allow ? IDS_ALLOW : IDS_BLOCK))
                 : Text::Get(IDS_MSG_FW_OFF));
    RefreshRuleRows();
}

void MainWindow::SetPolicy(RuleAction policy) {
    const RuleAction previous = m_policy;
    const bool guard = m_ctl->FirewallEnabled() && LockoutRisks(m_ruleSet, previous).empty() && !LockoutRisks(m_ruleSet, policy).empty();
    if (guard && !ConfirmRisks(m_ruleSet, policy)) return;
    if (!Report(m_ctl->SetPolicy(policy), Text::Get(IDS_ERR_FIREWALL).c_str())) return;
    if (guard) {
        ArmRevert(Guarded::Firewall, [this, previous] {
            (void)m_ctl->SetPolicy(previous);
            m_policy = previous;
            SaveRules();
        });
    }
    m_policy = policy;
    SaveRules();
    RefreshRuleRows();
    UpdateControls();
}

std::optional<std::wstring> MainWindow::RuleDialog(const std::wstring& heading, const std::wstring& text, const std::wstring& ok) {
    DialogSpec spec;
    spec.heading = heading;
    spec.message = Text::Get(IDS_DLG_RULE_MESSAGE);
    spec.monospace = Text::Get(IDS_RULE_HELP);
    spec.width = 640;
    spec.fields.push_back({Text::Get(IDS_DLG_RULE_FIELD), text, L"block out tcp dport 443", true});
    spec.ok = ok;
    spec.validate = [](const std::vector<std::wstring>& v) -> std::optional<std::wstring> {
        if (v.empty() || v[0].empty()) return std::wstring();  // nothing typed yet: no message, OK disabled
        auto rule = ParseRule(ToUtf8(v[0]));
        if (!rule) return ToWide(rule.error());
        return std::nullopt;
    };
    spec.preview = [](const std::vector<std::wstring>& v) {
        auto rule = ParseRule(ToUtf8(v.empty() ? std::wstring() : v[0]));
        if (!rule) return std::wstring();
        return Text::Get(rule->action == RuleAction::Allow ? IDS_PILL_ALLOW : IDS_PILL_BLOCK) + L"  ·  " + ToWide(Summarize(rule->match));
    };
    const DialogResult result = RunDialog(m_hwnd, spec);
    if (result.button != 1 || result.values.empty()) return std::nullopt;
    return result.values[0];
}

bool MainWindow::AddRule(std::wstring initial) {
    const auto text = RuleDialog(Text::Get(IDS_DLG_ADD_RULE), initial, Text::Get(IDS_DLG_ADD));
    if (!text) return false;
    auto rule = ParseRule(ToUtf8(*text));
    if (!rule) return false;
    std::vector<Rule> rules = m_ruleSet;
    rules.push_back(std::move(*rule));
    if (!PushRules(std::move(rules))) return false;
    m_rules.Select(static_cast<int>(m_ruleSet.size()) - 1);
    SetStatus(Level::Success, Text::Format(IDS_MSG_RULE_ADDED, ToWide(RuleText(m_ruleSet.back()))));
    return true;
}

void MainWindow::EditRule() {
    const int index = m_rules.Selected();
    if (index < 0 || index >= static_cast<int>(m_ruleSet.size())) return;
    const Rule& current = m_ruleSet[static_cast<size_t>(index)];
    const auto text = RuleDialog(Text::Get(IDS_DLG_EDIT_RULE), ToWide(RuleText(current)), Text::Get(IDS_DLG_SAVE));
    if (!text) return;
    auto rule = ParseRule(ToUtf8(*text));
    if (!rule) return;
    rule->id = current.id;
    rule->enabled = current.enabled;
    std::vector<Rule> rules = m_ruleSet;
    rules[static_cast<size_t>(index)] = std::move(*rule);
    PushRules(std::move(rules));
}

void MainWindow::RemoveRule() {
    const int index = m_rules.Selected();
    if (index < 0 || index >= static_cast<int>(m_ruleSet.size())) return;
    std::vector<Rule> rules = m_ruleSet;
    rules.erase(rules.begin() + index);
    if (PushRules(std::move(rules)) && !m_ruleSet.empty()) m_rules.Select(std::min(index, static_cast<int>(m_ruleSet.size()) - 1));
}

void MainWindow::MoveRule(int delta) {
    const int index = m_rules.Selected(), target = index + delta;
    if (index < 0 || target < 0 || target >= static_cast<int>(m_ruleSet.size())) return;
    std::vector<Rule> rules = m_ruleSet;
    std::swap(rules[static_cast<size_t>(index)], rules[static_cast<size_t>(target)]);
    if (PushRules(std::move(rules))) m_rules.Select(target);
}

void MainWindow::ToggleRule() {
    const int index = m_rules.Selected();
    if (index < 0 || index >= static_cast<int>(m_ruleSet.size())) return;
    std::vector<Rule> rules = m_ruleSet;
    rules[static_cast<size_t>(index)].enabled = !rules[static_cast<size_t>(index)].enabled;
    PushRules(std::move(rules));
}

void MainWindow::ImportRules() {
    const auto path = PickFile(m_hwnd, false, {{Text::Get(IDS_FILE_RULES), L"*.rules;*.txt"}, {Text::Get(IDS_FILE_ALL), L"*.*"}});
    if (!path) return;
    std::ifstream in(*path, std::ios::binary);
    std::stringstream buffer;
    buffer << in.rdbuf();
    std::string text = buffer.str();
    if (text.starts_with("\xEF\xBB\xBF")) text.erase(0, 3);
    auto parsed = ParseRulesText(text);
    if (!in || !parsed) {
        const std::wstring detail = parsed ? FormatError() : Text::Format(IDS_MSG_FILE_LINE, *path, parsed.error().line, ToWide(parsed.error().message));
        Inform(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_ERR_RULES_FILE), detail, true);
        return;
    }
    std::vector<Rule> rules = std::move(*parsed);
    if (!m_ruleSet.empty()) {
        DialogSpec spec;
        spec.heading = Text::Get(IDS_DLG_IMPORT);
        spec.message = Text::Format(IDS_DLG_IMPORT_MESSAGE, *path, rules.size(), m_ruleSet.size());
        spec.ok = Text::Get(IDS_DLG_REPLACE);
        spec.extra = Text::Get(IDS_DLG_APPEND);
        const int button = RunDialog(m_hwnd, spec).button;
        if (button == 0) return;
        if (button == 2) {
            std::vector<Rule> merged = m_ruleSet;
            merged.insert(merged.end(), rules.begin(), rules.end());
            rules = std::move(merged);
        }
    }
    const size_t count = rules.size();
    if (PushRules(std::move(rules))) SetStatus(Level::Success, Text::Format(IDS_MSG_IMPORTED, count, *path));
}

void MainWindow::ExportRules() {
    const auto path = PickFile(m_hwnd, true, {{Text::Get(IDS_FILE_RULES), L"*.rules;*.txt"}}, L"wirescope.rules", L"rules");
    if (!path) return;
    std::ofstream out(*path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
    out << FormatRulesText(m_ruleSet);
    if (out) SetStatus(Level::Success, Text::Format(IDS_MSG_EXPORTED, m_ruleSet.size(), *path));
    else Inform(m_hwnd, Text::Format(IDS_MSG_SAVE_FAILED, *path), FormatError(), true);
}

void MainWindow::ToggleOffload() {
    const bool on = !m_offload;
    if (!Report(m_ctl->SetKernelOffload(on), Text::Get(IDS_ERR_FIREWALL).c_str())) return;
    m_offload = on;
    SaveRules();
    UpdateControls();
    InvalidateArea(m_rulesCard);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Simulator
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void MainWindow::ApplyProfile() {
    m_profileDirty = false;
    SaveSimulator();
    if (auto r = m_ctl->SetImpairment(m_profile); !r) {
        m_profile.enabled = m_ctl->Impairment().enabled;
        Report(r, Text::Get(IDS_ERR_SIMULATOR).c_str());
    }
}

void MainWindow::ToggleSimulator() {
    m_profile.enabled = !m_ctl->Impairment().enabled;
    ApplyProfile();
    const bool on = m_ctl->Impairment().enabled;
    if (on == m_profile.enabled) {
        SetStatus(on ? Level::Success : Level::Info,
                  on ? Text::Format(IDS_MSG_SIM_ON, m_profile.latencyMs, m_profile.jitterMs, m_profile.lossPercent) : Text::Get(IDS_MSG_SIM_OFF));
    }
    m_delayHistory.clear();
    m_dropHistory.clear();
    m_lastSampleUs = 0;
    UpdateControls();
    InvalidateArea(m_liveCard);
}

void MainWindow::ApplyPreset(size_t index) {
    const auto presets = ImpairmentPresets();
    if (index >= presets.size()) return;
    const ImpairmentPreset& p = presets[index];
    m_profile.latencyMs = p.latencyMs;
    m_profile.jitterMs = p.jitterMs;
    m_profile.lossPercent = p.lossPercent;
    m_profile.rateKbps = p.rateKbps;
    SyncSimulatorControls();
    m_profileDirty = true;
    SetStatus(Level::Info, Text::Get(p.name));
}

void MainWindow::ResetSimulator() {
    m_profile.latencyMs = 0;
    m_profile.jitterMs = 0;
    m_profile.lossPercent = 0;
    m_profile.rateKbps = 0;
    m_profile.dir = Dir::Both;
    m_profile.preserveOrder = true;
    m_profile.match.clear();
    SyncSimulatorControls();
    m_profileDirty = true;
    UpdateControls();
}

void MainWindow::SetDirection(Dir dir) {
    m_profile.dir = dir;
    m_profileDirty = true;
    UpdateControls();
}

void MainWindow::OnMatchChanged() {
    const std::string text = ToUtf8(EditText(m_matchEdit));
    if (auto selector = ParseSelector(text); !selector) {
        m_matchError = ToWide(selector.error());
    } else {
        m_matchError.clear();
        if (text != m_profile.match) {
            m_profile.match = text;
            m_profileDirty = true;
        }
    }
    InvalidateArea(m_condCard);
    UpdateControls();
}

}  // namespace WS::Ui
```

`src/gui/MainWindowDetail.h`:

```h
// WireScope - Internal to the MainWindow*.cpp files: command identifiers, layout constants, buttons.
#pragma once
#include "gui/Widgets.h"
#include "resources/resource.h"
#include "support/Language.h"

#include <cmath>
#include <string>
#include <Windows.h>

namespace WS::Ui::MainWindowDetail {

inline constexpr wchar_t kClassName[] = L"WireScope.MainWindow";
inline constexpr wchar_t kAppVersion[] = L"2.0";
inline constexpr wchar_t kCopyright[] = L"\u00A9 2026 Marek Weso\u0142owski - wesmar";

inline constexpr int kIdFilter = 2000, kIdPackets = 2001, kIdDetails = 2002, kIdRules = 2003, kIdLatency = 2004, kIdJitter = 2005,

// Bandwidth limit as people read it: "unlimited", "384 kbit/s", "20.0 Mbit/s".
inline std::wstring RateText(uint32_t kbps) {
    if (kbps == 0) return Text::Get(IDS_VALUE_UNLIMITED);
    if (kbps < 1000) return Text::Format(IDS_VALUE_KBPS, kbps);
    return Text::Format(IDS_VALUE_MBPS, static_cast<double>(kbps) / 1000.0);
}

// Slider position to a bandwidth that reads well: coarser steps the faster the link.
inline uint32_t RoundRate(double kbps) {
    const double step = kbps < 100 ? 1 : kbps < 1000 ? 8 : kbps < 10000 ? 100 : kbps < 100000 ? 1000 : 10000;
    return static_cast<uint32_t>(std::max(0.0, std::round(kbps / step) * step));
}

inline constexpr float kNavItemH = 40, kCardHeaderH = 40, kRowH = 46;
```

`src/gui/MainWindowDriver.cpp`:

```cpp
// WireScope - Main window: the Network driver page. Install, remove, start, stop and the start type of
// wsddntf, with an engineering report of its state (core/DriverSetup.h does the work). Every action
// runs on a worker thread; WireScope lets go of the driver first and opens it again afterwards.
#include "core/DriverSetup.h"
#include "gui/Dialogs.h"
#include "gui/MainWindow.h"
#include "gui/MainWindowDetail.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <format>

namespace WS::Ui {
using namespace MainWindowDetail;

namespace {

namespace DS = DriverSetup;

UINT ShortTypeName(DS::StartType type) {
    switch (type) {
    case DS::StartType::Boot: return IDS_DRV_SHORT_BOOT;
    case DS::StartType::System: return IDS_DRV_SHORT_SYSTEM;
    case DS::StartType::Automatic: return IDS_DRV_SHORT_AUTO;
    case DS::StartType::Manual: return IDS_DRV_SHORT_MANUAL;
    case DS::StartType::Disabled: return IDS_DRV_SHORT_DISABLED;
    }
    return IDS_DRV_SHORT_SYSTEM;
}

std::wstring RemoteNote() {
    return GetSystemMetrics(SM_REMOTESESSION) ? Text::Get(IDS_DLG_DRV_REMOTE) : std::wstring();
}

}  // namespace

// What the worker hands back to the window (WM_APP message, owned by the receiver).
struct MainWindow::DriverJobResult {
    std::wstring done;  // empty = only the state was read
    std::expected<DS::Outcome, std::wstring> outcome;
    DS::Status status;
};

void MainWindow::RefreshDriver() {
    RunDriverJob(IDS_DRV_STATE_READING, {}, nullptr, false);
}

void MainWindow::RunDriverJob(UINT doing, std::wstring done, std::function<std::expected<DS::Outcome, std::wstring>()> work, bool release) {
    if (m_drvDoing) {
        SetStatus(Level::Warning, Text::Get(IDS_DRV_BUSY));
        return;
    }
    if (release) ReleaseDriver();
    m_drvDoing = doing;
    if (work) SetStatus(Level::Info, Text::Get(doing));
    UpdateControls();
    InvalidateArea(m_drvCard);
    if (m_drvThread.joinable()) m_drvThread.join();
    const bool inUse = m_bridge->IsConnected();
    const HWND window = m_hwnd;
    m_drvThread = std::jthread([window, inUse, done = std::move(done), work = std::move(work)] {
        auto result = std::make_unique<DriverJobResult>();
        result->done = done;
        if (work) result->outcome = work();
        result->status = DS::Query(inUse);
        if (PostMessageW(window, kDriverJobDone, 0, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(result.get()))) result.release();
    });
}

void MainWindow::OnDriverJobDone(LPARAM lParam) {
    const std::unique_ptr<DriverJobResult> result(reinterpret_cast<DriverJobResult*>(lParam));
    if (m_drvThread.joinable()) m_drvThread.join();
    m_drvDoing = 0;
    m_drvStatus = std::move(result->status);
    m_drvKnown = true;
    if (!result->done.empty()) {
        if (!result->outcome) {
            SetStatus(Level::Error, result->outcome.error());
            Inform(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_NAV_DRIVER), result->outcome.error(), true);
        } else {
            std::wstring text = result->done;
            for (const auto& note : result->outcome->notes) text += L"  ·  " + note;
            SetStatus(result->outcome->reboot ? Level::Warning : Level::Success, text);
            if (result->outcome->reboot) Inform(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_NAV_DRIVER), Text::Get(IDS_DRV_REBOOT));
        }
        // Take the driver again if it answers, as at start-up.
        if (!m_bridge->IsConnected() && m_drvStatus.deviceOpens) {
            ConnectDriver();
            RestoreMonitor();
        }
    }
    UpdateControls();
    Layout();
}

void MainWindow::ReleaseDriver() {
    // Everything off first: the adapter mode and the filter table go back to how they were found.
    m_revertAt = 0;
    m_guarded = Guarded::None;
    m_undo = nullptr;
    m_ctl->Shutdown();
    m_bridge->Disconnect();
    m_driverOk = false;
    m_adapters.clear();
    m_adapterIndex = 0;
    m_driverText = Text::Get(IDS_DRV_BUSY);
    m_list.SetPlaceholder(m_driverText);
    Layout();
}

void MainWindow::RestoreMonitor() {
    // Counting per program only reads copies of packets, so the saved choice comes back by itself.
    if (!m_driverOk || m_adapters.empty() || !Settings::ReadDword(L"ProcessMonitor", 0)) return;
    if (auto r = m_ctl->SetMonitor(true); !r) SetStatus(Level::Warning, r.error());
}

void MainWindow::DriverAction(UINT command) {
    if (m_drvDoing) {
        SetStatus(Level::Warning, Text::Get(IDS_DRV_BUSY));
        return;
    }
    switch (command) {
    case CmdDrvInstall: {
        const auto inf = DS::FindPackage();
        if (!inf) {
            Inform(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_NAV_DRIVER), Text::Get(IDS_DRV_NO_PACKAGE_FOLDER), true);
            return;
        }
        if (!Confirm(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_DLG_DRV_INSTALL), Text::Format(IDS_DLG_DRV_INSTALL_MESSAGE, *inf) + RemoteNote(),
                     Text::Get(IDS_DRV_INSTALL))) {
            return;
        }
        RunDriverJob(IDS_DRV_DOING_INSTALL, Text::Get(IDS_DRV_DONE_INSTALL), [inf] { return DS::Install(*inf); }, true);
        return;
    }
    case CmdDrvUninstall:
        if (!Confirm(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_DLG_DRV_UNINSTALL), Text::Get(IDS_DLG_DRV_UNINSTALL_MESSAGE) + RemoteNote(), Text::Get(IDS_DRV_UNINSTALL),
                     true)) {
            return;
        }
        RunDriverJob(IDS_DRV_DOING_UNINSTALL, Text::Get(IDS_DRV_DONE_UNINSTALL), [] { return DS::Uninstall(); }, true);
        return;
    case CmdDrvStart:
        if (!Confirm(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_DLG_DRV_START), Text::Get(IDS_DLG_DRV_START_MESSAGE) + RemoteNote(), Text::Get(IDS_DRV_START))) return;
        RunDriverJob(IDS_DRV_DOING_START, Text::Get(IDS_DRV_DONE_START), [] { return DS::Start(); }, true);
        return;
    case CmdDrvStop:
        if (!Confirm(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_DLG_DRV_CHANGE), Text::Get(IDS_DLG_DRV_STOP_MESSAGE) + RemoteNote(), Text::Get(IDS_DRV_STOP), true)) return;
        RunDriverJob(IDS_DRV_DOING_STOP, Text::Get(IDS_DRV_DONE_STOP), [] { return DS::Stop(); }, true);
        return;
    case CmdDrvRefresh:
        RefreshDriver();
        return;
    case CmdDrvCopy: {
        std::wstring text;
        for (const auto& [label, value] : DS::Report(m_drvStatus)) text += std::format(L"{:<14}{}\r\n", label, value);
        CopyToClipboard(m_hwnd, text);
        return;
    }
    default:
        break;
    }
    if (command >= CmdDrvTypeFirst && command <= CmdDrvTypeLast) {
        const auto type = static_cast<DS::StartType>(static_cast<DWORD>(DS::StartType::System) + (command - CmdDrvTypeFirst));
        const bool disabled = type == DS::StartType::Disabled;
        if (disabled && !Confirm(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_DLG_DRV_DISABLE), Text::Get(IDS_DLG_DRV_DISABLED_MESSAGE) + RemoteNote(),
                                 Text::Get(IDS_DRV_SHORT_DISABLED), true)) {
            return;
        }
        RunDriverJob(IDS_DRV_DOING_TYPE, Text::Format(IDS_DRV_DONE_TYPE, Text::Get(ShortTypeName(type))), [type] { return DS::SetStartType(type); },
                     disabled);
    }
}

void MainWindow::ShowStartTypeMenu() {
    PopupMenu menu;
    menu.AddHeader(Text::Get(IDS_DRV_TYPE_HEADER));
    const UINT names[] = {IDS_DRV_TYPE_SYSTEM, IDS_DRV_TYPE_AUTO, IDS_DRV_TYPE_MANUAL, IDS_DRV_TYPE_DISABLED};
    for (UINT i = 0; i < std::size(names); ++i) {
        const auto type = static_cast<DS::StartType>(static_cast<DWORD>(DS::StartType::System) + i);
        menu.AddItem(CmdDrvTypeFirst + i, Text::Get(names[i]), {}, m_drvStatus.service && m_drvStatus.startType == type, true);
    }
    RECT r{};
    GetWindowRect(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdDrvStartType), &r);
    if (const UINT cmd = menu.Track(m_hwnd, m_fonts, {r.left, r.bottom + m_fonts.S(2)}, &r)) DriverAction(cmd);
}

void MainWindow::UpdateDriverControls() {
    const DS::Status& s = m_drvStatus;
    const bool idle = m_drvDoing == 0, known = m_drvKnown, admin = IsElevated();
    const bool can = idle && known && admin;
    auto enable = [&](UINT id, bool on) {
        HWND b = GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, static_cast<int>(id));
        if ((IsWindowEnabled(b) != FALSE) == on) return;
        if (!on && GetFocus() == b) SendMessageW(m_hwnd, WM_NEXTDLGCTL, 0, FALSE);
        EnableWindow(b, on);
    };
    enable(CmdDrvInstall, can && !s.installed && s.package.has_value());
    enable(CmdDrvUninstall, can && (s.installed || s.service || !s.staged.empty()));
    enable(CmdDrvStart, can && s.installed && s.startType != DS::StartType::Disabled && !(s.Running() && s.Attached() && s.deviceOpens));
    enable(CmdDrvStop, can && s.installed && (s.Running() || s.Attached()));
    enable(CmdDrvStartType, can && s.service);
    enable(CmdDrvRefresh, idle);
    enable(CmdDrvCopy, known);
    const std::wstring type = s.service ? Text::Format(IDS_DRV_START_TYPE, Text::Get(ShortTypeName(s.startType))) : Text::Format(IDS_DRV_START_TYPE, L"—");
    HWND combo = GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdDrvStartType);
    wchar_t current[128]{};
    GetWindowTextW(combo, current, static_cast<int>(std::size(current)));
    if (type != current) SetWindowTextW(combo, type.c_str());
}

void MainWindow::PaintDriver(Canvas& c) {
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    const DS::Status& s = m_drvStatus;
    const auto [state, dot] = [&]() -> std::pair<UINT, D2D1_COLOR_F> {
        if (m_drvDoing) return {m_drvDoing, Color::AccentText};
        if (!m_drvKnown) return {IDS_DRV_STATE_READING, Color::Text3};
        if (!s.installed) return {IDS_DRV_STATE_NONE, Color::Text3};
        if (!s.Running()) return s.Attached() ? std::pair{IDS_DRV_STATE_HOLDING, Color::Critical} : std::pair{IDS_DRV_STATE_STOPPED, Color::Text3};
        if (!s.Attached()) return {IDS_DRV_STATE_DETACHED, Color::Caution};
        if (!s.deviceOpens) return {IDS_DRV_STATE_SILENT, Color::Caution};
        return {IDS_DRV_STATE_OK, Color::Success};
    }();
    PaintCard(c, m_drvCard, Text::Get(IDS_CARD_DRIVER));
    const std::wstring note = Text::Get(state);
    const float noteW = c.Width(note, Font::Caption) + 1;
    const float headMid = m_drvCard.top + f.F(kCardHeaderH) / 2;
    const float noteRight = m_drvCard.right - f.F(kPad);
    c.Text(note, {noteRight - noteW, m_drvCard.top, noteRight, m_drvCard.top + f.F(kCardHeaderH)}, Font::Caption, Color::Text2, Align::Right);
    c.Circle({noteRight - noteW - f.F(10), headMid}, f.F(4), dot);
    if (!m_drvKnown) return;

    // The report in two columns; a section starts with an unindented label.
    const float x0 = m_drvCard.left + f.F(kPad), labelW = f.F(150), right = m_drvCard.right - f.F(kPad);
    const float lineH = f.F(23), bottom = m_drvCard.bottom - f.F(kPad);
    float y = m_drvCard.top + f.F(kCardHeaderH);
    bool first = true;
    for (const auto& [label, value] : DS::Report(s)) {
        const bool section = !label.starts_with(L" ");
        if (section && !first) y += f.F(6);
        first = false;
        if (y + lineH > bottom) break;
        const std::wstring_view name = section ? std::wstring_view(label) : std::wstring_view(label).substr(label.find_first_not_of(L' '));
        c.Text(name, {x0 + (section ? 0 : f.F(14)), y, x0 + labelW, y + lineH}, section ? Font::Strong : Font::Caption, section ? Color::Text : Color::Text3);
        c.Text(value, {x0 + labelW, y, right, y + lineH}, Font::Mono, section ? Color::Text : Color::Text2);
        y += lineH;
    }
}

}  // namespace WS::Ui
```
