`src/gui/MainWindowLayout.cpp`:

```cpp
// WireScope - Main window: layout, window placement and painting.
#include "gui/MainWindow.h"
#include "gui/MainWindowDetail.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <format>

namespace WS::Ui {
using namespace MainWindowDetail;

namespace {

void Place(HWND hwnd, const D2D1_RECT_F& r) {
    SetWindowPos(hwnd, nullptr, static_cast<int>(std::lround(r.left)), static_cast<int>(std::lround(r.top)),
                 static_cast<int>(std::lround(r.right - r.left)), static_cast<int>(std::lround(r.bottom - r.top)),
                 SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
}

}  // namespace

int MainWindow::MinClientWidth() const { return m_fonts.S(900); }
int MainWindow::MinClientHeight() const { return m_fonts.S(600); }

void MainWindow::Layout() {
    if (!m_list.hwnd()) return;
    RECT rc{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &rc);
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    const float W = static_cast<float>(rc.right), H = static_cast<float>(rc.bottom);
    const float m = f.F(kMargin), gap = f.F(kGap), pad = f.F(kPad), cmdH = f.F(kCmdH);
    auto item = [&](UINT id) { return GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, static_cast<int>(id)); };

    // Frame: header, navigation rail, content, status strip.
    m_header = {0, 0, W, f.F(kHeaderH)};
    m_status = {0, H - f.F(kStatusH), W, H};
    m_nav = {f.F(8), m_header.bottom, f.F(8) + f.F(kNavW), m_status.top - f.F(8)};
    m_content = {m_nav.right + f.F(12), m_header.bottom, W - m, m_status.top - f.F(8)};
    const float comboW = std::clamp(W * 0.32f, f.F(240), f.F(400));
    Place(item(CmdAdapter), {W - m - comboW, (m_header.bottom - cmdH) / 2, W - m, (m_header.bottom + cmdH) / 2});

    float y = m_nav.top + f.F(4);
    for (UINT id : {CmdPageCapture, CmdPageProcesses, CmdPageFirewall, CmdPageSimulator, CmdPageDriver}) {
        Place(item(id), {m_nav.left, y, m_nav.right, y + f.F(kNavItemH)});
        y += f.F(kNavItemH) + f.F(2);
    }
    float by = m_nav.bottom - f.F(kNavItemH);
    Place(item(CmdAbout), {m_nav.left, by, m_nav.right, by + f.F(kNavItemH)});
    by -= f.F(kNavItemH) + f.F(2);
    Place(item(CmdLanguage), {m_nav.left, by, m_nav.right, by + f.F(kNavItemH)});
    by -= f.F(16) + f.F(44);
    Place(item(CmdKill), {m_nav.left + f.F(4), by, m_nav.right - f.F(4), by + f.F(44)});

    float top = m_content.top;
    const bool pending = m_revertAt != 0;
    if (m_ctl->KillSwitch() || pending) {
        m_banner = {m_content.left, top, m_content.right, top + f.F(44)};
        top = m_banner.bottom + gap;
    } else {
        m_banner = {};
    }
    // Keep / Undo sit on the banner while a change waits for confirmation.
    const float bh = f.F(30), bmid = (m_banner.top + m_banner.bottom) / 2;
    Place(item(CmdUndoChanges), {m_banner.right - f.F(12) - f.F(140), bmid - bh / 2, m_banner.right - f.F(12), bmid + bh / 2});
    Place(item(CmdKeepChanges), {m_banner.right - f.F(20) - f.F(260), bmid - bh / 2, m_banner.right - f.F(20) - f.F(140), bmid + bh / 2});
    for (UINT id : {CmdKeepChanges, CmdUndoChanges}) ShowWindow(item(id), pending ? SW_SHOWNA : SW_HIDE);
    const float L = m_content.left, R = m_content.right, B = m_content.bottom;
    const float cmdBottom = top + cmdH;
    const int lineH = f.S(19);
    auto row = [&](float x, std::initializer_list<std::pair<UINT, int>> buttons) {  // widths in DIP
        for (const auto& [id, width] : buttons) {
            const float w = f.F(static_cast<float>(width));
            Place(item(id), {x, top, x + w, cmdBottom});
            x += w + f.F(8);
        }
        return x;
    };
    auto placeEdit = [&](HWND edit, const D2D1_RECT_F& box) {
        const float mid = (box.top + box.bottom) / 2;
        Place(edit, {box.left + f.F(10), mid - static_cast<float>(lineH) / 2, box.right - f.F(10), mid + static_cast<float>(lineH) / 2});
    };

    // Capture: commands, filter, packet list, splitter, details.
    {
        const float x = row(L, {{CmdStart, 130}, {CmdStop, 110}, {CmdClear, 110}, {CmdSave, 130}});
        Place(item(CmdElevate), {L, top, L + f.F(250), cmdBottom});
        const float fx = std::max(x + f.F(22), R - f.F(400));
        m_filterBox = {fx, top, R, cmdBottom};
        placeEdit(m_filterEdit, m_filterBox);
        const float listTop = cmdBottom + gap;
        const float avail = std::max(f.F(160), B - listTop - gap);
        const float listH = std::round(avail * m_split);
        m_listCard = {L, listTop, R, listTop + listH};
        m_splitter = {L, m_listCard.bottom, R, m_listCard.bottom + gap};
        m_detailsCard = {L, m_splitter.bottom, R, B};
        Place(m_list.hwnd(), Inset(m_listCard, f.F(2), f.F(2)));
        Place(m_details.hwnd(), Inset(m_detailsCard, f.F(2), f.F(2)));
    }

    // Processes: counting switch and reset, the program list, details with the actions at the bottom.
    {
        const float x = row(L, {{CmdProcMonitor, 250}, {CmdProcReset, 160}});
        m_procSummary = {x + f.F(16), top, R, cmdBottom};
        const float below = B - cmdBottom - gap;
        const float detailsH = std::clamp(std::round(below * 0.4f), f.F(236), f.F(300));
        m_procCard = {L, cmdBottom + gap, R, B - detailsH - gap};
        m_procDetailsCard = {L, m_procCard.bottom + gap, R, B};
        Place(m_procList.hwnd(), {m_procCard.left + f.F(2), m_procCard.top + f.F(kCardHeaderH), m_procCard.right - f.F(2),
                                  m_procCard.bottom - f.F(2)});
        const float ay = m_procDetailsCard.bottom - pad - cmdH;
        float ax = m_procDetailsCard.left + pad;
        for (const auto& [id, width] : {std::pair{CmdProcBlock, 130.0f}, std::pair{CmdProcLimit, 170.0f}, std::pair{CmdProcImpair, 130.0f},
                                        std::pair{CmdProcPackets, 160.0f}, std::pair{CmdProcFolder, 150.0f}}) {
            Place(item(id), {ax, ay, ax + f.F(width), ay + cmdH});
            ax += f.F(width) + f.F(8);
        }
        m_procDetailsBody = {m_procDetailsCard.left + pad, m_procDetailsCard.top + f.F(14), m_procDetailsCard.right - pad, ay - f.F(12)};
    }

    // Network driver: actions on top, the report, start type, refresh and copy below.
    {
        row(L, {{CmdDrvInstall, 140}, {CmdDrvUninstall, 150}, {CmdDrvStart, 130}, {CmdDrvStop, 140}});
        const float bottomTop = B - cmdH;
        m_drvCard = {L, cmdBottom + gap, R, bottomTop - gap};
        float bx = L;
        for (const auto& [id, width] : {std::pair{CmdDrvStartType, 260.0f}, std::pair{CmdDrvRefresh, 130.0f}, std::pair{CmdDrvCopy, 160.0f}}) {
            Place(item(id), {bx, bottomTop, bx + f.F(width), B});
            bx += f.F(width) + f.F(8);
        }
    }

    // Firewall: switch and policy, rule card, rule commands and the offload switch.
    {
        row(L, {{CmdFwToggle, 140}, {CmdFwPolicy, 220}});
        float x = R;
        for (const auto& [id, width] : {std::pair{CmdFwExport, 120.0f}, std::pair{CmdFwImport, 120.0f}, std::pair{CmdFwAdd, 140.0f}}) {
            Place(item(id), {x - f.F(width), top, x, cmdBottom});
            x -= f.F(width) + f.F(8);
        }
        const float bottomTop = B - cmdH;
        m_rulesCard = {L, cmdBottom + gap, R, bottomTop - gap};
        Place(m_rules.hwnd(), {m_rulesCard.left + f.F(2), m_rulesCard.top + f.F(kCardHeaderH), m_rulesCard.right - f.F(2),
                               m_rulesCard.bottom - f.F(2)});
        float bx = L;
        for (const auto& [id, width] : {std::pair{CmdFwEdit, 110.0f}, std::pair{CmdFwRemove, 110.0f}, std::pair{CmdFwUp, 120.0f},
                                        std::pair{CmdFwDown, 130.0f}}) {
            Place(item(id), {bx, bottomTop, bx + f.F(width), B});
            bx += f.F(width) + f.F(8);
        }
        Place(item(CmdFwOffload), {std::max(bx + f.F(16), R - f.F(420)), bottomTop, R, B});
    }

    // Simulator: conditions card (sliders, direction, traffic match, order) and live card.
    {
        row(L, {{CmdSimToggle, 140}, {CmdSimPreset, 230}, {CmdSimReset, 110}});
        const float cardsTop = cmdBottom + gap;
        const bool wide = R - L >= f.F(880);
        const float rowH = f.F(kRowH);
        const float condH = f.F(kCardHeaderH) + rowH * 6 + f.F(22) + f.F(44) + pad;
        const float condW = wide ? std::round((R - L) * 0.54f) : R - L;
        m_condCard = {L, cardsTop, L + condW, wide ? std::max(B, cardsTop + condH) : cardsTop + condH};
        m_liveCard = wide ? D2D1_RECT_F{m_condCard.right + gap, cardsTop, R, B} : D2D1_RECT_F{L, m_condCard.bottom + gap, R, B};

        const float x0 = m_condCard.left + pad, x1 = m_condCard.right - pad;
        const float labelW = f.F(124), valueW = f.F(84);
        float ry = m_condCard.top + f.F(kCardHeaderH);
        Slider* sliders[] = {&m_latency, &m_jitter, &m_loss, &m_rate};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < std::size(sliders); ++i) {
            m_sliderRows[i] = {x0, ry, x1, ry + rowH};
            Place(sliders[i]->hwnd(), {x0 + labelW, ry + f.F(7), x1 - valueW, ry + rowH - f.F(7)});
            ry += rowH;
        }
        m_dirRow = {x0, ry, x1, ry + rowH};
        float sx = x0 + labelW;
        for (UINT id : {CmdDirBoth, CmdDirIn, CmdDirOut}) {
            const float w = std::min(f.F(128), (x1 - x0 - labelW - f.F(16)) / 3);
            Place(item(id), {sx, ry + f.F(7), sx + w, ry + rowH - f.F(7)});
            sx += w + f.F(8);
        }
        ry += rowH;
        m_matchRow = {x0, ry, x1, ry + rowH};
        m_matchBox = {x0 + labelW, ry + f.F(6), x1, ry + rowH - f.F(6)};
        placeEdit(m_matchEdit, m_matchBox);
        ry += rowH;
        m_matchHint = {x0 + labelW, ry - f.F(4), x1, ry + f.F(16)};
        ry += f.F(22);
        Place(item(CmdSimOrder), {x0, ry, x1, ry + f.F(36)});

        const D2D1_RECT_F& live = m_liveCard;
        const float tilesTop = live.top + f.F(kCardHeaderH);
        m_tiles = {live.left + pad, tilesTop, live.right - pad, tilesTop + f.F(64) * 2 + f.F(8)};
        const float chartsTop = m_tiles.bottom + f.F(16);
        const float chartH = std::max(f.F(50), (live.bottom - pad - chartsTop - f.F(16)) / 3);
        m_delayChart = {live.left + pad, chartsTop, live.right - pad, chartsTop + chartH};
        m_dropChart = {live.left + pad, m_delayChart.bottom + f.F(8), live.right - pad, m_delayChart.bottom + f.F(8) + chartH};
        m_throughputChart = {live.left + pad, m_dropChart.bottom + f.F(8), live.right - pad, m_dropChart.bottom + f.F(8) + chartH};
    }
    InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

void MainWindow::ShowPage(Page page) {
    m_page = page;
    Settings::WriteDword(L"Page", static_cast<DWORD>(page));
    const bool capture = page == Page::Capture, firewall = page == Page::Firewall, simulator = page == Page::Simulator,
               processes = page == Page::Processes, driver = page == Page::Driver;
    const bool elevate = capture && !m_driverOk && !IsElevated();
    auto show = [&](HWND h, bool visible) {
        if (!h) return;
        if (!visible && GetFocus() == h) SetFocus(nullptr);
        ShowWindow(h, visible ? SW_SHOWNA : SW_HIDE);
    };
    auto item = [&](UINT id) { return GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, static_cast<int>(id)); };
    for (UINT id : {CmdStart, CmdStop}) show(item(id), capture && !elevate);
    show(item(CmdElevate), elevate);
    for (UINT id : {CmdClear, CmdSave}) show(item(id), capture);
    for (HWND h : {m_filterEdit, m_list.hwnd(), m_details.hwnd()}) show(h, capture);
    for (UINT id : {CmdProcMonitor, CmdProcReset, CmdProcBlock, CmdProcLimit, CmdProcImpair, CmdProcPackets, CmdProcFolder}) {
        show(item(id), processes);
    }
    show(m_procList.hwnd(), processes);
    for (UINT id : {CmdDrvInstall, CmdDrvUninstall, CmdDrvStart, CmdDrvStop, CmdDrvStartType, CmdDrvRefresh, CmdDrvCopy}) show(item(id), driver);
    for (UINT id : {CmdFwToggle, CmdFwPolicy, CmdFwAdd, CmdFwImport, CmdFwExport, CmdFwEdit, CmdFwRemove, CmdFwUp, CmdFwDown, CmdFwOffload}) {
        show(item(id), firewall);
    }
    show(m_rules.hwnd(), firewall);
    for (UINT id : {CmdSimToggle, CmdSimPreset, CmdSimReset, CmdDirBoth, CmdDirIn, CmdDirOut, CmdSimOrder}) show(item(id), simulator);
    for (HWND h : {m_latency.hwnd(), m_jitter.hwnd(), m_loss.hwnd(), m_rate.hwnd(), m_matchEdit}) show(h, simulator);

    m_looks[CmdPageCapture].checked = capture;
    m_looks[CmdPageProcesses].checked = processes;
    m_looks[CmdPageFirewall].checked = firewall;
    m_looks[CmdPageSimulator].checked = simulator;
    m_looks[CmdPageDriver].checked = driver;
    for (UINT id : {CmdPageCapture, CmdPageProcesses, CmdPageFirewall, CmdPageSimulator, CmdPageDriver}) InvalidateRect(item(id), nullptr, FALSE);
    Layout();
    if (processes) RefreshProcesses();  // at once, not on the next timer tick
    if (driver && !m_drvDoing) RefreshDriver();
}

void MainWindow::RestorePlacement(int showCommand) {
    const UINT dpi = GetDpiForWindow(m_hwnd);
    RECT desired{0, 0, MulDiv(1280, static_cast<int>(dpi), 96), MulDiv(800, static_cast<int>(dpi), 96)};
    AdjustWindowRectExForDpi(&desired, WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW, FALSE, 0, dpi);
    int w = desired.right - desired.left, h = desired.bottom - desired.top;
    MONITORINFO mi{sizeof mi};
    GetMonitorInfoW(MonitorFromWindow(m_hwnd, MONITOR_DEFAULTTOPRIMARY), &mi);
    w = std::min<int>(w, mi.rcWork.right - mi.rcWork.left);
    h = std::min<int>(h, mi.rcWork.bottom - mi.rcWork.top);
    int x = mi.rcWork.left + (mi.rcWork.right - mi.rcWork.left - w) / 2;
    int y = mi.rcWork.top + (mi.rcWork.bottom - mi.rcWork.top - h) / 2;

    // Saved position (physical pixels) when it is still on a monitor.
    int sx = 0, sy = 0, sw = 0, sh = 0;
    const std::wstring saved = Settings::Read(L"WindowRect");
    if (swscanf_s(saved.c_str(), L"%d %d %d %d", &sx, &sy, &sw, &sh) == 4 && sw > 400 && sh > 300) {
        const RECT r{sx, sy, sx + sw, sy + sh};
        if (MonitorFromRect(&r, MONITOR_DEFAULTTONULL)) {
            x = sx;
            y = sy;
            w = sw;
            h = sh;
        }
    }
    SetWindowPos(m_hwnd, nullptr, x, y, w, h, SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
    const bool maximized = Settings::ReadDword(L"WindowMaximized", 0) != 0;
    ShowWindow(m_hwnd, showCommand == SW_SHOWMINIMIZED || showCommand == SW_MINIMIZE ? SW_SHOWNORMAL
                       : maximized && showCommand == SW_SHOWNORMAL                ? SW_SHOWMAXIMIZED
                                                                                  : showCommand);
    UpdateWindow(m_hwnd);
}

void MainWindow::SavePlacement() {
    WINDOWPLACEMENT wp{sizeof wp};
    if (!GetWindowPlacement(m_hwnd, &wp)) return;
    const RECT& r = wp.rcNormalPosition;
    Settings::Write(L"WindowRect", std::format(L"{} {} {} {}", r.left, r.top, r.right - r.left, r.bottom - r.top));
    Settings::WriteDword(L"WindowMaximized", wp.showCmd == SW_SHOWMAXIMIZED ? 1 : 0);
}

void MainWindow::InvalidateArea(const D2D1_RECT_F& r) {
    const RECT area = ToRect(Inset(r, -2, -2));
    InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, &area, FALSE);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Painting
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void MainWindow::Paint() {
    PaintScope ps(m_hwnd);
    RECT client{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
    Ui::Paint(
        ps.dc(), client, m_fonts,
        [&](Canvas& c) {
            c.Clear(Graphics::Get().Base());
            PaintHeader(c);
            if (m_revertAt) {
                const auto& f = m_fonts;
                const uint64_t now = GetTickCount64();
                const uint64_t left = m_revertAt > now ? (m_revertAt - now + 999) / 1000 : 0;
                c.Fill(m_banner, WithAlpha(Color::Caution, 0.14f), f.F(6));
                c.Stroke(m_banner, WithAlpha(Color::Caution, 0.55f), f.F(6));
                c.Text(std::wstring(1, Icon::Warning), {m_banner.left + f.F(14), m_banner.top, m_banner.left + f.F(34), m_banner.bottom},
                       Font::Icon, Color::Caution, Align::Center);
                c.Text(Text::Format(IDS_REVERT_BANNER, left), {m_banner.left + f.F(44), m_banner.top, m_banner.right - f.F(290), m_banner.bottom},
                       Font::Strong, Color::Text);
            } else if (m_banner.bottom > m_banner.top) {
                const auto& f = m_fonts;
                c.Fill(m_banner, WithAlpha(Color::Danger, 0.85f), f.F(6));
                c.Text(std::wstring(1, Icon::Warning), {m_banner.left + f.F(14), m_banner.top, m_banner.left + f.F(34), m_banner.bottom},
                       Font::Icon, Color::Text, Align::Center);
                const std::wstring adapter = m_adapters.empty() ? std::wstring() : ToWide(m_adapters[m_adapterIndex].FriendlyName);
                c.Text(Text::Format(IDS_BANNER_KILL, adapter), {m_banner.left + f.F(44), m_banner.top, m_banner.right - f.F(14), m_banner.bottom},
                       Font::Strong, Color::Text);
            }
            switch (m_page) {
            case Page::Capture: PaintCapture(c); break;
            case Page::Firewall: PaintFirewall(c); break;
            case Page::Simulator: PaintSimulator(c); break;
            case Page::Processes: PaintProcesses(c); break;
            case Page::Driver: PaintDriver(c); break;
            }
            PaintStatus(c);
        },
        [&](HDC dc) { FillFieldsGdi(dc); });
}

void MainWindow::PaintHeader(Canvas& c) {
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    const float mid = m_header.bottom / 2;
    const D2D1_RECT_F logo{f.F(20), mid - f.F(15), f.F(50), mid + f.F(15)};
    c.Fill(logo, Color::Accent, f.F(7));
    c.Text(std::wstring(1, Icon::Network), logo, Font::Icon, Color::Text, Align::Center);
    c.Text(L"WireScope", {logo.right + f.F(12), mid - f.F(19), logo.right + f.F(160), mid + f.F(5)}, Font::Title, Color::Text);
    c.Text(Text::Get(IDS_APP_TAGLINE), {logo.right + f.F(13), mid + f.F(3), m_header.right * 0.6f, mid + f.F(19)}, Font::Caption, Color::Text3);
}

void MainWindow::PaintCard(Canvas& c, const D2D1_RECT_F& card, const std::wstring& title, const std::wstring& note) {
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    c.Fill(card, Color::Card, f.F(8));
    c.Stroke(card, Color::CardStroke, f.F(8));
    if (title.empty()) return;
    const D2D1_RECT_F head{card.left + f.F(kPad), card.top, card.right - f.F(kPad), card.top + f.F(kCardHeaderH)};
    const float tw = c.Width(title, Font::Strong) + 1;
    c.Text(title, {head.left, head.top, head.left + tw, head.bottom}, Font::Strong, Color::Text);
    if (!note.empty()) c.Text(note, {head.left + tw + f.F(16), head.top, head.right, head.bottom}, Font::Caption, Color::Text3, Align::Right);
}

void MainWindow::PaintField(Canvas& c, const D2D1_RECT_F& box, HWND edit, bool onCard, bool error) {
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    c.Fill(box, onCard ? Color::FieldOnCard : Color::Control, f.F(4));
    c.Stroke(box, Color::ControlStroke, f.F(4));
    const bool focused = GetFocus() == edit;
    const D2D1_COLOR_F line = error ? Color::Critical : focused ? Color::AccentText : White(0.30f);
    c.Fill({box.left + f.F(1), box.bottom - f.F(focused || error ? 2.0f : 1.0f), box.right - f.F(1), box.bottom}, line);
}

void MainWindow::FillFieldsGdi(HDC dc) {
    // The EDIT controls paint with GDI; their surroundings in the field box are filled the same way,
    // so field and control read as one surface.
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    auto fill = [&](const D2D1_RECT_F& box, HBRUSH brush) {
        const RECT r{static_cast<LONG>(box.left + f.F(3)), static_cast<LONG>(box.top + f.F(3)), static_cast<LONG>(box.right - f.F(3)),
                     static_cast<LONG>(box.bottom - f.F(3))};
        FillRect(dc, &r, brush);
    };
    if (m_page == Page::Capture) fill(m_filterBox, m_fieldBrush.get());
    if (m_page == Page::Simulator) fill(m_matchBox, m_cardFieldBrush.get());
}

void MainWindow::PaintCapture(Canvas& c) {
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    c.Text(std::wstring(1, Icon::Search), {m_filterBox.left - f.F(22), m_filterBox.top, m_filterBox.left - f.F(8), m_filterBox.bottom},
           Font::Icon, m_filter.empty() ? Color::Text3 : Color::AccentText, Align::Center);
    PaintField(c, m_filterBox, m_filterEdit, false);
    PaintCard(c, m_listCard, {});
    PaintCard(c, m_detailsCard, {});
    // Splitter grip
    const float mid = (m_splitter.top + m_splitter.bottom) / 2, cx = (m_splitter.left + m_splitter.right) / 2;
    c.Fill({cx - f.F(18), mid - f.F(1.5f), cx + f.F(18), mid + f.F(1.5f)}, m_dragSplit ? Color::AccentText : White(0.18f), f.F(1.5f));
}

void MainWindow::PaintFirewall(Canvas& c) {
    const std::wstring note = Text::Get(m_offload ? IDS_CARD_RULES_KERNEL : IDS_CARD_RULES_ENGINE);
    PaintCard(c, m_rulesCard, std::format(L"{}  ·  {}", Text::Get(IDS_CARD_RULES), m_ruleSet.size()), note);
}

void MainWindow::PaintChart(Canvas& c, const D2D1_RECT_F& r, const std::wstring& title, const std::deque<double>& values,
                            const std::wstring& unit, bool bars, D2D1_COLOR_F color) {
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    const double current = values.empty() ? 0.0 : values.back();
    double peak = 0;
    for (double v : values) peak = std::max(peak, v);
    c.Text(title, {r.left, r.top, r.right - f.F(90), r.top + f.F(18)}, Font::Caption, Color::Text3);
    c.Text(std::format(L"{:.1f} {}", current, unit), {r.right - f.F(120), r.top, r.right, r.top + f.F(18)}, Font::Strong, Color::Text, Align::Right);
    const D2D1_RECT_F plot{r.left, r.top + f.F(24), r.right, r.bottom};
    if (plot.bottom - plot.top < f.F(20)) return;
    // Scale: a round maximum above the peak, recessive grid at the maximum and the middle.
    double scale = 1;
    for (double step : {1.0, 2.0, 5.0, 10.0, 20.0, 50.0, 100.0, 200.0, 500.0, 1000.0, 2000.0, 5000.0, 10000.0, 20000.0}) {
        scale = step;
        if (peak <= step * 0.9) break;
    }
    const float h = plot.bottom - plot.top;
    c.Line({plot.left, plot.top + 0.5f}, {plot.right, plot.top + 0.5f}, Color::Grid);
    c.Line({plot.left, plot.top + h / 2}, {plot.right, plot.top + h / 2}, Color::Grid);
    c.Line({plot.left, plot.bottom - 0.5f}, {plot.right, plot.bottom - 0.5f}, Color::CardStroke);
    c.Text(std::format(L"{:g} {}", scale, unit), {plot.left + f.F(4), plot.top + f.F(1), plot.left + f.F(120), plot.top + f.F(15)}, Font::Caption,
           Color::Text3);
    constexpr size_t kSamples = 120;
    const float step = (plot.right - plot.left) / static_cast<float>(kSamples - 1);
    const size_t first = kSamples - std::min(values.size(), kSamples);
    auto yOf = [&](double v) { return plot.bottom - static_cast<float>(std::min(v / scale, 1.0)) * (h - f.F(2)); };
    if (bars) {
        const float bw = std::max(1.0f, step - f.F(1));
        for (size_t i = 0; i < values.size() && i < kSamples; ++i) {
            if (values[i] <= 0) continue;
            const float x = plot.left + static_cast<float>(first + i) * step;
            c.Fill({x - bw / 2, yOf(values[i]), x + bw / 2, plot.bottom - f.F(1)}, color, std::min(bw / 2, f.F(1.5f)));
        }
    } else if (values.size() >= 2) {
        std::vector<D2D1_POINT_2F> points;
        points.reserve(values.size());
        for (size_t i = 0; i < values.size() && i < kSamples; ++i) {
            points.push_back({plot.left + static_cast<float>(first + i) * step, yOf(values[i])});
        }
        c.Area(points.data(), points.size(), plot.bottom - f.F(1), WithAlpha(color, 0.14f));
        c.Polyline(points.data(), points.size(), color, f.F(2));
        c.Circle(points.back(), f.F(3.5f), color);
    }
}

void MainWindow::PaintSimulator(Canvas& c) {
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    PaintCard(c, m_condCard, Text::Get(IDS_CARD_CONDITIONS));
    const UINT labels[] = {IDS_SIM_LATENCY, IDS_SIM_JITTER, IDS_SIM_LOSS, IDS_SIM_RATE};
    const std::wstring values[] = {Text::Format(IDS_VALUE_MS, m_profile.latencyMs), Text::Format(IDS_VALUE_JITTER, m_profile.jitterMs),
                                   Text::Format(IDS_VALUE_PERCENT, m_profile.lossPercent), RateText(m_profile.rateKbps)};
    const float labelW = f.F(124);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::size(labels); ++i) {
        const D2D1_RECT_F& r = m_sliderRows[i];
        c.Text(Text::Get(labels[i]), {r.left, r.top, r.left + labelW, r.bottom}, Font::Body, Color::Text2);
        c.Text(values[i], {r.right - f.F(80), r.top, r.right, r.bottom}, Font::Strong, Color::Text, Align::Right);
    }
    c.Text(Text::Get(IDS_SIM_DIRECTION), {m_dirRow.left, m_dirRow.top, m_dirRow.left + labelW, m_dirRow.bottom}, Font::Body, Color::Text2);
    c.Text(Text::Get(IDS_SIM_MATCH), {m_matchRow.left, m_matchRow.top, m_matchRow.left + labelW, m_matchRow.bottom}, Font::Body, Color::Text2);
    PaintField(c, m_matchBox, m_matchEdit, true, !m_matchError.empty());
    if (!m_matchError.empty()) c.Text(m_matchError, m_matchHint, Font::Caption, Color::Critical);
    else c.Text(Text::Get(IDS_SIM_MATCH_HINT), m_matchHint, Font::Caption, Color::Text3);

    // Live card: tiles and two small charts (one measure each, never a second axis).
    const bool on = m_profile.enabled && m_ctl->Impairment().enabled;
    std::wstring note = on ? std::wstring() : Text::Get(IDS_SIM_OFF_NOTE);
    if (on && !m_stats.HighResolutionTimer) note = Text::Get(IDS_SIM_TIMER_LOW);
    PaintCard(c, m_liveCard, Text::Get(IDS_CARD_LIVE), note);
    const uint64_t dropped = m_stats.SimDropped + m_stats.SimOverflow;
    const double lossRate = m_stats.SimSelected ? 100.0 * static_cast<double>(dropped) / static_cast<double>(m_stats.SimSelected) : 0.0;
    const double avgMs = m_stats.SimDelayed ? static_cast<double>(m_stats.SimDelaySumUs) / static_cast<double>(m_stats.SimDelayed) / 1000.0 : 0.0;
    struct Tile {
        UINT label;
        std::wstring value;
        bool critical;
    };
    const Tile tiles[] = {
        {IDS_TILE_MATCHED, FormatCount(m_stats.SimSelected), false},
        {IDS_TILE_DELAYED, FormatCount(m_stats.SimDelayed), false},
        {IDS_TILE_DROPPED, FormatCount(dropped), dropped > 0},
        {IDS_TILE_LOSS, std::format(L"{:.1f} %", lossRate), false},
        {IDS_TILE_INFLIGHT, FormatCount(m_stats.SimInFlight), false},
        {IDS_TILE_AVG, std::format(L"{:.1f} ms", avgMs), false},
    };
    const float tw = (m_tiles.right - m_tiles.left - f.F(16)) / 3, th = f.F(64);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::size(tiles); ++i) {
        const float x = m_tiles.left + static_cast<float>(i % 3) * (tw + f.F(8));
        const float y = m_tiles.top + static_cast<float>(i / 3) * (th + f.F(8));
        const D2D1_RECT_F t{x, y, x + tw, y + th};
        c.Fill(t, Color::Control, f.F(6));
        float lx = t.left + f.F(12);
        if (tiles[i].critical) {
            c.Circle({lx + f.F(3), t.top + f.F(17)}, f.F(3), Color::Critical);
            lx += f.F(12);
        }
        c.Text(Text::Get(tiles[i].label), {lx, t.top + f.F(8), t.right - f.F(8), t.top + f.F(26)}, Font::Caption, Color::Text3);
        c.Text(tiles[i].value, {t.left + f.F(12), t.top + f.F(26), t.right - f.F(8), t.bottom - f.F(6)}, Font::Hero, on ? Color::Text : Color::Text2);
    }
    PaintChart(c, m_delayChart, Text::Get(IDS_CHART_DELAY), m_delayHistory, L"ms", false, Color::AccentText);
    PaintChart(c, m_dropChart, Text::Get(IDS_CHART_DROPS), m_dropHistory, L"/s", true, Color::Critical);
    PaintChart(c, m_throughputChart, Text::Get(IDS_CHART_RATE), m_throughputHistory, L"kbit/s", false, Color::Success);
}

void MainWindow::PaintStatus(Canvas& c) {
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    const D2D1_RECT_F& s = m_status;
    c.Line({s.left, s.top + 0.5f}, {s.right, s.top + 0.5f}, White(0.06f));
    float x = s.left + f.F(20);
    c.Circle({x, (s.top + s.bottom) / 2}, f.F(4), m_driverOk ? Color::Success : Color::Critical);
    x += f.F(12);
    std::wstring left = m_driverOk ? Text::Get(IDS_ST_DRIVER_OK) : Text::Get(IDS_ST_DRIVER_FAIL);
    if (!m_adapters.empty()) left += L"  ·  " + ToWide(m_adapters[m_adapterIndex].FriendlyName);
    const float lw = std::min(c.Width(left, Font::Caption) + 1, s.right * 0.34f);
    c.Text(left, {x, s.top, x + lw, s.bottom}, Font::Caption, Color::Text2);
    x += lw + f.F(24);

    // Chips on the right: what is active.
    float rx = s.right - f.F(16);
    auto chip = [&](UINT text, D2D1_COLOR_F color, bool solid) {
        const std::wstring label = Text::Get(text);
        const float w = c.Width(label, Font::Label) + f.F(16);
        const D2D1_RECT_F r{rx - w, s.top + f.F(8), rx, s.bottom - f.F(8)};
        c.Fill(r, solid ? color : WithAlpha(color, 0.16f), (r.bottom - r.top) / 2);
        c.Text(label, r, Font::Label, solid ? Color::Text : color, Align::Center);
        rx -= w + f.F(6);
    };
    if (m_ctl->KillSwitch()) chip(IDS_CHIP_KILL, Color::Danger, true);
    if (m_ctl->Impairment().enabled) chip(IDS_CHIP_SIMULATOR, Color::Caution, false);
    if (m_ctl->FirewallEnabled()) chip(IDS_CHIP_FIREWALL, Color::Success, false);
    if (m_ctl->Monitoring()) chip(IDS_CHIP_MONITOR, Color::AccentText, false);

    // Middle: a recent message, else the capture state and traffic.
    const D2D1_RECT_F middle{x, s.top, rx - f.F(12), s.bottom};
    if (!m_statusText.empty() && GetTickCount64() < m_statusUntil) {
        const D2D1_COLOR_F color = m_statusLevel == Level::Error     ? Color::Critical
                                   : m_statusLevel == Level::Warning ? Color::Caution
                                   : m_statusLevel == Level::Success ? Color::Success
                                                                     : Color::Text2;
        c.Text(m_statusText, middle, Font::Caption, color);
        return;
    }
    const bool capturing = m_ctl->Capturing();
    std::wstring text = Text::Get(capturing ? IDS_ST_CAPTURING : IDS_ST_IDLE);
    if (m_stats.TotalPackets) {
        text += L"  ·  " + Text::Format(IDS_ST_TRAFFIC, FormatCount(m_stats.TotalPackets), std::lround(m_stats.PacketsPerSec),
                                              FormatRate(m_stats.BytesPerSec));
        text += std::format(L"  ·  DNS {}  ·  TCP {}  ·  UDP {}  ·  ICMP {}", FormatCount(m_stats.DnsQueries),
                            FormatCount(m_stats.TcpPackets), FormatCount(m_stats.UdpPackets), FormatCount(m_stats.IcmpPackets));
    }
    c.Text(text, middle, Font::Caption, capturing ? Color::Text2 : Color::Text3);
}

}  // namespace WS::Ui
```

```cpp
// WireScope - Main window: drop-down and context menus, language switching, About.
#include "gui/Dialogs.h"
#include "gui/MainWindow.h"
#include "gui/MainWindowDetail.h"
#include "resources/resource.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <CommCtrl.h>

namespace WS::Ui {
using namespace MainWindowDetail;

namespace {

// Drops a menu below the button that opened it.
UINT TrackBelow(PopupMenu& menu, HWND owner, HWND button, const Fonts& fonts) {
    RECT r{};
    GetWindowRect(button, &r);
    return menu.Track(owner, fonts, {r.left, r.bottom + fonts.S(2)}, &r);
}

}  // namespace

void MainWindow::ShowAdapterMenu() {
    if (m_ctl->AdapterLocked()) {
        SetStatus(Level::Warning, Text::Get(IDS_DP_ADAPTER_BUSY));
        return;
    }
    PopupMenu menu;
    menu.AddHeader(Text::Get(IDS_CM_ADAPTERS));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_adapters.size() && CmdAdapterFirst + i <= CmdAdapterLast; ++i) {
        const auto& a = m_adapters[i];
        std::wstring detail = ToWide(a.MacAddress);
        if (a.HasGateway) detail = Text::Get(IDS_CM_DEFAULT_ROUTE) + L"  ·  " + detail;
        menu.AddItem(static_cast<UINT>(CmdAdapterFirst + i), ToWide(a.FriendlyName), detail, i == m_adapterIndex, true);
    }
    menu.AddSeparator();
    menu.AddItem(CmdRefreshAdapters, Text::Get(IDS_CM_REFRESH));
    if (const UINT cmd = TrackBelow(menu, m_hwnd, GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdAdapter), m_fonts)) OnCommand(cmd, 0, nullptr);
}

void MainWindow::ShowPolicyMenu() {
    PopupMenu menu;
    menu.AddHeader(Text::Get(IDS_CM_POLICY_HEADER));
    menu.AddItem(CmdPolicyAllow, Text::Get(IDS_CM_POLICY_ALLOW), {}, m_policy == RuleAction::Allow, true);
    menu.AddItem(CmdPolicyBlock, Text::Get(IDS_CM_POLICY_BLOCK), {}, m_policy == RuleAction::Block, true);
    const UINT cmd = TrackBelow(menu, m_hwnd, GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdFwPolicy), m_fonts);
    if (cmd == CmdPolicyAllow) SetPolicy(RuleAction::Allow);
    else if (cmd == CmdPolicyBlock) SetPolicy(RuleAction::Block);
}

void MainWindow::ShowPresetMenu() {
    PopupMenu menu;
    menu.AddHeader(Text::Get(IDS_PRESETS_HEADER));
    const auto presets = ImpairmentPresets();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < presets.size() && CmdPresetFirst + i <= CmdPresetLast; ++i) {
        const auto& p = presets[i];
        const bool current = p.latencyMs == m_profile.latencyMs && p.jitterMs == m_profile.jitterMs &&
                             p.lossPercent == m_profile.lossPercent && p.rateKbps == m_profile.rateKbps;
        menu.AddItem(static_cast<UINT>(CmdPresetFirst + i), Text::Get(p.name),
                     Text::Format(IDS_PRESET_DETAIL, p.latencyMs, p.jitterMs, p.lossPercent, RateText(p.rateKbps)), current, true);
    }
    if (const UINT cmd = TrackBelow(menu, m_hwnd, GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdSimPreset), m_fonts)) OnCommand(cmd, 0, nullptr);
}

void MainWindow::ShowContextMenu(HWND target, POINT screen) {
    if (target == m_list.hwnd() || target == m_details.hwnd()) {
        const PacketRef p = target == m_list.hwnd() ? m_list.Selected() : m_details.Packet();
        if (!p) return;
        // The remote side of the conversation: destination of outbound, source of inbound packets.
        const std::string& remote = p->Dir == Direction::Outbound ? p->Destination : p->Source;
        const bool ip = p->Protocol != ProtocolType::Unknown && p->Protocol != ProtocolType::ARP;
        PopupMenu menu;
        const size_t marked = m_list.MarkedCount();
        menu.AddItem(CmdCopySummary, marked > 1 ? Text::Format(IDS_CM_COPY_SUMMARIES, marked) : Text::Get(IDS_CM_COPY_SUMMARY), L"Ctrl+C");
        menu.AddItem(CmdCopyDetails, Text::Get(IDS_CM_COPY_DETAILS));
        menu.AddItem(CmdCopyHex, Text::Get(IDS_CM_COPY_HEX));
        menu.AddSeparator();
        menu.AddItem(CmdSaveSelected, Text::Format(IDS_CM_SAVE_SELECTED, std::max<size_t>(marked, 1)));
        menu.AddItem(CmdSelectAll, Text::Get(IDS_CM_SELECT_ALL), L"Ctrl+A");
        menu.AddSeparator();
        menu.AddItem(CmdFilterSource, Text::Format(IDS_CM_ONLY_SOURCE, ToWide(p->Source)));
        menu.AddItem(CmdFilterDestination, Text::Format(IDS_CM_ONLY_DESTINATION, ToWide(p->Destination)));
        if (!p->DomainOrHost.empty()) menu.AddItem(CmdFilterHost, Text::Format(IDS_CM_ONLY, ToWide(p->DomainOrHost)));
        menu.AddItem(CmdFilterProtocol, Text::Format(IDS_CM_ONLY, ToWide(p->ProtocolName)));
        if (!m_filter.empty()) menu.AddItem(CmdClearFilter, Text::Get(IDS_CM_CLEAR_FILTER));
        if (ip) {
            menu.AddSeparator();
            menu.AddItem(CmdBlockRemote, Text::Format(IDS_CM_BLOCK_REMOTE, ToWide(remote)));
            menu.AddItem(CmdImpairRemote, Text::Format(IDS_CM_IMPAIR_REMOTE, ToWide(remote)));
        }
        auto filterBy = [&](const std::string& text) {
            SetWindowTextW(m_filterEdit, ToWide(text).c_str());  // EN_CHANGE rebuilds the view
        };
        switch (menu.Track(m_hwnd, m_fonts, screen)) {
        case CmdCopySummary: CopySummaries(); break;
        case CmdSaveSelected: SavePcap(true); break;
        case CmdSelectAll: m_list.SelectAll(); break;
        case CmdCopyDetails: m_details.SetPacket(p, m_baseTime); CopyToClipboard(m_hwnd, m_details.Text()); break;
        case CmdCopyHex: m_details.SetPacket(p, m_baseTime); CopyToClipboard(m_hwnd, m_details.HexText()); break;
        case CmdFilterSource: filterBy(p->Source); break;
        case CmdFilterDestination: filterBy(p->Destination); break;
        case CmdFilterHost: filterBy(p->DomainOrHost); break;
        case CmdFilterProtocol: filterBy(p->ProtocolName); break;
        case CmdClearFilter: filterBy({}); break;
        case CmdBlockRemote:
            ShowPage(Page::Firewall);
            AddRule(ToWide("block remote " + remote));
            break;
        case CmdImpairRemote:
            SetWindowTextW(m_matchEdit, ToWide("remote " + remote).c_str());
            ShowPage(Page::Simulator);
            break;
        default: break;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (target == m_procList.hwnd()) {
        const auto process = SelectedProcess();
        if (!process) return;
        const bool named = Actionable(process.get());
        PopupMenu menu;
        menu.AddItem(CmdProcBlock, Text::Get(IDS_PROC_BLOCK), {}, false, false, named);
        menu.AddItem(CmdProcLimit, Text::Get(IDS_PROC_LIMIT), {}, false, false, named && m_ctl->CanControl());
        menu.AddItem(CmdProcImpair, Text::Get(IDS_PROC_IMPAIR), {}, false, false, named);
        menu.AddSeparator();
        menu.AddItem(CmdProcPackets, Text::Get(IDS_PROC_PACKETS), L"Enter", false, false, named);
        menu.AddItem(CmdProcFolder, Text::Get(IDS_PROC_FOLDER), {}, false, false, !process->path.empty());
        menu.AddItem(CmdProcCopyPath, Text::Get(IDS_PROC_COPY_PATH), {}, false, false, !process->path.empty());
        if (const UINT cmd = menu.Track(m_hwnd, m_fonts, screen)) OnCommand(cmd, 0, nullptr);
        return;
    }
    if (target == m_rules.hwnd()) {
        const int index = m_rules.Selected();
        if (index < 0 || index >= static_cast<int>(m_ruleSet.size())) return;
        const bool enabled = m_ruleSet[static_cast<size_t>(index)].enabled;
        PopupMenu menu;
        menu.AddItem(CmdFwEdit, Text::Get(IDS_FW_EDIT), L"Enter");
        menu.AddItem(enabled ? CmdRuleDisable : CmdRuleEnable, Text::Get(enabled ? IDS_CM_DISABLE : IDS_CM_ENABLE), L"Space");
        menu.AddSeparator();
        menu.AddItem(CmdFwUp, Text::Get(IDS_FW_UP), L"Alt+↑", false, false, index > 0);
        menu.AddItem(CmdFwDown, Text::Get(IDS_FW_DOWN), L"Alt+↓", false, false, index + 1 < static_cast<int>(m_ruleSet.size()));
        menu.AddSeparator();
        menu.AddItem(CmdFwRemove, Text::Get(IDS_FW_REMOVE), L"Del");
        const UINT cmd = menu.Track(m_hwnd, m_fonts, screen);
        if (cmd == CmdRuleEnable || cmd == CmdRuleDisable) ToggleRule();
        else if (cmd) OnCommand(cmd, 0, nullptr);
    }
}

void MainWindow::ShowLanguageMenu() {
    m_languages = Text::Available();
    PopupMenu menu;
    const bool automatic = Text::Automatic();
    std::wstring detected = Text::Detect();
    for (const auto& l : m_languages) {
        if (l.code == detected) detected = l.name;
    }
    menu.AddItem(CmdLanguageAuto, Text::Format(IDS_LANGUAGE_AUTO, detected), {}, automatic, true);
    menu.AddSeparator();
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_languages.size() && CmdLanguageFirst + i <= CmdLanguageLast; ++i) {
        const auto& l = m_languages[i];
        menu.AddItem(static_cast<UINT>(CmdLanguageFirst + i), l.name, l.code == L"en" ? std::wstring() : std::format(L"{}%", l.Coverage()),
                     !automatic && l.code == Text::Current(), true);
    }
    RECT r{};
    GetWindowRect(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, CmdLanguage), &r);
    if (const UINT cmd = menu.Track(m_hwnd, m_fonts, {r.right, r.top}, &r)) OnCommand(cmd, 0, nullptr);
}

void MainWindow::SetLanguage(UINT command) {
    if (command == CmdLanguageAuto) {
        Text::Use(L"auto", true);
    } else {
        const size_t index = command - CmdLanguageFirst;
        if (index >= m_languages.size()) return;
        Text::Use(m_languages[index].code, true);
    }
    ApplyLanguage();
}

void MainWindow::ApplyLanguage() {
    for (const ButtonSpec& b : kButtons) {
        if (b.text) SetWindowTextW(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, static_cast<int>(b.id)), Text::Get(b.text).c_str());
    }
    SendMessageW(m_filterEdit, EM_SETCUEBANNER, TRUE, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(Text::Get(IDS_FILTER_CUE).c_str()));
    SendMessageW(m_matchEdit, EM_SETCUEBANNER, TRUE, reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(Text::Get(IDS_MATCH_CUE).c_str()));
    m_list.SetPlaceholder(m_driverOk ? Text::Get(m_filter.empty() ? IDS_LIST_EMPTY : IDS_LIST_NO_MATCH) : m_driverText);
    m_procList.SetPlaceholder(Text::Get(IDS_PROC_EMPTY));
    const PacketRef selected = m_details.Packet();
    m_details.SetPacket(nullptr, 0);
    m_details.SetPacket(selected, m_baseTime);
    RefreshRuleRows();
    RefreshProcesses();
    if (!m_matchError.empty()) OnMatchChanged();
    UpdateControls();
    RedrawWindow(m_hwnd, nullptr, nullptr, RDW_INVALIDATE | RDW_ALLCHILDREN);
}

void MainWindow::ShowAbout() {
    DialogSpec spec;
    spec.heading = Text::Format(IDS_ABOUT, kAppVersion);
    spec.message = Text::Format(IDS_ABOUT_MESSAGE, kCopyright, kGitHubRepo);
    spec.cancelButton = false;
    spec.ok = Text::Get(IDS_CLOSE);
    spec.width = 560;
    RunDialog(m_hwnd, spec);
}
```

`src/gui/MainWindowProcesses.cpp`:

```cpp
// WireScope - Main window: the Processes page. Traffic per program, its sockets and signature, and
// the actions that turn a program into a firewall rule, a bandwidth limit or a simulator target.
#include "core/ProcessTrust.h"
#include "core/Rules.h"
#include "gui/Dialogs.h"
#include "gui/MainWindow.h"
#include "gui/MainWindowDetail.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
#include <iphlpapi.h>
#include <ShlObj.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <charconv>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <format>

namespace WS::Ui {
using namespace MainWindowDetail;

namespace {

constexpr uint64_t kRecheckMs = 2000;  // how often a program without sockets is checked for having exited
constexpr double kSmoothing = 0.6;     // weight of the newest sample in the displayed rates

const std::wstring& WindowsFolder() {
    static const std::wstring folder = [] {
        std::wstring path(MAX_PATH, L'\0');
        path.resize(GetWindowsDirectoryW(path.data(), MAX_PATH));
        if (!path.empty() && path.back() != L'\\') path += L'\\';
        return FoldCase(path);
    }();
    return folder;
}

// Services of Windows share these processes: a rule for one of them reaches far beyond one program.
bool PartOfWindows(const ProcessInfo& p) {
    return p.pid == 4 || (!p.path.empty() && !WindowsFolder().empty() && FoldCase(p.path).starts_with(WindowsFolder()));
}

std::wstring StartedText(uint64_t filetime) {
    if (filetime == 0) return {};
    const FILETIME utc{static_cast<DWORD>(filetime), static_cast<DWORD>(filetime >> 32)};
    SYSTEMTIME system{}, local{};
    if (!FileTimeToSystemTime(&utc, &system) || !SystemTimeToTzSpecificLocalTime(nullptr, &system, &local)) return {};
    return std::format(L"{:04}-{:02}-{:02} {:02}:{:02}:{:02}", local.wYear, local.wMonth, local.wDay, local.wHour, local.wMinute,
                       local.wSecond);
}

// Established connections first, then other TCP states, listeners, UDP ports.
int Rank(const Endpoint& e) {
    if (e.protocol != 6) return 3;
    if (e.state == MIB_TCP_STATE_ESTAB) return 0;
    return e.state == MIB_TCP_STATE_LISTEN ? 2 : 1;
}

std::wstring Address(const Endpoint& e, const std::array<uint8_t, 16>& address, uint16_t port) {
    if (e.version == 4) {
        uint32_t v4 = 0;
        std::memcpy(&v4, address.data(), sizeof v4);
        return ToWide(std::format("{}:{}", FormatIpv4(v4), port));
    }
    return ToWide(std::format("[{}]:{}", FormatIpv6(std::span<const uint8_t, 16>(address)), port));
}

std::wstring EndpointText(const Endpoint& e) {
    std::wstring text = (e.protocol == 6 ? L"TCP  " : L"UDP  ") + Address(e, e.local, e.localPort);
    if (e.protocol != 6) return text;
    if (e.state == MIB_TCP_STATE_LISTEN) return text + L"  " + Text::Get(IDS_TCP_LISTEN);
    const UINT state = e.state == MIB_TCP_STATE_ESTAB                                         ? IDS_TCP_ESTABLISHED
                       : e.state == MIB_TCP_STATE_SYN_SENT || e.state == MIB_TCP_STATE_SYN_RCVD ? IDS_TCP_CONNECTING
                                                                                               : IDS_TCP_CLOSING;
    return text + L"  →  " + Address(e, e.remote, e.remotePort) + L"  " + Text::Get(state);
}

std::optional<uint32_t> ParseKbps(const std::vector<std::wstring>& values) {
    if (values.empty()) return std::nullopt;
    std::wstring_view text = values[0];
    while (!text.empty() && text.front() == L' ') text.remove_prefix(1);
    while (!text.empty() && text.back() == L' ') text.remove_suffix(1);
    const std::string digits = ToUtf8(text);
    uint32_t value = 0;
    const auto [end, ec] = std::from_chars(digits.data(), digits.data() + digits.size(), value);
    if (digits.empty() || ec != std::errc{} || end != digits.data() + digits.size() || value < 8 || value > 1'000'000) return std::nullopt;
    return value;
}

}  // namespace

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Data: socket tables, traffic totals, signatures
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void MainWindow::RefreshProcesses() {
    auto& engine = m_ctl->Engine();
    m_procSnapshot = ProcessMapper::Instance().Current();
    const ProcessMapper::Snapshot& snapshot = *m_procSnapshot;
    const bool counting = engine.Accounting();
    const uint64_t nowUs = MonotonicMicroseconds(), nowMs = GetTickCount64();
    const double seconds = m_procSampleUs ? std::max(0.05, static_cast<double>(nowUs - m_procSampleUs) / 1e6) : 0.0;
    m_procSampleUs = nowUs;

    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, ProcessRow> rows;
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::shared_ptr<const ProcessInfo>> infos;
    auto rowFor = [&](const std::shared_ptr<const ProcessInfo>& p) -> ProcessRow& {
        auto [it, inserted] = rows.try_emplace(p ? p->id : 0);
        ProcessRow& r = it->second;
        if (inserted) {
            r.counted = counting;
            if (p) {
                r.id = p->id;
                r.pid = p->pid;
                r.name = p->display.empty() ? Text::Format(IDS_PROC_UNNAMED, p->pid) : p->display;
                r.path = p->path;
                infos.emplace(p->id, p);
            }
        }
        return r;
    };

    // Programs with sockets right now.
    std::vector<uint32_t> sockets(snapshot.processes.size(), 0);
    for (const Endpoint& e : snapshot.endpoints) ++sockets[e.process];
    for (size_t i = 0; i < snapshot.processes.size(); ++i) {
        ProcessRow& r = rowFor(snapshot.processes[i]);
        r.sockets = sockets[i];
        m_procStates[r.id] = {true, nowMs};
    }

    // Traffic totals and rates (also of programs that have closed their sockets since).
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, ProcessRate> rates;
    m_procIn = m_procOut = 0;
    for (const ProcessTraffic& t : engine.ProcessTotals()) {
        ProcessRow& r = rowFor(t.process);
        r.counted = true;
        r.bytesIn = t.total.bytesIn;
        r.bytesOut = t.total.bytesOut;
        r.packetsIn = t.total.packetsIn;
        r.packetsOut = t.total.packetsOut;
        ProcessRate rate{t.total.bytesIn, t.total.bytesOut, 0, 0};
        if (const auto previous = m_procRates.find(r.id); previous != m_procRates.end() && seconds > 0) {
            const ProcessRate& p = previous->second;
            const double in = static_cast<double>(t.total.bytesIn - std::min(t.total.bytesIn, p.bytesIn)) / seconds;
            const double out = static_cast<double>(t.total.bytesOut - std::min(t.total.bytesOut, p.bytesOut)) / seconds;
            rate.rateIn = p.rateIn + (in - p.rateIn) * kSmoothing;
            rate.rateOut = p.rateOut + (out - p.rateOut) * kSmoothing;
        }
        r.rateIn = rate.rateIn;
        r.rateOut = rate.rateOut;
        m_procIn += rate.rateIn;
        m_procOut += rate.rateOut;
        rates.emplace(r.id, rate);
    }
    m_procRates = std::move(rates);

    // Exited or not, and does it look like what it claims to be.
    m_procAlerts = 0;
    std::vector<ProcessRow> list;
    list.reserve(rows.size());
    for (auto& [id, r] : rows) {
        if (id != 0) {
            const ProcessInfo& info = *infos.at(id);
            ProcessState& state = m_procStates[id];
            if (r.sockets == 0 && state.running && nowMs - state.checkedAt >= kRecheckMs) {
                state.running = ProcessMapper::Running(info);
                state.checkedAt = nowMs;
            }
            r.running = state.running;
            if (!info.path.empty()) {
                const TrustReport trust = ProcessTrust::Instance().Check(info.path);
                r.signature = trust.signature;
                r.risk = trust.risk();
            }
            if (r.running && r.risk == Risk::High) ++m_procAlerts;
        }
        list.push_back(std::move(r));
    }
    std::erase_if(m_procStates, [&](const auto& entry) { return !infos.contains(entry.first); });
    m_procInfo = std::move(infos);
    m_procCount = m_procInfo.size();
    m_procList.SetRows(std::move(list));
    if (m_page == Page::Processes) {
        InvalidateArea(m_procSummary);
        InvalidateArea(m_procCard);
        InvalidateArea(m_procDetailsCard);
    }
    UpdateControls();
}

std::shared_ptr<const ProcessInfo> MainWindow::SelectedProcess() const {
    const ProcessRow* row = m_procList.Selected();
    if (!row || row->id == 0) return nullptr;
    const auto it = m_procInfo.find(row->id);
    return it == m_procInfo.end() ? nullptr : it->second;
}

bool MainWindow::Actionable(const ProcessInfo* process) {
    return process && process->pid != 4 && !process->name.empty();
}

std::string MainWindow::AppToken(const ProcessInfo& process) const {
    // The name is short and survives updates that move a program to a new folder. The path is used
    // when the name alone would also hit another program: an imitation of a Windows component, or
    // a second program of the same name in another folder.
    bool byPath = (ProcessTrust::Instance().Check(process.path).flags & TrustFlag::Imitation) != 0;
    for (const auto& [id, other] : m_procInfo) {
        if (other->name == process.name && !other->pathKey.empty() && other->pathKey != process.pathKey) byPath = true;
    }
    if (process.path.empty()) byPath = false;
    return "app " + QuoteToken(byPath ? ToUtf8(process.path) : process.name);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Painting
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void MainWindow::PaintProcesses(Canvas& c) {
    const bool counting = m_ctl->Engine().Accounting();
    const std::wstring summary = counting ? Text::Format(IDS_PROC_SUMMARY, m_procCount, FormatRate(m_procIn), FormatRate(m_procOut))
                                          : Text::Format(IDS_PROC_COUNT, m_procCount);
    c.Text(summary, m_procSummary, Font::Caption, Color::Text2, Align::Right);
    const std::wstring adapter = m_adapters.empty() ? std::wstring() : ToWide(m_adapters[m_adapterIndex].FriendlyName);
    PaintCard(c, m_procCard, Text::Get(IDS_CARD_PROCESSES), counting ? Text::Format(IDS_PROC_ON_NOTE, adapter) : Text::Get(IDS_PROC_OFF_NOTE));
    PaintCard(c, m_procDetailsCard, {});
    PaintProcessDetails(c);
}

void MainWindow::PaintProcessDetails(Canvas& c) {
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    const D2D1_RECT_F& body = m_procDetailsBody;
    const ProcessRow* row = m_procList.Selected();
    if (!row) {
        c.Text(Text::Get(IDS_PROC_SELECT), body, Font::Body, Color::Text3, Align::Center);
        return;
    }
    const auto process = SelectedProcess();
    const float split = body.left + std::round((body.right - body.left) * 0.55f);
    const D2D1_RECT_F left{body.left, body.top, split - f.F(24), body.bottom};
    const D2D1_RECT_F right{split, body.top, body.right, body.bottom};
    const float lineH = f.F(24);

    // Heading: name, process id
    float x = left.left, y = left.top;
    if (row->risk == Risk::High) {
        c.Text(std::wstring(1, Icon::Warning), {x, y, x + f.F(22), y + f.F(28)}, Font::Icon, Color::Critical, Align::Center);
        x += f.F(30);
    }
    const std::wstring name = row->id == 0 ? Text::Get(IDS_PROC_NO_PROCESS) : row->name;
    const float nameW = std::min(c.Width(name, Font::Title) + 1, left.right - x);
    c.Text(name, {x, y, x + nameW, y + f.F(28)}, Font::Title, row->running ? Color::Text : Color::Text2);
    std::wstring tag = row->id == 0 ? std::wstring() : std::format(L"PID {}", row->pid);
    if (!row->running) tag += L"  ·  " + Text::Get(IDS_PROC_EXITED);
    c.Text(tag, {x + nameW + f.F(12), y, left.right, y + f.F(28)}, Font::Caption, Color::Text3);
    y += f.F(36);

    auto line = [&](const std::wstring& text, D2D1_COLOR_F color, wchar_t icon = 0, D2D1_COLOR_F iconColor = Color::Text3) {
        if (y + lineH > left.bottom + f.F(2)) return;
        float lx = left.left;
        if (icon) {
            c.Text(std::wstring(1, icon), {lx, y, lx + f.F(16), y + lineH}, Font::IconSmall, iconColor, Align::Center);
            lx += f.F(24);
        }
        c.Text(text, {lx, y, left.right, y + lineH}, Font::Caption, color);
        y += lineH;
    };

    if (process) {
        line(process->path.empty() ? Text::Get(IDS_SIG_NO_PATH) : process->path, Color::Text2, Icon::Folder);
        if (!process->path.empty()) {
            const TrustReport trust = ProcessTrust::Instance().Check(process->path);
            const bool high = trust.risk() == Risk::High;
            switch (trust.signature) {
            case Signature::Pending: line(Text::Get(IDS_SIG_PENDING), Color::Text3, Icon::Refresh); break;
            case Signature::Signed:
                line(trust.signer.empty() ? Text::Get(IDS_SIG_SIGNED_ANON) : Text::Format(IDS_SIG_SIGNED, trust.signer), Color::Text2, Icon::Check,
                     Color::Success);
                break;
            case Signature::Unsigned: line(Text::Get(IDS_SIG_UNSIGNED), high ? Color::Critical : Color::Caution, Icon::Warning, high ? Color::Critical : Color::Caution); break;
            case Signature::Invalid: line(Text::Get(IDS_SIG_INVALID), Color::Critical, Icon::Warning, Color::Critical); break;
            case Signature::Unknown: line(Text::Get(IDS_SIG_UNKNOWN), Color::Text3, Icon::Info); break;
            case Signature::Package:
                line(trust.signer.empty() ? Text::Get(IDS_SIG_PACKAGE_ANON) : Text::Format(IDS_SIG_PACKAGE, trust.signer), Color::Text2,
                     Icon::Check, Color::Success);
                break;
            }
            if (trust.risk() != Risk::None) {
                std::wstring reasons;
                for (const auto& [flag, text] : {std::pair{TrustFlag::Imitation, IDS_RISK_IMITATION}, std::pair{TrustFlag::Hidden, IDS_RISK_HIDDEN},
                                                 std::pair{TrustFlag::UserFolder, IDS_RISK_USER_FOLDER}}) {
                    if (!(trust.flags & flag)) continue;
                    if (!reasons.empty()) reasons += L"  ·  ";
                    reasons += Text::Get(text);
                }
                if (!reasons.empty()) line(reasons, high ? Color::Critical : Color::Caution, Icon::Info, high ? Color::Critical : Color::Caution);
            }
        }
        if (const std::wstring started = StartedText(process->started); !started.empty()) {
            line(Text::Format(IDS_PROC_STARTED, started), Color::Text3, Icon::Play);
        }
    } else {
        line(Text::Get(IDS_PROC_NO_PROCESS_NOTE), Color::Text2, Icon::Info);
    }
    if (row->counted) {
        line(Text::Format(IDS_PROC_TRAFFIC, FormatBytes(row->bytesIn), FormatCount(row->packetsIn), FormatBytes(row->bytesOut),
                          FormatCount(row->packetsOut)),
             Color::Text2, Icon::Speed);
    } else {
        line(Text::Get(IDS_PROC_NOT_COUNTED), Color::Text3, Icon::Speed);
    }

    // Sockets of this process, from the snapshot the list was built from.
    if (!process || !m_procSnapshot) return;
    std::vector<const Endpoint*> endpoints;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_procSnapshot->processes.size(); ++i) {
        if (m_procSnapshot->processes[i]->id != process->id) continue;
        for (const Endpoint& e : m_procSnapshot->endpoints) {
            if (e.process == i) endpoints.push_back(&e);
        }
    }
    std::ranges::stable_sort(endpoints, {}, [](const Endpoint* e) { return Rank(*e); });
    float ry = right.top + f.F(4);
    c.Text(std::format(L"{}  ·  {}", Text::Get(IDS_PROC_COL_SOCKETS), endpoints.size()), {right.left, ry, right.right, ry + f.F(20)}, Font::Label,
           Color::Text3);
    ry += f.F(28);
    if (endpoints.empty()) {
        c.Text(Text::Get(IDS_PROC_NO_SOCKETS), {right.left, ry, right.right, ry + f.F(20)}, Font::Caption, Color::Text3);
        return;
    }
    const float socketH = f.F(21);
    const size_t fit = static_cast<size_t>(std::max(1.0f, std::floor((right.bottom - ry) / socketH)));
    const size_t shown = endpoints.size() <= fit ? endpoints.size() : fit - 1;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < shown; ++i) {
        const Endpoint& e = *endpoints[i];
        const bool established = e.protocol == 6 && e.state == MIB_TCP_STATE_ESTAB;
        c.Text(EndpointText(e), {right.left, ry, right.right, ry + socketH}, Font::Mono, established ? Color::Text2 : Color::Text3);
        ry += socketH;
    }
    if (shown < endpoints.size()) {
        c.Text(Text::Format(IDS_PROC_MORE, endpoints.size() - shown), {right.left, ry, right.right, ry + socketH}, Font::Caption, Color::Text3);
    }
}

void MainWindow::ToggleMonitor() {
    const bool on = !m_ctl->Monitoring();
    if (!Report(m_ctl->SetMonitor(on), Text::Get(IDS_ERR_MONITOR).c_str())) return;
    Settings::WriteDword(L"ProcessMonitor", on ? 1 : 0);
    const std::wstring adapter = m_adapters.empty() ? std::wstring() : ToWide(m_adapters[m_adapterIndex].FriendlyName);
    SetStatus(on ? Level::Success : Level::Info, on ? Text::Format(IDS_MSG_MONITOR_ON, adapter) : Text::Get(IDS_MSG_MONITOR_OFF));
    m_procSampleUs = 0;  // rates start again from the next sample
    RefreshProcesses();
}

void MainWindow::ResetProcessCounters() {
    m_ctl->Engine().ResetProcessTotals();
    m_procRates.clear();
    m_procSampleUs = 0;
    RefreshProcesses();
}

void MainWindow::BlockProcess() {
    // A shared_ptr: the confirmation and the rule dialog run the message loop, and the timer may
    // rebuild the process list meanwhile.
    const auto process = SelectedProcess();
    if (!Actionable(process.get())) return;
    if (PartOfWindows(*process) && !Confirm(m_hwnd, Text::Get(IDS_DLG_PROC_SYSTEM), Text::Format(IDS_DLG_PROC_SYSTEM_MESSAGE, process->display),
                                            Text::Get(IDS_CONTINUE), true)) {
        return;
    }
    const std::wstring rule = ToWide("block " + AppToken(*process));
    ShowPage(Page::Firewall);
    if (AddRule(rule) && !m_ctl->FirewallEnabled()) SetStatus(Level::Warning, Text::Get(IDS_MSG_RULE_FW_OFF));
}

void MainWindow::LimitProcess() {
    const auto process = SelectedProcess();
    if (!Actionable(process.get())) return;
    DialogSpec spec;
    spec.heading = Text::Format(IDS_DLG_LIMIT, process->display);
    spec.message = Text::Get(IDS_DLG_LIMIT_MESSAGE);
    spec.fields.push_back({Text::Get(IDS_DLG_LIMIT_FIELD), std::to_wstring(m_profile.rateKbps ? m_profile.rateKbps : 1000), L"1000"});
    spec.ok = Text::Get(IDS_DLG_LIMIT_OK);
    spec.validate = [](const std::vector<std::wstring>& v) -> std::optional<std::wstring> {
        if (v.empty() || v[0].empty()) return std::wstring();  // nothing typed yet: no message, OK disabled
        if (!ParseKbps(v)) return Text::Get(IDS_DLG_LIMIT_BAD);
        return std::nullopt;
    };
    spec.preview = [](const std::vector<std::wstring>& v) {
        const auto kbps = ParseKbps(v);
        return kbps ? std::format(L"{}  ≈  {}", RateText(*kbps), FormatRate(*kbps * 125.0)) : std::wstring();
    };
    const DialogResult result = RunDialog(m_hwnd, spec);
    const auto kbps = result.button == 1 ? ParseKbps(result.values) : std::nullopt;
    if (!kbps) return;

    // A clean shaper for this program alone: no added delay or loss, both directions.
    m_profile.latencyMs = 0;
    m_profile.jitterMs = 0;
    m_profile.lossPercent = 0;
    m_profile.rateKbps = *kbps;
    m_profile.dir = Dir::Both;
    m_profile.preserveOrder = true;
    m_profile.match = AppToken(*process);
    m_profile.enabled = true;
    SyncSimulatorControls();
    ApplyProfile();
    m_delayHistory.clear();
    m_dropHistory.clear();
    m_lastSampleUs = 0;
    if (m_ctl->Impairment().enabled) SetStatus(Level::Success, Text::Format(IDS_MSG_PROC_LIMITED, process->display, RateText(*kbps)));
    UpdateControls();
}

void MainWindow::ImpairProcess() {
    const auto process = SelectedProcess();
    if (!Actionable(process.get())) return;
    SetWindowTextW(m_matchEdit, ToWide(AppToken(*process)).c_str());  // EN_CHANGE checks and applies it
    ShowPage(Page::Simulator);
}

void MainWindow::ShowProcessPackets() {
    const auto process = SelectedProcess();
    if (!Actionable(process.get())) return;
    SetWindowTextW(m_filterEdit, process->display.c_str());  // EN_CHANGE rebuilds the view
    ShowPage(Page::Capture);
}

void MainWindow::OpenProcessFolder() {
    const auto process = SelectedProcess();
    if (!process || process->path.empty()) return;
    if (PIDLIST_ABSOLUTE item = ILCreateFromPathW(process->path.c_str())) {
        SHOpenFolderAndSelectItems(item, 0, nullptr, 0);
        ILFree(item);
    }
}

void MainWindow::CopyProcessPath() {
    const auto process = SelectedProcess();
    if (!process || process->path.empty()) return;
    if (CopyToClipboard(m_hwnd, process->path)) SetStatus(Level::Info, Text::Get(IDS_PROC_COPIED));
}
```

`src/gui/MainWindowState.cpp`:

```cpp
// WireScope - Main window: driver and adapters, the UI timer, what is possible right now, settings.
#include "gui/Dialogs.h"
#include "gui/MainWindow.h"
#include "gui/MainWindowDetail.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <format>

namespace WS::Ui {
using namespace MainWindowDetail;

namespace {
constexpr size_t kHistory = 120;  // 60 s of 500 ms samples
}

void MainWindow::ConnectDriver() {
    if (auto r = m_bridge->Connect(); !r) {
        m_driverOk = false;
        m_driverText = IsElevated() ? Text::Format(IDS_MSG_DRIVER, r.error()) : Text::Get(IDS_MSG_ADMIN);
        m_list.SetPlaceholder(m_driverText);
        SetStatus(Level::Error, m_driverText);
        UpdateControls();
        return;
    }
    m_driverOk = true;
    if (const std::wstring notice = m_ctl->Attach(); !notice.empty()) SetStatus(m_ctl->CanControl() ? Level::Warning : Level::Info, notice);
    RefreshAdapters();
}

void MainWindow::RefreshAdapters() {
    auto list = m_bridge->QueryAdapters();
    if (!list || list->empty()) {
        m_adapters.clear();
        SetStatus(Level::Error, list ? Text::Get(IDS_MSG_NO_ADAPTERS) : list.error());
        UpdateControls();
        return;
    }
    // Keep the previous choice, else the saved one while its link is up, else the adapter with the
    // default route (the user may have moved from Ethernet to Wi-Fi since).
    const bool restart = m_adapters.empty();
    const std::string previous = restart ? ToUtf8(Settings::Read(L"Adapter")) : m_adapters[m_adapterIndex].SystemName;
    m_adapters = std::move(*list);
    size_t index = 0;
    bool found = false;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_adapters.size(); ++i) {
        if (!previous.empty() && m_adapters[i].SystemName == previous && (!restart || m_adapters[i].IsUp)) {
            index = i;
            found = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!found) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < m_adapters.size(); ++i) {
            if (m_adapters[i].HasGateway) {
                index = i;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    SelectAdapter(index);
}

void MainWindow::UpdateControls() {
    const bool driver = m_driverOk && !m_adapters.empty();
    const bool control = driver && m_ctl->CanControl();
    const bool capturing = m_ctl->Capturing();
    const int rule = m_rules.Selected();
    const bool ruleSelected = rule >= 0 && rule < static_cast<int>(m_ruleSet.size());
    auto enable = [&](UINT id, bool on) {
        HWND b = GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, static_cast<int>(id));
        if ((IsWindowEnabled(b) != FALSE) == on) return;
        if (!on && GetFocus() == b) SendMessageW(m_hwnd, WM_NEXTDLGCTL, 0, FALSE);  // never disable the focused control
        EnableWindow(b, on);
    };
    enable(CmdAdapter, driver && !m_ctl->AdapterLocked());
    enable(CmdStart, driver && !capturing);
    enable(CmdStop, capturing);
    enable(CmdSave, m_list.Count() > 0);
    enable(CmdKill, control);
    enable(CmdFwToggle, control);
    enable(CmdFwOffload, control);
    enable(CmdFwEdit, ruleSelected);
    enable(CmdFwRemove, ruleSelected);
    enable(CmdFwUp, ruleSelected && rule > 0);
    enable(CmdFwDown, ruleSelected && rule + 1 < static_cast<int>(m_ruleSet.size()));
    enable(CmdFwExport, !m_ruleSet.empty());
    enable(CmdSimToggle, control && m_matchError.empty());
    const auto process = SelectedProcess();
    const bool named = Actionable(process.get());
    enable(CmdProcMonitor, driver);
    enable(CmdProcBlock, named);
    enable(CmdProcLimit, named && control && m_matchError.empty());
    enable(CmdProcImpair, named);
    enable(CmdProcPackets, named);
    enable(CmdProcFolder, process && !process->path.empty());

    auto check = [&](UINT id, bool on) {
        ButtonLook& look = m_looks[id];
        if (look.checked == on) return;
        look.checked = on;
        InvalidateRect(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, static_cast<int>(id)), nullptr, FALSE);
    };
    check(CmdKill, m_ctl->KillSwitch());
    check(CmdFwToggle, m_ctl->FirewallEnabled());
    check(CmdFwOffload, m_offload);
    check(CmdSimToggle, m_ctl->Impairment().enabled);
    check(CmdProcMonitor, m_ctl->Monitoring());
    check(CmdSimOrder, m_profile.preserveOrder);
    check(CmdDirBoth, m_profile.dir == Dir::Both);
    check(CmdDirIn, m_profile.dir == Dir::In);
    check(CmdDirOut, m_profile.dir == Dir::Out);
    auto setText = [&](UINT id, const std::wstring& text) {  // only on change: every call repaints the button
        HWND b = GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, static_cast<int>(id));
        wchar_t current[256]{};
        GetWindowTextW(b, current, static_cast<int>(std::size(current)));
        if (text != current) SetWindowTextW(b, text.c_str());
    };
    setText(CmdKill, Text::Get(m_ctl->KillSwitch() ? IDS_KILL_ON : IDS_KILL));
    setText(CmdFwPolicy, Text::Format(IDS_FW_POLICY, Text::Get(m_policy == RuleAction::Allow ? IDS_ALLOW : IDS_BLOCK)));
    m_looks[CmdPageFirewall].badge = m_ctl->FirewallEnabled() ? std::to_wstring(m_ruleSet.size()) : std::wstring();
    m_looks[CmdPageSimulator].badge = m_ctl->Impairment().enabled ? std::wstring(L"●") : std::wstring();
    m_looks[CmdPageProcesses].badge = m_procAlerts > 0 ? std::to_wstring(m_procAlerts) : std::wstring();
    m_looks[CmdPageProcesses].alert = m_procAlerts > 0;
    for (UINT id : {CmdPageProcesses, CmdPageFirewall, CmdPageSimulator}) InvalidateRect(GetDlgItem(m_hwnd, static_cast<int>(id)), nullptr, FALSE);
    UpdateDriverControls();
    InvalidateArea(m_status);
}

void MainWindow::SetStatus(Level level, std::wstring text) {
    m_statusLevel = level;
    m_statusText = std::move(text);
    m_statusUntil = GetTickCount64() + (level == Level::Error ? 15000 : 6000);
    InvalidateArea(m_status);
}

bool MainWindow::Report(const std::expected<void, std::wstring>& result, const wchar_t* heading) {
    UpdateControls();
    if (result) return true;
    SetStatus(Level::Error, result.error());
    Inform(m_hwnd, heading, result.error(), true);
    return false;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Timer: new packets, counters, history
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void MainWindow::OnTimer() {
    if (!m_driverOk) return;
    if (m_revertAt) {
        if (GetTickCount64() >= m_revertAt) UndoChanges(true);
        else InvalidateArea(m_banner);  // the countdown
    }
    PullPackets();
    m_stats = m_ctl->Engine().GetStats();
    if (m_profileDirty) ApplyProfile();
    if (++m_tick % kSlowTicks == 0) {
        if (m_ctl->FirewallEnabled()) RefreshRuleRows();
        if (m_page == Page::Processes || m_ctl->Engine().Accounting()) RefreshProcesses();
        SampleSimulator();
        if (m_page == Page::Simulator) {
            InvalidateArea(m_liveCard);
            InvalidateArea(m_condCard);
        }
        UpdateControls();
    }
    InvalidateArea(m_status);
}

bool MainWindow::PassesFilter(const DecodedPacket& p) const {
    if (m_filter.empty()) return true;
    const std::string needle = ToUtf8(m_filter);
    if (ContainsIgnoreCase(p.ProtocolName, needle) || ContainsIgnoreCase(p.Source, needle) || ContainsIgnoreCase(p.Destination, needle) ||
        ContainsIgnoreCase(p.DomainOrHost, needle) || ContainsIgnoreCase(p.Info, needle) || ContainsIgnoreCase(p.Process, needle)) {
        return true;
    }
    const std::string ports = std::format("{} {}", p.SourcePort, p.DestPort);
    return p.SourcePort && ContainsIgnoreCase(ports, needle);
}

void MainWindow::PullPackets() {
    auto& engine = m_ctl->Engine();
    if (engine.ClearGeneration() != m_clearGeneration) {
        m_clearGeneration = engine.ClearGeneration();
        m_list.Clear();
    }
    std::vector<PacketRef> fresh;
    engine.CopyPacketsAfter(m_lastIndex, fresh);
    if (fresh.empty()) return;
    m_lastIndex = fresh.back()->Index;
    if (m_baseTime == 0) {
        m_baseTime = fresh.front()->TimestampUs;
        m_list.SetBaseTime(m_baseTime);
    }
    if (!m_filter.empty()) std::erase_if(fresh, [&](const PacketRef& p) { return !PassesFilter(*p); });
    const bool wasEmpty = m_list.Count() == 0;
    m_list.Append(fresh);
    if (wasEmpty && m_list.Count() > 0) UpdateControls();
}

void MainWindow::RebuildView() {
    auto all = m_ctl->Engine().GetRecentPackets();
    m_lastIndex = all.empty() ? m_lastIndex : all.back()->Index;
    if (!m_filter.empty()) std::erase_if(all, [&](const PacketRef& p) { return !PassesFilter(*p); });
    m_list.SetPlaceholder(Text::Get(m_filter.empty() ? IDS_LIST_EMPTY : IDS_LIST_NO_MATCH));
    m_list.SetRows(std::move(all));
    m_details.SetPacket(m_list.Selected(), m_baseTime);
    UpdateControls();
}

void MainWindow::RefreshRuleRows() {
    if (m_ctl->FirewallEnabled()) m_fw = m_ctl->PollFirewall();
    std::vector<RuleRow> rows;
    rows.reserve(m_ruleSet.size());
    for (const Rule& r : m_ruleSet) {
        RuleRow row;
        row.id = r.id;
        row.enabled = r.enabled;
        row.action = r.action;
        row.text = ToWide(r.text);
        row.summary = ToWide(Summarize(r.match));
        if (const auto it = m_fw.rules.find(r.id); it != m_fw.rules.end()) row.hits = it->second;
        rows.push_back(std::move(row));
    }
    m_rules.SetRows(std::move(rows));
    m_rules.SetPolicy(m_policy, m_fw.policy, m_ctl->FirewallEnabled());
}

void MainWindow::SampleSimulator() {
    const uint64_t now = MonotonicMicroseconds();
    const uint64_t dropped = m_stats.SimDropped + m_stats.SimOverflow;
    if (m_lastSampleUs) {
        const double seconds = std::max(0.001, static_cast<double>(now - m_lastSampleUs) / 1e6);
        const uint64_t bytes = m_stats.SimBytes - std::min(m_stats.SimBytes, m_lastSimBytes);
        const double kbps = (static_cast<double>(bytes) * 8.0) / seconds / 1000.0;
        m_throughputHistory.push_back(kbps);
        while (m_throughputHistory.size() > kHistory) m_throughputHistory.pop_front();

        if (m_ctl->Impairment().enabled) {
            const uint64_t delayed = m_stats.SimDelayed - std::min(m_stats.SimDelayed, m_lastDelayed);
            const uint64_t delaySum = m_stats.SimDelaySumUs - std::min(m_stats.SimDelaySumUs, m_lastDelaySum);
            // No packet delayed in the interval: keep the line at the configured latency instead of 0.
            const double avg = delayed ? static_cast<double>(delaySum) / static_cast<double>(delayed) / 1000.0
                                       : (m_delayHistory.empty() ? 0.0 : m_delayHistory.back());
            m_delayHistory.push_back(avg);
            m_dropHistory.push_back(static_cast<double>(dropped - std::min(dropped, m_lastDropped)) / seconds);
            while (m_delayHistory.size() > kHistory) m_delayHistory.pop_front();
            while (m_dropHistory.size() > kHistory) m_dropHistory.pop_front();
        }
    }
    m_lastSampleUs = now;
    m_lastDelayed = m_stats.SimDelayed;
    m_lastDelaySum = m_stats.SimDelaySumUs;
    m_lastDropped = dropped;
    m_lastSimBytes = m_stats.SimBytes;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Settings
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void MainWindow::LoadSettings() {
    m_split = std::clamp(static_cast<float>(Settings::ReadDword(L"Split", 580)) / 1000.0f, 0.25f, 0.85f);
    if (auto parsed = ParseRulesText(ToUtf8(Settings::Read(L"FirewallRules")))) {
        m_ruleSet = std::move(*parsed);
        for (Rule& r : m_ruleSet) r.id = m_ctl->NewRuleId();
    }
    (void)m_ctl->SetRules(m_ruleSet);
    m_policy = Settings::ReadDword(L"FirewallPolicy", 0) ? RuleAction::Block : RuleAction::Allow;
    (void)m_ctl->SetPolicy(m_policy);
    m_offload = Settings::ReadDword(L"KernelOffload", 1) != 0;
    (void)m_ctl->SetKernelOffload(m_offload);

    m_profile.latencyMs = std::min<uint32_t>(Settings::ReadDword(L"SimLatency", 120), 2000);
    m_profile.jitterMs = std::min<uint32_t>(Settings::ReadDword(L"SimJitter", 20), 500);
    m_profile.lossPercent = std::min(100.0, Settings::ReadDword(L"SimLoss", 20) / 10.0);
    const DWORD dir = Settings::ReadDword(L"SimDirection", 3);
    m_profile.dir = dir == 1 ? Dir::In : dir == 2 ? Dir::Out : Dir::Both;
    m_profile.preserveOrder = Settings::ReadDword(L"SimOrder", 1) != 0;
    m_profile.rateKbps = std::min<uint32_t>(Settings::ReadDword(L"SimRate", 0), 1'000'000);
    m_profile.match = ToUtf8(Settings::Read(L"SimMatch"));
    m_profile.enabled = false;  // never impair the network unasked at start-up
    if (auto selector = ParseSelector(m_profile.match); !selector) m_profile.match.clear();
    m_page = static_cast<Page>(std::min<DWORD>(Settings::ReadDword(L"Page", 0), static_cast<DWORD>(Page::Driver)));
}

void MainWindow::SaveRules() {
    Settings::Write(L"FirewallRules", ToWide(FormatRulesText(m_ruleSet)));
    Settings::WriteDword(L"FirewallPolicy", m_policy == RuleAction::Block ? 1 : 0);
    Settings::WriteDword(L"KernelOffload", m_offload ? 1 : 0);
}

void MainWindow::SaveSimulator() {
    Settings::WriteDword(L"SimLatency", m_profile.latencyMs);
    Settings::WriteDword(L"SimJitter", m_profile.jitterMs);
    Settings::WriteDword(L"SimLoss", static_cast<DWORD>(std::lround(m_profile.lossPercent * 10)));
    Settings::WriteDword(L"SimDirection", static_cast<DWORD>(m_profile.dir));
    Settings::WriteDword(L"SimOrder", m_profile.preserveOrder ? 1 : 0);
    Settings::WriteDword(L"SimRate", m_profile.rateKbps);
    Settings::Write(L"SimMatch", ToWide(m_profile.match));
}

void MainWindow::SyncSimulatorControls() {
    m_latency.SetValue(m_profile.latencyMs);
    m_jitter.SetValue(m_profile.jitterMs);
    m_loss.SetValue(m_profile.lossPercent);
    m_rate.SetValue(m_profile.rateKbps);
    SetWindowTextW(m_matchEdit, ToWide(m_profile.match).c_str());
    m_matchError.clear();
    if (m_page == Page::Simulator) InvalidateArea(m_condCard);
}

}  // namespace WS::Ui
```
