```cpp
#include "gui/Menus.h"
#include "gui/Widgets.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace WS::Ui {
namespace {
const Fonts* g_fonts = nullptr;  // fonts of the menu being tracked (one modal menu loop at a time)
}

PopupMenu::PopupMenu() : m_menu(CreatePopupMenu()), m_background(CreateSolidBrush(ToColorRef(Color::Flyout))) {
    MENUINFO info{sizeof info};
    info.fMask = MIM_BACKGROUND | MIM_STYLE;
    info.hbrBack = m_background.get();
    info.dwStyle = MNS_CHECKORBMP;
    SetMenuInfo(m_menu.get(), &info);
}

void PopupMenu::AddItem(UINT id, std::wstring text, std::wstring shortcut, bool checked, bool radio, bool enabled) {
    auto data = std::make_unique<Data>(Data{std::move(text), std::move(shortcut), false, radio, false});
    MENUITEMINFOW item{sizeof item};
    item.fMask = MIIM_FTYPE | MIIM_ID | MIIM_DATA | MIIM_STRING | MIIM_STATE;
    item.fType = MFT_OWNERDRAW | (radio ? MFT_RADIOCHECK : 0);
    item.fState = (checked ? MFS_CHECKED : 0) | (enabled ? 0 : MFS_DISABLED);
    item.wID = id;
    item.dwItemData = reinterpret_cast<ULONG_PTR>(data.get());
    item.dwTypeData = data->text.data();  // kept for accessibility tools
    InsertMenuItemW(m_menu.get(), static_cast<UINT>(GetMenuItemCount(m_menu.get())), TRUE, &item);
    m_data.push_back(std::move(data));
}

void PopupMenu::AddHeader(std::wstring text) {
    auto data = std::make_unique<Data>(Data{std::move(text), {}, false, false, true});
    MENUITEMINFOW item{sizeof item};
    item.fMask = MIIM_FTYPE | MIIM_ID | MIIM_DATA | MIIM_STRING | MIIM_STATE;
    item.fType = MFT_OWNERDRAW;
    item.fState = MFS_DISABLED;
    item.wID = 0;
    item.dwItemData = reinterpret_cast<ULONG_PTR>(data.get());
    item.dwTypeData = data->text.data();
    InsertMenuItemW(m_menu.get(), static_cast<UINT>(GetMenuItemCount(m_menu.get())), TRUE, &item);
    m_data.push_back(std::move(data));
}

void PopupMenu::AddSeparator() {
    auto data = std::make_unique<Data>(Data{{}, {}, true, false, false});
    MENUITEMINFOW item{sizeof item};
    item.fMask = MIIM_FTYPE | MIIM_DATA;
    item.fType = MFT_OWNERDRAW | MFT_SEPARATOR;
    item.dwItemData = reinterpret_cast<ULONG_PTR>(data.get());
    InsertMenuItemW(m_menu.get(), static_cast<UINT>(GetMenuItemCount(m_menu.get())), TRUE, &item);
    m_data.push_back(std::move(data));
}

UINT PopupMenu::Track(HWND owner, const Fonts& fonts, POINT screen, const RECT* exclude) {
    g_fonts = &fonts;
    TPMPARAMS params{sizeof params, {}};
    if (exclude) params.rcExclude = *exclude;
    const UINT command = static_cast<UINT>(TrackPopupMenuEx(m_menu.get(), TPM_LEFTALIGN | TPM_TOPALIGN | TPM_VERTICAL | TPM_RETURNCMD |
                                                                              TPM_RIGHTBUTTON,
                                                            screen.x, screen.y, owner, exclude ? &params : nullptr));
    g_fonts = nullptr;
    return command;
}

bool PopupMenu::Measure(MEASUREITEMSTRUCT& mis) {
    const auto* data = reinterpret_cast<const Data*>(mis.itemData);
    if (!data || !g_fonts) return false;
    const Fonts& f = *g_fonts;
    if (data->separator) {
        mis.itemWidth = static_cast<UINT>(f.S(40));
        mis.itemHeight = static_cast<UINT>(f.S(9));
        return true;
    }
    const Font font = data->header ? Font::Label : Font::Body;
    const float text = TextWidth(f, font, data->text);
    const float shortcut = data->shortcut.empty() ? 0 : TextWidth(f, Font::Caption, data->shortcut) + f.F(32);
    mis.itemWidth = static_cast<UINT>(f.F(36) + text + shortcut + f.F(20));
    mis.itemHeight = static_cast<UINT>(f.S(data->header ? 26 : 32));
    return true;
}

bool PopupMenu::Draw(const DRAWITEMSTRUCT& dis) {
    const auto* data = reinterpret_cast<const Data*>(dis.itemData);
    if (!data || !g_fonts) return false;
    const Fonts& f = *g_fonts;
    const bool disabled = dis.itemState & (ODS_DISABLED | ODS_GRAYED);
    const bool selected = (dis.itemState & ODS_SELECTED) && !disabled;
    const bool checked = dis.itemState & ODS_CHECKED;
    Ui::Paint(dis.hDC, dis.rcItem, f, [&](Canvas& c) {
        const D2D1_RECT_F r = ToF(dis.rcItem);
        c.Clear(Color::Flyout);
        if (data->separator) {
            const float y = std::floor((r.top + r.bottom) / 2) + 0.5f;
            c.Line({r.left + f.F(4), y}, {r.right - f.F(4), y}, Color::FlyoutStroke);
            return;
        }
        if (data->header) {
            c.Text(data->text, {r.left + f.F(14), r.top + f.F(4), r.right - f.F(12), r.bottom}, Font::Label, Color::Text3);
            return;
        }
        if (selected) c.Fill(Inset(r, f.F(4), f.F(2)), Color::FlyoutHot, f.F(4));
        const D2D1_COLOR_F fg = disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : Color::Text;
        if (checked) {
            if (data->radio) {
                c.Circle({r.left + f.F(20), (r.top + r.bottom) / 2}, f.F(3.5f), disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : Color::AccentText);
            } else {
                c.Text(std::wstring(1, Icon::Check), {r.left + f.F(10), r.top, r.left + f.F(30), r.bottom}, Font::IconSmall, fg,
                       Align::Center);
            }
        }
        c.Text(data->text, {r.left + f.F(36), r.top, r.right - f.F(12), r.bottom}, Font::Body, fg);
        if (!data->shortcut.empty()) {
            c.Text(data->shortcut, {r.left, r.top, r.right - f.F(16), r.bottom}, Font::Caption,
                   disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : Color::Text3, Align::Right);
        }
    });
    return true;
}

}  // namespace WS::Ui
```

```h
// WireScope - Owner-drawn popup menus in the dark palette (adapter picker, presets, context menus).
#pragma once
#include "gui/Theme.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace WS::Ui {

class PopupMenu {
public:
    PopupMenu();
    PopupMenu(const PopupMenu&) = delete;
    PopupMenu& operator=(const PopupMenu&) = delete;

    void AddItem(UINT id, std::wstring text, std::wstring shortcut = {}, bool checked = false, bool radio = false,
                 bool enabled = true);
    void AddSeparator();
    void AddHeader(std::wstring text);  // disabled caption line

    // Modal; returns the chosen command or 0. `exclude` keeps the menu clear of that screen rectangle
    // (e.g. drops it below the button that opened it).
    UINT Track(HWND owner, const Fonts& fonts, POINT screen, const RECT* exclude = nullptr);

    // The owner forwards WM_MEASUREITEM / WM_DRAWITEM with CtlType == ODT_MENU here.
    static bool Measure(MEASUREITEMSTRUCT& mis);
    static bool Draw(const DRAWITEMSTRUCT& dis);

private:
    struct Data {
        std::wstring text, shortcut;
        bool separator = false, radio = false, header = false;
    };
    MenuHandle m_menu;
    Gdi<HBRUSH> m_background;
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Data>> m_data;
};

}  // namespace WS::Ui
```

`src/gui/PacketDetails.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "gui/PacketDetails.h"
#include "gui/PacketList.h"
#include "resources/resource.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <windowsx.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <format>

namespace WS::Ui {
namespace {

constexpr wchar_t kClass[] = L"WireScope.PacketDetails";

std::wstring WallClock(uint64_t timestampUs) {
    const uint64_t ft = timestampUs * 10 + 116444736000000000ULL;  // Unix epoch -> FILETIME
    FILETIME utc{static_cast<DWORD>(ft), static_cast<DWORD>(ft >> 32)}, local{};
    SYSTEMTIME st{};
    FileTimeToLocalFileTime(&utc, &local);
    FileTimeToSystemTime(&local, &st);
    return std::format(L"{:02}:{:02}:{:02}.{:06}", st.wHour, st.wMinute, st.wSecond, timestampUs % 1'000'000);
}

}  // namespace

HWND PacketDetails::Create(HWND parent, int id) {
    RegisterControlClass(kClass, Proc);
    m_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(0, kClass, L"Packet details", WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | WS_TABSTOP, 0, 0, 10, 10, parent,
                             reinterpret_cast<HMENU>(static_cast<INT_PTR>(id)), GetModuleHandleW(nullptr), this);
    return m_hwnd;
}

LRESULT CALLBACK PacketDetails::Proc(HWND hwnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    auto* self = ControlFromWindow<PacketDetails>(hwnd, message, lParam);
    if (message == WM_NCCREATE && self) self->m_hwnd = hwnd;
    if (message == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA, 0);
        if (self) self->m_hwnd = nullptr;
        return DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
    }
    return self ? self->Handle(message, wParam, lParam) : DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

void PacketDetails::SetPacket(PacketRef packet, uint64_t baseTimeUs) {
    if (packet == m_packet) return;
    m_packet = std::move(packet);
    m_fields.clear();
    m_title.clear();
    m_subtitle.clear();
    m_fate.clear();
    m_scroll.offset = 0;
    if (m_packet) {
        const DecodedPacket& p = *m_packet;
        m_title = Text::Format(IDS_DET_TITLE, p.Index, ToWide(p.ProtocolName));
        const double rel = p.TimestampUs >= baseTimeUs ? static_cast<double>(p.TimestampUs - baseTimeUs) / 1e6 : 0.0;
        m_subtitle = std::format(L"{}  \u00B7  {}  \u00B7  {}  \u00B7  +{:.6f} s", Text::Get(p.Dir == Direction::Outbound ? IDS_DIR_OUT : IDS_DIR_IN),
                                 Text::Format(IDS_DET_LENGTH, p.Length), WallClock(p.TimestampUs), rel);
        if (!p.DomainOrHost.empty()) m_subtitle += L"  ·  " + ToWide(p.DomainOrHost);
        if (!p.Process.empty()) m_subtitle += L"  ·  [" + ToWide(p.Process) + L"]";
        switch (p.Fate) {
        case PacketFate::Observed: m_fate = Text::Get(IDS_FATE_OBSERVED_LONG); m_fateColor = Color::Text3; break;
        case PacketFate::Passed: m_fate = Text::Get(IDS_FATE_PASSED_LONG); m_fateColor = Color::Success; break;
        case PacketFate::Delayed:
            m_fate = Text::Format(IDS_FATE_DELAYED_LONG, static_cast<double>(p.DelayUs) / 1000.0);
            m_fateColor = Color::Caution;
            break;
        case PacketFate::Dropped: m_fate = Text::Get(IDS_FATE_DROPPED_LONG); m_fateColor = Color::Critical; break;
        case PacketFate::Blocked: m_fate = Text::Get(IDS_FATE_BLOCKED_LONG); m_fateColor = Color::Critical; break;
        case PacketFate::Killed: m_fate = Text::Get(IDS_FATE_KILLED_LONG); m_fateColor = Color::Critical; break;
        }
        m_fields = PacketParser::Breakdown(p.RawData);
        if (!p.Info.empty()) m_fields.push_back({"Summary", "Info", p.Info});
    }
    m_measuredWidth = -1;
    if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

std::wstring PacketDetails::Text() const {
    if (!m_packet) return {};
    std::wstring out = m_title + L"\r\n" + m_subtitle + L"\r\n" + m_fate + L"\r\n";
    std::string layer;
    for (const auto& field : m_fields) {
        if (field.layer != layer) {
            layer = field.layer;
            out += L"\r\n" + ToWide(layer) + L"\r\n";
        }
        out += std::format(L"  {:<22}{}\r\n", ToWide(field.name), ToWide(field.value));
    }
    return out;
}

std::wstring PacketDetails::HexText() const {
    if (!m_packet) return {};
    std::wstring hex = ToWide(FormatHexDump(m_packet->RawData, m_packet->RawData.size()));
    std::wstring out;
    for (wchar_t c : hex) {
        if (c == L'\n') out += L'\r';
        out += c;
    }
    return out;
}

void PacketDetails::Relayout() {
    m_measuredWidth = -1;
    if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

void PacketDetails::Measure(float width) {
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    m_measuredWidth = width;
    m_twoColumns = width >= f.F(820);
    const float line = f.F(20);
    // Header block + one line per field + a line per layer heading.
    size_t layers = 0;
    std::string layer;
    for (const auto& field : m_fields) {
        if (field.layer != layer) {
            layer = field.layer;
            ++layers;
        }
    }
    const float headers = f.F(78) + static_cast<float>(m_fields.size()) * line + static_cast<float>(layers) * f.F(28);
    const size_t hexLines = m_packet ? (m_packet->RawData.size() + 15) / 16 : 0;
    const float hex = f.F(34) + static_cast<float>(hexLines) * f.F(17);
    m_scroll.content = (m_twoColumns ? std::max(headers, hex) : headers + hex) + f.F(12);
}

LRESULT PacketDetails::Handle(UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    RECT client{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
    switch (message) {
    case WM_ERASEBKGND:
        return 1;
    case WM_PAINT:
        Paint();
        return 0;
    case WM_SIZE:
        m_measuredWidth = -1;
        InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    case WM_GETDLGCODE:
        return DLGC_WANTARROWS;
    case WM_KEYDOWN: {
        const float step = m_fonts.F(20), before = m_scroll.offset;
        switch (wParam) {
        case VK_UP: m_scroll.ScrollTo(m_scroll.offset - step); break;
        case VK_DOWN: m_scroll.ScrollTo(m_scroll.offset + step); break;
        case VK_PRIOR: m_scroll.ScrollTo(m_scroll.offset - m_scroll.view); break;
        case VK_NEXT: m_scroll.ScrollTo(m_scroll.offset + m_scroll.view); break;
        case VK_HOME: m_scroll.ScrollTo(0); break;
        case VK_END: m_scroll.ScrollTo(m_scroll.Max()); break;
        default: return DefWindowProcW(m_hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
        }
        if (m_scroll.offset != before) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_LBUTTONDOWN:
    case WM_RBUTTONDOWN: {
        SetFocus(m_hwnd);
        if (message == WM_LBUTTONDOWN && m_scroll.MouseDown({GET_X_LPARAM(lParam), GET_Y_LPARAM(lParam)}, client, m_fonts)) {
            SetCapture(m_hwnd);
            InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        }
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_MOUSEMOVE: {
        TRACKMOUSEEVENT tme{sizeof tme, TME_LEAVE, m_hwnd, 0};
        TrackMouseEvent(&tme);
        if (m_scroll.MouseMove({GET_X_LPARAM(lParam), GET_Y_LPARAM(lParam)}, client, m_fonts)) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_MOUSELEAVE:
        if (m_scroll.hot) {
            m_scroll.hot = false;
            InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        }
        return 0;
    case WM_LBUTTONUP:
        if (m_scroll.dragging) {
            m_scroll.dragging = false;
            ReleaseCapture();
            InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        }
        return 0;
    case WM_CAPTURECHANGED:
        m_scroll.dragging = false;
        return 0;
    case WM_MOUSEWHEEL:
        if (m_scroll.Wheel(GET_WHEEL_DELTA_WPARAM(wParam), WheelStep(m_fonts, m_fonts.F(20)))) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(m_hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

void PacketDetails::Paint() {
    PaintScope ps(m_hwnd);
    RECT client{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    Ui::Paint(ps.dc(), client, f, [&](Canvas& c) {
        c.Clear(Graphics::Get().Surface(Color::Card));
        const float width = static_cast<float>(client.right);
        if (!m_packet) {
            c.Text(Text::Get(IDS_DET_EMPTY), ToF(client), Font::Body, Color::Text3, Align::Center);
            return;
        }
        if (width != m_measuredWidth) Measure(width);
        m_scroll.view = static_cast<float>(client.bottom);
        m_scroll.Clamp();

        const float pad = f.F(16);
        const float right = width - f.F(14);
        const float split = m_twoColumns ? std::floor(width * 0.46f) : right;
        c.PushClip(ToF(client));
        float y = f.F(12) - m_scroll.offset;

        // Title, subtitle and what happened to the packet.
        const D2D1_COLOR_F pc = ProtocolColor(*m_packet);
        c.Fill({pad, y + f.F(6), pad + f.F(4), y + f.F(24)}, pc, f.F(2));
        c.Text(m_title, {pad + f.F(12), y, split - pad, y + f.F(30)}, Font::Title, Color::Text);
        y += f.F(30);
        c.Text(m_subtitle, {pad, y, split - pad, y + f.F(18)}, Font::Caption, Color::Text2);
        y += f.F(20);
        c.Circle({pad + f.F(4), y + f.F(9)}, f.F(3.5f), m_fateColor);
        c.Text(m_fate, {pad + f.F(14), y, split - pad, y + f.F(18)}, Font::Caption, m_fateColor);
        y += f.F(28);

        // Header fields grouped by layer.
        const float keyW = std::min(f.F(150), (split - pad * 2) * 0.42f);
        std::string layer;
        for (const auto& field : m_fields) {
            if (field.layer != layer) {
                layer = field.layer;
                y += f.F(6);
                c.Text(ToWide(layer), {pad, y, split - pad, y + f.F(18)}, Font::Label, Color::AccentText);
                y += f.F(22);
            }
            c.Text(ToWide(field.name), {pad + f.F(8), y, pad + keyW, y + f.F(20)}, Font::Caption, Color::Text3);
            c.Text(ToWide(field.value), {pad + keyW, y, split - pad, y + f.F(20)}, Font::Body, Color::Text);
            y += f.F(20);
        }

        // Hex dump: offset, 16 bytes, ASCII.
        float hx = m_twoColumns ? split + pad : pad;
        float hy = m_twoColumns ? f.F(12) - m_scroll.offset : y + f.F(14);
        if (m_twoColumns) c.Line({split, f.F(12)}, {split, static_cast<float>(client.bottom) - f.F(12)}, Color::CardStroke);
        c.Text(Text::Format(IDS_DET_BYTES, m_packet->RawData.size()), {hx, hy, right, hy + f.F(18)}, Font::Label, Color::Text3);
        hy += f.F(26);
        const auto& raw = m_packet->RawData;
        const float charW = c.Width(L"0", Font::Mono);
        for (size_t at = 0; at < raw.size(); at += 16) {
            const float lineTop = hy, lineBottom = hy + f.F(17);
            hy = lineBottom;
            if (lineBottom < 0 || lineTop > static_cast<float>(client.bottom)) continue;
            std::wstring bytes, ascii;
            for (size_t i = at; i < at + 16; ++i) {
                if (i < raw.size()) {
                    bytes += std::format(L"{:02X} ", raw[i]);
                    ascii += (raw[i] >= 32 && raw[i] < 127) ? static_cast<wchar_t>(raw[i]) : L'·';
                } else {
                    bytes += L"   ";
                }
                if (i - at == 7) bytes += L' ';
            }
            c.Text(std::format(L"{:04X}", at), {hx, lineTop, hx + charW * 5, lineBottom}, Font::Mono, Color::Text3);
            const float bx = hx + charW * 6;
            c.Text(bytes, {bx, lineTop, bx + charW * 50, lineBottom}, Font::Mono, Color::Text2);
            c.Text(ascii, {bx + charW * 50, lineTop, right, lineBottom}, Font::Mono, Color::Text3);
        }
        c.PopClip();
        m_scroll.Draw(c, client);
    });
}

}  // namespace WS::Ui
```

`src/gui/PacketList.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "gui/PacketList.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <windowsx.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <charconv>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>

namespace WS::Ui {
namespace {

constexpr wchar_t kClass[] = L"WireScope.PacketList";
constexpr size_t kMaxRows = 20000;

bool CtrlDown() { return (GetKeyState(VK_CONTROL) & 0x8000) != 0; }
bool ShiftDown() { return (GetKeyState(VK_SHIFT) & 0x8000) != 0; }

// "192.168.0.10" as a number, so that 10.0.0.2 sorts before 192.168.0.1; nullopt for anything else.
std::optional<uint32_t> Ipv4(std::string_view s) {
    uint32_t value = 0;
    for (int part = 0; part < 4; ++part) {
        unsigned octet = 0;
        const auto [end, ec] = std::from_chars(s.data(), s.data() + s.size(), octet);
        if (ec != std::errc{} || octet > 255 || end == s.data()) return std::nullopt;
        value = (value << 8) | octet;
        s.remove_prefix(static_cast<size_t>(end - s.data()));
        if (part < 3) {
            if (s.empty() || s.front() != '.') return std::nullopt;
            s.remove_prefix(1);
        }
    }
    return s.empty() ? std::optional<uint32_t>(value) : std::nullopt;
}

// IPv4 first and in numeric order, then the rest (IPv6, MAC) as text; the port breaks a tie.
int CompareEndpoint(const std::string& a, uint16_t portA, const std::string& b, uint16_t portB) {
    const auto va = Ipv4(a), vb = Ipv4(b);
    if (va && vb) {
        if (*va != *vb) return *va < *vb ? -1 : 1;
    } else if (va || vb) {
        return va ? -1 : 1;
    } else if (const int c = a.compare(b); c != 0) {
        return c < 0 ? -1 : 1;
    }
    return portA < portB ? -1 : portA > portB ? 1 : 0;
}

int CompareText(const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
    const int c = _stricmp(a.c_str(), b.c_str());
    return c < 0 ? -1 : c > 0 ? 1 : 0;
}

template <class T>
int Compare(T a, T b) {
    return a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0;
}

}  // namespace

HWND PacketList::Create(HWND parent, int id) {
    RegisterControlClass(kClass, Proc);
    m_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(0, kClass, L"Packets", WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | WS_TABSTOP, 0, 0, 10, 10, parent,
                             reinterpret_cast<HMENU>(static_cast<INT_PTR>(id)), GetModuleHandleW(nullptr), this);
    return m_hwnd;
}

LRESULT CALLBACK PacketList::Proc(HWND hwnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    auto* self = ControlFromWindow<PacketList>(hwnd, message, lParam);
    if (message == WM_NCCREATE && self) self->m_hwnd = hwnd;
    if (message == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA, 0);
        if (self) self->m_hwnd = nullptr;
        return DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
    }
    return self ? self->Handle(message, wParam, lParam) : DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Order
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
bool PacketList::Before(const DecodedPacket& a, const DecodedPacket& b) const {
    int key = 0;
    switch (m_sort) {
    case Sort::Number: break;
    case Sort::Time: key = Compare(a.TimestampUs, b.TimestampUs); break;
    case Sort::Direction: key = Compare(static_cast<int>(a.Dir), static_cast<int>(b.Dir)); break;
    case Sort::Protocol: key = CompareText(a.ProtocolName, b.ProtocolName); break;
    case Sort::Source: key = CompareEndpoint(a.Source, a.SourcePort, b.Source, b.SourcePort); break;
    case Sort::Destination: key = CompareEndpoint(a.Destination, a.DestPort, b.Destination, b.DestPort); break;
    case Sort::Length: key = Compare(a.Length, b.Length); break;
    case Sort::Info: key = CompareText(a.Info, b.Info); break;
    }
    if (key == 0) key = Compare(a.Index, b.Index);  // a strict order: equal keys keep capture order
    return m_descending ? key > 0 : key < 0;
}

void PacketList::SetSort(Sort sort) {
    if (sort == m_sort) {
        m_descending = !m_descending;
    } else {
        m_sort = sort;
        m_descending = false;
    }
    std::stable_sort(m_rows.begin(), m_rows.end(), [this](const PacketRef& a, const PacketRef& b) { return Before(*a, *b); });
    m_hot = -1;
    Refocus();
    // The newest packet is at one end only when sorted by number; then the view follows it again.
    m_follow = m_sort == Sort::Number && m_focus == 0;
    if (m_follow) m_scroll.offset = m_descending ? 0 : m_scroll.Max();
    UpdateExtent();
    if (m_selected >= 0) m_scroll.EnsureVisible(static_cast<float>(m_selected) * RowH(), static_cast<float>(m_selected + 1) * RowH());
    if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

int PacketList::RowOf(uint64_t index) const {
    if (index == 0) return -1;
    if (m_sort == Sort::Number) {  // sorted by Index: binary search
        auto less = [this](const PacketRef& p, uint64_t i) { return m_descending ? p->Index > i : p->Index < i; };
        const auto it = std::lower_bound(m_rows.begin(), m_rows.end(), index, less);
        return it != m_rows.end() && (*it)->Index == index ? static_cast<int>(it - m_rows.begin()) : -1;
    }
    const auto it = std::find_if(m_rows.begin(), m_rows.end(), [index](const PacketRef& p) { return p->Index == index; });
    return it == m_rows.end() ? -1 : static_cast<int>(it - m_rows.begin());
}

void PacketList::Refocus() {
    m_selected = RowOf(m_focus);
    if (m_selected < 0) m_focus = 0;
}

void PacketList::UpdateExtent() {
    RECT rc{};
    if (m_hwnd) GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &rc);
    m_scroll.view = std::max(0.0f, static_cast<float>(rc.bottom) - HeaderH());
    m_scroll.content = static_cast<float>(m_rows.size()) * RowH();
    if (m_follow) m_scroll.offset = m_sort == Sort::Number && m_descending ? 0 : m_scroll.Max();
    m_scroll.Clamp();
}

void PacketList::Trim() {
    if (m_rows.size() <= kMaxRows) return;
    const size_t drop = m_rows.size() - kMaxRows + kMaxRows / 10;
    if (Chronological()) {
        m_rows.erase(m_rows.begin(), m_rows.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(drop));
        m_scroll.offset -= static_cast<float>(drop) * RowH();
    } else {
        // The oldest packets go, wherever the order put them.
        std::vector<uint64_t> indexes;
        indexes.reserve(m_rows.size());
        for (const auto& p : m_rows) indexes.push_back(p->Index);
        std::nth_element(indexes.begin(), indexes.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(drop), indexes.end());
        const uint64_t keepFrom = indexes[drop];
        std::erase_if(m_rows, [keepFrom](const PacketRef& p) { return p->Index < keepFrom; });
    }
    const uint64_t oldest = m_rows.empty() ? 0 : (*std::min_element(m_rows.begin(), m_rows.end(), [](const PacketRef& a, const PacketRef& b) {
                                                     return a->Index < b->Index;
                                                 }))->Index;
    std::erase_if(m_marked, [oldest](uint64_t i) { return i < oldest; });
    if (m_anchor < oldest) m_anchor = 0;
    Refocus();
    m_hot = -1;
}

void PacketList::SetRows(std::vector<PacketRef> rows) {
    m_rows = std::move(rows);
    if (!Chronological()) {
        std::stable_sort(m_rows.begin(), m_rows.end(), [this](const PacketRef& a, const PacketRef& b) { return Before(*a, *b); });
    }
    std::unordered_set<uint64_t> listed;  // a filter may have hidden selected packets
    listed.reserve(m_rows.size());
    for (const auto& p : m_rows) listed.insert(p->Index);
    std::erase_if(m_marked, [&](uint64_t i) { return !listed.contains(i); });
    m_hot = -1;
    Refocus();
    Trim();
    UpdateExtent();
    if (m_selected >= 0 && !m_follow) m_scroll.EnsureVisible(static_cast<float>(m_selected) * RowH(), static_cast<float>(m_selected + 1) * RowH());
    if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

void PacketList::Append(const std::vector<PacketRef>& rows) {
    if (rows.empty()) return;
    if (Chronological()) {
        m_rows.insert(m_rows.end(), rows.begin(), rows.end());
    } else {
        // Sort the new batch and merge it in: linear, instead of sorting the whole list every tick.
        auto before = [this](const PacketRef& a, const PacketRef& b) { return Before(*a, *b); };
        const auto middle = static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(m_rows.size());
        m_rows.insert(m_rows.end(), rows.begin(), rows.end());
        std::stable_sort(m_rows.begin() + middle, m_rows.end(), before);
        std::inplace_merge(m_rows.begin(), m_rows.begin() + middle, m_rows.end(), before);
        const float anchorTop = static_cast<float>(m_selected) * RowH() - m_scroll.offset;
        Refocus();
        // Keep the focused row where it was on the screen while rows arrive above it.
        if (m_selected >= 0 && !m_follow) m_scroll.offset = static_cast<float>(m_selected) * RowH() - anchorTop;
    }
    Trim();
    UpdateExtent();
    if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

void PacketList::Clear() {
    m_rows.clear();
    m_marked.clear();
    m_focus = m_anchor = 0;
    m_selected = m_hot = -1;
    m_follow = true;
    m_scroll = {};
    UpdateExtent();
    if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

void PacketList::SetBaseTime(uint64_t timestampUs) {
    m_baseTime = timestampUs;
    if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

void PacketList::SetPlaceholder(std::wstring text) {
    m_placeholder = std::move(text);
    if (m_hwnd && m_rows.empty()) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

PacketRef PacketList::Selected() const {
    if (m_selected < 0 || m_selected >= static_cast<int>(m_rows.size())) return {};
    return m_rows[static_cast<size_t>(m_selected)];
}

std::vector<PacketRef> PacketList::Marked() const {
    std::vector<PacketRef> out;
    out.reserve(m_marked.size());
    for (const auto& p : m_rows) {
        if (m_marked.contains(p->Index)) out.push_back(p);
    }
    std::ranges::sort(out, {}, [](const PacketRef& p) { return p->Index; });
    return out;
}

void PacketList::SelectAll() {
    if (m_rows.empty()) return;
    for (const auto& p : m_rows) m_marked.insert(p->Index);
    if (m_focus == 0) {
        m_focus = m_anchor = m_rows.front()->Index;
        m_selected = 0;
    }
    InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
    Notify(LBN_SELCHANGE);
}

void PacketList::Relayout() {
    UpdateExtent();
    if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

PacketList::Columns PacketList::Layout(float width) const {
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    Columns c{};
    c.right = width - f.F(12);
    c.no = f.F(10);
    c.time = c.no + f.F(62);
    c.dir = c.time + f.F(74);
    c.proto = c.dir + f.F(30);
    c.src = c.proto + f.F(74);
    const float fixedTail = f.F(64);  // length column
    const float flexible = std::max(f.F(200), c.right - c.src - fixedTail);
    const float endpoint = std::clamp(flexible * 0.27f, f.F(120), f.F(270));
    c.dst = c.src + endpoint;
    c.len = c.dst + endpoint;
    c.info = c.len + fixedTail;
    return c;
}

int PacketList::RowAt(POINT p) const {
    const float y = static_cast<float>(p.y) - HeaderH();
    if (y < 0) return -1;
    const int row = static_cast<int>(std::floor((y + m_scroll.offset) / RowH()));
    return row >= 0 && row < static_cast<int>(m_rows.size()) ? row : -1;
}

std::optional<PacketList::Sort> PacketList::HeaderAt(POINT p) const {
    if (static_cast<float>(p.y) >= HeaderH()) return std::nullopt;
    RECT client{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
    const Columns c = Layout(static_cast<float>(client.right));
    const float x = static_cast<float>(p.x);
    if (x < c.time) return Sort::Number;
    if (x < c.dir) return Sort::Time;
    if (x < c.proto) return Sort::Direction;
    if (x < c.src) return Sort::Protocol;
    if (x < c.dst) return Sort::Source;
    if (x < c.len) return Sort::Destination;
    if (x < c.info) return Sort::Length;
    return Sort::Info;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Selection
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void PacketList::Notify(WORD code) {
    SendMessageW(GetParent(m_hwnd), WM_COMMAND, MAKEWPARAM(GetDlgCtrlID(m_hwnd), code), reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(m_hwnd));
}

void PacketList::Focus(int row, bool extend, bool toggle) {
    if (m_rows.empty()) return;
    row = std::clamp(row, 0, static_cast<int>(m_rows.size()) - 1);
    const uint64_t index = m_rows[static_cast<size_t>(row)]->Index;
    if (toggle) {
        if (!m_marked.erase(index)) m_marked.insert(index);
        m_anchor = index;
    } else if (extend && m_anchor) {
        const int from = RowOf(m_anchor) < 0 ? row : RowOf(m_anchor);
        if (!CtrlDown()) m_marked.clear();
        for (int i = std::min(from, row); i <= std::max(from, row); ++i) m_marked.insert(m_rows[static_cast<size_t>(i)]->Index);
    } else {
        m_marked = {index};
        m_anchor = index;
    }
    m_focus = index;
    m_selected = row;
    m_scroll.EnsureVisible(static_cast<float>(row) * RowH(), static_cast<float>(row + 1) * RowH());
    const bool newestEnd = m_sort == Sort::Number && (m_descending ? row == 0 : row == static_cast<int>(m_rows.size()) - 1);
    m_follow = newestEnd && (m_descending ? m_scroll.offset <= 0.5f : m_scroll.AtEnd());
    InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
    Notify(LBN_SELCHANGE);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Input
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
LRESULT PacketList::Handle(UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    RECT client{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
    switch (message) {
    case WM_ERASEBKGND:
        return 1;
    case WM_PAINT:
        Paint();
        return 0;
    case WM_SIZE:
        UpdateExtent();
        InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    case WM_GETDLGCODE:
        return DLGC_WANTARROWS;
    case WM_SETFOCUS:
    case WM_KILLFOCUS:
        InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    case WM_KEYDOWN: {
        const int page = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(m_scroll.view / RowH()) - 1);
        const bool shift = ShiftDown();
        if (CtrlDown() && wParam == 'C') {
            Notify(PacketListCopy);
            return 0;
        }
        if (CtrlDown() && wParam == 'A') {
            SelectAll();
            return 0;
        }
        const int last = static_cast<int>(m_rows.size()) - 1;
        switch (wParam) {
        case VK_UP: Focus(m_selected < 0 ? last : m_selected - 1, shift, false); return 0;
        case VK_DOWN: Focus(m_selected + 1, shift, false); return 0;
        case VK_PRIOR: Focus(m_selected - page, shift, false); return 0;
        case VK_NEXT: Focus(m_selected + page, shift, false); return 0;
        case VK_HOME: Focus(0, shift, false); return 0;
        case VK_END:
            Focus(last, shift, false);
            m_follow = Chronological();
            return 0;
        case VK_ESCAPE:
            m_marked.clear();
            m_focus = m_anchor = 0;
            m_selected = -1;
            m_follow = m_sort == Sort::Number;
            UpdateExtent();
            InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
            Notify(LBN_SELCHANGE);
            return 0;
        }
        break;
    }
    case WM_LBUTTONDOWN:
    case WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK:
    case WM_RBUTTONDOWN: {
        SetFocus(m_hwnd);
        const POINT p{GET_X_LPARAM(lParam), GET_Y_LPARAM(lParam)};
        if (message != WM_RBUTTONDOWN && m_scroll.MouseDown(p, client, m_fonts, HeaderH())) {
            SetCapture(m_hwnd);
            m_follow = false;
            InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
            return 0;
        }
        if (message == WM_LBUTTONDOWN) {
            if (const auto sort = HeaderAt(p)) {
                SetSort(*sort);
                return 0;
            }
        }
        const int row = RowAt(p);
        if (row < 0) return 0;
        if (message == WM_RBUTTONDOWN) {
            // The context menu acts on the selection: a click inside it keeps it.
            if (!m_marked.contains(m_rows[static_cast<size_t>(row)]->Index)) Focus(row, false, false);
            return 0;
        }
        const bool ctrl = (wParam & MK_CONTROL) != 0, shift = (wParam & MK_SHIFT) != 0;
        Focus(row, shift, ctrl && !shift);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_SETCURSOR:
        if (LOWORD(lParam) == HTCLIENT) {
            POINT p{};
            GetCursorPos(&p);
            ScreenToClient(m_hwnd, &p);
            SetCursor(LoadCursorW(nullptr, HeaderAt(p) ? IDC_HAND : IDC_ARROW));
            return TRUE;
        }
        break;
    case WM_MOUSEMOVE: {
        const POINT p{GET_X_LPARAM(lParam), GET_Y_LPARAM(lParam)};
        if (!m_tracking) {
            TRACKMOUSEEVENT tme{sizeof tme, TME_LEAVE, m_hwnd, 0};
            m_tracking = TrackMouseEvent(&tme) != FALSE;
        }
        bool repaint = m_scroll.MouseMove(p, client, m_fonts, HeaderH());
        if (m_scroll.dragging) m_follow = Chronological() && m_scroll.AtEnd();
        const int hot = m_scroll.dragging || m_scroll.hot ? -1 : RowAt(p);
        if (hot != m_hot) {
            m_hot = hot;
            repaint = true;
        }
        if (repaint) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_LBUTTONUP:
        if (m_scroll.dragging) {
            m_scroll.dragging = false;
            ReleaseCapture();
            InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        }
        return 0;
    case WM_CAPTURECHANGED:
        m_scroll.dragging = false;
        return 0;
    case WM_MOUSELEAVE:
        m_tracking = false;
        m_hot = -1;
        m_scroll.hot = false;
        InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    case WM_MOUSEWHEEL:
        if (m_scroll.Wheel(GET_WHEEL_DELTA_WPARAM(wParam), WheelStep(m_fonts, RowH()))) {
            m_follow = m_sort == Sort::Number && (m_descending ? m_scroll.offset <= 0.5f : m_scroll.AtEnd());
            InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        }
        return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(m_hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

}  // namespace WS::Ui

```

`src/gui/PacketList.h`:

```h
// WireScope - Packet list: virtual (only visible rows are drawn), keyboard and mouse driven.
//
// Sorted by any column (click the header; again for the other direction). In the order of arrival it
// follows the newest packet while scrolled to that end; scrolling or selecting a row pins the view.
// Several packets can be selected: Ctrl+click toggles one, Shift+click or Shift+arrows a range,
// Ctrl+A all. The selection belongs to the packets, so it survives sorting and new arrivals; the
// focused packet is the one the details pane shows.
//
// Notifies the parent with WM_COMMAND: LBN_SELCHANGE (selection), PacketListCopy (Ctrl+C).
// Right-click and the menu key raise WM_CONTEXTMENU in the parent.
#pragma once
#include "core/PacketEngine.h"
#include "gui/Widgets.h"
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>

namespace WS::Ui {

inline constexpr WORD PacketListCopy = 0x0200;

D2D1_COLOR_F ProtocolColor(const DecodedPacket& p);

class PacketList {
public:
    enum class Sort { Number, Time, Direction, Protocol, Source, Destination, Length, Info };

    explicit PacketList(const Fonts& fonts) : m_fonts(fonts) {}
    PacketList(const PacketList&) = delete;
    PacketList& operator=(const PacketList&) = delete;

    HWND Create(HWND parent, int id);
    [[nodiscard]] HWND hwnd() const noexcept { return m_hwnd; }

    void SetRows(std::vector<PacketRef> rows);       // replaces the rows (in capture order), keeps the selection
    void Append(const std::vector<PacketRef>& rows);  // newer packets, in capture order
    void Clear();
    void SetBaseTime(uint64_t timestampUs);
    void SetPlaceholder(std::wstring text);
    [[nodiscard]] PacketRef Selected() const;                 // the focused packet
    [[nodiscard]] std::vector<PacketRef> Marked() const;       // every selected packet, in capture order
    [[nodiscard]] size_t MarkedCount() const noexcept { return m_marked.size(); }
    void SelectAll();
    [[nodiscard]] size_t Count() const noexcept { return m_rows.size(); }
    void Relayout();

private:
    struct Columns {
        float no, time, dir, proto, src, dst, len, info, right;
    };
    static LRESULT CALLBACK Proc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM);
    LRESULT Handle(UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM);
    void Paint();  // PacketListPaint.cpp
    [[nodiscard]] Columns Layout(float width) const;
    [[nodiscard]] float RowH() const { return m_fonts.F(26); }
    [[nodiscard]] float HeaderH() const { return m_fonts.F(30); }
    [[nodiscard]] int RowAt(POINT p) const;
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<Sort> HeaderAt(POINT p) const;
    [[nodiscard]] int RowOf(uint64_t index) const;  // -1 when the packet is not listed
    [[nodiscard]] bool Before(const DecodedPacket& a, const DecodedPacket& b) const;  // the current order
    [[nodiscard]] bool Chronological() const noexcept { return m_sort == Sort::Number && !m_descending; }
    void SetSort(Sort sort);
    // Moves the focus to `row`. extend: select the range from the anchor; toggle: flip this row only.
    void Focus(int row, bool extend, bool toggle);
    void Notify(WORD code);
    void Refocus();  // the focused row after the rows moved
    void UpdateExtent();
    void Trim();

    const Fonts& m_fonts;
    HWND m_hwnd = nullptr;
    std::vector<PacketRef> m_rows;  // in display order
    Sort m_sort = Sort::Number;
    bool m_descending = false;
    std::unordered_set<uint64_t> m_marked;  // selected packets by Index
    uint64_t m_focus = 0, m_anchor = 0;     // packet Index, 0 = none (indexes start at 1)
    int m_selected = -1;                    // row of m_focus
    int m_hot = -1;
    bool m_follow = true;
    bool m_tracking = false;
    uint64_t m_baseTime = 0;
    Scroller m_scroll;
    std::wstring m_placeholder;
};

}  // namespace WS::Ui
```

`src/gui/PacketListPaint.cpp`:

```cpp
// WireScope - Packet list: painting (header with the sort mark, rows, selection, protocol and fate pills).
#include "gui/PacketList.h"
#include "resources/resource.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <format>

namespace WS::Ui {
namespace {

std::wstring Endpoint(const std::string& address, uint16_t port) {
    if (port == 0) return ToWide(address);
    if (address.find(':') != std::string::npos) return std::format(L"[{}]:{}", ToWide(address), port);
    return std::format(L"{}:{}", ToWide(address), port);
}

}  // namespace

D2D1_COLOR_F ProtocolColor(const DecodedPacket& p) {
    if (p.ProtocolName == "HTTP") return Color::Http;
    switch (p.Protocol) {
    case ProtocolType::TCP: return Color::Tcp;
    case ProtocolType::UDP: return p.ProtocolName == "UDP" ? Color::Udp : Color::Dns;  // DHCP, NTP
    case ProtocolType::DNS: return Color::Dns;
    case ProtocolType::TLS: return Color::Tls;
    case ProtocolType::ICMP: return Color::Icmp;
    case ProtocolType::ARP: return Color::Arp;
    default: return p.ProtocolName == "ICMPv6" ? Color::Icmp : Color::OtherProtocol;
    }
}

void PacketList::Paint() {
    PaintScope ps(m_hwnd);
    RECT client{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    const bool focused = GetFocus() == m_hwnd;
    Ui::Paint(ps.dc(), client, f, [&](Canvas& c) {
        c.Clear(Graphics::Get().Surface(Color::Card));
        const float width = static_cast<float>(client.right);
        const Columns col = Layout(width);
        const float headerH = HeaderH();

        // Column header: the sorted column is brighter and carries the direction.
        struct Head {
            UINT text;  // 0 = no title (the direction arrows)
            Sort sort;
            float left, right;
            Align align;
        };
        const Head heads[] = {
            {IDS_COL_NO, Sort::Number, col.no, col.time - f.F(12), Align::Right},
            {IDS_COL_TIME, Sort::Time, col.time, col.dir - f.F(6), Align::Left},
            {0, Sort::Direction, col.dir, col.proto - f.F(6), Align::Center},
            {IDS_COL_PROTOCOL, Sort::Protocol, col.proto, col.src - f.F(6), Align::Left},
            {IDS_COL_SOURCE, Sort::Source, col.src, col.dst - f.F(8), Align::Left},
            {IDS_COL_DESTINATION, Sort::Destination, col.dst, col.len - f.F(8), Align::Left},
            {IDS_COL_LENGTH, Sort::Length, col.len, col.info - f.F(16), Align::Right},
            {IDS_COL_INFO, Sort::Info, col.info, col.right, Align::Left},
        };
        for (const Head& h : heads) {
            const bool sorted = h.sort == m_sort;
            const std::wstring title = h.text ? Text::Get(h.text) : std::wstring();
            if (sorted) {
                const std::wstring arrow(1, m_descending ? Icon::ChevronDown : Icon::Up);
                const float tw = title.empty() ? 0.0f : c.Width(title, Font::Label);
                float ax = h.align == Align::Right ? h.right - tw - f.F(16) : h.left + tw + f.F(4);
                if (h.align == Align::Center) ax = (h.left + h.right) / 2 - f.F(6);
                c.Text(arrow, {ax, 0, ax + f.F(12), headerH}, Font::IconSmall, Color::AccentText, Align::Center);
            }
            if (!title.empty()) c.Text(title, {h.left, 0, h.right, headerH}, Font::Label, sorted ? Color::Text2 : Color::Text3, h.align);
        }
        c.Line({f.F(6), headerH - 0.5f}, {width - f.F(6), headerH - 0.5f}, Color::CardStroke);

        if (m_rows.empty()) {
            c.Text(m_placeholder, {0, headerH, width, static_cast<float>(client.bottom)}, Font::Body, Color::Text3, Align::Center);
            return;
        }

        const float rowH = RowH();
        const D2D1_RECT_F area{0, headerH, width, static_cast<float>(client.bottom)};
        c.PushClip(area);
        const int first = static_cast<int>(std::floor(m_scroll.offset / rowH));
        const int last = std::min(static_cast<int>(m_rows.size()) - 1, static_cast<int>((m_scroll.offset + m_scroll.view) / rowH) + 1);
        const float rightEdge = width - (m_scroll.Visible() ? f.F(12) : f.F(4));
        for (int i = std::max(first, 0); i <= last; ++i) {
            const DecodedPacket& p = *m_rows[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
            const float top = headerH + static_cast<float>(i) * rowH - m_scroll.offset;
            const float bottom = top + rowH;
            const D2D1_RECT_F box{f.F(4), top + f.F(1), rightEdge, bottom - f.F(1)};
            const bool marked = m_marked.contains(p.Index), current = i == m_selected, hot = i == m_hot;
            if (marked) {
                c.Fill(box, Color::Selected, f.F(4));
            } else if (hot) {
                c.Fill(box, Color::Hover, f.F(4));
            }
            if (current) {  // the packet the details pane shows
                const float mid = (top + bottom) / 2;
                c.Fill({box.left + f.F(1), mid - f.F(7), box.left + f.F(4), mid + f.F(7)}, Color::AccentText, f.F(1.5f));
                if (focused) c.Stroke(box, White(0.18f), f.F(4));
            }
            const bool dead = p.Fate == PacketFate::Dropped || p.Fate == PacketFate::Blocked || p.Fate == PacketFate::Killed;
            const D2D1_COLOR_F ink = dead ? Color::Text3 : Color::Text;

            c.Text(std::to_wstring(p.Index), {col.no, top, col.time - f.F(12), bottom}, Font::Caption, Color::Text3, Align::Right);
            const double seconds = p.TimestampUs >= m_baseTime ? static_cast<double>(p.TimestampUs - m_baseTime) / 1e6 : 0.0;
            c.Text(std::format(L"{:.3f}", seconds), {col.time, top, col.dir - f.F(6), bottom}, Font::Caption, Color::Text2);
            const bool out = p.Dir == Direction::Outbound;
            c.Text(std::wstring(1, out ? Icon::ArrowUp : Icon::ArrowDown), {col.dir, top, col.dir + f.F(18), bottom}, Font::IconSmall,
                   out ? Color::AccentText : Color::Success, Align::Center);

            // Protocol pill
            const std::wstring proto = ToWide(p.ProtocolName);
            const D2D1_COLOR_F pc = ProtocolColor(p);
            const float pw = std::min(c.Width(proto, Font::Label) + f.F(12), col.src - col.proto - f.F(8));
            const D2D1_RECT_F pill{col.proto, top + f.F(5), col.proto + pw, bottom - f.F(5)};
            c.Fill(pill, WithAlpha(pc, dead ? 0.08f : 0.16f), f.F(3));
            c.Text(proto, pill, Font::Label, dead ? WithAlpha(pc, 0.6f) : pc, Align::Center);

            c.Text(Endpoint(p.Source, p.SourcePort), {col.src, top, col.dst - f.F(8), bottom}, Font::Body, ink);
            c.Text(Endpoint(p.Destination, p.DestPort), {col.dst, top, col.len - f.F(8), bottom}, Font::Body, ink);
            c.Text(std::to_wstring(p.Length), {col.len, top, col.info - f.F(16), bottom}, Font::Caption, Color::Text2, Align::Right);

            // Info: what the data plane did first, then the host name and the summary.
            float x = col.info;
            std::wstring fate;
            D2D1_COLOR_F fateColor = Color::Caution;
            switch (p.Fate) {
            case PacketFate::Delayed: fate = Text::Format(IDS_FATE_DELAY, (p.DelayUs + 500) / 1000); break;
            case PacketFate::Dropped: fate = Text::Get(IDS_FATE_SIMDROP); fateColor = Color::Critical; break;
            case PacketFate::Blocked: fate = Text::Get(IDS_FATE_BLOCKED); fateColor = Color::Critical; break;
            case PacketFate::Killed: fate = Text::Get(IDS_FATE_KILLED); fateColor = Color::Critical; break;
            default: break;
            }
            if (!fate.empty()) {
                const float fw = c.Width(fate, Font::Label) + f.F(12);
                const D2D1_RECT_F b{x, top + f.F(5), x + fw, bottom - f.F(5)};
                c.Fill(b, WithAlpha(fateColor, 0.15f), f.F(3));
                c.Text(fate, b, Font::Label, fateColor, Align::Center);
                x += fw + f.F(8);
            }
            if (!p.DomainOrHost.empty()) {
                const std::wstring host = ToWide(p.DomainOrHost);
                const float hw = std::min(c.Width(host, Font::Strong) + 1, std::max(0.0f, col.right - x));
                c.Text(host, {x, top, x + hw, bottom}, Font::Strong, dead ? Color::Text3 : Color::AccentText);
                x += hw + f.F(10);
            }
            if (!p.Process.empty()) {
                const std::wstring proc = ToWide(p.Process);
                const float procW = std::min(c.Width(proc, Font::Label) + f.F(12), std::max(0.0f, col.right - x));
                if (procW > f.F(10)) {
                    const D2D1_RECT_F pb{x, top + f.F(5), x + procW, bottom - f.F(5)};
                    c.Fill(pb, WithAlpha(Color::AccentText, dead ? 0.06f : 0.12f), f.F(3));
                    c.Text(proc, pb, Font::Label, dead ? Color::Text3 : Color::AccentText, Align::Center);
                    x += procW + f.F(8);
                }
            }
            c.Text(ToWide(p.Info), {x, top, col.right, bottom}, Font::Body, dead ? Color::Text3 : Color::Text2);
        }
        c.PopClip();
        m_scroll.Draw(c, client, headerH);
    });
}

}  // namespace WS::Ui
```

`src/gui/ProcessList.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "gui/ProcessList.h"
#include "resources/resource.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include <windowsx.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <format>

namespace WS::Ui {
namespace {

constexpr wchar_t kClass[] = L"WireScope.ProcessList";

uint64_t Total(const ProcessRow& r) {
    return r.bytesIn + r.bytesOut;
}

}  // namespace

HWND ProcessList::Create(HWND parent, int id) {
    RegisterControlClass(kClass, Proc);
    m_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(0, kClass, L"Processes", WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | WS_TABSTOP, 0, 0, 10, 10, parent,
                             reinterpret_cast<HMENU>(static_cast<INT_PTR>(id)), GetModuleHandleW(nullptr), this);
    return m_hwnd;
}

LRESULT CALLBACK ProcessList::Proc(HWND hwnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    auto* self = ControlFromWindow<ProcessList>(hwnd, message, lParam);
    if (message == WM_NCCREATE && self) self->m_hwnd = hwnd;
    if (message == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA, 0);
        if (self) self->m_hwnd = nullptr;
        return DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
    }
    return self ? self->Handle(message, wParam, lParam) : DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

void ProcessList::UpdateExtent() {
    RECT rc{};
    if (m_hwnd) GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &rc);
    m_scroll.view = std::max(0.0f, static_cast<float>(rc.bottom) - HeaderH());
    m_scroll.content = static_cast<float>(m_rows.size()) * RowH() + m_fonts.F(4);
    m_scroll.Clamp();
}

void ProcessList::SortRows() {
    auto key = [this](const ProcessRow& a, const ProcessRow& b) -> int {  // <0: a first in ascending order
        auto cmp = [](auto x, auto y) { return x < y ? -1 : x > y ? 1 : 0; };
        switch (m_sort) {
        case Sort::Name: return _wcsicmp(a.name.c_str(), b.name.c_str());
        case Sort::Pid: return cmp(a.pid, b.pid);
        case Sort::Download: return cmp(a.rateIn, b.rateIn);
        case Sort::Upload: return cmp(a.rateOut, b.rateOut);
        case Sort::Total: return cmp(Total(a), Total(b));
        case Sort::Sockets: return cmp(a.sockets, b.sockets);
        }
        return 0;
    };
    std::stable_sort(m_rows.begin(), m_rows.end(), [&](const ProcessRow& a, const ProcessRow& b) {
        if ((a.id == 0) != (b.id == 0)) return b.id == 0;  // traffic without a process stays last
        if (const int k = key(a, b); k != 0) return m_descending ? k > 0 : k < 0;
        if (Total(a) != Total(b)) return Total(a) > Total(b);
        if (const int n = _wcsicmp(a.name.c_str(), b.name.c_str()); n != 0) return n < 0;
        return a.id < b.id;
    });
}

void ProcessList::SetRows(std::vector<ProcessRow> rows) {
    m_rows = std::move(rows);
    Resort();
}

void ProcessList::Resort() {
    SortRows();
    m_selected = -1;
    if (m_hasSelection) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < m_rows.size(); ++i) {
            if (m_rows[i].id == m_selectedId) m_selected = static_cast<int>(i);
        }
    }
    if (m_selected < 0 && m_hasSelection) {
        m_hasSelection = false;  // the process left the list
        Notify(LBN_SELCHANGE);
    }
    UpdateExtent();
    if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

void ProcessList::SetPlaceholder(std::wstring text) {
    if (text == m_placeholder) return;
    m_placeholder = std::move(text);
    if (m_hwnd && m_rows.empty()) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

const ProcessRow* ProcessList::Selected() const noexcept {
    return m_selected >= 0 && m_selected < static_cast<int>(m_rows.size()) ? &m_rows[static_cast<size_t>(m_selected)] : nullptr;
}

void ProcessList::Relayout() {
    UpdateExtent();
    if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

void ProcessList::Select(int index) {
    if (m_rows.empty()) return;
    index = std::clamp(index, 0, static_cast<int>(m_rows.size()) - 1);
    const bool changed = index != m_selected || !m_hasSelection;
    m_selected = index;
    m_selectedId = m_rows[static_cast<size_t>(index)].id;
    m_hasSelection = true;
    m_scroll.EnsureVisible(static_cast<float>(index) * RowH(), static_cast<float>(index + 1) * RowH());
    if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
    if (changed) Notify(LBN_SELCHANGE);
}

void ProcessList::Notify(WORD code) {
    if (m_hwnd) SendMessageW(GetParent(m_hwnd), WM_COMMAND, MAKEWPARAM(GetDlgCtrlID(m_hwnd), code), reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(m_hwnd));
}

ProcessList::Columns ProcessList::Layout(float width) const {
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    Columns c{};
    c.right = width - (m_scroll.Visible() ? f.F(14) : f.F(8));
    c.sockets = c.right - f.F(64);
    c.total = c.sockets - f.F(100);
    c.up = c.total - f.F(96);
    c.down = c.up - f.F(96);
    c.pid = c.down - f.F(64);
    c.mark = f.F(8);
    c.name = f.F(38);
    return c;
}

int ProcessList::RowAt(POINT p) const {
    const float y = static_cast<float>(p.y) - HeaderH();
    if (y < 0) return -1;
    const int row = static_cast<int>(std::floor((y + m_scroll.offset) / RowH()));
    return row >= 0 && row < static_cast<int>(m_rows.size()) ? row : -1;
}

std::optional<ProcessList::Sort> ProcessList::HeaderAt(POINT p) const {
    if (static_cast<float>(p.y) >= HeaderH()) return std::nullopt;
    RECT client{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
    const Columns c = Layout(static_cast<float>(client.right));
    const float x = static_cast<float>(p.x);
    if (x < c.name) return std::nullopt;
    if (x < c.pid) return Sort::Name;
    if (x < c.down) return Sort::Pid;
    if (x < c.up) return Sort::Download;
    if (x < c.total) return Sort::Upload;
    if (x < c.sockets) return Sort::Total;
    if (x < c.right) return Sort::Sockets;
    return std::nullopt;
}

LRESULT ProcessList::Handle(UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    RECT client{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
    switch (message) {
    case WM_ERASEBKGND:
        return 1;
    case WM_PAINT:
        Paint();
        return 0;
    case WM_SIZE:
        UpdateExtent();
        InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    case WM_GETDLGCODE:
        return DLGC_WANTARROWS;
    case WM_SETFOCUS:
    case WM_KILLFOCUS:
        InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    case WM_KEYDOWN: {
        const int page = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(m_scroll.view / RowH()) - 1);
        switch (wParam) {
        case VK_UP: Select(m_selected < 0 ? 0 : m_selected - 1); return 0;
        case VK_DOWN: Select(m_selected + 1); return 0;
        case VK_PRIOR: Select(m_selected - page); return 0;
        case VK_NEXT: Select(m_selected < 0 ? 0 : m_selected + page); return 0;
        case VK_HOME: Select(0); return 0;
        case VK_END: Select(static_cast<int>(m_rows.size()) - 1); return 0;
        case VK_RETURN: if (m_selected >= 0) Notify(LBN_DBLCLK); return 0;
        }
        break;
    }
    case WM_LBUTTONDOWN:
    case WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK:
    case WM_RBUTTONDOWN: {
        SetFocus(m_hwnd);
        const POINT p{GET_X_LPARAM(lParam), GET_Y_LPARAM(lParam)};
        if (message != WM_RBUTTONDOWN && m_scroll.MouseDown(p, client, m_fonts, HeaderH())) {
            SetCapture(m_hwnd);
            InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
            return 0;
        }
        if (message == WM_LBUTTONDOWN) {
            if (const auto sort = HeaderAt(p)) {
                if (*sort == m_sort) {
                    m_descending = !m_descending;
                } else {
                    m_sort = *sort;
                    m_descending = *sort != Sort::Name && *sort != Sort::Pid;  // biggest first, names A to Z
                }
                Resort();
                if (m_selected >= 0) m_scroll.EnsureVisible(static_cast<float>(m_selected) * RowH(), static_cast<float>(m_selected + 1) * RowH());
                return 0;
            }
        }
        const int row = RowAt(p);
        if (row < 0) return 0;
        Select(row);
        if (message == WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK) Notify(LBN_DBLCLK);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_MOUSEMOVE: {
        const POINT p{GET_X_LPARAM(lParam), GET_Y_LPARAM(lParam)};
        if (!m_tracking) {
            TRACKMOUSEEVENT tme{sizeof tme, TME_LEAVE, m_hwnd, 0};
            m_tracking = TrackMouseEvent(&tme) != FALSE;
        }
        bool repaint = m_scroll.MouseMove(p, client, m_fonts, HeaderH());
        const int hot = m_scroll.dragging || m_scroll.hot ? -1 : RowAt(p);
        if (hot != m_hot) {
            m_hot = hot;
            repaint = true;
        }
        if (repaint) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_SETCURSOR:
        if (LOWORD(lParam) == HTCLIENT) {
            POINT p{};
            GetCursorPos(&p);
            ScreenToClient(m_hwnd, &p);
            SetCursor(LoadCursorW(nullptr, HeaderAt(p) ? IDC_HAND : IDC_ARROW));
            return TRUE;
        }
        break;
    case WM_LBUTTONUP:
        if (m_scroll.dragging) {
            m_scroll.dragging = false;
            ReleaseCapture();
            InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        }
        return 0;
    case WM_CAPTURECHANGED:
        m_scroll.dragging = false;
        return 0;
    case WM_MOUSELEAVE:
        m_tracking = false;
        m_hot = -1;
        m_scroll.hot = false;
        InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    case WM_MOUSEWHEEL:
        if (m_scroll.Wheel(GET_WHEEL_DELTA_WPARAM(wParam), WheelStep(m_fonts, RowH()))) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(m_hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

void ProcessList::Paint() {
    PaintScope ps(m_hwnd);
    RECT client{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    const bool focused = GetFocus() == m_hwnd;
    UpdateExtent();
    Ui::Paint(ps.dc(), client, f, [&](Canvas& c) {
        c.Clear(Graphics::Get().Surface(Color::Card));
        const float width = static_cast<float>(client.right);
        const Columns col = Layout(width);
        const float headerH = HeaderH();

        // Header: the sorted column is brighter and carries the direction.
        struct Head {
            UINT text;
            Sort sort;
            float left, right;
            Align align;
        };
        const Head heads[] = {
            {IDS_PROC_COL_PROGRAM, Sort::Name, col.name, col.pid - f.F(8), Align::Left},
            {IDS_PROC_COL_PID, Sort::Pid, col.pid, col.down - f.F(8), Align::Right},
            {IDS_PROC_COL_DOWN, Sort::Download, col.down, col.up - f.F(8), Align::Right},
            {IDS_PROC_COL_UP, Sort::Upload, col.up, col.total - f.F(8), Align::Right},
            {IDS_PROC_COL_TOTAL, Sort::Total, col.total, col.sockets - f.F(8), Align::Right},
            {IDS_PROC_COL_SOCKETS, Sort::Sockets, col.sockets, col.right - f.F(4), Align::Right},
        };
        for (const Head& h : heads) {
            const bool sorted = h.sort == m_sort;
            float right = h.right;
            if (sorted) {
                const wchar_t arrow = m_descending ? Icon::ChevronDown : Icon::Up;
                if (h.align == Align::Right) {
                    c.Text(std::wstring(1, arrow), {right - f.F(12), 0, right, headerH}, Font::IconSmall, Color::AccentText, Align::Center);
                    right -= f.F(16);
                } else {
                    const float w = c.Width(Text::Get(h.text), Font::Label);
                    c.Text(std::wstring(1, arrow), {h.left + w + f.F(4), 0, h.left + w + f.F(16), headerH}, Font::IconSmall, Color::AccentText,
                           Align::Center);
                }
            }
            c.Text(Text::Get(h.text), {h.left, 0, right, headerH}, Font::Label, sorted ? Color::Text2 : Color::Text3, h.align);
        }
        c.Line({f.F(6), headerH - 0.5f}, {width - f.F(6), headerH - 0.5f}, Color::CardStroke);

        if (m_rows.empty()) {
            c.Text(m_placeholder, {f.F(16), headerH, width - f.F(16), static_cast<float>(client.bottom)}, Font::Body, Color::Text3, Align::Center);
            return;
        }

        double maxIn = 1, maxOut = 1;  // scale of the rate bars: the busiest row fills its column
        for (const auto& r : m_rows) {
            maxIn = std::max(maxIn, r.rateIn);
            maxOut = std::max(maxOut, r.rateOut);
        }
        const float rowH = RowH();
        c.PushClip({0, headerH, width, static_cast<float>(client.bottom)});
        const int first = static_cast<int>(std::floor(m_scroll.offset / rowH));
        const int last = std::min(static_cast<int>(m_rows.size()) - 1, static_cast<int>((m_scroll.offset + m_scroll.view) / rowH) + 1);
        for (int i = std::max(first, 0); i <= last; ++i) {
            const ProcessRow& r = m_rows[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
            const float top = headerH + static_cast<float>(i) * rowH - m_scroll.offset;
            const float bottom = top + rowH, mid = top + rowH / 2;
            const D2D1_RECT_F box{f.F(4), top + f.F(1), col.right + f.F(4), bottom - f.F(1)};
            if (i == m_selected) {
                c.Fill(box, Color::Selected, f.F(4));
                c.Fill({box.left + f.F(1), mid - f.F(8), box.left + f.F(4), mid + f.F(8)}, Color::AccentText, f.F(1.5f));
                if (focused) c.Stroke(box, White(0.18f), f.F(4));
            } else if (i == m_hot) {
                c.Fill(box, Color::Hover, f.F(4));
            }
            const bool dim = !r.running || r.id == 0;

            // Mark: a warning for suspicious programs, a dot for unsigned ones.
            const D2D1_RECT_F mark{col.mark + f.F(4), top, col.name - f.F(4), bottom};
            if (r.risk == Risk::High) {
                c.Text(std::wstring(1, Icon::Warning), mark, Font::Icon, Color::Critical, Align::Center);
            } else if (r.risk == Risk::Notice) {
                c.Circle({(mark.left + mark.right) / 2, mid}, f.F(3.5f), Color::Caution);
            }

            // Name, a status pill, the path below.
            const std::wstring name = r.id == 0 ? Text::Get(IDS_PROC_NO_PROCESS) : r.name;
            const float nameRight = col.pid - f.F(12);
            const float nameW = std::min(c.Width(name, Font::Strong) + 1, nameRight - col.name);
            c.Text(name, {col.name, top + f.F(6), col.name + nameW, mid + f.F(1)}, Font::Strong, dim ? Color::Text2 : Color::Text);
            UINT pill = 0;
            D2D1_COLOR_F pillColor = Color::Text3;
            if (!r.running) {
                pill = IDS_PROC_EXITED;
            } else if (r.risk == Risk::High) {
                pill = IDS_PILL_SUSPICIOUS;
                pillColor = Color::Critical;
            } else if (r.signature == Signature::Unsigned) {
                pill = IDS_PILL_UNSIGNED;
                pillColor = Color::Caution;
            }
            if (pill) {
                const std::wstring text = Text::Get(pill);
                const float x = col.name + nameW + f.F(8);
                const float w = c.Width(text, Font::Label) + f.F(12);
                if (x + w <= nameRight) {
                    const D2D1_RECT_F p{x, top + f.F(9), x + w, mid - f.F(1)};
                    c.Fill(p, WithAlpha(pillColor, 0.16f), f.F(3));
                    c.Text(text, p, Font::Label, pillColor, Align::Center);
                }
            }
            const std::wstring detail = r.id == 0 ? Text::Get(IDS_PROC_NO_PROCESS_NOTE) : r.path;
            c.Text(detail, {col.name, mid + f.F(1), nameRight, bottom - f.F(6)}, Font::Caption, Color::Text3);

            // Numbers
            auto number = [&](const std::wstring& text, float left, float right, bool strong) {
                c.Text(text, {left, top, right, bottom}, Font::Body, strong ? Color::Text : Color::Text3, Align::Right);
            };
            number(r.id == 0 ? std::wstring(L"—") : std::to_wstring(r.pid), col.pid, col.down - f.F(8), false);
            auto rate = [&](double value, double peak, float left, float right, D2D1_COLOR_F color) {
                if (!r.counted) {
                    number(L"—", left, right, false);
                    return;
                }
                number(value >= 1 ? FormatRate(value) : std::wstring(L"0"), left, right, value >= 1);
                // Share of the busiest row (square root: quiet programs stay visible next to a download).
                const float w = (right - left) * static_cast<float>(std::sqrt(value / peak));
                if (w >= f.F(3)) c.Fill({right - w, bottom - f.F(7), right, bottom - f.F(5)}, WithAlpha(color, 0.7f), f.F(1));
            };
            rate(r.rateIn, maxIn, col.down, col.up - f.F(8), Color::Success);
            rate(r.rateOut, maxOut, col.up, col.total - f.F(8), Color::AccentText);
            number(r.counted ? FormatBytes(Total(r)) : std::wstring(L"—"), col.total, col.sockets - f.F(8), r.counted && Total(r) > 0);
            number(r.id == 0 ? std::wstring(L"—") : std::to_wstring(r.sockets), col.sockets, col.right - f.F(4), r.sockets > 0);
        }
        c.PopClip();
        m_scroll.Draw(c, client, headerH);
    });
}

}  // namespace WS::Ui
```

`src/gui/ProcessList.h`:

```h
// WireScope - Process list: one row per program instance with its traffic rates, totals and
// sockets, a warning mark for programs that do not look like what they claim to be, and a header
// that sorts by any column. Notifies the parent with WM_COMMAND:
//   LBN_SELCHANGE  selection changed     LBN_DBLCLK  double click or Enter
// Right-click and the menu key raise WM_CONTEXTMENU in the parent.
#pragma once
#include "core/ProcessTrust.h"
#include "gui/Widgets.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace WS::Ui {

struct ProcessRow {
    uint32_t id = 0;   // ProcessInfo::id; 0 = traffic that belongs to no process
    DWORD pid = 0;
    std::wstring name;
    std::wstring path;
    double rateIn = 0, rateOut = 0;  // bytes per second
    uint64_t bytesIn = 0, bytesOut = 0;
    uint64_t packetsIn = 0, packetsOut = 0;
    uint32_t sockets = 0;
    bool counted = false;  // traffic totals exist (counting was on)
    bool running = true;
    Signature signature = Signature::Unknown;
    Risk risk = Risk::None;
};

class ProcessList {
public:
    enum class Sort { Name, Pid, Download, Upload, Total, Sockets };

    explicit ProcessList(const Fonts& fonts) : m_fonts(fonts) {}
    ProcessList(const ProcessList&) = delete;
    ProcessList& operator=(const ProcessList&) = delete;

    HWND Create(HWND parent, int id);
    [[nodiscard]] HWND hwnd() const noexcept { return m_hwnd; }
    void SetRows(std::vector<ProcessRow> rows);  // sorted here; keeps the selected process
    void SetPlaceholder(std::wstring text);
    [[nodiscard]] const ProcessRow* Selected() const noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] const std::vector<ProcessRow>& Rows() const noexcept { return m_rows; }
    void Relayout();

private:
    struct Columns {
        float mark, name, pid, down, up, total, sockets, right;
    };
    static LRESULT CALLBACK Proc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM);
    LRESULT Handle(UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM);
    void Paint();
    void SortRows();
    void Resort();  // sorts and finds the selected process again
    void Select(int row);
    void Notify(WORD code);
    void UpdateExtent();
    [[nodiscard]] Columns Layout(float width) const;
    [[nodiscard]] float RowH() const { return m_fonts.F(46); }
    [[nodiscard]] float HeaderH() const { return m_fonts.F(32); }
    [[nodiscard]] int RowAt(POINT p) const;
    [[nodiscard]] std::optional<Sort> HeaderAt(POINT p) const;

    const Fonts& m_fonts;
    HWND m_hwnd = nullptr;
    std::vector<ProcessRow> m_rows;
    int m_selected = -1;
    uint32_t m_selectedId = 0;
    bool m_hasSelection = false;
    int m_hot = -1;
    bool m_tracking = false;
    Sort m_sort = Sort::Download;
    bool m_descending = true;
    Scroller m_scroll;
    std::wstring m_placeholder;
};

}  // namespace WS::Ui
```
