`src/gui/RuleList.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "gui/RuleList.h"
#include "resources/resource.h"
#include "support/Common.h"
#include "support/Language.h"
#include <windowsx.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <format>

namespace WS::Ui {
namespace {
constexpr wchar_t kClass[] = L"WireScope.RuleList";
}

HWND RuleList::Create(HWND parent, int id) {
    RegisterControlClass(kClass, Proc);
    m_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(0, kClass, L"Firewall rules", WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | WS_TABSTOP, 0, 0, 10, 10, parent,
                             reinterpret_cast<HMENU>(static_cast<INT_PTR>(id)), GetModuleHandleW(nullptr), this);
    return m_hwnd;
}

LRESULT CALLBACK RuleList::Proc(HWND hwnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    auto* self = ControlFromWindow<RuleList>(hwnd, message, lParam);
    if (message == WM_NCCREATE && self) self->m_hwnd = hwnd;
    if (message == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA, 0);
        if (self) self->m_hwnd = nullptr;
        return DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
    }
    return self ? self->Handle(message, wParam, lParam) : DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

void RuleList::UpdateExtent() {
    RECT rc{};
    if (m_hwnd) GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &rc);
    m_scroll.view = static_cast<float>(rc.bottom);
    m_scroll.content = static_cast<float>(m_rows.size() + 1) * RowH() + m_fonts.F(8);
    m_scroll.Clamp();
}

void RuleList::SetRows(std::vector<RuleRow> rows) {
    const uint64_t keep = m_selected >= 0 && m_selected < static_cast<int>(m_rows.size()) ? m_rows[static_cast<size_t>(m_selected)].id : 0;
    m_rows = std::move(rows);
    m_selected = -1;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < m_rows.size(); ++i) {
        if (m_rows[i].id == keep) m_selected = static_cast<int>(i);
    }
    m_hot = -1;
    UpdateExtent();
    if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

void RuleList::SetPolicy(RuleAction policy, HitCounter hits, bool active) {
    m_policy = policy;
    m_policyHits = hits;
    m_active = active;
    if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

void RuleList::SetHits(uint64_t id, HitCounter hits) {
    for (auto& r : m_rows) {
        if (r.id == id && (r.hits.packets != hits.packets || r.hits.bytes != hits.bytes)) {
            r.hits = hits;
            if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        }
    }
}

void RuleList::Select(int index) {
    if (m_rows.empty()) return;
    index = std::clamp(index, 0, static_cast<int>(m_rows.size()) - 1);
    const bool changed = index != m_selected;
    m_selected = index;
    m_scroll.EnsureVisible(static_cast<float>(index) * RowH(), static_cast<float>(index + 1) * RowH());
    if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
    if (changed) Notify(LBN_SELCHANGE);
}

void RuleList::Relayout() {
    UpdateExtent();
    if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
}

void RuleList::Notify(WORD code) {
    SendMessageW(GetParent(m_hwnd), WM_COMMAND, MAKEWPARAM(GetDlgCtrlID(m_hwnd), code), reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(m_hwnd));
}

int RuleList::RowAt(POINT p) const {
    const int row = static_cast<int>(std::floor((static_cast<float>(p.y) + m_scroll.offset - m_fonts.F(4)) / RowH()));
    return row >= 0 && row < static_cast<int>(m_rows.size()) ? row : -1;
}

D2D1_RECT_F RuleList::SwitchRect(int row) const {
    const float top = m_fonts.F(4) + static_cast<float>(row) * RowH() - m_scroll.offset;
    const float mid = top + RowH() / 2;
    return {m_fonts.F(16), mid - m_fonts.F(10), m_fonts.F(56), mid + m_fonts.F(10)};
}

LRESULT RuleList::Handle(UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    RECT client{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
    switch (message) {
    case WM_ERASEBKGND:
        return 1;
    case WM_PAINT:
        Paint();
        return 0;
    case WM_SIZE:
        UpdateExtent();
        InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    case WM_GETDLGCODE:
        return DLGC_WANTARROWS | DLGC_WANTCHARS;
    case WM_SETFOCUS:
    case WM_KILLFOCUS:
        InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    case WM_SYSKEYDOWN:
        if (wParam == VK_UP) {
            Notify(RuleListMoveUp);
            return 0;
        }
        if (wParam == VK_DOWN) {
            Notify(RuleListMoveDown);
            return 0;
        }
        break;
    case WM_KEYDOWN:
        switch (wParam) {
        case VK_UP: Select(m_selected < 0 ? 0 : m_selected - 1); return 0;
        case VK_DOWN: Select(m_selected + 1); return 0;
        case VK_HOME: Select(0); return 0;
        case VK_END: Select(static_cast<int>(m_rows.size()) - 1); return 0;
        case VK_SPACE: if (m_selected >= 0) Notify(RuleListToggle); return 0;
        case VK_DELETE: if (m_selected >= 0) Notify(RuleListDelete); return 0;
        case VK_RETURN: if (m_selected >= 0) Notify(LBN_DBLCLK); return 0;
        }
        break;
    case WM_CHAR:
        return 0;  // Space and Enter are handled on key down
    case WM_LBUTTONDOWN:
    case WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK:
    case WM_RBUTTONDOWN: {
        SetFocus(m_hwnd);
        const POINT p{GET_X_LPARAM(lParam), GET_Y_LPARAM(lParam)};
        if (message != WM_RBUTTONDOWN && m_scroll.MouseDown(p, client, m_fonts)) {
            SetCapture(m_hwnd);
            InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
            return 0;
        }
        const int row = RowAt(p);
        if (row < 0) return 0;
        Select(row);
        const D2D1_RECT_F sw = SwitchRect(row);
        const bool onSwitch = static_cast<float>(p.x) >= sw.left - m_fonts.F(6) && static_cast<float>(p.x) <= sw.right + m_fonts.F(6);
        if (message == WM_LBUTTONDOWN && onSwitch) Notify(RuleListToggle);
        else if (message == WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK && !onSwitch) Notify(LBN_DBLCLK);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_MOUSEMOVE: {
        const POINT p{GET_X_LPARAM(lParam), GET_Y_LPARAM(lParam)};
        if (!m_tracking) {
            TRACKMOUSEEVENT tme{sizeof tme, TME_LEAVE, m_hwnd, 0};
            m_tracking = TrackMouseEvent(&tme) != FALSE;
        }
        bool repaint = m_scroll.MouseMove(p, client, m_fonts);
        const int hot = m_scroll.dragging || m_scroll.hot ? -1 : RowAt(p);
        if (hot != m_hot) {
            m_hot = hot;
            repaint = true;
        }
        if (repaint) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_LBUTTONUP:
        if (m_scroll.dragging) {
            m_scroll.dragging = false;
            ReleaseCapture();
            InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        }
        return 0;
    case WM_CAPTURECHANGED:
        m_scroll.dragging = false;
        return 0;
    case WM_MOUSELEAVE:
        m_tracking = false;
        m_hot = -1;
        m_scroll.hot = false;
        InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    case WM_MOUSEWHEEL:
        if (m_scroll.Wheel(GET_WHEEL_DELTA_WPARAM(wParam), WheelStep(m_fonts, RowH()))) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(m_hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

void RuleList::Paint() {
    PaintScope ps(m_hwnd);
    RECT client{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    const bool focused = GetFocus() == m_hwnd;
    m_scroll.view = static_cast<float>(client.bottom);
    m_scroll.Clamp();
    Ui::Paint(ps.dc(), client, f, [&](Canvas& c) {
        c.Clear(Graphics::Get().Surface(Color::Card));
        const float width = static_cast<float>(client.right);
        const float right = width - (m_scroll.Visible() ? f.F(14) : f.F(6));
        const float rowH = RowH();
        c.PushClip(ToF(client));

        auto hitsText = [](const HitCounter& h) {
            return h.packets ? Text::Format(IDS_RULES_HITS, FormatCount(h.packets), FormatBytes(h.bytes)) : Text::Get(IDS_RULES_NO_HITS);
        };
        auto actionPill = [&](RuleAction action, float x, float mid, bool dim) {
            const bool block = action == RuleAction::Block;
            const D2D1_COLOR_F color = block ? Color::Critical : Color::Success;
            const std::wstring text = Text::Get(block ? IDS_PILL_BLOCK : IDS_PILL_ALLOW);
            const D2D1_RECT_F pill{x, mid - f.F(10), x + std::max(f.F(54), c.Width(text, Font::Label) + f.F(14)), mid + f.F(10)};
            c.Fill(pill, WithAlpha(color, dim ? 0.07f : 0.16f), f.F(3));
            c.Text(text, pill, Font::Label, dim ? WithAlpha(color, 0.55f) : color, Align::Center);
        };

        for (size_t i = 0; i < m_rows.size(); ++i) {
            const RuleRow& r = m_rows[i];
            const float top = f.F(4) + static_cast<float>(i) * rowH - m_scroll.offset;
            if (top + rowH < 0 || top > static_cast<float>(client.bottom)) continue;
            const float mid = top + rowH / 2;
            const D2D1_RECT_F box{f.F(4), top + f.F(1), right, top + rowH - f.F(1)};
            const int index = static_cast<int>(i);
            if (index == m_selected) {
                c.Fill(box, Color::Selected, f.F(4));
                c.Fill({box.left + f.F(1), mid - f.F(8), box.left + f.F(4), mid + f.F(8)}, Color::AccentText, f.F(1.5f));
                if (focused) c.Stroke(box, White(0.18f), f.F(4));
            } else if (index == m_hot) {
                c.Fill(box, Color::Hover, f.F(4));
            }

            // Switch
            const D2D1_RECT_F sw = SwitchRect(index);
            const float h = sw.bottom - sw.top;
            if (r.enabled) c.Fill(sw, Color::Accent, h / 2);
            else {
                c.Fill(sw, Color::Control, h / 2);
                c.Stroke(sw, Color::Text3, h / 2);
            }
            c.Circle({r.enabled ? sw.right - h / 2 : sw.left + h / 2, mid}, f.F(6), r.enabled ? Color::Text : Color::Text2);

            // Position, action, text and meaning
            c.Text(std::to_wstring(i + 1), {f.F(62), top, f.F(84), top + rowH}, Font::Caption, Color::Text3, Align::Center);
            actionPill(r.action, f.F(90), mid, !r.enabled);
            const float x = f.F(170);
            const std::wstring hits = hitsText(r.hits);
            const float hitsW = std::min(c.Width(hits, Font::Caption) + f.F(4), (right - x) * 0.4f);
            const float textRight = right - hitsW - f.F(16);
            c.Text(r.text, {x, top + f.F(7), textRight, mid + f.F(1)}, Font::Mono, r.enabled ? Color::Text : Color::TextDisabled);
            c.Text(r.summary, {x, mid + f.F(1), textRight, top + rowH - f.F(7)}, Font::Caption, r.enabled ? Color::Text3 : Color::TextDisabled);
            c.Text(hits, {right - hitsW - f.F(8), top, right - f.F(8), top + rowH}, Font::Caption,
                   r.hits.packets && r.enabled ? Color::Text2 : Color::Text3, Align::Right);
        }

        // Default policy row
        const float top = f.F(4) + static_cast<float>(m_rows.size()) * rowH - m_scroll.offset;
        const float mid = top + rowH / 2;
        c.Line({f.F(12), top + f.F(4)}, {right - f.F(4), top + f.F(4)}, Color::CardStroke);
        c.Text(L"—", {f.F(62), top, f.F(84), top + rowH}, Font::Caption, Color::Text3, Align::Center);
        actionPill(m_policy, f.F(90), mid, false);
        c.Text(Text::Get(IDS_RULES_POLICY), {f.F(170), top + f.F(7), right * 0.6f, mid + f.F(1)}, Font::Strong, Color::Text);
        c.Text(Text::Get(m_rows.empty() ? IDS_RULES_POLICY_EMPTY : IDS_RULES_POLICY_NOTE),
               {f.F(170), mid + f.F(1), right * 0.75f, top + rowH - f.F(7)}, Font::Caption, Color::Text3);
        c.Text(m_active ? hitsText(m_policyHits) : Text::Get(IDS_RULES_OFF), {right * 0.6f, top, right - f.F(8), top + rowH},
               Font::Caption, Color::Text3, Align::Right);
        c.PopClip();
        m_scroll.Draw(c, client);
    });
}

}  // namespace WS::Ui

`src/gui/RuleList.h`:

```h
// WireScope - Firewall rule list: one row per rule (switch, action, rule text, meaning, hit counters)
// and a closing row for the default policy. Notifies the parent with WM_COMMAND:
//   LBN_SELCHANGE   selection changed           LBN_DBLCLK  edit the selected rule (double click, Enter)
//   RuleListToggle  switch clicked / Space      RuleListDelete  Delete key
//   RuleListMoveUp / RuleListMoveDown  Alt+Up / Alt+Down
#pragma once
#include "core/Rules.h"
#include "gui/Widgets.h"
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace WS::Ui {

inline constexpr WORD RuleListToggle = 0x0300, RuleListDelete = 0x0301, RuleListMoveUp = 0x0302, RuleListMoveDown = 0x0303;

struct RuleRow {
    uint64_t id = 0;
    bool enabled = true;
    RuleAction action = RuleAction::Block;
    std::wstring text;     // rule without the action word
    std::wstring summary;  // what it means
    HitCounter hits;
};

class RuleList {
public:
    explicit RuleList(const Fonts& fonts) : m_fonts(fonts) {}
    RuleList(const RuleList&) = delete;
    RuleList& operator=(const RuleList&) = delete;

    HWND Create(HWND parent, int id);
    [[nodiscard]] HWND hwnd() const noexcept { return m_hwnd; }
    void SetRows(std::vector<RuleRow> rows);  // keeps the selected rule (by id)
    void SetPolicy(RuleAction policy, HitCounter hits, bool active);
    void SetHits(uint64_t id, HitCounter hits);
    [[nodiscard]] int Selected() const noexcept { return m_selected; }  // index into the rows, -1 = none
    void Select(int index);
    void Relayout();

private:
    static LRESULT CALLBACK Proc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM);
    LRESULT Handle(UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM);
    void Paint();
    void Notify(WORD code);
    [[nodiscard]] float RowH() const { return m_fonts.F(52); }
    [[nodiscard]] int RowAt(POINT p) const;
    [[nodiscard]] D2D1_RECT_F SwitchRect(int row) const;
    void UpdateExtent();

    const Fonts& m_fonts;
    HWND m_hwnd = nullptr;
    std::vector<RuleRow> m_rows;
    RuleAction m_policy = RuleAction::Allow;
    HitCounter m_policyHits;
    bool m_active = false;
    int m_selected = -1;
    int m_hot = -1;
    bool m_tracking = false;
    Scroller m_scroll;
};

}  // namespace WS::Ui

#include "gui/Theme.h"
#include <dwmapi.h>
#include <uxtheme.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <optional>
#include <cmath>

#pragma comment(lib, "d2d1.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "dwrite.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "dwmapi.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "uxtheme.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "gdi32.lib")

namespace WS::Ui {

COLORREF ToColorRef(D2D1_COLOR_F c) {
    auto byte = [](float v) { return static_cast<BYTE>(std::lround(std::clamp(v, 0.0f, 1.0f) * 255.0f)); };
    return RGB(byte(c.r), byte(c.g), byte(c.b));
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Graphics
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Graphics& Graphics::Get() {
    static Graphics instance;
    return instance;
}

Graphics::Graphics() {
    D2D1_FACTORY_OPTIONS options{};
    D2D1CreateFactory(D2D1_FACTORY_TYPE_SINGLE_THREADED, __uuidof(ID2D1Factory), &options,
                      reinterpret_cast<void**>(m_d2d.GetAddressOf()));
    DWriteCreateFactory(DWRITE_FACTORY_TYPE_SHARED, __uuidof(IDWriteFactory),
                        reinterpret_cast<IUnknown**>(m_dwrite.GetAddressOf()));
}

Graphics::~Graphics() {
    if (m_memDc && m_oldBitmap) SelectObject(m_memDc.get(), m_oldBitmap);
    m_dib.reset();
    m_memDc.reset();
}

ID2D1DCRenderTarget* Graphics::Target() {
    if (!m_target && m_d2d) {
        // Software rendering: no GPU read-back per paint and no device-loss handling for a small UI.
        const auto props = D2D1::RenderTargetProperties(
            D2D1_RENDER_TARGET_TYPE_SOFTWARE, D2D1::PixelFormat(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, D2D1_ALPHA_MODE_PREMULTIPLIED),
            96.0f, 96.0f);
        m_d2d->CreateDCRenderTarget(&props, m_target.GetAddressOf());
    }
    return m_target.Get();
}

bool Graphics::HasFamily(const wchar_t* family) const {
    if (!m_dwrite) return false;
    ComPtr<IDWriteFontCollection> fonts;
    if (FAILED(m_dwrite->GetSystemFontCollection(fonts.GetAddressOf(), FALSE))) return false;
    UINT32 index = 0;
    BOOL exists = FALSE;
    return SUCCEEDED(fonts->FindFamilyName(family, &index, &exists)) && exists;
}

D2D1_COLOR_F Graphics::Surface(D2D1_COLOR_F layer) const noexcept {
    if (mica) return layer;
    const D2D1_COLOR_F b = Color::OpaqueBase;
    return {layer.r * layer.a + b.r * (1 - layer.a), layer.g * layer.a + b.g * (1 - layer.a),
            layer.b * layer.a + b.b * (1 - layer.a), 1.0f};
}

COLORREF Graphics::GdiSurface(D2D1_COLOR_F layer) const noexcept {
    if (!mica) return ToColorRef(Surface(layer));
    // Premultiplied value with alpha 0: DWM adds it to the backdrop, matching the D2D layer.
    return ToColorRef({layer.r * layer.a, layer.g * layer.a, layer.b * layer.a, 1.0f});
}

HDC Graphics::Buffer(int width, int height) {
    width = std::max(width, 1);
    height = std::max(height, 1);
    if (m_memDc && width <= m_bufferWidth && height <= m_bufferHeight) return m_memDc.get();
    if (!m_memDc) m_memDc.reset(CreateCompatibleDC(nullptr));
    if (!m_memDc) return nullptr;
    if (m_oldBitmap) SelectObject(m_memDc.get(), m_oldBitmap);
    m_oldBitmap = nullptr;
    m_dib.reset();
    // Round up to avoid reallocating on every pixel of a window resize.
    m_bufferWidth = std::max(m_bufferWidth, (width + 255) & ~255);
    m_bufferHeight = std::max(m_bufferHeight, (height + 255) & ~255);
    BITMAPINFO info{};
    info.bmiHeader.biSize = sizeof info.bmiHeader;
    info.bmiHeader.biWidth = m_bufferWidth;
    info.bmiHeader.biHeight = -m_bufferHeight;  // top-down
    info.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
    info.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
    info.bmiHeader.biCompression = BI_RGB;
    void* bits = nullptr;
    m_dib.reset(CreateDIBSection(m_memDc.get(), &info, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0));
    if (!m_dib) return nullptr;
    m_oldBitmap = SelectObject(m_memDc.get(), m_dib.get());
    return m_memDc.get();
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Fonts
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void Fonts::Create(UINT dpi) {
    m_dpi = dpi ? dpi : 96;
    auto& g = Graphics::Get();
    if (!g.DWrite()) return;
    m_uiFamily = g.HasFamily(L"Segoe UI Variable Text") ? L"Segoe UI Variable Text" : L"Segoe UI";
    const wchar_t* display = g.HasFamily(L"Segoe UI Variable Display") ? L"Segoe UI Variable Display" : L"Segoe UI";
    m_monoFamily = g.HasFamily(L"Cascadia Mono") ? L"Cascadia Mono" : L"Consolas";
    const wchar_t* icons = g.HasFamily(L"Segoe Fluent Icons") ? L"Segoe Fluent Icons" : L"Segoe MDL2 Assets";

    struct Spec {
        Font font;
        const wchar_t* family;
        float size;
        DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT weight;
    };
    const Spec specs[] = {
        {Font::Body, m_uiFamily, 13.0f, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL},
        {Font::Strong, m_uiFamily, 13.0f, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_SEMI_BOLD},
        {Font::Caption, m_uiFamily, 11.5f, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL},
        {Font::Label, m_uiFamily, 10.5f, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_SEMI_BOLD},
        {Font::Mono, m_monoFamily, 11.5f, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL},
        {Font::Icon, icons, 14.0f, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL},
        {Font::IconSmall, icons, 10.0f, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL},
        {Font::Title, display, 20.0f, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_SEMI_BOLD},
        {Font::Hero, display, 22.0f, DWRITE_FONT_WEIGHT_SEMI_BOLD},
    };
    ComPtr<IDWriteInlineObject> ellipsis;
    for (const Spec& s : specs) {
        auto& slot = m_formats[static_cast<std::size_t>(s.font)];
        slot.Reset();
        const float size = F(s.size);
        m_sizes[static_cast<std::size_t>(s.font)] = size;
        if (FAILED(g.DWrite()->CreateTextFormat(s.family, nullptr, s.weight, DWRITE_FONT_STYLE_NORMAL,
                                                DWRITE_FONT_STRETCH_NORMAL, size, L"en-us", slot.GetAddressOf())))
            continue;
        slot->SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_NO_WRAP);
        slot->SetParagraphAlignment(DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_CENTER);
        if (g.DWrite()->CreateEllipsisTrimmingSign(slot.Get(), ellipsis.ReleaseAndGetAddressOf()) == S_OK) {
            const DWRITE_TRIMMING trimming{DWRITE_TRIMMING_GRANULARITY_CHARACTER, 0, 0};
            slot->SetTrimming(&trimming, ellipsis.Get());
        }
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Canvas
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Canvas::Canvas(ID2D1RenderTarget& target, const Fonts& fonts) : m_rt(target), m_fonts(fonts) {}

ID2D1SolidColorBrush* Canvas::Brush(D2D1_COLOR_F c) {
    if (!m_brush) m_rt.CreateSolidColorBrush(c, m_brush.GetAddressOf());
    else m_brush->SetColor(c);
    return m_brush.Get();
}

void Canvas::Clear(D2D1_COLOR_F c) { m_rt.Clear(c); }

void Canvas::Fill(const D2D1_RECT_F& r, D2D1_COLOR_F c, float radius) {
    if (r.right <= r.left || r.bottom <= r.top) return;
    if (radius > 0) m_rt.FillRoundedRectangle(D2D1::RoundedRect(r, radius, radius), Brush(c));
    else m_rt.FillRectangle(r, Brush(c));
}

void Canvas::Stroke(const D2D1_RECT_F& r, D2D1_COLOR_F c, float radius, float width) {
    const D2D1_RECT_F in = Inset(r, width / 2, width / 2);  // keep the stroke inside, on pixel centres
    if (in.right <= in.left || in.bottom <= in.top) return;
    if (radius > 0) m_rt.DrawRoundedRectangle(D2D1::RoundedRect(in, radius, radius), Brush(c), width);
    else m_rt.DrawRectangle(in, Brush(c), width);
}

void Canvas::Line(D2D1_POINT_2F a, D2D1_POINT_2F b, D2D1_COLOR_F c, float width) { m_rt.DrawLine(a, b, Brush(c), width); }

void Canvas::Circle(D2D1_POINT_2F center, float radius, D2D1_COLOR_F c) {
    m_rt.FillEllipse(D2D1::Ellipse(center, radius, radius), Brush(c));
}

namespace {
ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> PathOf(const D2D1_POINT_2F* points, size_t count, std::optional<float> baseline) {
    ComPtr<ID2D1PathGeometry> path;
    auto* d2d = Graphics::Get().D2D();
    if (!d2d || count < 2 || FAILED(d2d->CreatePathGeometry(path.GetAddressOf()))) return {};
    ComPtr<ID2D1GeometrySink> sink;
    if (FAILED(path->Open(sink.GetAddressOf()))) return {};
    if (baseline) {
        sink->BeginFigure({points[0].x, *baseline}, D2D1_FIGURE_BEGIN_FILLED);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) sink->AddLine(points[i]);
        sink->AddLine({points[count - 1].x, *baseline});
        sink->EndFigure(D2D1_FIGURE_END_CLOSED);
    } else {
        sink->BeginFigure(points[0], D2D1_FIGURE_BEGIN_HOLLOW);
        for (size_t i = 1; i < count; ++i) sink->AddLine(points[i]);
        sink->EndFigure(D2D1_FIGURE_END_OPEN);
    }
    if (FAILED(sink->Close())) return {};
    return path;
}
}  // namespace

void Canvas::Polyline(const D2D1_POINT_2F* points, size_t count, D2D1_COLOR_F c, float width) {
    if (auto path = PathOf(points, count, std::nullopt)) m_rt.DrawGeometry(path.Get(), Brush(c), width);
}

void Canvas::Area(const D2D1_POINT_2F* points, size_t count, float baseline, D2D1_COLOR_F c) {
    if (auto path = PathOf(points, count, baseline)) m_rt.FillGeometry(path.Get(), Brush(c));
}

void Canvas::Text(std::wstring_view text, const D2D1_RECT_F& r, Font font, D2D1_COLOR_F c, Align align) {
    IDWriteTextFormat* format = m_fonts[font];
    if (!format || text.empty() || r.right <= r.left) return;
    format->SetTextAlignment(align == Align::Center ? DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
                             : align == Align::Right ? DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_TRAILING
                                                     : DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_LEADING);
    m_rt.DrawText(text.data(), static_cast<UINT32>(text.size()), format, r, Brush(c), D2D1_DRAW_TEXT_OPTIONS_CLIP);
}

namespace {
ComPtr<IDWriteTextLayout> Layout(IDWriteTextFormat* format, std::wstring_view text, float width, bool wrap) {
    ComPtr<IDWriteTextLayout> layout;
    auto* dw = Graphics::Get().DWrite();
    if (!dw || !format) return layout;
    if (FAILED(dw->CreateTextLayout(text.data(), static_cast<UINT32>(text.size()), format, std::max(width, 1.0f), 1.0e6f,
                                    layout.GetAddressOf())))
        return layout;
    layout->SetParagraphAlignment(DWRITE_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT_NEAR);
    layout->SetTextAlignment(DWRITE_TEXT_ALIGNMENT_LEADING);
    if (wrap) {
        layout->SetWordWrapping(DWRITE_WORD_WRAPPING_WRAP);
        const DWRITE_TRIMMING none{DWRITE_TRIMMING_GRANULARITY_NONE, 0, 0};
        layout->SetTrimming(&none, nullptr);
    }
    return layout;
}
}  // namespace

float TextWidth(const Fonts& fonts, Font font, std::wstring_view text) {
    auto layout = Layout(fonts[font], text, 1.0e6f, false);
    DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS m{};
    if (!layout || FAILED(layout->GetMetrics(&m))) return 0;
    return m.widthIncludingTrailingWhitespace;
}

float Canvas::Width(std::wstring_view text, Font font) { return TextWidth(m_fonts, font, text); }

float TextHeight(const Fonts& fonts, Font font, std::wstring_view text, float width) {
    auto layout = Layout(fonts[font], text, width, true);
    DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS m{};
    if (!layout || FAILED(layout->GetMetrics(&m))) return 0;
    return m.height;
}

float Canvas::ParagraphHeight(std::wstring_view text, float width, Font font) { return TextHeight(m_fonts, font, text, width); }

float Canvas::Paragraph(std::wstring_view text, const D2D1_RECT_F& r, Font font, D2D1_COLOR_F c) {
    auto layout = Layout(m_fonts[font], text, r.right - r.left, true);
    if (!layout) return 0;
    m_rt.DrawTextLayout({r.left, r.top}, layout.Get(), Brush(c), D2D1_DRAW_TEXT_OPTIONS_CLIP);
    DWRITE_TEXT_METRICS m{};
    layout->GetMetrics(&m);
    return m.height;
}

void Canvas::PushClip(const D2D1_RECT_F& r) { m_rt.PushAxisAlignedClip(r, D2D1_ANTIALIAS_MODE_ALIASED); }
void Canvas::PopClip() { m_rt.PopAxisAlignedClip(); }

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Paint
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void Paint(HDC dc, const RECT& rect, const Fonts& fonts, const std::function<void(Canvas&)>& draw,
           const std::function<void(HDC)>& gdi) {
    const int width = rect.right - rect.left, height = rect.bottom - rect.top;
    if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) return;
    auto& g = Graphics::Get();
    HDC buffer = g.Buffer(width, height);
    ID2D1DCRenderTarget* target = g.Target();
    if (!buffer || !target) return;

    const RECT local{0, 0, width, height};
    if (FAILED(target->BindDC(buffer, &local))) return;
    target->BeginDraw();
    target->SetTransform(D2D1::Matrix3x2F::Translation(static_cast<float>(-rect.left), static_cast<float>(-rect.top)));
    target->SetTextAntialiasMode(D2D1_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_MODE_GRAYSCALE);
    {
        Canvas canvas(*target, fonts);
        draw(canvas);
    }
    if (target->EndDraw() == D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET) g.ResetTarget();
    if (gdi) {
        const int saved = SaveDC(buffer);
        SetViewportOrgEx(buffer, -rect.left, -rect.top, nullptr);
        gdi(buffer);
        RestoreDC(buffer, saved);
    }
    BitBlt(dc, rect.left, rect.top, width, height, buffer, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Window backdrop
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void ApplyBackdrop(HWND window) {
    const BOOL dark = TRUE;
    DwmSetWindowAttribute(window, DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE, &dark, sizeof dark);
    HIGHCONTRASTW contrast{sizeof contrast};
    const bool highContrast = SystemParametersInfoW(SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST, sizeof contrast, &contrast, 0) &&
                              (contrast.dwFlags & HCF_HIGHCONTRASTON);
    auto& g = Graphics::Get();
    const DWM_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE backdrop = highContrast ? DWMSBT_NONE : DWMSBT_MAINWINDOW;
    g.mica = SUCCEEDED(DwmSetWindowAttribute(window, DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE, &backdrop, sizeof backdrop)) && !highContrast;
    const MARGINS margins = g.mica ? MARGINS{-1, -1, -1, -1} : MARGINS{0, 0, 0, 0};
    DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea(window, &margins);
    if (!g.mica) {
        const COLORREF caption = ToColorRef(Color::OpaqueBase);  // Windows 11 without Mica: seamless caption
        DwmSetWindowAttribute(window, DWMWA_CAPTION_COLOR, &caption, sizeof caption);
    }
}

}  // namespace WS::Ui

`src/gui/Theme.h`:

```h
// WireScope - Rendering foundation: palette, DPI-scaled DirectWrite fonts and a Direct2D canvas.
//
// Mica needs per-pixel alpha in the window's redirection surface, which GDI cannot produce (it
// writes alpha 0). Every surface is therefore painted with Direct2D into a premultiplied 32-bit DIB
// and copied to the window as a whole: transparent pixels show the Mica backdrop, cards are
// translucent layers on top of it, text is anti-aliased with correct alpha.
#pragma once
#include "support/Handle.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <d2d1.h>
#include <dwrite.h>
#include <wrl/client.h>
#include <array>
#include <functional>
#include <string_view>

namespace WS::Ui {

using Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr;

constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Rgb(unsigned hex, float alpha = 1.0f) {
    return {static_cast<float>((hex >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255.0f, static_cast<float>((hex >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255.0f,
            static_cast<float>(hex & 0xFF) / 255.0f, alpha};
}
constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F White(float alpha) { return {1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, alpha}; }
constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Black(float alpha) { return {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, alpha}; }
constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F WithAlpha(D2D1_COLOR_F c, float alpha) { return {c.r, c.g, c.b, c.a * alpha}; }

// Windows 11 dark-theme layer values with a deep cyan accent.
namespace Color {
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Card = White(0.050f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F CardStroke = White(0.075f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Control = White(0.061f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F ControlHot = White(0.090f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F ControlPressed = White(0.035f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F ControlDisabled = White(0.040f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F ControlStroke = White(0.075f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F FieldOnCard = White(0.105f);  // Control drawn over Card
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Text = White(1.000f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Text2 = White(0.786f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Text3 = White(0.545f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F TextDisabled = White(0.363f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Accent = Rgb(0x0E7490);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F AccentHot = Rgb(0x0F86A6);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F AccentPressed = Rgb(0x155E75);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F AccentText = Rgb(0x67E8F9);  // accent for text and indicators on dark layers
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Success = Rgb(0x6CCB5F);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Caution = Rgb(0xFCE100);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Critical = Rgb(0xFF99A4);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Danger = Rgb(0xC42B1C);      // solid fill of an engaged kill switch
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F DangerHot = Rgb(0xD13B2C);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Hover = White(0.045f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Selected = White(0.080f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Track = White(0.100f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Grid = White(0.060f);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Flyout = Rgb(0x2C2C2C);  // popup menus are opaque windows
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F FlyoutHot = Rgb(0x3A3A3A);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F FlyoutStroke = Rgb(0x454545);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F OpaqueBase = Rgb(0x202020);  // window background without Mica

// Protocol identity (fixed per protocol, never by rank)
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Tcp = Rgb(0x6CCB5F);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Udp = Rgb(0x60A5FA);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Dns = Rgb(0x22D3EE);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Tls = Rgb(0xFBBF24);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Http = Rgb(0xFB923C);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Icmp = Rgb(0xF472B6);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F Arp = Rgb(0xA78BFA);
inline constexpr D2D1_COLOR_F OtherProtocol = Rgb(0xA1A1AA);
}  // namespace Color

COLORREF ToColorRef(D2D1_COLOR_F c);  // opaque colours only

enum class Font : std::size_t { Body, Strong, Caption, Label, Mono, Icon, IconSmall, Title, Hero, Count };

// DirectWrite formats for one DPI. Sizes are in physical pixels (render targets run at 96 DPI).
class Fonts {
public:
    void Create(UINT dpi);
    [[nodiscard]] IDWriteTextFormat* operator[](Font f) const { return m_formats[static_cast<std::size_t>(f)].Get(); }
    [[nodiscard]] UINT dpi() const noexcept { return m_dpi; }
    [[nodiscard]] int S(int v) const noexcept { return MulDiv(v, static_cast<int>(m_dpi), 96); }
    [[nodiscard]] float F(float v) const noexcept { return v * static_cast<float>(m_dpi) / 96.0f; }
    [[nodiscard]] float Size(Font f) const { return m_sizes[static_cast<std::size_t>(f)]; }
    [[nodiscard]] const wchar_t* UiFamily() const noexcept { return m_uiFamily; }
    [[nodiscard]] const wchar_t* MonoFamily() const noexcept { return m_monoFamily; }

private:
    UINT m_dpi = 96;
    const wchar_t* m_uiFamily = L"Segoe UI";
    const wchar_t* m_monoFamily = L"Consolas";
    std::array<ComPtr<IDWriteTextFormat>, static_cast<std::size_t>(Font::Count)> m_formats;
    std::array<float, static_cast<std::size_t>(Font::Count)> m_sizes{};
};

// Process-wide graphics objects (UI thread only).
class Graphics {
public:
    static Graphics& Get();
    [[nodiscard]] bool Ready() const noexcept { return m_d2d && m_dwrite; }
    [[nodiscard]] ID2D1Factory* D2D() const noexcept { return m_d2d.Get(); }
    [[nodiscard]] IDWriteFactory* DWrite() const noexcept { return m_dwrite.Get(); }
    ID2D1DCRenderTarget* Target();
    void ResetTarget() { m_target.Reset(); }
    bool HasFamily(const wchar_t* family) const;

    // Mica is decided per process: either every window gets it or none does.
    bool mica = false;
    [[nodiscard]] D2D1_COLOR_F Base() const noexcept { return mica ? Black(0.0f) : Color::OpaqueBase; }
    // The pixel value a child window must fill with to look like `layer` drawn over the base.
    [[nodiscard]] D2D1_COLOR_F Surface(D2D1_COLOR_F layer) const noexcept;
    // GDI colour that reproduces `layer` (GDI pixels have alpha 0: on Mica they add to the backdrop).
    [[nodiscard]] COLORREF GdiSurface(D2D1_COLOR_F layer) const noexcept;

    // Reusable 32-bit top-down DIB (grows only).
    HDC Buffer(int width, int height);

private:
    Graphics();
    ~Graphics();
    ComPtr<ID2D1Factory> m_d2d;
    ComPtr<IDWriteFactory> m_dwrite;
    ComPtr<ID2D1DCRenderTarget> m_target;
    MemoryDc m_memDc;  // destroyed after the DIB is deselected (see ~Graphics)
    Gdi<HBITMAP> m_dib;
    HGDIOBJ m_oldBitmap = nullptr;
    int m_bufferWidth = 0, m_bufferHeight = 0;
};

enum class Align { Left, Center, Right };

class Canvas {
public:
    Canvas(ID2D1RenderTarget& target, const Fonts& fonts);
    [[nodiscard]] const Fonts& fonts() const noexcept { return m_fonts; }
    [[nodiscard]] ID2D1RenderTarget& target() noexcept { return m_rt; }

    void Clear(D2D1_COLOR_F c);
    void Fill(const D2D1_RECT_F& r, D2D1_COLOR_F c, float radius = 0);
    void Stroke(const D2D1_RECT_F& r, D2D1_COLOR_F c, float radius = 0, float width = 1);
    void Line(D2D1_POINT_2F a, D2D1_POINT_2F b, D2D1_COLOR_F c, float width = 1);
    void Circle(D2D1_POINT_2F center, float radius, D2D1_COLOR_F c);
    void Polyline(const D2D1_POINT_2F* points, size_t count, D2D1_COLOR_F c, float width);
    void Area(const D2D1_POINT_2F* points, size_t count, float baseline, D2D1_COLOR_F c);
    // Single line, vertically centred, ellipsis when it does not fit.
    void Text(std::wstring_view text, const D2D1_RECT_F& r, Font font, D2D1_COLOR_F c, Align align = Align::Left);
    // Wrapped paragraph from the top of `r`; returns the height used.
    float Paragraph(std::wstring_view text, const D2D1_RECT_F& r, Font font, D2D1_COLOR_F c);
    float Width(std::wstring_view text, Font font);
    float ParagraphHeight(std::wstring_view text, float width, Font font);
    void PushClip(const D2D1_RECT_F& r);
    void PopClip();

private:
    ID2D1SolidColorBrush* Brush(D2D1_COLOR_F c);
    ID2D1RenderTarget& m_rt;
    const Fonts& m_fonts;
    ComPtr<ID2D1SolidColorBrush> m_brush;
};

// Text width without a render target (layout and menus measure before painting).
float TextWidth(const Fonts& fonts, Font font, std::wstring_view text);
float TextHeight(const Fonts& fonts, Font font, std::wstring_view text, float width);  // wrapped

// Paints `rect` (client coordinates of `dc`) through the shared DIB.
// `gdi` runs after Direct2D on the same buffer, for areas that must match GDI-drawn child controls.
void Paint(HDC dc, const RECT& rect, const Fonts& fonts, const std::function<void(Canvas&)>& draw,
           const std::function<void(HDC)>& gdi = {});

constexpr D2D1_RECT_F ToF(const RECT& r) {
    return {static_cast<float>(r.left), static_cast<float>(r.top), static_cast<float>(r.right), static_cast<float>(r.bottom)};
}
constexpr D2D1_RECT_F Inset(const D2D1_RECT_F& r, float dx, float dy) { return {r.left + dx, r.top + dy, r.right - dx, r.bottom - dy}; }
inline RECT ToRect(const D2D1_RECT_F& r) {
    return {static_cast<LONG>(r.left), static_cast<LONG>(r.top), static_cast<LONG>(r.right + 0.999f), static_cast<LONG>(r.bottom + 0.999f)};
}

// Applies dark title bar + Mica (or the opaque fallback) to a top-level window.
void ApplyBackdrop(HWND window);

}  // namespace WS::Ui

`src/gui/Widgets.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "gui/Widgets.h"
#include <CommCtrl.h>
#include <windowsx.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <memory>

#pragma comment(lib, "comctl32.lib")

namespace WS::Ui {
namespace {

HINSTANCE Instance() { return GetModuleHandleW(nullptr); }

// Button hover tracking. Only one control can be under the mouse, so one HWND is enough.
HWND g_hotButton = nullptr;

LRESULT CALLBACK ButtonProc(HWND hwnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam, UINT_PTR id, DWORD_PTR) {
    switch (message) {
    case WM_MOUSEMOVE:
        if (g_hotButton != hwnd) {
            if (HWND old = std::exchange(g_hotButton, hwnd)) InvalidateRect(old, nullptr, FALSE);
            TRACKMOUSEEVENT tme{sizeof tme, TME_LEAVE, hwnd, 0};
            TrackMouseEvent(&tme);
            InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        }
        break;
    case WM_MOUSELEAVE:
        if (g_hotButton == hwnd) {
            g_hotButton = nullptr;
            InvalidateRect(hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        }
        break;
    case WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK:
        // Owner-drawn buttons turn a quick second click into BN_DOUBLECLICKED; treat it as a click.
        return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, WM_LBUTTONDOWN, wParam, lParam);
    case WM_ERASEBKGND:
        return 1;
    case WM_ENABLE:
        if (!wParam && g_hotButton == hwnd) g_hotButton = nullptr;
        break;
    case WM_NCDESTROY:
        if (g_hotButton == hwnd) g_hotButton = nullptr;
        RemoveWindowSubclass(hwnd, ButtonProc, id);
        break;
    }
    return DefSubclassProc(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

}  // namespace

float WheelStep(const Fonts& f, float rowHeight) {
    UINT lines = 3;
    SystemParametersInfoW(SPI_GETWHEELSCROLLLINES, 0, &lines, 0);
    if (lines == WHEEL_PAGESCROLL) lines = 10;
    return std::max(rowHeight, f.F(18)) * static_cast<float>(std::max(lines, 1u));
}

void RegisterControlClass(const wchar_t* name, WNDPROC proc) {
    WNDCLASSEXW wc{sizeof wc};
    if (GetClassInfoExW(Instance(), name, &wc)) return;
    wc.style = CS_DBLCLKS;
    wc.lpfnWndProc = proc;
    wc.hInstance = Instance();
    wc.hCursor = LoadCursorW(nullptr, IDC_ARROW);
    wc.lpszClassName = name;
    RegisterClassExW(&wc);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Buttons
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
HWND CreateButton(HWND parent, int id, const wchar_t* text) {
    HWND b = CreateWindowExW(0, L"BUTTON", text, WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | WS_TABSTOP | BS_OWNERDRAW, 0, 0, 10, 10, parent,
                             reinterpret_cast<HMENU>(static_cast<INT_PTR>(id)), Instance(), nullptr);
    if (b) SetWindowSubclass(b, ButtonProc, 1, 0);
    return b;
}

void DrawButton(const DRAWITEMSTRUCT& dis, const Fonts& f, const ButtonLook& look) {
    const bool disabled = dis.itemState & ODS_DISABLED;
    const bool pressed = (dis.itemState & ODS_SELECTED) && !disabled;
    const bool focus = (dis.itemState & ODS_FOCUS) && !(dis.itemState & ODS_NOFOCUSRECT);
    const bool hot = g_hotButton == dis.hwndItem && !disabled;
    wchar_t label[200]{};
    GetWindowTextW(dis.hwndItem, label, static_cast<int>(std::size(label)));
    const std::wstring_view text(label);
    auto& g = Graphics::Get();

    Paint(dis.hDC, dis.rcItem, f, [&](Canvas& c) {
        const D2D1_RECT_F r = ToF(dis.rcItem);
        c.Clear(look.onCard ? g.Surface(Color::Card) : g.Base());
        const float radius = f.F(4);
        D2D1_COLOR_F fg = disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : pressed ? Color::Text2 : Color::Text;
        const std::wstring icon = look.icon ? std::wstring(1, look.icon) : std::wstring();

        // Icon + label centred as one group (Standard, Accent, Danger, Segment).
        auto iconAndLabel = [&](D2D1_COLOR_F iconColor, D2D1_COLOR_F textColor, Font font) {
            const float pad = f.F(10);
            const float iconW = look.icon ? f.F(16) + (text.empty() ? 0 : f.F(8)) : 0;
            const float tw = std::min(c.Width(text, font), std::max(0.0f, r.right - r.left - 2 * pad - iconW));
            float x = r.left + (r.right - r.left - iconW - tw) / 2;
            if (look.icon) {
                c.Text(icon, {x, r.top, x + f.F(16), r.bottom}, Font::Icon, iconColor, Align::Center);
                x += iconW;
            }
            if (!text.empty()) c.Text(text, {x, r.top, x + tw + 1, r.bottom}, font, textColor);
        };

        switch (look.kind) {
        case ButtonKind::Accent: {
            const D2D1_COLOR_F fill = disabled ? Color::ControlDisabled : pressed ? Color::AccentPressed : hot ? Color::AccentHot : Color::Accent;
            c.Fill(r, fill, radius);
            if (disabled) c.Stroke(r, Color::ControlStroke, radius);
            else fg = pressed ? White(0.8f) : Color::Text;
            iconAndLabel(fg, fg, Font::Body);
            break;
        }
        case ButtonKind::Danger: {
            D2D1_COLOR_F fill = look.checked ? (hot ? Color::DangerHot : Color::Danger)
                                : disabled ? Color::ControlDisabled
                                : pressed ? Color::ControlPressed
                                : hot     ? Color::ControlHot
                                          : Color::Control;
            c.Fill(r, fill, radius);
            if (!look.checked) c.Stroke(r, WithAlpha(Color::Critical, disabled ? 0.15f : 0.35f), radius);
            const D2D1_COLOR_F ink = disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : look.checked ? Color::Text : Color::Critical;
            iconAndLabel(ink, look.checked ? Color::Text : fg, Font::Strong);
            break;
        }
        case ButtonKind::Icon:
            if (hot || pressed) c.Fill(r, pressed ? Color::ControlPressed : Color::Hover, radius);
            c.Text(icon, r, Font::Icon, fg, Align::Center);
            break;
        case ButtonKind::Nav: {
            if (look.checked || hot || pressed) c.Fill(Inset(r, 0, f.F(1)), look.checked ? Color::Selected : pressed ? Color::ControlPressed : Color::Hover, radius);
            if (look.checked) {
                const float mid = (r.top + r.bottom) / 2;
                c.Fill({r.left + f.F(1), mid - f.F(8), r.left + f.F(4), mid + f.F(8)}, Color::AccentText, f.F(1.5f));
            }
            const float x = r.left + f.F(14);
            c.Text(icon, {x, r.top, x + f.F(18), r.bottom}, Font::Icon, look.checked ? Color::AccentText : Color::Text2, Align::Center);
            const float tx = x + f.F(30);
            const float tw = c.Width(text, Font::Body);
            c.Text(text, {tx, r.top, r.right - f.F(8), r.bottom}, Font::Body, disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : Color::Text);
            if (!look.badge.empty()) {
                const float bw = c.Width(look.badge, Font::Label) + f.F(12);
                const float bx = std::min(tx + tw + f.F(8), r.right - f.F(8) - bw);
                const D2D1_RECT_F b{bx, r.top + f.F(9), bx + bw, r.bottom - f.F(9)};
                const D2D1_COLOR_F ink = look.alert ? Color::Critical : Color::AccentText;
                c.Fill(b, WithAlpha(ink, 0.16f), (b.bottom - b.top) / 2);
                c.Text(look.badge, b, Font::Label, ink, Align::Center);
            }
            break;
        }
        case ButtonKind::Toggle: {
            // Windows 11 toggle switch with its label to the right.
            const float h = f.F(20), w = f.F(40);
            const float top = (r.top + r.bottom - h) / 2;
            const D2D1_RECT_F pill{r.left + f.F(2), top, r.left + f.F(2) + w, top + h};
            if (look.checked) {
                c.Fill(pill, disabled ? Color::ControlDisabled : hot ? Color::AccentHot : Color::Accent, h / 2);
            } else {
                c.Fill(pill, hot ? Color::ControlHot : Color::Control, h / 2);
                c.Stroke(pill, disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : Color::Text3, h / 2, f.F(1));
            }
            const float knob = (hot || pressed) ? f.F(7) : f.F(6);
            const float kx = look.checked ? pill.right - h / 2 : pill.left + h / 2;
            c.Circle({kx, (pill.top + pill.bottom) / 2}, knob, disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : look.checked ? Color::Text : Color::Text2);
            c.Text(text, {pill.right + f.F(10), r.top, r.right, r.bottom}, Font::Body, disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : Color::Text);
            if (focus) c.Stroke(Inset(pill, -f.F(3), -f.F(3)), Color::Text, (h + f.F(6)) / 2, f.F(1.5f));
            return;
        }
        case ButtonKind::Segment: {
            const D2D1_COLOR_F fill = look.checked ? WithAlpha(Color::AccentText, 0.14f)
                                      : pressed    ? Color::ControlPressed
                                      : hot        ? Color::ControlHot
                                                   : Color::Control;
            c.Fill(r, fill, radius);
            c.Stroke(r, look.checked ? WithAlpha(Color::AccentText, 0.55f) : Color::ControlStroke, radius);
            const D2D1_COLOR_F ink = disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : look.checked ? Color::AccentText : Color::Text2;
            iconAndLabel(ink, look.checked ? Color::Text : fg, Font::Body);
            break;
        }
        case ButtonKind::Combo: {
            c.Fill(r, disabled ? Color::ControlDisabled : pressed ? Color::ControlPressed : hot ? Color::ControlHot : Color::Control, radius);
            c.Stroke(r, Color::ControlStroke, radius);
            float x = r.left + f.F(10);
            if (look.icon) {
                c.Text(icon, {x, r.top, x + f.F(16), r.bottom}, Font::Icon, disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : Color::Text2, Align::Center);
                x += f.F(24);
            }
            c.Text(text, {x, r.top, r.right - f.F(30), r.bottom}, Font::Body, fg);
            c.Text(std::wstring(1, Icon::ChevronDown), {r.right - f.F(28), r.top, r.right - f.F(8), r.bottom}, Font::IconSmall,
                   disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : Color::Text2, Align::Center);
            break;
        }
        case ButtonKind::Standard:
            c.Fill(r, disabled ? Color::ControlDisabled : pressed ? Color::ControlPressed : hot ? Color::ControlHot : Color::Control, radius);
            c.Stroke(r, Color::ControlStroke, radius);
            iconAndLabel(disabled ? Color::TextDisabled : Color::Text2, fg, Font::Body);
            break;
        }
        if (focus) c.Stroke(r, Color::Text, radius, f.F(1.5f));
    });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Scroller
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void Scroller::Clamp() { offset = std::clamp(offset, 0.0f, Max()); }

void Scroller::EnsureVisible(float top, float bottom) {
    if (top < offset) offset = top;
    else if (bottom > offset + view) offset = bottom - view;
    Clamp();
}

D2D1_RECT_F Scroller::Track(const RECT& client, const Fonts& f, float top) const {
    return {static_cast<float>(client.right) - f.F(9), static_cast<float>(client.top) + top + f.F(3),
            static_cast<float>(client.right) - f.F(2), static_cast<float>(client.bottom) - f.F(3)};
}

D2D1_RECT_F Scroller::Thumb(const RECT& client, const Fonts& f, float top) const {
    const D2D1_RECT_F t = Track(client, f, top);
    const float h = t.bottom - t.top;
    const float thumb = std::max(f.F(24), h * (content > 0 ? view / content : 1.0f));
    const float y = t.top + (Max() > 0 ? (h - thumb) * offset / Max() : 0);
    return {t.left, y, t.right, y + thumb};
}

void Scroller::Draw(Canvas& c, const RECT& client, float top) const {
    if (!Visible()) return;
    const auto& f = c.fonts();
    D2D1_RECT_F t = Thumb(client, f, top);
    const float w = (hot || dragging) ? f.F(6) : f.F(3);
    t.left = t.right - w;
    c.Fill(t, White(hot || dragging ? 0.50f : 0.30f), w / 2);
}

bool Scroller::MouseDown(POINT p, const RECT& client, const Fonts& f, float top) {
    if (!Visible()) return false;
    const D2D1_RECT_F t = Track(client, f, top);
    if (static_cast<float>(p.x) < t.left - f.F(3) || static_cast<float>(p.y) < t.top) return false;
    const D2D1_RECT_F thumb = Thumb(client, f, top);
    const float y = static_cast<float>(p.y);
    if (y < thumb.top) offset -= view;
    else if (y > thumb.bottom) offset += view;
    Clamp();
    dragging = true;
    grabY = y;
    grabOffset = offset;
    return true;
}

bool Scroller::MouseMove(POINT p, const RECT& client, const Fonts& f, float top) {
    if (dragging) {
        const D2D1_RECT_F t = Track(client, f, top), thumb = Thumb(client, f, top);
        const float range = (t.bottom - t.top) - (thumb.bottom - thumb.top);
        const float before = offset;
        if (range > 0) offset = grabOffset + (static_cast<float>(p.y) - grabY) * Max() / range;
        Clamp();
        return offset != before;
    }
    const bool now = Visible() && static_cast<float>(p.x) >= Track(client, f, top).left - f.F(3);
    if (now == hot) return false;
    hot = now;
    return true;
}

bool Scroller::Wheel(int delta, float step) {
    const float before = offset;
    offset -= static_cast<float>(delta) / WHEEL_DELTA * step;
    Clamp();
    return offset != before;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Slider
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
namespace {
constexpr wchar_t kSliderClass[] = L"WireScope.Slider";
}

HWND Slider::Create(HWND parent, int id, double min, double max, double step, double gamma) {
    m_min = min;
    m_max = max;
    m_step = step;
    m_gamma = gamma;
    m_value = min;
    RegisterControlClass(kSliderClass, Proc);
    m_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(0, kSliderClass, L"", WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | WS_TABSTOP, 0, 0, 10, 10, parent,
                             reinterpret_cast<HMENU>(static_cast<INT_PTR>(id)), Instance(), this);
    return m_hwnd;
}

LRESULT CALLBACK Slider::Proc(HWND hwnd, UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    auto* self = ControlFromWindow<Slider>(hwnd, message, lParam);
    if (message == WM_NCCREATE && self) self->m_hwnd = hwnd;
    if (message == WM_NCDESTROY) {
        SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA, 0);
        if (self) self->m_hwnd = nullptr;
        return DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
    }
    return self ? self->Handle(message, wParam, lParam) : DefWindowProcW(hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

double Slider::Position() const {
    if (m_max <= m_min) return 0;
    const double linear = std::clamp((m_value - m_min) / (m_max - m_min), 0.0, 1.0);
    return std::pow(linear, 1.0 / m_gamma);
}

double Slider::FromPosition(double t) const {
    return m_min + (m_max - m_min) * std::pow(std::clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0), m_gamma);
}

D2D1_RECT_F Slider::TrackRect() const {
    RECT rc{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &rc);
    const float pad = m_fonts.F(10);
    return {static_cast<float>(rc.left) + pad, static_cast<float>(rc.top), static_cast<float>(rc.right) - pad, static_cast<float>(rc.bottom)};
}

void Slider::SetValue(double value, bool notify) {
    value = std::clamp(value, m_min, m_max);
    if (m_step > 0) value = m_min + std::round((value - m_min) / m_step) * m_step;
    value = std::clamp(value, m_min, m_max);
    if (value == m_value) return;
    m_value = value;
    if (m_hwnd) InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
    if (notify && m_hwnd) {
        SendMessageW(GetParent(m_hwnd), WM_COMMAND, MAKEWPARAM(GetDlgCtrlID(m_hwnd), SliderChanged), reinterpret_cast<LPARAM>(m_hwnd));
    }
}

void Slider::SetFromX(int x) {
    const D2D1_RECT_F t = TrackRect();
    const double pos = (static_cast<double>(x) - t.left) / std::max(1.0f, t.right - t.left);
    SetValue(FromPosition(pos), true);
}

void Slider::Paint() {
    PaintScope ps(m_hwnd);
    RECT client{};
    GetClientRect(m_hwnd, &client);
    const auto& f = m_fonts;
    const bool enabled = IsWindowEnabled(m_hwnd);
    Ui::Paint(ps.dc(), client, f, [&](Canvas& c) {
        c.Clear(m_onCard ? Graphics::Get().Surface(Color::Card) : Graphics::Get().Base());
        const D2D1_RECT_F t = TrackRect();
        const float mid = (t.top + t.bottom) / 2;
        const float x = t.left + static_cast<float>(Position()) * (t.right - t.left);
        c.Fill({t.left, mid - f.F(2), t.right, mid + f.F(2)}, Color::Track, f.F(2));
        c.Fill({t.left, mid - f.F(2), x, mid + f.F(2)}, enabled ? Color::AccentText : Color::TextDisabled, f.F(2));
        // Thumb: ring + accent centre that grows under the mouse (Windows 11 slider).
        c.Circle({x, mid}, f.F(10), Rgb(0x454545));
        c.Circle({x, mid}, f.F(9), Rgb(0x2D2D2D));
        c.Circle({x, mid}, (m_hot || m_dragging) ? f.F(6.5f) : f.F(5), enabled ? Color::AccentText : Color::TextDisabled);
        if (GetFocus() == m_hwnd) c.Stroke({x - f.F(13), mid - f.F(13), x + f.F(13), mid + f.F(13)}, Color::Text, f.F(13), f.F(1.5f));
    });
}

LRESULT Slider::Handle(UINT message, WPARAM wParam, LPARAM lParam) {
    switch (message) {
    case WM_ERASEBKGND:
        return 1;
    case WM_PAINT:
        Paint();
        return 0;
    case WM_SIZE:
    case WM_ENABLE:
    case WM_SETFOCUS:
    case WM_KILLFOCUS:
        InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    case WM_GETDLGCODE:
        return DLGC_WANTARROWS;
    case WM_KEYDOWN: {
        const double big = std::max(m_step * 10, (m_max - m_min) / 20);
        switch (wParam) {
        case VK_LEFT: case VK_DOWN: SetValue(m_value - m_step, true); return 0;
        case VK_RIGHT: case VK_UP: SetValue(m_value + m_step, true); return 0;
        case VK_PRIOR: SetValue(m_value + big, true); return 0;
        case VK_NEXT: SetValue(m_value - big, true); return 0;
        case VK_HOME: SetValue(m_min, true); return 0;
        case VK_END: SetValue(m_max, true); return 0;
        }
        break;
    }
    case WM_LBUTTONDOWN:
        SetFocus(m_hwnd);
        SetCapture(m_hwnd);
        m_dragging = true;
        SetFromX(GET_X_LPARAM(lParam));
        return 0;
    case WM_MOUSEMOVE:
        if (!m_tracking) {
            TRACKMOUSEEVENT tme{sizeof tme, TME_LEAVE, m_hwnd, 0};
            m_tracking = TrackMouseEvent(&tme) != FALSE;
        }
        if (!m_hot) {
            m_hot = true;
            InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        }
        if (m_dragging) SetFromX(GET_X_LPARAM(lParam));
        return 0;
    case WM_MOUSELEAVE:
        m_tracking = false;
        m_hot = false;
        InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        return 0;
    case WM_LBUTTONUP:
        if (m_dragging) {
            m_dragging = false;
            ReleaseCapture();
            InvalidateRect(m_hwnd, nullptr, FALSE);
        }
        return 0;
    case WM_CAPTURECHANGED:
        m_dragging = false;
        return 0;
    case WM_MOUSEWHEEL:
        SetValue(m_value + (GET_WHEEL_DELTA_WPARAM(wParam) > 0 ? m_step : -m_step), true);
        return 0;
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(m_hwnd, message, wParam, lParam);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Clipboard
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
bool CopyToClipboard(HWND owner, const std::wstring& text) {
    if (!OpenClipboard(owner)) return false;
    const ScopeExit close([] { CloseClipboard(); });
    EmptyClipboard();
    const std::size_t bytes = (text.size() + 1) * sizeof(wchar_t);
    struct GlobalFreer {
        void operator()(void* h) const noexcept { GlobalFree(h); }
    };
    std::unique_ptr<void, GlobalFreer> memory(GlobalAlloc(GMEM_MOVEABLE, bytes));
    if (!memory) return false;
    if (void* p = GlobalLock(memory.get())) {
        std::memcpy(p, text.c_str(), bytes);
        GlobalUnlock(memory.get());
    } else {
        return false;
    }
    if (!SetClipboardData(CF_UNICODETEXT, memory.get())) return false;
    (void)memory.release();  // owned by the clipboard now
    return true;
}

}  // namespace WS::Ui

`src/gui/Widgets.h`:

```h
// WireScope - Controls drawn with the Direct2D canvas: owner-drawn buttons (push, accent, combo,
// navigation, toggle switch, segment, kill switch), a slider and the shared scroll bar. All of them
// are real child windows, so Tab, focus and keyboard work as usual.
#pragma once
#include "gui/Theme.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <functional>
#include <string>

namespace WS::Ui {

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Buttons (BS_OWNERDRAW, drawn from the parent's WM_DRAWITEM)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
enum class ButtonKind { Standard, Accent, Combo, Icon, Nav, Toggle, Segment, Danger };

struct ButtonLook {
    ButtonKind kind = ButtonKind::Standard;
    wchar_t icon = 0;        // Segoe Fluent Icons code point
    bool onCard = false;     // sits on a card layer (else directly on the window background)
    bool checked = false;    // Nav: current page, Toggle: on, Segment: chosen, Danger: engaged
    std::wstring badge;      // Nav: small pill after the label
    bool alert = false;      // Nav: the badge asks for attention (critical colour)
};

HWND CreateButton(HWND parent, int id, const wchar_t* text);
void DrawButton(const DRAWITEMSTRUCT& dis, const Fonts& fonts, const ButtonLook& look);

// Common icon code points (Segoe Fluent Icons / Segoe MDL2 Assets).
namespace Icon {
inline constexpr wchar_t ChevronDown = 0xE70D, ChevronRight = 0xE76C, ArrowUp = 0xE74A, ArrowDown = 0xE74B;
inline constexpr wchar_t Delete = 0xE74D, Add = 0xE710, Edit = 0xE70F, Play = 0xE768, Stop = 0xE71A;
inline constexpr wchar_t Save = 0xE74E, Clear = 0xE894, Search = 0xE721, Shield = 0xEA18, Network = 0xE968;
inline constexpr wchar_t Speed = 0xEC4A, Power = 0xE7E8, Refresh = 0xE72C, Import = 0xE8B5, Export = 0xEDE1;
inline constexpr wchar_t Info = 0xE946, Check = 0xE73E, Warning = 0xE7BA, Globe = 0xE774, Filter = 0xE71C;
inline constexpr wchar_t Up = 0xE70E, Down = 0xE70D, Admin = 0xE7EF, Language = 0xF2B7;
inline constexpr wchar_t Apps = 0xE71D, Blocked = 0xE733, Folder = 0xE8B7, Copy = 0xE8C8, Repair = 0xE90F;
}  // namespace Icon

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Vertical scrolling shared by the lists.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct Scroller {
    float offset = 0, content = 0, view = 0;
    bool dragging = false, hot = false;
    float grabY = 0, grabOffset = 0;

    [[nodiscard]] float Max() const { return content > view ? content - view : 0; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool Visible() const { return content > view + 0.5f; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool AtEnd() const { return offset >= Max() - 1.0f; }
    void Clamp();
    void ScrollTo(float y) { offset = y; Clamp(); }
    void EnsureVisible(float top, float bottom);
    [[nodiscard]] D2D1_RECT_F Track(const RECT& client, const Fonts& f, float top = 0) const;
    [[nodiscard]] D2D1_RECT_F Thumb(const RECT& client, const Fonts& f, float top = 0) const;
    void Draw(Canvas& c, const RECT& client, float top = 0) const;
    bool MouseDown(POINT p, const RECT& client, const Fonts& f, float top = 0);  // true = handled (capture)
    bool MouseMove(POINT p, const RECT& client, const Fonts& f, float top = 0);  // true = repaint needed
    bool Wheel(int delta, float step);                                          // true = offset changed
};

float WheelStep(const Fonts& f, float rowHeight);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Slider: value in [min, max] snapped to `step`. `gamma` > 1 gives the low end more travel
// (position = ((value - min) / (max - min)) ^ (1 / gamma)). Notifies the parent with
// WM_COMMAND(id, SliderChanged) while the value changes.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
inline constexpr WORD SliderChanged = 0x0100;

class Slider {
public:
    explicit Slider(const Fonts& fonts) : m_fonts(fonts) {}
    Slider(const Slider&) = delete;
    Slider& operator=(const Slider&) = delete;

    HWND Create(HWND parent, int id, double min, double max, double step, double gamma);
    [[nodiscard]] HWND hwnd() const noexcept { return m_hwnd; }
    [[nodiscard]] double Value() const noexcept { return m_value; }
    void SetValue(double value, bool notify = false);
    void SetOnCard(bool onCard) { m_onCard = onCard; }

private:
    static LRESULT CALLBACK Proc(HWND, UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM);
    LRESULT Handle(UINT, WPARAM, LPARAM);
    void Paint();
    [[nodiscard]] double Position() const;          // 0..1
    [[nodiscard]] double FromPosition(double t) const;
    [[nodiscard]] D2D1_RECT_F TrackRect() const;
    void SetFromX(int x);

    const Fonts& m_fonts;
    HWND m_hwnd = nullptr;
    double m_min = 0, m_max = 1, m_step = 1, m_gamma = 1, m_value = 0;
    bool m_dragging = false, m_hot = false, m_tracking = false, m_onCard = true;
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helpers for the custom controls
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
void RegisterControlClass(const wchar_t* name, WNDPROC proc);

template <class T>
T* ControlFromWindow(HWND hwnd, UINT message, LPARAM lParam) {
    if (message == WM_NCCREATE) {
        auto* self = static_cast<T*>(reinterpret_cast<CREATESTRUCTW*>(lParam)->lpCreateParams);
        SetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA, reinterpret_cast<LONG_PTR>(self));
        return self;
    }
    return reinterpret_cast<T*>(GetWindowLongPtrW(hwnd, GWLP_USERDATA));
}

// Copies text to the clipboard (CF_UNICODETEXT).
bool CopyToClipboard(HWND owner, const std::wstring& text);

}  // namespace WS::Ui

10205="{}": الحد الأقصى لبادئة IPv4 هو /32
10206="{}" ليس عنوان IP صالحاً أو بادئة أو نطاق IPv4
10207="{}" ليس منفذاً أو نطاق منافذ صالحاً (0-65535)
10208=يبدأ نطاق المنافذ "{}" بقيمة أعلى من نهايته
10209=تحتاج القاعدة إلى أكثر من {} من إدخالات برنامج التشغيل؛ استخدم بادئات CIDR بدلاً من النطاقات الواسعة
10210=Rule syntax:   allow|block  [in|out|both]  [ip4|ip6]  [tcp|udp|icmp|proto N]\n               [from|to|remote|local ADDR]  [sport|dport|rport|lport|port P]  [type N]  [app NAME|PATH]\n\n  ADDR  1.2.3.4   1.2.3.0/24   10.0.0.1-10.0.0.50   2001:db8::/32   (العنوان ADDR بمفرده = remote)\n  P     443   27015-27030\n  NAME  discord.exe  أو  discord     PATH  C:\\Tools\\nc.exe   (القيمة التي تحتوي على مسافات توضع بين "علامات تنصيص")\n  يتبع remote/local و rport/lport اتجاه الحزمة (الصادر: remote = الوجهة).\n  "port" يطابق كلا الجانبين. يتم فحص القواعد من الأعلى للأسفل، وأول مطابقة هي التي تسري؛\n  الحزم التي لا تطابق أي قاعدة تتبع السياسة الافتراضية.\n\nأمثلة:\n  block out tcp dport 443              حظر HTTPS الصادر\n  block udp rport 27015-27030          قطع نطاق خوادم ألعاب في كلا الاتجاهين\n  allow remote 192.168.0.0/16          إبقاء الشبكة المحلية LAN متاحة\n  block in icmp type 8                 تجاهل ping الوارد\n  block 203.0.113.7                    مضيف واحد، أي بروتوكول\n  block app discord.exe                برنامج واحد (مقابس TCP و UDP الخاصة به)\n  block app "C:\\Tools\\net cat.exe"    نسخة واحدة من برنامج عبر مسارها\n  allow out udp dport 53               DNS (ضعها فوق قاعدة حظر أوسع)\n

Pravidla se vyhodnocují shora dolů, rozhoduje první shoda;\n  pakety bez odpovídajícího pravidla podléhají výchozí zásadě.\n\nPříklady:\n  block out tcp dport 443              žádné odchozí HTTPS\n  block udp rport 27015-27030          odříznout rozsah herního serveru v obou směrech\n  allow remote 192.168.0.0/16          místní síť zůstává dostupná\n  block in icmp type 8                 ignorovat příchozí ping\n  block 203.0.113.7                    jeden hostitel, libovolný protokol\n  block app discord.exe                jeden program (jeho sokety TCP a UDP)\n  block app "C:\\Tools\\net cat.exe"    jedna kopie programu určená cestou\n  allow out udp dport 53               DNS (umístit nad širší blokaci)\n

# Rule syntax errors
10184="{}" nécessite une valeur
10185=directions contradictoires
10186=ip4 et ip6 ont tous deux été spécifiés
10187=plus d'un protocole spécifié
10188="{}" n'est ni un nom ni un numéro de protocole
10189="{}" n'est pas un type ICMP (0-255)
10190="{}" spécifié deux fois
10191="{}" inattendu
10192=plus d'une adresse distante spécifiée
10193=utilisez from/to ou remote/local, pas les deux
10194=utilisez sport/dport ou rport/lport, pas les deux
10195="port" correspond déjà aux deux côtés ; supprimez les autres mots-clés de port
10196=les ports ne s'appliquent qu'à tcp et udp
10197="type" ne s'applique qu'à icmp
10198=les adresses IPv4 et IPv6 ne peuvent pas être mélangées dans une même règle
10199=la famille d'adresses contredit ip4/ip6
10200=règle vide
10201=une règle commence par allow ou block, pas "{}"
10202="{}" n'est pas une plage IPv4 (a.b.c.d-e.f.g.h)
10203=la plage "{}" commence au-delà de sa fin
10204="{}" a une longueur de préfixe non valide
10205="{}" : un préfixe IPv4 est au maximum /32
10206="{}" n'est ni une adresse IP, ni un préfixe, ni une plage IPv4
10207="{}" n'est ni un port ni une plage de ports (0-65535)
10208=la plage de ports "{}" commence au-delà de sa fin
10209=la règle nécessite plus de {} entrées de pilote ; utilisez des préfixes CIDR au lieu de plages étendues
10210=Syntaxe de règle : allow|block  [in|out|both]  [ip4|ip6]  [tcp|udp|icmp|proto N]\n                     [from|to|remote|local ADDR]  [sport|dport|rport|lport|port P]  [type N]  [app NOM|CHEMIN]\n\n  ADDR    1.2.3.4   1.2.3.0/24   10.0.0.1-10.0.0.50   2001:db8::/32   (une ADDR seule = remote)\n  P       443   27015-27030\n  NOM     discord.exe  ou  discord     CHEMIN  C:\\Tools\\nc.exe   (valeurs avec espaces entre "guillemets")\n  remote/local et rport/lport suivent la direction du paquet (sortant : remote = destination).\n  "port" correspond aux deux côtés. Les règles sont vérifiées de haut en bas, la première gagne ;\n  les paquets sans règle correspondante suivent la stratégie par défaut.\n\nExemples :\n  block out tcp dport 443              aucun HTTPS sortant\n  block udp rport 27015-27030          couper une plage de serveurs de jeu dans les deux sens\n  allow remote 192.168.0.0/16          garder le réseau local accessible\n  block in icmp type 8                 ignorer le ping entrant\n  block 203.0.113.7                    un seul hôte, tout protocole\n  block app discord.exe                un programme (ses sockets TCP et UDP)\n  block app "C:\\Tools\\net cat.exe"    une copie d'un programme, par son chemin\n  allow out udp dport 53               DNS (à placer au-dessus d'un blocage plus large)\n

# Rule syntax errors
10184="{}" के लिए एक मान की आवश्यकता है
10185=परस्पर विरोधी दिशाएं
10186=ip4 और ip6 दोनों दिए गए हैं
10187=एक से अधिक प्रोटोकॉल दिए गए हैं
10188="{}" कोई मान्य प्रोटोकॉल नाम या संख्या नहीं है
10189="{}" कोई मान्य ICMP प्रकार (0-255) नहीं है
10190="{}" दो बार दिया गया है
10191=अप्रत्याशित "{}"
10192=एक से अधिक रिमोट पते दिए गए हैं
10193=केवल from/to या remote/local का उपयोग करें, दोनों का नहीं
10194=केवल sport/dport या rport/lport का उपयोग करें, दोनों का नहीं
10195="port" पहले से ही दोनों पक्षों से मेल खाता है; अन्य पोर्ट कीवर्ड छोड़ दें
10196=पोर्ट केवल tcp और udp पर लागू होते हैं
10197="type" केवल icmp पर लागू होता है
10198=एक ही नियम में IPv4 और IPv6 पतों को मिलाया नहीं जा सकता
10199=पता परिवार ip4/ip6 का खंडन करता है
10200=रिक्त नियम
10201=एक नियम allow या block से शुरू होता है, "{}" से नहीं
10202="{}" कोई IPv4 श्रेणी (a.b.c.d-e.f.g.h) नहीं है
10203=श्रेणी "{}" अपने अंत से ऊपर शुरू होती है
10204="{}" में अमान्य उपसर्ग लंबाई है
10205="{}": एक IPv4 उपसर्ग अधिकतम /32 हो सकता है
10206="{}" कोई IP पता, उपसर्ग या IPv4 श्रेणी नहीं है
10207="{}" कोई पोर्ट या पोर्ट श्रेणी (0-65535) नहीं है
10208=पोर्ट श्रेणी "{}" अपने अंत से ऊपर शुरू होती है
10209=नियम को {} से अधिक ड्राइवर प्रविष्टियों की आवश्यकता है; विस्तृत श्रेणियों के बजाय CIDR उपसर्गों का उपयोग करें
10210=Rule syntax:   allow|block  [in|out|both]  [ip4|ip6]  [tcp|udp|icmp|proto N]\n               [from|to|remote|local ADDR]  [sport|dport|rport|lport|port P]  [type N]  [app NAME|PATH]\n\n  ADDR  1.2.3.4   1.2.3.0/24   10.0.0.1-10.0.0.50   2001:db8::/32   (केवल ADDR = remote)\n  P     443   27015-27030\n  NAME  discord.exe  या  discord     PATH  C:\\Tools\\nc.exe   (रिक्त स्थान वाले मान "उद्धरण चिह्नों" में रखे जाते हैं)\n  remote/local और rport/lport पैकेट की दिशा का पालन करते हैं (जावक: remote = गंतव्य)।\n  "port" दोनों पक्षों से मेल खाता है। नियम ऊपर से नीचे जाँचे जाते हैं, पहला मिलान मान्य होता है;\n  जिन पैकेटों पर कोई नियम लागू नहीं होता, वे डिफ़ॉल्ट नीति का पालन करते हैं।\n\nउदाहरण:\n  block out tcp dport 443              जावक HTTPS ब्लॉक करें\n  block udp rport 27015-27030          गेम सर्वर श्रेणी को दोनों तरफ से काटें\n  allow remote 192.168.0.0/16          स्थानीय नेटवर्क (LAN) को सुलभ रखें\n  block in icmp type 8                 आने वाले पिंग को अनदेखा करें\n  block 203.0.113.7                    एक होस्ट, कोई भी प्रोटोकॉल\n  block app discord.exe                एक प्रोग्राम (इसके TCP और UDP सॉकेट)\n  block app "C:\\Tools\\net cat.exe"    पथ द्वारा किसी प्रोग्राम की एक प्रति\n  allow out udp dport 53               DNS (इसे व्यापक ब्लॉक के ऊपर रखें)\n

10210=Składnia reguły:  allow|block  [in|out|both]  [ip4|ip6]  [tcp|udp|icmp|proto N]\n                  [from|to|remote|local ADRES]  [sport|dport|rport|lport|port P]  [type N]  [app NAZWA|ŚCIEŻKA]\n\n  ADRES  1.2.3.4   1.2.3.0/24   10.0.0.1-10.0.0.50   2001:db8::/32   (sam ADRES = remote)\n  P      443   27015-27030\n  NAZWA  discord.exe  lub  discord   ŚCIEŻKA  C:\\Tools\\nc.exe   (wartość ze spacjami w "cudzysłowie")\n  remote/local i rport/lport zależą od kierunku pakietu (wychodzący: remote = cel).\n  "port" pasuje po obu stronach. Reguły są sprawdzane od góry, decyduje pierwsza pasująca;\n  pakiety bez pasującej reguły dostają politykę domyślną.\n\nPrzykłady:\n  block out tcp dport 443              bez wychodzącego HTTPS\n  block udp rport 27015-27030          odcięcie zakresu serwera gry w obie strony\n  allow remote 192.168.0.0/16          sieć lokalna pozostaje dostępna\n  block in icmp type 8                 ignorowanie przychodzących pingów\n  block 203.0.113.7                    jeden host, dowolny protokół\n  block app discord.exe                jeden program (jego gniazda TCP i UDP)\n  block app "C:\\Tools\\net cat.exe"    jedna kopia programu, wskazana ścieżką\n  allow out udp dport 53               DNS (umieść powyżej szerszej blokady)\n

10203=o intervalo “{}” começa acima do seu fim

10208=o intervalo de portas “{}” começa acima do seu fim

As regras são avaliadas de cima para baixo, a primeira vence;\n  pacotes que não corresponderem a nenhuma regra seguem a política padrão.\n\nExemplos:\n  block out tcp dport 443              sem HTTPS de saída\n  block udp rport 27015-27030          bloquear faixa de servidor de jogos em ambas as direções\n  allow remote 192.168.0.0/16          manter a rede local acessível\n  block in icmp type 8                 ignorar ping de entrada\n  block 203.0.113.7                    um host, qualquer protocolo\n  block app discord.exe                um programa (seus soquetes TCP e UDP)\n  block app "C:\\Tools\\net cat.exe"    uma cópia do programa indicada pelo caminho\n  allow out udp dport 53               DNS (coloque acima de um bloqueio mais amplo)\n

Правила проверяются сверху вниз, действует первое совпадение;\n  пакеты без совпадений подчиняются политике по умолчанию.\n\nПримеры:\n  block out tcp dport 443              запрет исходящего HTTPS\n  block udp rport 27015-27030          блокировка диапазона игрового сервера в обе стороны\n  allow remote 192.168.0.0/16          локальная сеть остаётся доступной\n  block in icmp type 8                 игнорирование входящего ping\n  block 203.0.113.7                    один узел, любой протокол\n  block app discord.exe                одна программа (её сокеты TCP и UDP)\n  block app "C:\\Tools\\net cat.exe"    одна копия программы, указанная путём\n  allow out udp dport 53               DNS (размещайте выше общего правила блокировки)\n

10210=Kural sözdizimi:  allow|block  [in|out|both]  [ip4|ip6]  [tcp|udp|icmp|proto N]\n                 [from|to|remote|local ADRES]  [sport|dport|rport|lport|port P]  [type N]  [app AD|YOL]\n\n  ADRES  1.2.3.4   1.2.3.0/24   10.0.0.1-10.0.0.50   2001:db8::/32   (tek başına ADRES = remote)\n  P      443   27015-27030\n  AD     discord.exe  veya  discord   YOL  C:\\Tools\\nc.exe   (boşluklu değer "tırnak" içine alınır)\n  remote/local ve rport/lport paketin yönünü takip eder (giden: remote = hedef).\n  "port" her iki taraf için geçerlidir. Kurallar yukarıdan aşağıya işlenir, ilk eşleşen kazanır;\n  hiçbir kurala uymayan paketler varsayılan ilkeye göre yönlendirilir.\n\nÖrnekler:\n  block out tcp dport 443              giden HTTPS engelleme\n  block udp rport 27015-27030          oyun sunucusu aralığını iki yönlü kesme\n  allow remote 192.168.0.0/16          yerel ağın erişilebilir kalmasını sağlama\n  block in icmp type 8                 gelen ping isteklerini yok sayma\n  block 203.0.113.7                    tek bir ana bilgisayar, herhangi bir protokol\n  block app discord.exe                tek bir program (TCP ve UDP soketleri)\n  block app "C:\\Tools\\net cat.exe"    yolu belirtilen program kopyası\n  allow out udp dport 53               DNS (daha geniş engellemenin üzerine yerleştirin)\n

# Rule syntax errors
10184=«{}» вимагає значення
10185=суперечливі напрямки
10186=указано і ip4, і ip6
10187=указано більше одного протоколу
10188=«{}» — не назва й не номер протоколу
10189=«{}» — не тип ICMP (0-255)
10190=«{}» указано двічі
10191=несподіване «{}»
10192=указано більше однієї віддаленої адреси
10193=використовуйте або from/to, або remote/local, але не обидва одразу
10194=використовуйте або sport/dport, або rport/lport, але не обидва одразу
10195=«port» уже охоплює обидві сторони; приберіть інші ключові слова портів
10196=порти застосовні лише до tcp і udp
10197=«type» застосовне лише до icmp
10198=в одному правилі не можна змішувати адреси IPv4 та IPv6
10199=родина адрес суперечить ip4/ip6
10200=порожнє правило
10201=правило починається з allow або block, а не з «{}»
10202=«{}» — не діапазон IPv4 (a.b.c.d-e.f.g.h)
10203=діапазон «{}» починається вище за свій кінець
10204=«{}» має недійсну довжину префікса
10205=«{}»: префікс IPv4 не довший за /32
10206=«{}» — не IP-адреса, не префікс і не діапазон IPv4
10207=«{}» — не порт і не діапазон портів (0-65535)
10208=діапазон портів «{}» починається вище за свій кінець
10209=правилу потрібно більше {} записів драйвера; використовуйте префікси CIDR замість широких діапазонів
10210=Синтаксис правила:  allow|block  [in|out|both]  [ip4|ip6]  [tcp|udp|icmp|proto N]\n                    [from|to|remote|local АДРЕСА]  [sport|dport|rport|lport|port P]  [type N]  [app НАЗВА|ШЛЯХ]\n\n  АДРЕСА  1.2.3.4   1.2.3.0/24   10.0.0.1-10.0.0.50   2001:db8::/32   (просто АДРЕСА = remote)\n  P       443   27015-27030\n  НАЗВА   discord.exe  або  discord   ШЛЯХ  C:\\Tools\\nc.exe   (значення з пробілами береться в "лапки")\n  remote/local та rport/lport залежать від напрямку пакета (вихідний: remote = одержувач).\n  "port" відповідає будь-якій стороні. Правила перевіряються зверху вниз, перемагає перший збіг;\n  пакети без збігів підпорядковуються політиці за замовчуванням.\n\nПриклади:\n  block out tcp dport 443              заборона вихідного HTTPS\n  block udp rport 27015-27030          блокування діапазону ігрового сервера в обидва боки\n  allow remote 192.168.0.0/16          локальна мережа залишається доступною\n  block in icmp type 8                 ігнорування вхідного ping\n  block 203.0.113.7                    один вузол, будь-який протокол\n  block app discord.exe                одна програма (її сокети TCP і UDP)\n  block app "C:\\Tools\\net cat.exe"    одна копія програми за шляхом\n  allow out udp dport 53               DNS (розміщуйте вище ширшого блокування)\n

10210=規則語法:   allow|block  [in|out|both]  [ip4|ip6]  [tcp|udp|icmp|proto N]\n               [from|to|remote|local 位址]  [sport|dport|rport|lport|port 連接埠]  [type N]  [app 名稱|路徑]\n\n  位址  1.2.3.4   1.2.3.0/24   10.0.0.1-10.0.0.50   2001:db8::/32   (單獨的「位址」 = remote)\n  連接埠  443   27015-27030\n  名稱  discord.exe  或  discord     路徑  C:\\Tools\\nc.exe   (含空格的值請用 "引號" 括起)\n  remote/local 與 rport/lport 遵循封包方向 (傳出: remote = 目的)。\n  "port" 符合任一側。規則自頂向下檢查，以第一個相符項為準；\n  未符合任何規則的封包套用預設原則。\n\n範例:\n  block out tcp dport 443              阻止傳出 HTTPS\n  block udp rport 27015-27030          雙向中斷遊戲伺服器連接埠範圍\n  allow remote 192.168.0.0/16          保持區域網路可連線\n  block in icmp type 8                 略過傳入 ping\n  block 203.0.113.7                    單一主機，任何通訊協定\n  block app discord.exe                單一程式 (其 TCP 與 UDP 通訊端)\n  block app "C:\\Tools\\net cat.exe"    透過路徑指定單一程式複本\n  allow out udp dport 53               DNS (置於較廣泛的封鎖規則上方)\n
