`src/support/Common.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "support/Common.h"
#include <format>
#include <vector>

namespace WS {

bool IsElevated() noexcept {
    HANDLE token = nullptr;
    if (!OpenProcessToken(GetCurrentProcess(), TOKEN_QUERY, &token)) {
        return false;
    }
    TOKEN_ELEVATION elevation{};
    DWORD size = 0;
    const BOOL success = GetTokenInformation(token, TokenElevation, &elevation, sizeof(elevation), &size);
    CloseHandle(token);
    return success && elevation.TokenIsElevated != 0;
}

std::wstring FormatError(DWORD code) {
    wchar_t* message = nullptr;
    const DWORD length = FormatMessageW(
        FORMAT_MESSAGE_ALLOCATE_BUFFER | FORMAT_MESSAGE_FROM_SYSTEM | FORMAT_MESSAGE_IGNORE_INSERTS,
        nullptr,
        code,
        MAKELANGID(LANG_NEUTRAL, SUBLANG_DEFAULT),
        reinterpret_cast<LPWSTR>(&message),
        0,
        nullptr
    );

    if (length == 0 || !message) {
        return std::format(L"Error 0x{:08X} ({})", code, code);
    }

    std::wstring result(message, length);
    LocalFree(message);

    while (!result.empty() && (result.back() == L'\r' || result.back() == L'\n' || result.back() == L' ')) {
        result.pop_back();
    }
    return result;
}

std::wstring FormatBytes(uint64_t bytes) {
    constexpr double KiB = 1024.0;
    constexpr double MiB = KiB * 1024.0;
    constexpr double GiB = MiB * 1024.0;

    const double b = static_cast<double>(bytes);
    if (b >= GiB) {
        return std::format(L"{:.2f} GiB", b / GiB);
    }
    if (b >= MiB) {
        return std::format(L"{:.2f} MiB", b / MiB);
    }
    if (b >= KiB) {
        return std::format(L"{:.1f} KiB", b / KiB);
    }
    return std::format(L"{} B", bytes);
}

std::wstring FormatRate(double bytesPerSec) {
    constexpr double KiB = 1024.0;
    constexpr double MiB = KiB * 1024.0;

    if (bytesPerSec >= MiB) {
        return std::format(L"{:.2f} MiB/s", bytesPerSec / MiB);
    }
    if (bytesPerSec >= KiB) {
        return std::format(L"{:.1f} KiB/s", bytesPerSec / KiB);
    }
    return std::format(L"{:.0f} B/s", bytesPerSec);
}

std::wstring FormatCount(uint64_t value) {
    std::wstring digits = std::to_wstring(value);
    std::wstring out;
    out.reserve(digits.size() + digits.size() / 3);
    const size_t lead = digits.size() % 3;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < digits.size(); ++i) {
        if (i != 0 && i >= lead && (i - lead) % 3 == 0) out.push_back(L',');
        out.push_back(digits[i]);
    }
    return out;
}

uint64_t MonotonicMicroseconds() noexcept {
    static const uint64_t frequency = [] {
        LARGE_INTEGER f{};
        QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f);
        return static_cast<uint64_t>(f.QuadPart ? f.QuadPart : 1);
    }();
    LARGE_INTEGER now{};
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&now);
    const uint64_t ticks = static_cast<uint64_t>(now.QuadPart);
    return (ticks / frequency) * 1'000'000ULL + (ticks % frequency) * 1'000'000ULL / frequency;
}

uint64_t BootTimeSeconds() noexcept {
    return GetCurrentTimestampMicroseconds() / 1'000'000ULL - GetTickCount64() / 1000ULL;
}

uint64_t GetCurrentTimestampMicroseconds() noexcept {
    FILETIME ft{};
    GetSystemTimeAsFileTime(&ft);
    const uint64_t t = (static_cast<uint64_t>(ft.dwHighDateTime) << 32) | ft.dwLowDateTime;
    // Convert 100-nanosecond intervals (since Jan 1, 1601) to microseconds (since epoch Jan 1, 1970)
    constexpr uint64_t EpochDiff = 116444736000000000ULL;
    if (t < EpochDiff) return 0;
    return (t - EpochDiff) / 10;
}

} // namespace WS
```

`src/support/Handle.h`:

```h
// WireScope - RAII owners for Win32 resources (Modern C++23).
// Every handle the program opens is owned by one of these types.
#pragma once
#include <Windows.h>
#include <type_traits>
#include <utility>

namespace WS {

// Generic owner. Traits supplies the handle type, its "no handle" value and how to close it.
template <class Traits>
class Unique {
public:
    using Type = typename Traits::Type;

    Unique() noexcept = default;
    explicit Unique(Type value) noexcept : m_value(value) {}
    Unique(const Unique&) = delete;
    Unique& operator=(const Unique&) = delete;
    Unique(Unique&& other) noexcept : m_value(std::exchange(other.m_value, Traits::Invalid())) {}
    Unique& operator=(Unique&& other) noexcept {
        if (this != &other) {
            reset(std::exchange(other.m_value, Traits::Invalid()));
        }
        return *this;
    }
    ~Unique() { reset(); }

    [[nodiscard]] Type get() const noexcept { return m_value; }
    [[nodiscard]] explicit operator bool() const noexcept { return m_value != Traits::Invalid(); }
    [[nodiscard]] Type* put() noexcept { reset(); return &m_value; }
    Type release() noexcept { return std::exchange(m_value, Traits::Invalid()); }
    void reset(Type value = Traits::Invalid()) noexcept {
        if (m_value != Traits::Invalid()) {
            Traits::Close(m_value);
        }
        m_value = value;
    }

private:
    Type m_value = Traits::Invalid();
};

namespace traits {

struct KernelHandle {
    using Type = HANDLE;
    static Type Invalid() noexcept { return nullptr; }
    static void Close(Type h) noexcept { if (h && h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) CloseHandle(h); }
};

struct FileHandle {
    using Type = HANDLE;
    static Type Invalid() noexcept { return INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE; }
    static void Close(Type h) noexcept { if (h && h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) CloseHandle(h); }
};

struct FindHandle {
    using Type = HANDLE;
    static Type Invalid() noexcept { return INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE; }
    static void Close(Type h) noexcept { if (h && h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) FindClose(h); }
};

struct ServiceHandle {
    using Type = SC_HANDLE;
    static Type Invalid() noexcept { return nullptr; }
    static void Close(Type h) noexcept { if (h) CloseServiceHandle(h); }
};

struct RegistryKey {
    using Type = HKEY;
    static Type Invalid() noexcept { return nullptr; }
    static void Close(Type h) noexcept { if (h) RegCloseKey(h); }
};

struct DeviceContext {
    using Type = HDC;
    static Type Invalid() noexcept { return nullptr; }
    static void Close(Type h) noexcept { if (h) DeleteDC(h); }
};

struct GdiObject {
    using Type = HGDIOBJ;
    static Type Invalid() noexcept { return nullptr; }
    static void Close(Type h) noexcept { if (h) DeleteObject(h); }
};

template <class T, auto CloseFn>
struct NullIsInvalid {
    using Type = T;
    static Type Invalid() noexcept { return nullptr; }
    static void Close(Type h) noexcept { CloseFn(h); }
};

inline void DeleteGdi(HGDIOBJ h) noexcept { DeleteObject(h); }
inline void DestroyMenuHandle(HMENU h) noexcept { DestroyMenu(h); }
inline void DestroyAccel(HACCEL h) noexcept { DestroyAcceleratorTable(h); }
inline void Unhook(HHOOK h) noexcept { UnhookWindowsHookEx(h); }
inline void DestroyIconHandle(HICON h) noexcept { DestroyIcon(h); }

} // namespace traits

using Handle = Unique<traits::KernelHandle>;
using FileHandle = Unique<traits::FileHandle>;
using FindHandle = Unique<traits::FindHandle>;        // FindFirstFile
using ServiceHandle = Unique<traits::ServiceHandle>;  // OpenSCManager, OpenService
using RegKey = Unique<traits::RegistryKey>;
using DeviceContextHandle = Unique<traits::DeviceContext>;
using MemoryDc = DeviceContextHandle;  // CreateCompatibleDC
using GdiHandle = Unique<traits::GdiObject>;
template <class T>
using Gdi = Unique<traits::NullIsInvalid<T, traits::DeleteGdi>>;  // HBRUSH, HFONT, HBITMAP ...
using MenuHandle = Unique<traits::NullIsInvalid<HMENU, traits::DestroyMenuHandle>>;
using AccelHandle = Unique<traits::NullIsInvalid<HACCEL, traits::DestroyAccel>>;
using HookHandle = Unique<traits::NullIsInvalid<HHOOK, traits::Unhook>>;
using IconHandle = Unique<traits::NullIsInvalid<HICON, traits::DestroyIconHandle>>;

// BeginPaint / EndPaint.
class PaintScope {
public:
    explicit PaintScope(HWND window) noexcept : m_window(window) { BeginPaint(window, &m_ps); }
    PaintScope(const PaintScope&) = delete;
    PaintScope& operator=(const PaintScope&) = delete;
    ~PaintScope() { EndPaint(m_window, &m_ps); }
    [[nodiscard]] HDC dc() const noexcept { return m_ps.hdc; }
    [[nodiscard]] const RECT& area() const noexcept { return m_ps.rcPaint; }

private:
    HWND m_window;
    PAINTSTRUCT m_ps{};
};

// Runs a callable on scope exit, for one-off cleanups that have no handle type.
template <class F>
class [[nodiscard]] ScopeExit {
public:
    explicit ScopeExit(F f) noexcept(std::is_nothrow_move_constructible_v<F>) : m_f(std::move(f)) {}
    ScopeExit(const ScopeExit&) = delete;
    ScopeExit& operator=(const ScopeExit&) = delete;
    ~ScopeExit() { if (m_active) m_f(); }
    void dismiss() noexcept { m_active = false; }

private:
    F m_f;
    bool m_active = true;
};

} // namespace WS
```

`src/support/Language.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "support/Language.h"
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cwctype>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <mutex>
#include <shared_mutex>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>

namespace WS::Text {
namespace {
namespace fs = std::filesystem;

constexpr LANGID kEnglish = MAKELANGID(LANG_ENGLISH, SUBLANG_ENGLISH_US);

struct State {
    std::shared_mutex lock;  // the worker thread reads strings while the UI may switch language
    std::wstring code = L"en";
    bool automatic = false;
    std::unordered_map<UINT, std::wstring> strings;  // the .lng file; empty = English
};

State& S() {
    static State state;
    return state;
}

std::wstring Lower(std::wstring_view s) {
    std::wstring out(s);
    for (auto& c : out) c = static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towlower(c));
    return out;
}

HMODULE Module() {
    static const HMODULE module = [] {
        HMODULE m = nullptr;
        GetModuleHandleExW(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT,
                           reinterpret_cast<LPCWSTR>(&Module), &m);
        return m;
    }();
    return module;
}

// String tables are stored in blocks of 16 length-prefixed strings.
std::wstring LoadResourceString(UINT id, LANGID language) {
    HMODULE module = Module();
    HRSRC info = FindResourceExW(module, RT_STRING, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(id / 16 + 1), language);
    if (!info) return {};
    HGLOBAL data = LoadResource(module, info);
    const auto* p = static_cast<const WCHAR*>(data ? LockResource(data) : nullptr);
    if (!p) return {};
    const WCHAR* end = p + SizeofResource(module, info) / sizeof(WCHAR);
    for (UINT i = 0; i < id % 16 && p < end; ++i) p += 1 + *p;
    if (p >= end || p + 1 + *p > end) return {};
    return std::wstring(p + 1, *p);
}

// Every id of the English table, ascending (read once).
const std::vector<UINT>& EnglishIds() {
    static const std::vector<UINT> ids = [] {
        std::vector<UINT> blocks, result;
        EnumResourceNamesW(
            Module(), RT_STRING,
            [](HMODULE, LPCWSTR, LPWSTR name, LONG_PTR param) -> BOOL {
                if (IS_INTRESOURCE(name))
                    reinterpret_cast<std::vector<UINT>*>(param)->push_back(static_cast<UINT>(reinterpret_cast<ULONG_PTR>(name)));
                return TRUE;
            },
            reinterpret_cast<LONG_PTR>(&blocks));
        std::ranges::sort(blocks);
        for (UINT block : blocks)
            for (UINT i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
                if (const UINT id = (block - 1) * 16 + i; !LoadResourceString(id, kEnglish).empty()) result.push_back(id);
        return result;
    }();
    return ids;
}

fs::path LanguageDirectory() {
    std::wstring self(MAX_PATH, L'\0');
    for (;;) {
        const DWORD n = GetModuleFileNameW(Module(), self.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(self.size()));
        if (n == 0) return {};
        if (n < self.size()) {
            self.resize(n);
            break;
        }
        self.resize(self.size() * 2);
    }
    return fs::path(self).parent_path() / L"language";
}

std::wstring Widen(std::string_view utf8) {
    if (utf8.empty()) return {};
    const int n = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, utf8.data(), static_cast<int>(utf8.size()), nullptr, 0);
    std::wstring out(static_cast<std::size_t>(std::max(n, 0)), L'\0');
    if (n > 0) MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, utf8.data(), static_cast<int>(utf8.size()), out.data(), n);
    return out;
}

std::string Narrow(std::wstring_view text) {
    if (text.empty()) return {};
    const int n = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()), nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
    std::string out(static_cast<std::size_t>(std::max(n, 0)), '\0');
    if (n > 0) WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()), out.data(), n, nullptr, nullptr);
    return out;
}

std::wstring Unescape(std::wstring_view raw) {
    std::wstring out;
    out.reserve(raw.size());
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < raw.size(); ++i) {
        if (raw[i] == L'\\' && i + 1 < raw.size()) {
            switch (raw[i + 1]) {
            case L'n': out += L'\n'; ++i; continue;
            case L'r': out += L'\r'; ++i; continue;
            case L't': out += L'\t'; ++i; continue;
            case L'\\': out += L'\\'; ++i; continue;
            default: break;
            }
        }
        out += raw[i];
    }
    return out;
}

std::wstring Escape(std::wstring_view text) {
    std::wstring out;
    for (wchar_t c : text) {
        switch (c) {
        case L'\n': out += L"\\n"; break;
        case L'\r': out += L"\\r"; break;
        case L'\t': out += L"\\t"; break;
        case L'\\': out += L"\\\\"; break;
        default: out += c; break;
        }
    }
    return out;
}

bool ValidCode(std::wstring_view code) {
    return !code.empty() && code.size() <= 16 &&
           std::ranges::all_of(code, [](wchar_t c) { return std::iswalnum(c) || c == L'-' || c == L'_'; });
}

struct LngFile {
    Language language;
    fs::path path;
    std::unordered_map<UINT, std::wstring> strings;
};

// Parses a .lng file: "#name=", "#locale=" headers and (when `strings`) the ID=text lines.
bool ReadLng(const fs::path& path, LngFile& out, bool strings) {
    std::ifstream in(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!in) return false;
    out.path = path;
    out.language.code = Lower(path.stem().wstring());
    std::string line;
    bool first = true;
    while (std::getline(in, line)) {
        if (first && line.starts_with("\xEF\xBB\xBF")) line.erase(0, 3);  // UTF-8 BOM
        first = false;
        if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();
        if (line.starts_with("#name=")) {
            out.language.name = Widen(std::string_view(line).substr(6));
            continue;
        }
        if (line.starts_with("#locale=")) {
            const std::wstring list = Lower(Widen(std::string_view(line).substr(8)));
            for (std::size_t start = 0; start <= list.size();) {
                std::size_t end = list.find(L',', start);
                if (end == std::wstring::npos) end = list.size();
                std::wstring tag = list.substr(start, end - start);
                std::erase_if(tag, [](wchar_t c) { return std::iswspace(c) != 0; });
                std::ranges::replace(tag, L'_', L'-');
                if (!tag.empty()) out.language.locales.push_back(std::move(tag));
                start = end + 1;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if (!strings || line.empty() || line[0] == '#') continue;
        const std::size_t eq = line.find('=');
        if (eq == std::string::npos || eq == 0 || eq > 9) continue;
        UINT id = 0;
        bool numeric = true;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < eq; ++i) {
            if (line[i] < '0' || line[i] > '9') { numeric = false; break; }
            id = id * 10 + static_cast<UINT>(line[i] - '0');
        }
        if (numeric) out.strings[id] = Unescape(Widen(std::string_view(line).substr(eq + 1)));
    }
    if (out.language.name.empty()) out.language.name = out.language.code;
    return true;
}

std::vector<LngFile> ScanFiles(bool strings) {
    std::vector<LngFile> files;
    std::error_code ec;
    for (const auto& entry : fs::directory_iterator(LanguageDirectory(), ec)) {
        if (!entry.is_regular_file(ec) || Lower(entry.path().extension().wstring()) != L".lng") continue;
        const std::wstring code = Lower(entry.path().stem().wstring());
        if (!ValidCode(code) || code == L"en") continue;
        LngFile file;
        if (ReadLng(entry.path(), file, strings)) files.push_back(std::move(file));
    }
    return files;
}

// {...} replacement fields of a std::format pattern.
struct Fields {
    std::size_t automatic = 0;          // "{}" / "{:spec}"
    std::vector<std::size_t> indexed;   // "{n}" / "{n:spec}"
    std::vector<std::wstring> specs;    // ":spec" parts
    bool valid = true;
};

Fields ParseFields(std::wstring_view s) {
    Fields f;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
        if (s[i] == L'{') {
            if (i + 1 < s.size() && s[i + 1] == L'{') { ++i; continue; }  // "{{" escape
            const std::size_t close = s.find(L'}', i);
            if (close == std::wstring_view::npos) { f.valid = false; break; }
            const std::wstring_view inside = s.substr(i + 1, close - i - 1);
            const std::size_t colon = inside.find(L':');
            const std::wstring_view id = inside.substr(0, colon);
            if (colon != std::wstring_view::npos) f.specs.emplace_back(inside.substr(colon));
            if (id.empty()) {
                ++f.automatic;
            } else if (std::ranges::all_of(id, [](wchar_t c) { return c >= L'0' && c <= L'9'; })) {
                f.indexed.push_back(static_cast<std::size_t>(std::wcstoul(std::wstring(id).c_str(), nullptr, 10)));
            } else {
                f.valid = false;
            }
            i = close;
        } else if (s[i] == L'}') {
            if (i + 1 < s.size() && s[i + 1] == L'}') { ++i; continue; }  // "}}" escape
            f.valid = false;
        }
    }
    if (f.automatic && !f.indexed.empty()) f.valid = false;  // std::format forbids mixing the two
    return f;
}

// A translation may leave values out (word order, case forms), but may not reference values the
// English pattern does not pass, use another format spec or be malformed.
bool CompatibleFields(std::wstring_view english, std::wstring_view translation) {
    const Fields en = ParseFields(english), tr = ParseFields(translation);
    if (!tr.valid) return false;
    std::size_t args = en.automatic;
    for (std::size_t i : en.indexed) args = std::max(args, i + 1);
    // Numbered patterns always receive a name twice, {0} in lower case and {1} capitalised; English
    // may use only one of them ("the {0}"), a translation the other ("{1}: ...").
    if (!en.indexed.empty()) args = std::max<std::size_t>(args, 2);
    if (tr.automatic > args) return false;
    if (std::ranges::any_of(tr.indexed, [&](std::size_t i) { return i >= args; })) return false;
    return std::ranges::all_of(tr.specs, [&](const std::wstring& s) { return std::ranges::contains(en.specs, s); });
}

}  // namespace

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Choosing the language
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
std::wstring Detect() {
    ULONG count = 0, size = 0;
    if (!GetUserPreferredUILanguages(MUI_LANGUAGE_NAME, &count, nullptr, &size) || !size) return L"en";
    std::wstring buffer(size, L'\0');
    if (!GetUserPreferredUILanguages(MUI_LANGUAGE_NAME, &count, buffer.data(), &size)) return L"en";

    const std::vector<LngFile> files = ScanFiles(false);
    auto declared = [&](const std::wstring& tag) -> const LngFile* {
        for (const auto& f : files)
            if (std::ranges::contains(f.language.locales, tag)) return &f;
        return nullptr;
    };
    auto named = [&](const std::wstring& stem) -> const LngFile* {
        for (const auto& f : files)
            if (f.language.code == stem) return &f;
        return nullptr;
    };
    auto localeName = [](const wchar_t* tag, LCTYPE type) {
        wchar_t value[16]{};
        return GetLocaleInfoEx(tag, type, value, static_cast<int>(std::size(value))) ? Lower(value) : std::wstring();
    };

    // The user's display languages in their order (Settings > Time & language > Language).
    for (const wchar_t* p = buffer.c_str(); *p; p += wcslen(p) + 1) {
        const std::wstring tag = Lower(p);                           // "pt-br"
        const std::wstring primary = tag.substr(0, tag.find(L'-'));  // "pt"
        if (primary == L"en") return L"en";
        const LngFile* match = declared(tag);
        if (!match) match = named(tag);
        if (!match) match = declared(primary);
        if (!match) match = named(primary);
        if (!match) match = named(localeName(p, LOCALE_SISO639LANGNAME2));  // "por", "pol", "deu"
        if (!match) match = named(localeName(p, LOCALE_SABBREVLANGNAME));   // "ptb", "plk", "deu"
        if (match) return match->language.code;
    }
    return L"en";
}

bool Automatic() {
    std::shared_lock guard(S().lock);
    return S().automatic;
}

bool Use(std::wstring_view requested, bool save) {
    std::wstring code = Lower(requested);
    const bool automatic = code.empty() || code == L"auto";
    if (automatic) code = Detect();
    LngFile file;
    bool ok = true;
    if (code != L"en") {
        // Only a plain file name, never a path (no "..\" tricks).
        ok = ValidCode(code) && ReadLng(LanguageDirectory() / (code + L".lng"), file, true);
        if (!ok) code = L"en";
    }
    {
        std::unique_lock guard(S().lock);
        S().code = code;
        S().automatic = automatic;
        S().strings = std::move(file.strings);
    }
    if (save && ok) Settings::Write(L"Language", automatic ? std::wstring(L"auto") : code);
    return ok;
}

void UseSaved() {
    // A saved language that has gone (its .lng file was removed) falls back to the Windows language.
    if (!Use(Settings::Read(L"Language", L"auto"))) Use(L"auto");
}

std::wstring Current() {
    std::shared_lock guard(S().lock);
    return S().code;
}

std::vector<Language> Available() {
    const auto& ids = EnglishIds();
    std::vector<Language> list;
    for (auto& f : ScanFiles(true)) {
        f.language.total = ids.size();
        f.language.translated = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::ranges::count_if(ids, [&](UINT id) {
            const auto it = f.strings.find(id);
            return it != f.strings.end() && !it->second.empty();
        }));
        list.push_back(std::move(f.language));
    }
    std::ranges::sort(list, [](const Language& a, const Language& b) {
        return CompareStringEx(LOCALE_NAME_INVARIANT, LINGUISTIC_IGNORECASE, a.name.c_str(), -1, b.name.c_str(), -1, nullptr, nullptr, 0) ==
               CSTR_LESS_THAN;
    });
    Language english{L"en", L"English", {L"en"}, ids.size(), ids.size()};
    list.insert(list.begin(), std::move(english));
    return list;
}

LANGID SystemLanguage() {
    std::shared_lock guard(S().lock);
    if (S().code == L"en") return kEnglish;
    const LCID lcid = LocaleNameToLCID(S().code.c_str(), 0);  // "pl" -> Polish, "pt-br" -> Portuguese (Brazil)
    return lcid ? LANGIDFROMLCID(lcid) : 0;                  // 0 = the user's default
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Strings
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
std::wstring English(UINT id) {
    std::wstring text = LoadResourceString(id, kEnglish);
    return text.empty() ? std::format(L"#{}", id) : text;
}

std::wstring Get(UINT id) {
    {
        std::shared_lock guard(S().lock);
        if (auto it = S().strings.find(id); it != S().strings.end() && !it->second.empty()) return it->second;
    }
    return English(id);
}

namespace detail {
std::wstring VFormat(UINT id, std::wformat_args args) {
    const std::wstring pattern = Get(id);
    try {
        return std::vformat(pattern, args);
    } catch (const std::format_error&) {
        try {
            return std::vformat(English(id), args);  // the translation has a broken placeholder
        } catch (const std::format_error&) {
            return pattern;
        }
    }
}
}  // namespace detail

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Tools for translators
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
bool ExportTemplate(const std::wstring& path) {
    std::ofstream out(fs::path(path), std::ios::binary | std::ios::trunc);
    if (!out) return false;
    out << Narrow(L"# WireScope language file. Translate the text after '=', keep the numbers and the {...} fields:\n"
                  L"# they may move or be left out, never add new ones. In numbered patterns {0} is a name in lower case\n"
                  L"# and {1} the same name capitalised (\"image\" / \"Image\") - use the one your grammar needs.\n"
                  L"# UTF-8. Escapes: \\n \\r \\t \\\\\n"
                  L"# Save as language\\<code>.lng next to WireScope.exe, e.g. language\\de.lng, and check it with\n"
                  L"#   WireScope.exe --lng-check language\\de.lng\n"
                  L"# #name   = the language's own name for the menu, e.g. Deutsch\n"
                  L"# #locale = the Windows display languages this file is for, e.g. de or pt-BR,pt\n"
                  L"#name=English\n#locale=en\n\n");
    for (UINT id : EnglishIds()) out << Narrow(std::format(L"{}={}\n", id, Escape(LoadResourceString(id, kEnglish))));
    return static_cast<bool>(out);
}

std::vector<Report> Check(const std::wstring& path) {
    std::vector<LngFile> files;
    if (path.empty()) {
        files = ScanFiles(true);
    } else if (LngFile f; ReadLng(fs::path(path), f, true)) {
        files.push_back(std::move(f));
    }
    const auto& ids = EnglishIds();
    const std::unordered_set<UINT> known(ids.begin(), ids.end());
    std::vector<Report> reports;
    for (auto& f : files) {
        Report r;
        r.file = f.path.wstring();
        for (UINT id : ids) {
            const auto it = f.strings.find(id);
            if (it == f.strings.end() || it->second.empty()) r.missing.push_back(id);
            else if (!CompatibleFields(LoadResourceString(id, kEnglish), it->second)) r.placeholders.push_back(id);
        }
        for (const auto& [id, text] : f.strings)
            if (!known.contains(id)) r.unknown.push_back(id);
        std::ranges::sort(r.unknown);
        r.language = std::move(f.language);
        r.language.total = ids.size();
        r.language.translated = ids.size() - r.missing.size();
        reports.push_back(std::move(r));
    }
    return reports;
}

}  // namespace WS::Text
```

```h
// WireScope - User-visible text. English is built in (STRINGTABLE, src/resources/lang/en.rc) and always works;
// every other language is a separate file next to the executable (like IrfanView's language files),
// in the format of the SFTP plugin:
//
//   language\<file>.lng    UTF-8, one "ID=text" per line, '#' comments, escapes \n \r \t \\
//     #name=Polski         the name shown in the menu (in that language)
//     #locale=pl           Windows languages the file covers, comma separated (pl, pt-BR, sr-Latn ...)
//
// Automatic choice: the user's preferred Windows display languages, in their order; for each one a
// file that declares it in #locale, else one named after it (pt-br.lng, pt.lng, por.lng - ISO 639-2 -
// or ptb.lng - the Windows abbreviation). Nothing matches: English. The user can also pick a language
// by hand. A missing or broken string falls back to English one by one, so a partial file still works.
//
// The command line is always English (scripts parse it); it never calls Use(), so code shared with the
// GUI (core error messages) speaks English there. `--lng-export` writes the English template,
// `--lng-check` reports coverage and broken placeholders of the language files.
#pragma once
#include "resources/resource.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <cstddef>
#include <format>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace WS::Text {

struct Language {
    std::wstring code;                  // "en" or the file name without .lng ("pl", "pt-br", "deu" ...)
    std::wstring name;                  // "English", "Polski" ...
    std::vector<std::wstring> locales;  // declared by #locale (lower case)
    std::size_t translated = 0;         // strings of the English table present in the file
    std::size_t total = 0;              // strings in the English table
    [[nodiscard]] int Coverage() const { return total ? static_cast<int>(translated * 100 / total) : 100; }
};

// GUI: the saved choice (setting "Language"); "auto" or nothing saved = the Windows language.
void UseSaved();
// Switches to `code` ("en", a file code such as "pl", or "auto") and optionally remembers it.
// False (and English) when the language is not available.
bool Use(std::wstring_view code, bool save = false);
[[nodiscard]] std::wstring Detect();   // the automatic choice, see above
[[nodiscard]] std::wstring Current();  // effective code
[[nodiscard]] bool Automatic();        // following the Windows language
[[nodiscard]] std::vector<Language> Available();  // English first, then the files sorted by name
// Language for system error messages (FormatMessage); English when the UI runs in English.
[[nodiscard]] LANGID SystemLanguage();

[[nodiscard]] std::wstring Get(UINT id);
[[nodiscard]] std::wstring English(UINT id);

// Writes every English string as "ID=text" (the starting point of a new .lng file).
bool ExportTemplate(const std::wstring& path);

// Translation report of one .lng file against the English table.
struct Report {
    Language language;
    std::wstring file;
    std::vector<UINT> missing;       // in English, not in the file
    std::vector<UINT> unknown;       // in the file, not in English (old or mistyped ids)
    std::vector<UINT> placeholders;  // {...} fields differ from English - would fall back to English
};
[[nodiscard]] std::vector<Report> Check(const std::wstring& file = {});  // one file, or every file in language\

namespace detail {
std::wstring VFormat(UINT id, std::wformat_args args);
}

// std::format with a translated pattern. A translation with a broken pattern falls back to English.
template <class... Args>
[[nodiscard]] std::wstring Format(UINT id, const Args&... args) {
    return detail::VFormat(id, std::make_wformat_args(args...));
}

}  // namespace WS::Text
```

```cpp
#include "support/Settings.h"
#include "support/Handle.h"

namespace WS::Settings {

namespace {

constexpr wchar_t kKey[] = L"Software\\WireScope";

RegKey Open(bool write) {
    RegKey key;
    if (write) {
        RegCreateKeyExW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, kKey, 0, nullptr, 0, KEY_SET_VALUE | KEY_QUERY_VALUE, nullptr, key.put(), nullptr);
    } else {
        RegOpenKeyExW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, kKey, 0, KEY_QUERY_VALUE, key.put());
    }
    return key;
}

} // namespace

std::wstring Read(const wchar_t* name, std::wstring_view fallback) {
    const RegKey key = Open(false);
    if (!key) return std::wstring(fallback);
    DWORD bytes = 0;
    if (RegGetValueW(key.get(), nullptr, name, RRF_RT_REG_SZ, nullptr, nullptr, &bytes) != ERROR_SUCCESS || bytes < sizeof(wchar_t)) {
        return std::wstring(fallback);
    }
    std::wstring value(bytes / sizeof(wchar_t), L'\0');
    if (RegGetValueW(key.get(), nullptr, name, RRF_RT_REG_SZ, nullptr, value.data(), &bytes) != ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        return std::wstring(fallback);
    }
    value.resize(wcsnlen(value.c_str(), value.size()));
    return value;
}

void Write(const wchar_t* name, std::wstring_view value) {
    const RegKey key = Open(true);
    if (!key) return;
    const std::wstring copy(value);
    RegSetValueExW(key.get(), name, 0, REG_SZ, reinterpret_cast<const BYTE*>(copy.c_str()),
                   static_cast<DWORD>((copy.size() + 1) * sizeof(wchar_t)));
}

DWORD ReadDword(const wchar_t* name, DWORD fallback) {
    const RegKey key = Open(false);
    if (!key) return fallback;
    DWORD value = 0;
    DWORD bytes = sizeof(value);
    if (RegGetValueW(key.get(), nullptr, name, RRF_RT_REG_DWORD, nullptr, &value, &bytes) != ERROR_SUCCESS) return fallback;
    return value;
}

void WriteDword(const wchar_t* name, DWORD value) {
    const RegKey key = Open(true);
    if (!key) return;
    RegSetValueExW(key.get(), name, 0, REG_DWORD, reinterpret_cast<const BYTE*>(&value), sizeof(value));
}

std::optional<std::vector<uint8_t>> ReadBinary(const wchar_t* name) {
    const RegKey key = Open(false);
    if (!key) return std::nullopt;
    DWORD bytes = 0;
    if (RegGetValueW(key.get(), nullptr, name, RRF_RT_REG_BINARY, nullptr, nullptr, &bytes) != ERROR_SUCCESS) return std::nullopt;
    std::vector<uint8_t> data(bytes);
    if (bytes && RegGetValueW(key.get(), nullptr, name, RRF_RT_REG_BINARY, nullptr, data.data(), &bytes) != ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        return std::nullopt;
    }
    data.resize(bytes);
    return data;
}

void WriteBinary(const wchar_t* name, std::span<const uint8_t> data) {
    const RegKey key = Open(true);
    if (!key) return;
    RegSetValueExW(key.get(), name, 0, REG_BINARY, data.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(data.size()));
}

void Delete(const wchar_t* name) {
    const RegKey key = Open(true);
    if (key) RegDeleteValueW(key.get(), name);
}

} // namespace WS::Settings
```

```cpp
#include "support/Text.h"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <format>

namespace WS {

std::wstring ToWide(std::string_view utf8) {
    if (utf8.empty()) return {};
    const int req = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, utf8.data(), static_cast<int>(utf8.size()), nullptr, 0);
    if (req <= 0) return {};
    std::wstring wide(static_cast<size_t>(req), L'\0');
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, utf8.data(), static_cast<int>(utf8.size()), wide.data(), req);
    return wide;
}

std::string ToUtf8(std::wstring_view wide) {
    if (wide.empty()) return {};
    const int req = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, wide.data(), static_cast<int>(wide.size()), nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
    if (req <= 0) return {};
    std::string utf8(static_cast<size_t>(req), '\0');
    WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, wide.data(), static_cast<int>(wide.size()), utf8.data(), req, nullptr, nullptr);
    return utf8;
}

std::wstring FoldCase(std::wstring_view text) {
    if (text.empty()) return {};
    std::wstring out(text);
    const int n = LCMapStringEx(LOCALE_NAME_INVARIANT, LCMAP_LOWERCASE, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()), out.data(),
                                static_cast<int>(out.size()), nullptr, nullptr, 0);
    if (n <= 0) return std::wstring(text);
    out.resize(static_cast<size_t>(n));
    return out;
}

std::string FoldCase(std::string_view utf8) {
    return ToUtf8(FoldCase(ToWide(utf8)));
}

std::string FormatMac(std::span<const uint8_t, 6> mac) {
    return std::format("{:02X}:{:02X}:{:02X}:{:02X}:{:02X}:{:02X}",
                       mac[0], mac[1], mac[2], mac[3], mac[4], mac[5]);
}

std::string FormatIpv4(uint32_t ipNetworkOrder) {
    const uint8_t b1 = static_cast<uint8_t>(ipNetworkOrder & 0xFF);
    const uint8_t b2 = static_cast<uint8_t>((ipNetworkOrder >> 8) & 0xFF);
    const uint8_t b3 = static_cast<uint8_t>((ipNetworkOrder >> 16) & 0xFF);
    const uint8_t b4 = static_cast<uint8_t>((ipNetworkOrder >> 24) & 0xFF);
    return std::format("{}.{}.{}.{}", b1, b2, b3, b4);
}

std::string FormatIpv6(std::span<const uint8_t, 16> ip) {
    std::string out;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 16; i += 2) {
        if (i > 0) out += ':';
        const uint16_t word = static_cast<uint16_t>((ip[i] << 8) | ip[i + 1]);
        out += std::format("{:x}", word);
    }
    return out;
}

std::string FormatHexDump(std::span<const uint8_t> data, size_t maxBytes) {
    const size_t len = std::min(data.size(), maxBytes);
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(len * 4);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i += 16) {
        out += std::format("{:04X}  ", i);
        // Hex bytes
        for (size_t j = 0; j < 16; ++j) {
            if (i + j < len) {
                out += std::format("{:02X} ", data[i + j]);
            } else {
                out += "   ";
            }
            if (j == 7) out += ' ';
        }
        out += " |";
        // ASCII representation
        for (size_t j = 0; j < 16 && (i + j) < len; ++j) {
            const uint8_t b = data[i + j];
            out += (b >= 32 && b <= 126) ? static_cast<char>(b) : '.';
        }
        out += "|\n";
    }

    if (data.size() > maxBytes) {
        out += std::format("... [{} more bytes truncated]\n", data.size() - maxBytes);
    }
    return out;
}

bool ContainsIgnoreCase(std::string_view haystack, std::string_view needle) noexcept {
    if (needle.empty()) return true;
    if (haystack.size() < needle.size()) return false;
    const auto it = std::search(haystack.begin(), haystack.end(), needle.begin(), needle.end(),
        [](char ch1, char ch2) {
            return std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch1)) ==
                   std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch2));
        });
    return it != haystack.end();
}

bool ContainsIgnoreCase(std::wstring_view haystack, std::wstring_view needle) noexcept {
    if (needle.empty()) return true;
    if (haystack.size() < needle.size()) return false;
    const auto it = std::search(haystack.begin(), haystack.end(), needle.begin(), needle.end(),
        [](wchar_t ch1, wchar_t ch2) {
            return towlower(ch1) == towlower(ch2);
        });
    return it != haystack.end();
}

} // namespace WS
```

`tools/WireScopeUi.psm1`:

```psm1
# WireScope - Drives the GUI from PowerShell for the scripts in tools\: starts bin\WireScope.exe, sends
# its commands, saves window screenshots, keeps the user's settings safe and closes it again.
# Command ids are read from src\gui\MainWindowDetail.h, so the scripts follow the enum when it changes.

$script:Root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$script:SettingsKey = 'HKCU:\Software\WireScope'

Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
Add-Type -TypeDefinition @'
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text;
public static class WireScopeWin32 {
    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] public struct RECT { public int Left, Top, Right, Bottom; }
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool GetWindowRect(IntPtr hwnd, out RECT rect);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool PrintWindow(IntPtr hwnd, IntPtr hdc, uint flags);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern IntPtr SetThreadDpiAwarenessContext(IntPtr context);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool PostMessageW(IntPtr hwnd, uint msg, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern IntPtr GetDlgItem(IntPtr hwnd, int id);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool IsWindowEnabled(IntPtr hwnd);
    [DllImport("dwmapi.dll")] public static extern int DwmGetWindowAttribute(IntPtr hwnd, int attribute, out RECT rect, int size);
    delegate bool EnumProc(IntPtr hwnd, IntPtr param);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern bool EnumWindows(EnumProc callback, IntPtr param);
    [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(IntPtr hwnd, out uint pid);
    [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)] static extern int GetClassNameW(IntPtr hwnd, StringBuilder name, int size);
    // Top-level window of a process by window class (dialogs are separate top-level windows).
    public static IntPtr Find(int pid, string windowClass) {
        IntPtr found = IntPtr.Zero;
        EnumWindows((h, p) => {
            uint id; GetWindowThreadProcessId(h, out id);
            var name = new StringBuilder(64); GetClassNameW(h, name, 64);
            if (id == (uint)pid && name.ToString() == windowClass) { found = h; return false; }
            return true;
        }, IntPtr.Zero);
        return found;
    }
}
'@

$WM_COMMAND = 0x0111
$WM_CLOSE = 0x0010

function Get-WireScopeCommands {
    # Command name -> id, from the Command enum (sequential values, "Name = number" restarts the count).
    $text = Get-Content (Join-Path $script:Root 'src\gui\MainWindowDetail.h') -Raw
    $body = [regex]::Match($text, 'enum Command : UINT \{(.*?)\};', 'Singleline').Groups[1].Value
    $body = [regex]::Replace($body, '//[^\n]*', '')
    $ids = @{}
    $next = 0
    foreach ($item in $body -split ',') {
        $item = $item.Trim()
        if (-not $item) { continue }
        if ($item -match '^(\w+)\s*=\s*(\d+)$') { $item = $Matches[1]; $next = [int]$Matches[2] }
        $ids[$item] = $next
        $next++
    }
    $ids
}

function Start-WireScope {
    # Refuses to run beside another instance: that one would own the data plane and the test would
    # see disabled controls.
    if (Get-Process WireScope -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw 'Another WireScope instance is running. Close it first.' }
    $exe = Join-Path $script:Root 'bin\WireScope.exe'
    if (-not (Test-Path $exe)) { throw "$exe not found: run build.ps1 first." }
    $process = Start-Process $exe -PassThru
    $window = [IntPtr]::Zero
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 50 -and $window -eq [IntPtr]::Zero; $i++) {
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200
        $process.Refresh()
        $window = $process.MainWindowHandle
    }
    if ($window -eq [IntPtr]::Zero) { Stop-Process -Id $process.Id -Force; throw 'The WireScope window did not appear.' }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1500  # driver, adapters, first paint
    [pscustomobject]@{ Process = $process; Window = $window; Commands = Get-WireScopeCommands }
}

function Send-WireScopeCommand($Session, [string]$Name) {
    $id = $Session.Commands[$Name]
    if ($null -eq $id) { throw "Unknown command $Name" }
    [WireScopeWin32]::PostMessageW($Session.Window, $WM_COMMAND, [IntPtr]$id, [IntPtr]::Zero) | Out-Null
}

function Test-WireScopeControl($Session, [string]$Name) {
    # True when the button of that command is enabled.
    [WireScopeWin32]::IsWindowEnabled([WireScopeWin32]::GetDlgItem($Session.Window, $Session.Commands[$Name]))
}

function Find-WireScopeDialog($Session, [int]$TimeoutMs = 6000) {
    for ($waited = 0; $waited -lt $TimeoutMs; $waited += 200) {
        $dialog = [WireScopeWin32]::Find($Session.Process.Id, 'WireScope.Dialog')
        if ($dialog -ne [IntPtr]::Zero) { return $dialog }
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200
    }
    [IntPtr]::Zero
}

function Confirm-WireScopeDialog([IntPtr]$Dialog) {
    [WireScopeWin32]::PostMessageW($Dialog, $WM_COMMAND, [IntPtr]1, [IntPtr]::Zero) | Out-Null  # IDOK
}

function Save-WindowShot([IntPtr]$Window, [string]$Path) {
    # The window draws itself into the bitmap (PrintWindow, PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT): nothing else on the
    # screen can end up in the file, and the window is not brought to the front while someone works.
    # The extended frame bounds (DWM attribute 9) cut off the invisible resize border.
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 900  # the last command repaints
    # Physical pixels for both rectangles: PowerShell is not DPI aware, and DWM always answers in pixels.
    $previous = [WireScopeWin32]::SetThreadDpiAwarenessContext([IntPtr](-4))  # PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2
    $outer = New-Object WireScopeWin32+RECT
    $frame = New-Object WireScopeWin32+RECT
    [WireScopeWin32]::GetWindowRect($Window, [ref]$outer) | Out-Null
    [WireScopeWin32]::DwmGetWindowAttribute($Window, 9, [ref]$frame, 16) | Out-Null
    if ($previous -ne [IntPtr]::Zero) { [WireScopeWin32]::SetThreadDpiAwarenessContext($previous) | Out-Null }
    $full = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap ($outer.Right - $outer.Left), ($outer.Bottom - $outer.Top)
    $graphics = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($full)
    $dc = $graphics.GetHdc()
    $printed = [WireScopeWin32]::PrintWindow($Window, $dc, 2)
    $graphics.ReleaseHdc($dc)
    $graphics.Dispose()
    try {
        if (-not $printed) { throw "PrintWindow failed for $Path" }
        $crop = [System.Drawing.Rectangle]::Intersect(
            (New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle ($frame.Left - $outer.Left), ($frame.Top - $outer.Top), ($frame.Right - $frame.Left), ($frame.Bottom - $frame.Top)),
            (New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle 0, 0, $full.Width, $full.Height))
        if ($crop.IsEmpty) { $crop = New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle 0, 0, $full.Width, $full.Height }
        $shot = $full.Clone($crop, $full.PixelFormat)
        $shot.Save($Path, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
        $shot.Dispose()
    } finally {
        $full.Dispose()
    }
    "saved $Path"
}

function Stop-WireScope($Session) {
    # WM_CLOSE: WireScope restores the adapter mode and the driver's filter table on the way out.
    [WireScopeWin32]::PostMessageW($Session.Window, $WM_CLOSE, [IntPtr]::Zero, [IntPtr]::Zero) | Out-Null
    $Session.Process.WaitForExit(8000) | Out-Null
    if (-not $Session.Process.HasExited) {
        Stop-Process -Id $Session.Process.Id -Force
        Write-Warning 'WireScope did not close and was stopped; its next start repairs the driver state.'
    }
}

function Backup-WireScopeSettings([string[]]$Names) {
    # Values (or their absence) before a test writes its own settings.
    $saved = @{}
    $values = Get-ItemProperty $script:SettingsKey -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    foreach ($name in $Names) {
        $saved[$name] = if ($values -and $values.PSObject.Properties[$name]) { $values.$name } else { $null }
    }
    $saved
}

function Restore-WireScopeSettings([hashtable]$Saved) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $script:SettingsKey)) { New-Item $script:SettingsKey -Force | Out-Null }
    foreach ($name in $Saved.Keys) {
        if ($null -eq $Saved[$name]) {
            Remove-ItemProperty $script:SettingsKey -Name $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        } else {
            $type = if ($Saved[$name] -is [int]) { 'DWord' } else { 'String' }
            Set-ItemProperty $script:SettingsKey -Name $name -Value $Saved[$name] -Type $type
        }
    }
}

function Get-WireScopeSetting([string]$Name) {
    $values = Get-ItemProperty $script:SettingsKey -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($values -and $values.PSObject.Properties[$Name]) { $values.$Name } else { $null }
}

Export-ModuleMember -Function * -Variable WM_COMMAND, WM_CLOSE

```

`tools/check-english.py`:

```py
# WireScope - Checks that what goes to GitHub is in English before it is published: code, comments,
# scripts, project files, README and file names. The maintainer works in Polish, so it looks for
# Polish letters and for common Polish words written without them.
#
# Not checked, on purpose: the translations (src/resources/language/*.lng and the Polish column of
# tools/strings.py), files the repository ignores, and this script, whose word list is Polish.
# Symbols such as arrows are fine; so are Polish letters used as an example in an English sentence
# (listed in ALLOWED).
#   python tools/check-english.py        exit 0 = clean, 1 = something to look at
import ast
import os
import re
import sys

ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), '..'))
SKIP_DIRS = {'.git', '.vs', 'bin', 'obj', 'x64', 'driver', 'rsc', 'priv', 'release'}
SKIP_FILES = {'tools/check-english.py', 'od_marka.txt', 'sonnet.txt'}
TEXT_EXT = {'.cpp', '.h', '.rc', '.manifest', '.ps1', '.psm1', '.py', '.md', '.txt', '.vcxproj', '.filters', '.slnx', '.json',
            '.sh', '.gitignore', '.gitattributes'}
LETTERS = re.compile('[ąćęłńóśźżĄĆĘŁŃÓŚŹŻ]')
WORDS = re.compile(r'(?<![A-Za-z_])(nie|jest|oraz|albo|lub|dla|przez|jako|tylko|teraz|gdy|jesli|jezeli|plik\w*|sterownik\w*|zapor\w*|'
                   r'regul[ayeo]\w*|pakiet\w*|polacz\w*|wylacz\w*|wlacz\w*|zmien\w*|uruchom\w*|blad\w*|bledu|ustaw\w*|sieci|ktor\w+|'
                   r'moze|wiecej|wszystk\w*|narzedz\w*|sprawdz\w*|przyklad\w*|uwaga|zrob\w*|tutaj|jezyk\w*|okno|przycisk\w*|strona|'
                   r'procesy|liczenie|zablokuj|ogranicz|symuluj|gniazd\w*|podpis\w*|wyzeruj)(?![A-Za-z_])', re.IGNORECASE)
ALLOWED = {
    ('src/support/Text.h', '"Ł" -> "ł"'),  # the case-folding example names the letters
    ('README.md', 'Marek Wesołowski'),     # the author's name
    ('LICENSE.md', 'Marek Wesołowski'),
    ('src/resources/app.rc', 'Marek Wesołowski'),
}
findings = 0


def report(rel, number, line, why):
    global findings
    if any(rel == f and snippet in line for f, snippet in ALLOWED):
        return
    findings += 1
    print(f'{rel}:{number}: [{why}] {line.strip()[:160]}')


def check(rel, number, text, what):
    if LETTERS.search(text):
        report(rel, number, text, f'{what}: Polish letters')
    elif match := WORDS.search(text):
        report(rel, number, text, f'{what}: "{match.group(0)}"')


def check_string_table(path, rel):
    # Comments and the English column only; the Polish column is the translation.
    source = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read()
    for number, line in enumerate(source.splitlines(), 1):
        if line.lstrip().startswith('#'):
            check(rel, number, line, 'comment')
    for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(source)):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and getattr(node.func, 'id', '') in ('T', 'G'):
            texts = [a.value for a in node.args if isinstance(a, ast.Constant) and isinstance(a.value, str)]
            english = texts[1] if node.func.id == 'T' and len(texts) > 1 else (texts[0] if texts else '')
            check(rel, node.lineno, english, 'English text')


for base, dirs, files in os.walk(ROOT):
    dirs[:] = sorted(d for d in dirs if d not in SKIP_DIRS)
    for name in sorted(dirs + files):
        rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(base, name), ROOT).replace('\\', '/')
        if rel not in SKIP_FILES:
            check(rel, 0, os.path.splitext(name)[0].replace('-', ' ').replace('_', ' '), 'file name')
    for name in sorted(files):
        path = os.path.join(base, name)
        rel = os.path.relpath(path, ROOT).replace('\\', '/')
        ext = os.path.splitext(name)[1].lower() or name.lower()
        if rel in SKIP_FILES or rel.startswith('src/resources/language/') or ext not in TEXT_EXT:
            continue
        if rel == 'tools/strings.py':
            check_string_table(path, rel)
            continue
        try:
            text = open(path, encoding='utf-8-sig').read()
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            report(rel, 0, '', 'not UTF-8')
            continue
        for number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
            check(rel, number, line, 'text')

print('clean' if findings == 0 else f'{findings} finding(s)')
sys.exit(1 if findings else 0)

```

```ps1
# WireScope - Compiles only the given translation units, with the project's settings and without
# linking: a quick check of a few changed files. Uses the toolchain that build.ps1 found and wrote
# into bin\build-receipt.json, so run build.ps1 once first.
#   .\tools\compile.ps1 src\core\Rules.cpp, src\gui\ProcessList.cpp
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string[]]$Files)
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$receiptPath = Join-Path $root 'bin\build-receipt.json'
if (-not (Test-Path $receiptPath)) { throw "${receiptPath} not found: run build.ps1 first." }
$receipt = Get-Content $receiptPath | ConvertFrom-Json
$msbuild = Join-Path $receipt.visualStudio 'MSBuild\Current\Bin\amd64\MSBuild.exe'
$output = & $msbuild (Join-Path $root 'WireScope.vcxproj') /t:ClCompile "/p:SelectedFiles=$($Files -join '%3B')" /p:Configuration=Release /p:Platform=x64 `
    "/p:VCToolsVersion=$($receipt.msvc)" "/p:WindowsTargetPlatformVersion=$($receipt.sdk)" /nologo /v:minimal /m 2>&1
$code = $LASTEXITCODE
$output | Where-Object { $_ -match 'error|warning' } | ForEach-Object { $_ -replace ' \[[^\]]*\.vcxproj\]$', '' } | Select-Object -Unique -First 60
"exit: $code"
exit $code
```

`tools/record_demo.py`:

```py
"""
WireScope - Automated video demonstration recorder (approx 30s)
Pure GUI showcase centered within standard 1920x1080 OBS canvas.
Zero cutoffs: window sits with comfortable margins on pure white studio backdrop.
"""

import os
import sys
import time
import glob
import ctypes
import subprocess
import threading
from ctypes import wintypes
import cv2

# DPI awareness (Per-Monitor V2)
user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
kernel32 = ctypes.windll.kernel32
user32.SetThreadDpiAwarenessContext(ctypes.c_void_p(-4))

# Attach thread to interactive desktop
hdesk = user32.OpenDesktopW('Default', 0, False, 0x10000000)
if not hdesk:
    print('Failed to open Default desktop, error:', kernel32.GetLastError())
    sys.exit(1)
user32.SetThreadDesktop(hdesk)

# Constants
HWND_TOPMOST = ctypes.c_void_p(-1)
SWP_SHOWWINDOW = 0x0040
WM_COMMAND = 0x0111
WM_CLOSE = 0x0010

# Structures for Win32 API
class STARTUPINFO(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ('cb', wintypes.DWORD), ('lpReserved', wintypes.LPWSTR), ('lpDesktop', wintypes.LPWSTR),
        ('lpTitle', wintypes.LPWSTR), ('dwX', wintypes.DWORD), ('dwY', wintypes.DWORD),
        ('dwXSize', wintypes.DWORD), ('dwYSize', wintypes.DWORD), ('dwXCountChars', wintypes.DWORD),
        ('dwYCountChars', wintypes.DWORD), ('dwFillAttribute', wintypes.DWORD), ('dwFlags', wintypes.DWORD),
        ('wShowWindow', wintypes.WORD), ('cbReserved2', wintypes.WORD), ('lpReserved2', ctypes.c_void_p),
        ('hStdInput', wintypes.HANDLE), ('hStdOutput', wintypes.HANDLE), ('hStdError', wintypes.HANDLE),
    ]

class PROCESS_INFORMATION(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ('hProcess', wintypes.HANDLE), ('hThread', wintypes.HANDLE),
        ('dwProcessId', wintypes.DWORD), ('dwThreadId', wintypes.DWORD),
    ]

class RECT(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('left', ctypes.c_long), ('top', ctypes.c_long), ('right', ctypes.c_long), ('bottom', ctypes.c_long)]

# Mouse control helpers
def move_mouse_smooth(x_target, y_target, duration=0.35, steps=25):
    pt = wintypes.POINT()
    user32.GetCursorPos(ctypes.byref(pt))
    x0, y0 = pt.x, pt.y
    for i in range(1, steps + 1):
        t = i / float(steps)
        ease = t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t) # smoothstep
        x = int(x0 + (x_target - x0) * ease)
        y = int(y0 + (y_target - y0) * ease)
        user32.SetCursorPos(x, y)
        time.sleep(duration / float(steps))

def click_control(hwnd, ctrl_id, duration=0.3):
    hctrl = user32.GetDlgItem(hwnd, ctrl_id)
    if not hctrl:
        return
    r = RECT()
    user32.GetWindowRect(hctrl, ctypes.byref(r))
    cx, cy = (r.left + r.right) // 2, (r.top + r.bottom) // 2
    move_mouse_smooth(cx, cy, duration=duration)
    time.sleep(0.08)
    user32.mouse_event(0x0002, 0, 0, 0, 0) # LEFTDOWN
    user32.PostMessageW(hwnd, WM_COMMAND, ctrl_id, 0)
    time.sleep(0.08)
    user32.mouse_event(0x0004, 0, 0, 0, 0) # LEFTUP
    time.sleep(0.15)

def click_coords(x, y, duration=0.3):
    move_mouse_smooth(x, y, duration=duration)
    time.sleep(0.08)
    user32.mouse_event(0x0002, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    time.sleep(0.08)
    user32.mouse_event(0x0004, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    time.sleep(0.15)

def drag_slider_track(hwnd, slider_id, frac_start=0.08, frac_end=0.40, duration=0.45):
    hslider = user32.GetDlgItem(hwnd, slider_id)
    if not hslider:
        return
    r = RECT()
    user32.GetWindowRect(hslider, ctypes.byref(r))
    y_mid = (r.top + r.bottom) // 2
    w = r.right - r.left
    x1 = int(r.left + w * frac_start)
    x2 = int(r.left + w * frac_end)

    move_mouse_smooth(x1, y_mid, duration=0.25)
    time.sleep(0.08)
    user32.mouse_event(0x0002, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    time.sleep(0.08)
    for i in range(1, 26):
        x = int(x1 + (x2 - x1) * (i / 25.0))
        user32.SetCursorPos(x, y_mid)
        time.sleep(duration / 25.0)
    time.sleep(0.08)
    user32.mouse_event(0x0004, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    time.sleep(0.18)

def main():
    vid_dir = r'C:\Users\Administrator\Videos'
    os.makedirs(vid_dir, exist_ok=True)
    before_files = set(os.listdir(vid_dir))

    # 1. Bring Chrome about:blank to the foreground as backdrop
    print('Locating Chrome about:blank window...')
    chrome_hwnd = None
    def enum_chrome(hwnd, lparam):
        nonlocal chrome_hwnd
        if user32.IsWindowVisible(hwnd):
            buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(256)
            user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, buf, 256)
            if 'about:blank' in buf.value or 'Google Chrome' in buf.value:
                chrome_hwnd = hwnd
                return False
        return True

    WNDENUMPROC = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, wintypes.HWND, wintypes.LPARAM)
    user32.EnumWindows(WNDENUMPROC(enum_chrome), 0)

    if chrome_hwnd:
        print(f'Bringing Chrome (HWND {chrome_hwnd}) to front as maximized backdrop...')
        user32.ShowWindow(chrome_hwnd, 3) # SW_MAXIMIZE
        user32.SetForegroundWindow(chrome_hwnd)
        user32.SetWindowPos(chrome_hwnd, 0, 0, 0, 1920, 1200, SWP_SHOWWINDOW)
        time.sleep(0.5)

    obs_exe = r'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\bin\64bit\obs64.exe'
    obs_cwd = r'C:\Program Files\obs-studio\bin\64bit'

    print('Launching OBS Studio on WinSta0\\Default...')
    si_obs = STARTUPINFO()
    si_obs.cb = ctypes.sizeof(STARTUPINFO)
    si_obs.lpDesktop = 'WinSta0\\Default'
    pi_obs = PROCESS_INFORMATION()

    cmd_obs = f'"{obs_exe}" --startrecording --minimize-to-tray'
    res = kernel32.CreateProcessW(None, cmd_obs, None, None, False, 0, None, obs_cwd, ctypes.byref(si_obs), ctypes.byref(pi_obs))
    if not res:
        print('Failed to launch OBS, error:', kernel32.GetLastError())
        sys.exit(1)

    obs_pid = pi_obs.dwProcessId
    print(f'OBS PID: {obs_pid}')

    # Wait for OBS recording engine
    print('Waiting for OBS recording engine to start...')
    logs_dir = os.path.expanduser(r'~\AppData\Roaming\obs-studio\logs')
    recording_active = False
    start_wait = time.time()
    while time.time() - start_wait < 25:
        logs = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(logs_dir, '*.txt')), key=os.path.getmtime)
        if logs:
            try:
                with open(logs[-1], encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
                    if '==== Recording Start ====' in f.read():
                        recording_active = True
                        break
            except Exception:
                pass
        time.sleep(0.5)

    if not recording_active:
        print('Warning: OBS Recording Start marker not detected, proceeding anyway...')
    else:
        print('OBS recording confirmed active!')

    # Launch WireScope GUI
    print('Launching WireScope GUI...')
    wirescope_exe = r'C:\Projekty\WireScope\bin\WireScope.exe'
    wirescope_dir = r'C:\Projekty\WireScope\bin'

    si_ws = STARTUPINFO()
    si_ws.cb = ctypes.sizeof(STARTUPINFO)
    si_ws.lpDesktop = 'WinSta0\\Default'
    pi_ws = PROCESS_INFORMATION()

    res_ws = kernel32.CreateProcessW(None, wirescope_exe, None, None, False, 0, None, wirescope_dir, ctypes.byref(si_ws), ctypes.byref(pi_ws))
    if not res_ws:
        print('Failed to launch WireScope GUI!')
        sys.exit(1)

    time.sleep(2.0)

    target_hwnd = None
    for _ in range(25):
        def enum_cb(hwnd, lparam):
            nonlocal target_hwnd
            pid = wintypes.DWORD()
            user32.GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, ctypes.byref(pid))
            if pid.value == pi_ws.dwProcessId:
                buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(256)
                user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, buf, 256)
                if 'WireScope' in buf.value:
                    target_hwnd = hwnd
                    return False
            return True

        user32.EnumWindows(WNDENUMPROC(enum_cb), 0)
        if target_hwnd:
            break
        time.sleep(0.2)

    if not target_hwnd:
        print('Could not find WireScope window!')
        sys.exit(1)

    # Frame WireScope safely inside the 1920x1080 canvas:
    # x=220, y=50, w=1480, h=960 -> top margin 50px, bottom margin 70px (before 1080), left/right 220px!
    # Zero cutoff, 100% visible, centered over pure white backdrop!
    print(f'Setting WireScope (HWND {target_hwnd}) to (220, 50, 1480, 960) HWND_TOPMOST...')
    user32.SetWindowPos(target_hwnd, HWND_TOPMOST, 220, 50, 1480, 960, SWP_SHOWWINDOW)
    user32.SetForegroundWindow(target_hwnd)
    time.sleep(1.0)

    t_action_start = time.time()

    win_rect = RECT()
    user32.GetWindowRect(target_hwnd, ctypes.byref(win_rect))

    # Command IDs
    CMD_PAGE_CAPTURE = 1001
    CMD_PAGE_PROCESSES = 1002
    CMD_PAGE_FIREWALL = 1003
    CMD_PAGE_SIMULATOR = 1004
    CMD_ABOUT = 1007
    CMD_START = 1012
    CMD_STOP = 1013
    CMD_SIM_TOGGLE = 1025

    # 1. LIVE CAPTURE DEMONSTRATION
    print('--- Step 1: Live Capture ---')
    click_control(target_hwnd, CMD_START)
    print('Clicked Start capture')

    def send_pings():
        subprocess.run(['ping', '-n', '5', '1.1.1.1'], capture_output=True)

    thr = threading.Thread(target=send_pings, daemon=True)
    thr.start()

    # Move mouse around capture area while packets arrive
    time.sleep(1.0)
    move_mouse_smooth(win_rect.left + 500, win_rect.top + 320, duration=0.6)
    time.sleep(2.0)

    # Click on a packet row to show protocol tree & hex dump
    click_coords(win_rect.left + 500, win_rect.top + 260)
    print('Selected packet row (details & hex rendered)')
    time.sleep(1.8)

    # Click Stop capture
    click_control(target_hwnd, CMD_STOP)
    print('Clicked Stop capture')
    time.sleep(1.0)

    # 2. PROCESS MONITOR TAB DEMONSTRATION
    print('--- Step 2: Processes Tab ---')
    click_control(target_hwnd, CMD_PAGE_PROCESSES)
    print('Switched to Processes page')
    time.sleep(1.5)

    # Hover and click a process row
    move_mouse_smooth(win_rect.left + 450, win_rect.top + 260, duration=0.5)
    click_coords(win_rect.left + 450, win_rect.top + 260)
    time.sleep(1.8)

    # 3. FIREWALL TAB DEMONSTRATION
    print('--- Step 3: Firewall Rules ---')
    click_control(target_hwnd, CMD_PAGE_FIREWALL)
    print('Switched to Firewall page')
    time.sleep(1.5)

    # Hover and click a rule row
    click_coords(win_rect.left + 450, win_rect.top + 240, duration=0.5)
    time.sleep(1.8)

    # 4. SIMULATOR TAB DEMONSTRATION
    print('--- Step 4: Network Impairment Simulator ---')
    click_control(target_hwnd, CMD_PAGE_SIMULATOR)
    print('Switched to Simulator page')
    time.sleep(1.5)

    # Drag Latency slider (id 2004) to ~80 ms
    drag_slider_track(target_hwnd, 2004, frac_start=0.06, frac_end=0.35, duration=0.5)
    print('Adjusted Latency slider to ~80 ms')

    # Drag Loss slider (id 2006) to ~5%
    drag_slider_track(target_hwnd, 2006, frac_start=0.06, frac_end=0.22, duration=0.4)
    print('Adjusted Loss slider to ~5%')

    time.sleep(0.6)
    # Enable simulation via CmdSimToggle (id 1025)
    click_control(target_hwnd, CMD_SIM_TOGGLE)
    print('Enabled impairment simulation')
    time.sleep(2.0)
    click_control(target_hwnd, CMD_SIM_TOGGLE)
    print('Disabled impairment simulation')
    time.sleep(1.0)

    # 5. ABOUT DIALOG DEMONSTRATION
    print('--- Step 5: About Dialog ---')
    click_control(target_hwnd, CMD_ABOUT)
    print('Opened About dialog')

    # Ensure About dialog is TOPMOST and visible
    time.sleep(0.5)
    dialog_hwnd = [0]
    def enum_dlg(hwnd, lparam):
        cname = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(64)
        user32.GetClassNameW(hwnd, cname, 64)
        if cname.value == 'WireScope.Dialog':
            dialog_hwnd[0] = hwnd
            return False
        return True
    user32.EnumWindows(WNDENUMPROC(enum_dlg), 0)

    if dialog_hwnd[0]:
        user32.SetWindowPos(dialog_hwnd[0], HWND_TOPMOST, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0x0001 | 0x0002 | SWP_SHOWWINDOW)

    time.sleep(3.0) # Viewer reads author, version, and GitHub repo

    # Dismiss About dialog
    if dialog_hwnd[0]:
        user32.PostMessageW(dialog_hwnd[0], WM_COMMAND, 1, 0) # IDOK
        print('Closed About dialog via IDOK')
    else:
        user32.keybd_event(0x0D, 0, 0, 0)
        time.sleep(0.05)
        user32.keybd_event(0x0D, 0, 2, 0)

    time.sleep(1.0)

    # Close WireScope GUI
    print('Closing WireScope GUI...')
    user32.PostMessageW(target_hwnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0)
    kernel32.WaitForSingleObject(pi_ws.hProcess, 4000)
    kernel32.CloseHandle(pi_ws.hThread)
    kernel32.CloseHandle(pi_ws.hProcess)
    time.sleep(1.0)

    t_action_end = time.time()
    total_demo_sec = t_action_end - t_action_start
    print(f'Total interactive sequence took {total_demo_sec:.1f} seconds.')

    # Stop OBS cleanly
    print('Stopping OBS Studio recording...')
    def enum_obs(hwnd, lparam):
        pid = wintypes.DWORD()
        user32.GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, ctypes.byref(pid))
        if pid.value == obs_pid:
            user32.PostMessageW(hwnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0)
        return True

    user32.EnumWindows(WNDENUMPROC(enum_obs), 0)

    try:
        kernel32.WaitForSingleObject(pi_obs.hProcess, 8000)
    finally:
        kernel32.CloseHandle(pi_obs.hThread)
        kernel32.CloseHandle(pi_obs.hProcess)

    time.sleep(2.5)

    after_files = set(os.listdir(vid_dir))
    new_vids = [f for f in after_files - before_files if f.endswith('.mp4')]
    if not new_vids:
        all_vids = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(vid_dir, '*.mp4')), key=os.path.getmtime)
        if all_vids:
            raw_video = all_vids[-1]
        else:
            print('No recorded video found in', vid_dir)
            sys.exit(1)
    else:
        raw_video = os.path.join(vid_dir, new_vids[0])

    print(f'Raw OBS video recorded: {raw_video}')

    final_output = os.path.join(vid_dir, 'WireScope_demo_30s.mp4')

    cap = cv2.VideoCapture(raw_video)
    total_frames = int(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_COUNT))
    fps = cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS) or 60.0
    cap.release()

    raw_duration = total_frames / fps
    print(f'Raw video duration: {raw_duration:.2f}s ({total_frames} frames @ {fps} fps)')

    ffmpeg_exe = 'ffmpeg'
    ss_start = max(0.0, raw_duration - total_demo_sec - 0.5)
    t_length = min(34.0, total_demo_sec + 1.0)

    print(f'Trimming with FFmpeg: start={ss_start:.2f}s, length={t_length:.2f}s, no audio...')
    ffmpeg_cmd = [
        ffmpeg_exe, '-y',
        '-ss', f'{ss_start:.2f}',
        '-i', raw_video,
        '-t', f'{t_length:.2f}',
        '-c:v', 'copy',
        '-an',
        final_output
    ]

    ff_res = subprocess.run(ffmpeg_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if ff_res.returncode != 0:
        print('FFmpeg error, falling back to full strip without trim:', ff_res.stderr)
        subprocess.run([ffmpeg_exe, '-y', '-i', raw_video, '-c:v', 'copy', '-an', final_output], capture_output=True)

    if os.path.exists(final_output):
        fcap = cv2.VideoCapture(final_output)
        fcnt = int(fcap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_COUNT))
        ffps = fcap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS)
        fw = fcap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_WIDTH)
        fh = fcap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_HEIGHT)
        fdur = fcnt / ffps if ffps > 0 else 0
        fcap.release()
        print(f'SUCCESS! Final video created: {final_output}')
        print(f'Specs: {fw:.0f}x{fh:.0f}, {ffps:.1f} fps, {fdur:.2f}s ({fcnt} frames), size: {os.path.getsize(final_output):,} bytes')
    else:
        print('Failed to produce final output video!')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

```

`tools/screenshots.ps1`:

```ps1
# WireScope - Screenshots of every GUI page, for reviewing a change or the README.
# Changes no traffic: -Count turns on per-program counting, which reads copies of packets (listen mode).
# The window draws itself into the files, so other windows on the screen never end up in them.
#   .\tools\screenshots.ps1                      pages as they start, into %TEMP%\WireScope-screenshots
#   .\tools\screenshots.ps1 -Count -Out shots    with traffic counted on the Processes page
#Requires -Version 7
param(
    [string]$Out = (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'WireScope-screenshots'),
    [switch]$Count
)
Import-Module (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'WireScopeUi.psm1') -Force
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Out | Out-Null

# The GUI saves the page and the counting switch; both are put back however the script ends.
$saved = Backup-WireScopeSettings @('ProcessMonitor', 'Page')
$session = Start-WireScope
try {
    if ($Count -and $saved['ProcessMonitor'] -ne 1) {
        Send-WireScopeCommand $session 'CmdPageProcesses'
        Send-WireScopeCommand $session 'CmdProcMonitor'
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 4  # a few samples for the rates
    }
    $pages = [ordered]@{ capture = 'CmdPageCapture'; processes = 'CmdPageProcesses'; firewall = 'CmdPageFirewall'; simulator = 'CmdPageSimulator' }
    $number = 1
    foreach ($page in $pages.Keys) {
        Send-WireScopeCommand $session $pages[$page]
        Save-WindowShot $session.Window (Join-Path $Out ('{0}-{1}.png' -f $number++, $page))
    }
} finally {
    Stop-WireScope $session
    Restore-WireScopeSettings $saved
}

```

```py
T('IDS_DLG_DRV_START', 'Start the network driver?', 'Uruchomić sterownik sieci?')

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rc_escape(s):
    # Resource compiler string: "" for a quote; \n stays an escape; a literal backslash is \\.
    return s.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('"', '""').replace('\n', '\\n')

def lng_escape(s):
    return s.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('\n', '\\n').replace('\r', '\\r').replace('\t', '\\t')

rows = [r for r in S if r[0] != '#']
width = max(len(r[0]) for r in rows) + 2
num = 10000
ids = {}
header = ['// WireScope - String and icon identifiers, shared by the .rc files and the C++ code.',
          '// The numbers are the keys of language\\<code>.lng files: never renumber an existing string,',
          '// add new strings after the last one (ids are assigned in this order).',
          '#ifndef WIRESCOPE_RESOURCE_H', '#define WIRESCOPE_RESOURCE_H', '', '#define IDI_APP 101', '#define IDR_DRIVER_IMAGE 102', '']
en = ['// WireScope - English strings, the reference for every translation (language\\<code>.lng).',
      '#pragma code_page(65001)  // UTF-8', 'LANGUAGE LANG_ENGLISH, SUBLANG_ENGLISH_US', '', 'STRINGTABLE', 'BEGIN']
pl = ['# WireScope - Polish language file (Polski).',
      '# Format: ID=text, UTF-8, escapes \\n \\r \\t \\\\ ; keep every {...} placeholder.',
      '# English, the reference, is built into WireScope.exe ("WireScope.exe --lng-export en.lng").',
      '#name=Polski', '#locale=pl']
group_base = 10000
for r in S:
    if r[0] == '#':
        header.append(f'// {r[1]}')
        en.append(f'    // {r[1]}')
        pl.append('')
        pl.append(f'# {r[1]}')
        continue
    name, e, p = r
    ids[name] = num
    header.append(f'#define {name:<{width}}{num}')
    en.append(f'    {name:<{width}}"{rc_escape(e)}"')
    pl.append(f'{num}={lng_escape(p)}')
    num += 1
header += ['', '#endif']
en += ['END', '']
open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'resource.h'), 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\r\n').write('\n'.join(header) + '\n')
os.makedirs(os.path.join(ROOT, 'lang'), exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(ROOT, 'language'), exist_ok=True)
open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'lang', 'en.rc'), 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\r\n').write('\n'.join(en))
open(os.path.join(ROOT, 'language', 'pl.lng'), 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\r\n').write('\n'.join(pl) + '\n')
print(len(rows), 'strings, last id', num - 1)
```

`tools/sync-project.py`:

```py
# WireScope - Rewrites the item groups of WireScope.vcxproj and WireScope.vcxproj.filters from the
# files under src\, so a source file added or removed is never forgotten in the project.
# Everything outside the item groups (settings, toolset, imports) is left as it is.
#   python tools/sync-project.py
import glob
import os

ROOT = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), '..'))
ORDER = ['app', 'core', 'gui', 'support', 'resources']
RC = 'src\\resources\\app.rc'
MANIFEST = 'src\\resources\\app.manifest'
EN = 'src\\resources\\lang\\en.rc'
BMP = 'src\\resources\\WireScope.bmp'


def files(pattern):
    found = [os.path.relpath(p, ROOT) for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(ROOT, 'src', '*', pattern))]
    return sorted(found, key=lambda p: (ORDER.index(p.split(os.sep)[1]), p.lower()))


def rewrite(name, start_marker, end_marker, groups):
    path = os.path.join(ROOT, name)
    text = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read().replace('\r\n', '\n')
    start = text.index(start_marker)
    end = text.index(end_marker) if end_marker else len(text)
    text = text[:start] + '\n'.join(groups) + '\n' + (text[end:] if end_marker else '')
    open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\r\n').write(text)
    data = open(path, 'rb').read()
    assert not any(c < 9 or c in (11, 12) or 13 < c < 32 for c in data), f'{name}: control characters'


cpp, hdr = files('*.cpp'), files('*.h')
lng = sorted(os.path.relpath(p, ROOT) for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(ROOT, 'src', 'resources', 'language', '*.lng')))
folder = lambda q: q.split(os.sep)[1]

project = (['  <ItemGroup>'] + [f'    <ClCompile Include="{p}" />' for p in cpp] + ['  </ItemGroup>', '  <ItemGroup>'] +
           [f'    <ClInclude Include="{p}" />' for p in hdr] +
           ['  </ItemGroup>', '  <ItemGroup>', f'    <ResourceCompile Include="{RC}" />', '  </ItemGroup>', '  <ItemGroup>',
            f'    <None Include="{MANIFEST}" />', f'    <None Include="{EN}" />', f'    <Image Include="{BMP}" />', '  </ItemGroup>', '  <ItemGroup>',
            '    <!-- Language files are not compiled in: they are copied next to the executable (bin\\language). -->'] +
           [f'    <CopyFileToFolders Include="{p}"><DestinationFolders>$(OutDir)language</DestinationFolders></CopyFileToFolders>' for p in lng] +
           ['  </ItemGroup>'])
rewrite('WireScope.vcxproj', '  <ItemGroup>\n    <ClCompile', '  <Import Project="$(VCTargetsPath)\\Microsoft.Cpp.targets" />', project)

filters = (['  <ItemGroup>'] + [f'    <ClCompile Include="{q}"><Filter>{folder(q)}</Filter></ClCompile>' for q in cpp] +
           ['  </ItemGroup>', '  <ItemGroup>'] + [f'    <ClInclude Include="{q}"><Filter>{folder(q)}</Filter></ClInclude>' for q in hdr] +
           ['  </ItemGroup>', '  <ItemGroup>', f'    <ResourceCompile Include="{RC}"><Filter>resources</Filter></ResourceCompile>',
            '  </ItemGroup>', '  <ItemGroup>', f'    <None Include="{MANIFEST}"><Filter>resources</Filter></None>',
            f'    <None Include="{EN}"><Filter>resources</Filter></None>', f'    <Image Include="{BMP}"><Filter>resources</Filter></Image>', '  </ItemGroup>', '  <ItemGroup>'] +
           [f'    <CopyFileToFolders Include="{q}"><Filter>resources</Filter></CopyFileToFolders>' for q in lng] +
           ['  </ItemGroup>', '</Project>'])
rewrite('WireScope.vcxproj.filters', '  <ItemGroup>\n    <ClCompile', None, filters)
print(len(cpp), 'sources,', len(hdr), 'headers,', len(lng), 'language files')

```

`tools/test-auto-undo.ps1`:

```ps1
# WireScope - Live test of the automatic undo of risky firewall changes.
#
# CHANGES LIVE TRAFFIC for about 20 seconds: the firewall is turned on with one rule that blocks only
# inbound Remote Desktop (TCP 3389). WireScope warns, applies it, and must undo it by itself after
# kRevertSeconds. The script then checks that the driver's filter table is empty again. Outbound
# traffic, DNS and web browsing are not affected. Your saved rules are put back afterwards.
#   .\tools\test-auto-undo.ps1 [-Out <folder for screenshots>]
#Requires -Version 7
param([string]$Out = (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'WireScope-screenshots'))
Import-Module (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'WireScopeUi.psm1') -Force
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Out | Out-Null
$exe = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'bin\WireScope.exe'

function Show-FilterTable {
    $p = Start-Process $exe -ArgumentList '--firewall-show' -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput "$env:TEMP\wirescope-table.txt"
    Get-Content "$env:TEMP\wirescope-table.txt" | Select-Object -First 1
    Remove-Item "$env:TEMP\wirescope-table.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

$saved = Backup-WireScopeSettings @('FirewallRules', 'FirewallPolicy', 'KernelOffload', 'Page')
Set-ItemProperty HKCU:\Software\WireScope -Name FirewallRules -Value "block in tcp dport 3389`n"
Set-ItemProperty HKCU:\Software\WireScope -Name FirewallPolicy -Value 0 -Type DWord
$session = Start-WireScope
try {
    Send-WireScopeCommand $session 'CmdPageFirewall'
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 600
    Save-WindowShot $session.Window (Join-Path $Out 'undo-1-before.png')
    Send-WireScopeCommand $session 'CmdFwToggle'
    $dialog = Find-WireScopeDialog $session
    if ($dialog -eq [IntPtr]::Zero) { throw 'No lockout warning appeared for a rule that blocks Remote Desktop.' }
    Save-WindowShot $dialog (Join-Path $Out 'undo-2-warning.png')
    Confirm-WireScopeDialog $dialog  # apply, with the automatic undo armed
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1500
    Save-WindowShot $session.Window (Join-Path $Out 'undo-3-countdown.png')
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 22
    Save-WindowShot $session.Window (Join-Path $Out 'undo-4-reverted.png')
    "firewall switch enabled again: $(Test-WireScopeControl $session 'CmdFwToggle')"
} finally {
    Stop-WireScope $session
    Restore-WireScopeSettings $saved
    Show-FilterTable  # expected: no entries
}

```

`tools/test-simulator.ps1`:

```ps1
# WireScope - Live test of the impairment simulator from the GUI.
#
# CHANGES LIVE TRAFFIC for about 25 seconds, and only ICMP to one host: the simulator adds 100 ms
# (+/- 10 ms) and drops 10 % of the pings to 1.1.1.1 (or -Target) while the capture runs. Everything
# else passes untouched. Expected: round trips about 100 ms above normal and a few lost pings.
# Your saved simulator settings are put back afterwards.
#   .\tools\test-simulator.ps1 [-Target 1.1.1.1] [-Out <folder for screenshots>]
#Requires -Version 7
param(
    [string]$Target = '1.1.1.1',
    [string]$Out = (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'WireScope-screenshots')
)
Import-Module (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'WireScopeUi.psm1') -Force
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $Out | Out-Null

$baseline = (Test-Connection $Target -Count 4 | Where-Object Status -eq 'Success' | Measure-Object Latency -Average).Average
$saved = Backup-WireScopeSettings @('SimLatency', 'SimJitter', 'SimLoss', 'SimDirection', 'SimRate', 'SimOrder', 'SimMatch', 'Page')
$key = 'HKCU:\Software\WireScope'
Set-ItemProperty $key -Name SimLatency -Value 100 -Type DWord
Set-ItemProperty $key -Name SimJitter -Value 10 -Type DWord
Set-ItemProperty $key -Name SimLoss -Value 100 -Type DWord   # tenths of a percent: 10 %
Set-ItemProperty $key -Name SimDirection -Value 3 -Type DWord
Set-ItemProperty $key -Name SimRate -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-ItemProperty $key -Name SimMatch -Value "icmp remote $Target"
$session = Start-WireScope
try {
    Send-WireScopeCommand $session 'CmdStart'      # capture
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
    Send-WireScopeCommand $session 'CmdSimToggle'  # simulator on
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
    $pings = Test-Connection $Target -Count 20 -TimeoutSeconds 2
    Send-WireScopeCommand $session 'CmdPageSimulator'
    Save-WindowShot $session.Window (Join-Path $Out 'simulator-live.png')
    Send-WireScopeCommand $session 'CmdPageCapture'
    Save-WindowShot $session.Window (Join-Path $Out 'simulator-capture.png')
} finally {
    Stop-WireScope $session
    Restore-WireScopeSettings $saved
}
$ok = @($pings | Where-Object Status -eq 'Success')
'baseline {0:N0} ms, impaired {1:N0} ms average, {2} of {3} pings lost' -f $baseline, ($ok | Measure-Object Latency -Average).Average,
    ($pings.Count - $ok.Count), $pings.Count
$after = (Test-Connection $Target -Count 2 | Where-Object Status -eq 'Success' | Measure-Object Latency -Average).Average
'after closing: {0:N0} ms' -f $after

```
